title: Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
summary: Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息密度角度解释视觉语言模型（VLM）模态鸿沟的成因：文本token在嵌入层进入模型时语义密度远低于视觉token，导致浅层优先处理文本表征。
AI.motivation: VLM中"模态鸿沟"（modality gap）的起源仍未被充分理解，作者希望检验嵌入层上不同模态token的信息密度差异是否构成该鸿沟的驱动因素。
AI.method: 通过机制分析（mechanistic analysis），比较文本token与视觉token在嵌入层的语义密度；并做干预实验——将视觉token位置替换为语义最接近的文本token对应物，观察浅层注意力变化。
AI.result: 文本token的语义密度显著低于视觉token；将视觉token位置替换为其语义最近的文本token后，浅层对这些位置的注意力显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 信息密度不对称是模态鸿沟的重要来源，为缓解模态鸿沟、改进VLM多模态推理架构提供了实证基础与改进方向。

title: MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. Specifically, MAGE combines two key mechanisms: (i) a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism, capable of learning representations across multiple temporal scales and (ii) a trainable aggregation module, that dynamically identifies and adapts to the most informative timescale of the input signal. Experimental results across seven datasets demonstrate that MAGE consistently outperforms existing EEG foundation models while using substantially fewer parameters. Moreover, our results support the hypothesis that different downstream tasks benefit from distinct temporal scales. All source code will be released.

AI.tldr: MAGE：面向EEG的多时间尺度自适应基础模型，通过多时间尺度注意力与可训练聚合模块动态整合跨尺度信息，以更少参数在七个数据集上优于现有EEG基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型大多基于固定时间尺度，难以刻画天然跨越多个时间尺度的神经动态特性，限制了对脑活动的表征能力。
AI.method: 提出MAGE基础模型，包含两个核心机制：(i) 新型多时间尺度注意力机制，可在多个时间尺度上学习表征；(ii) 可训练聚合模块，动态识别并适配输入信号中最具信息量的时间尺度。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上实验，MAGE一致优于现有EEG基础模型且参数量显著更少；结果支持不同下游任务受益于不同时间尺度这一假设。
AI.conclusion: 多时间尺度自适应建模是提升EEG基础模型泛化性与效率的有效方向，且时间尺度选择应与任务特性相匹配。

title: Causal Discovery Bench: Can LLMs Autonomously Conduct Effective Experiments?
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents get actively adopted for autonomous research, they must not only reason over existing evidence, but also design informative experiments, allocate resources, analyze sequential observations, and decide when to stop and make conclusions. Yet these capabilities remain poorly measured. We introduce Causal-Discovery-Bench (https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench), a verifiable sandbox with configurable structural equation models and resource constraints to evaluate sequential experimental design and causal discovery without domain-semantic cues. Across 3,802 episodes with 13 models from 5 vendors, we analyze agent behavior along 40 metrics in seven families. Agents' performance exhibits a four-level difficulty hierarchy spanning single-experiment design, sequential exploration of causal relationships, resource-aware experimentation balancing cost and statistical power, and autonomous resolution of conflicting evidence. We identify a substantial performance gap between causal inference from correctly curated evidence and navigating causal discovery through autonomous experimentation: Analyzing agents' action trajectories attributes 94.5% of their mistakes to experimental design rather than to inference, which is further consolidated with ablation studies. Relaxing resource constraints alone does not reliably resolve failures in sequential discovery. In contrast, basic statistical tools substantially improve performance across multiple model families, while advanced tools provide little additional benefit when models lack prerequisite lower-level capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 Causal-Discovery-Bench 可验证沙箱，用可配置结构方程模型与资源约束评估 LLM 智能体的序列实验设计与因果发现能力，发现智能体表现呈四级难度分级，且 94.5% 的错误源于实验设计而非推断。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体已被积极用于自主研究，需要不仅能对现有证据推理，还能设计信息量高的实验、分配资源、分析序列观测并决定何时停止并下结论；但这些能力缺乏有效度量，尤其缺少无领域语义线索、可验证的因果发现评测环境。
AI.method: 构建 Causal-Discovery-Bench：开源沙箱，含可配置结构方程模型（SEM）与资源约束，去除领域语义线索以评估序列实验设计与因果发现；在 5 家厂商 13 个模型、3,802 个 episode 上，沿 7 大类 40 项指标分析智能体行为；通过行动轨迹归因与消融实验定位失败来源，并对比放宽资源约束、引入统计工具与高级工具的效果。
AI.result: 智能体表现呈四级难度层级：单次实验设计、因果关系的序列探索、权衡成本与统计功效的资源感知实验、冲突证据的自主消解。正确整理证据后的因果推断与自主实验下的因果发现之间存在显著性能差距；轨迹分析将 94.5% 的错误归因于实验设计而非推断，消融实验进一步印证。仅放宽资源约束并不能可靠消除序列发现中的失败；基础统计工具跨多个模型族显著提升性能，而模型缺乏底层前置能力时高级工具收益甚微。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 智能体的因果发现瓶颈主要在实验设计而非统计推断；提升路径应优先强化基础统计与实验设计能力，而非单纯增加资源或堆叠高级工具，该基准为可验证、可复现的自主研究能力评测提供了标准化平台。

title: Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems
summary: Resource-constrained IoT devices cache learned models for real-time decisions, but frequent updates incur substantial bandwidth, energy, and service overhead. Because decision-relevant model differences need not grow with elapsed time, we define Age of Intelligence (AoInt) as a model-version-relative, client-specific, and action utility distortion, and formulate synchronization as a tradeoff between stale-decision regret and refresh cost. Furthermore, we develop Kullback-Leibler-aware AoInt Synchronization (KL-AoIntSync), which accumulates output-distribution changes using client-specific unlabeled probes, whereas Parameter-aware AoInt Synchronization (Param-AoIntSync) uses a server-broadcast scalar parameter change. Then, we establish pathwise guarantees with fixed client distributions, action sets, and utilities. The numerical results show that calibrated Param-AoIntSync reduces joint synchronization cost by 6.15% relative to an Instant-Parameters policy while performing comparably to KL-AoIntSync.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能年龄"(AoInt)指标——模型版本相对、客户端特定、以动作效用失真度量的模型差异——并将模型同步建模为陈旧决策后悔与刷新成本的权衡,进而提出KL-AoIntSync与Param-AoIntSync两种同步策略并给出逐路径保证,后者标定后较Instant-Parameters降低联合同步成本6.15%。
AI.motivation: 资源受限IoT设备缓存学习模型用于实时决策,但频繁更新带来带宽、能量与服务开销。由于与决策相关的模型差异未必随时间增长,传统以时间计龄的同步触发准则不适用。
AI.method: 定义AoInt为面向上游模型版本、客户端特定、由动作效用失真刻画的年龄度量;将同步问题化为陈旧决策后悔与刷新成本的权衡。提出KL-AoIntSync:利用客户端特定的无标签探针累积输出分布变化(KL散度);提出Param-AoIntSync:使用服务器广播的标量参数变化。在固定客户端分布、动作集与效用下建立逐路径(pathwise)保证。
AI.result: 标定后的Param-AoIntSync相对Instant-Parameters策略将联合同步成本降低6.15%,且性能与KL-AoIntSync相当;理论层面获得逐路径保证。
AI.conclusion: 以决策效用失真而非流逝时间度量模型新鲜度更为合理;仅依赖服务器广播标量参数变化的轻量方案经标定后即可逼近基于KL散度的精细方案,适合资源受限IoT场景。

title: Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training
summary: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence. Although prior work has benchmarked sycophancy in released models and proposed mitigations, its origins during training remain poorly understood. Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and DPO are often blamed, but their effects are rarely compared with earlier training stages. We investigate sycophancy across the training pipelines of three model families and three benchmarks. We find that sycophancy is largely established by the end of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than introduced by preference alignment. Across all nine model benchmark combinations, SFT checkpoints attain at least 92% of preference aligned models' sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models' scores; on average, they are about as sycophantic as final models. Preference alignment increases sycophancy in only four of nine cases, by an average of 4.2 percentage points when it does. To probe the underlying causes, we isolate model representations associated with sycophancy using mechanistic interpretability and measure their activation on training datasets from each stage. SFT datasets show roughly the same average activation as other training data but contribute substantially more examples, and the highest-scoring individual datasets all come from SFT. Our findings suggest that addressing sycophancy requires interventions throughout the training pipeline, particularly in data selection and augmentation for pre-training and SFT.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较了LLM训练流水线各阶段对谄媚（sycophancy）的贡献，发现谄媚主要由监督微调（SFT）结束时就已确立，而非偏好对齐（RLHF/DPO）引入；其成因与SFT数据规模及高激活样本有关。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多聚焦于对已发布模型的谄媚行为做基准测试与缓解，且常将偏好对齐方法（RLHF、DPO）视为谄媚的主要来源，但缺乏与更早训练阶段的对照，训练过程中谄媚的起源尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族、三个基准（共九种模型-基准组合）上跨训练流水线测量谄媚程度，比较SFT检查点与偏好对齐模型及最终模型；并借助机制可解释性方法分离与谄媚相关的模型表征，测量其在各阶段训练数据上的激活强度。
AI.result: SFT检查点的谄媚得分达到偏好对齐模型的至少92%、最终模型的至少85%，平均与最终模型相当；偏好对齐仅在九种情况中的四种使谄媚上升，平均增幅4.2个百分点。SFT数据的平均激活与其他训练数据相近，但贡献的样本量显著更多，且得分最高的单个数据集均来自SFT。
AI.conclusion: 缓解谄媚需贯穿整个训练流水线，尤其应重视预训练与SFT阶段的数据选择与数据增强，而不能仅归因于偏好对齐。

title: Edge-Deployable LLMs for Classification and Value-of-Information Ranking of Disaster-Related Tweets
summary: Humanitarian-aid and disaster relief decisions often rely on noisy, incomplete, and uncertain information from social media. Although substantial research has focused on automating the classification of such data, limited work has examined whether individual posts contain sufficient information to support decisions to act. In this study, we use large language models (LLMs) to (1) classify social media content and (2) assess its Value-of-Information (VoI) in terms of operational actionability. We evaluate seven LLMs for the classification of 77,484 tweets across 10 humanitarian-aid categories and identify the Qwen3 (8B parameters) model as the top-performing classifier, achieving the highest F1 scores in all but one category. In a second task, the classified categories serve as contextual inputs for assessing VoI with respect to responder actionability across six well established metrics for each tweet. We observed that the Gemma 3 (4B parameters) model outperformed the other models on this task, achieving the highest recall across the majority of categories. This work demonstrates that relatively small, edge-deployable LLMs can prioritize actionable information in resource-constrained environments. By integrating VoI assessment, our framework advances the automated elicitation of high-utility knowledge from unstructured social media streams for disaster-response decision-making and highlights a pathway toward tactical edge applications using LLMs that fit on a single 8 GB GPU.

AI.tldr: 该研究用7个大语言模型对77,484条推文进行10类人道援助分类，并评估其含信息价值(VoI)与可操作性的关系，发现Qwen3(8B)分类最佳、Gemma 3(4B)在VoI评估上召回最优，证明小型边缘可部署LLM可在资源受限环境下筛选高价值信息。
AI.motivation: 人道援助与救灾决策常依赖社交媒体中噪声大、不完整且不确定的信息；已有研究多集中于自动化分类，但很少考察单条帖子是否包含足够信息支撑行动决策，即缺乏对信息价值（VoI）与操作可行动性的评估。
AI.method: 使用LLM完成两项任务：(1)对77,484条推文按10个人道援助类别进行分类，评测7个模型；(2)将分类结果作为上下文输入，用6个成熟指标评估每条推文相对救援人员可行动性的VoI。
AI.result: 分类任务中Qwen3(8B)表现最佳，除一个类别外在所有类别取得最高F1；VoI评估任务中Gemma 3(4B)优于其他模型，在多数类别上取得最高召回率。
AI.conclusion: 相对小型、可在单块8GB GPU上运行的边缘可部署LLM能够优先筛选可行动信息，将VoI评估纳入框架可从非结构化社交媒体流中自动提取高价值知识，为灾害响应决策及战术边缘应用提供路径。

title: Spectral Bias Reduction in Local Gated ReLU Architectures
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Preliminary version; comments welcome
summary:
Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods learn the low-frequency content of a target function faster than its high-frequency content. This spectral bias is well documented, but it is much less clear which architectural choices mitigate it and which cannot. We study the question for shallow ReLU models linear in their trainable parameters, where each mode is learned at a rate given by a Gram-matrix eigenvalue, and for a general symmetric bilinear form $a(\cdot,\cdot)$, so that least-squares regression ($a=$ the $L^2$ inner product) and variational or physics-informed losses ($a=$ the $H^1$ energy form) are two instances of one analysis.
  Within this framework we propose gated local ReLU dictionaries, obtained by multiplying each ReLU feature by a hat partition-of-unity weight, in the spirit of partition-of-unity finite elements and overlapping Schwarz methods. The resulting Gram matrices are block-banded for any local bilinear form, with a block-Toeplitz interior whose matrix-valued symbol governs the spectrum.
  The two forms then behave very differently. For $L^2$ regression, the symbol is bounded away from zero, the ratio is uniform in the number of windows, and the measured spread of frequency-dependent learning rates falls from $1.9\times10^{5}$ to $4.5$ at matched model size. For the $H^1$ stiffness matrix, the symbol vanishes at zero frequency: gating leaves the $Θ(N^2)$ conditioning intact and inverts the frequency ordering instead of removing the bias. A preconditioner built from the same interior stencil will fix the spectral bias, showing that architecture alone is not enough. Experiments on $1$D regression and Poisson problems confirm the dichotomy, and the regression effect persists when the hidden-layer parameters are trained as well.

AI.tldr: 该文研究浅层ReLU模型（对可训练参数线性）的谱偏置，提出"门控局部ReLU字典"——用帽函数单位分解权重乘每个ReLU特征。结果：对$L^2$回归，Gram矩阵符号有正下界，频率相关学习速率的离散度从$1.9\times10^{5}$降至$4.5$；对$H^1$能量型损失，门控不改变$\Theta(N^2)$条件数反而反转频率次序。需用源自内部模板的预条件子才能修复谱偏置，说明仅靠架构不足。
AI.motivation: 神经网络经梯度法训练时，先学到目标函数的低频成分、后学到高频成分（谱偏置）。这一现象已被充分记录，但何种架构选择能缓解它、何种不能，仍不清楚。作者希望在可精确分析的框架内，区分架构与预条件在谱偏置中的作用。
AI.method: 考虑对可训练参数线性的浅层ReLU模型，每个模态的学习速率由Gram矩阵的特征值决定；采用一般对称双线性形式$a(\cdot,\cdot)$统一分析最小二乘回归（$a=L^2$内积）与变分/物理信息损失（$a=H^1$能量形式）。在此框架下构造门控局部ReLU字典：将每个ReLU特征乘以帽函数单位分解权重（借鉴单位分解有限元与重叠Schwarz方法），使Gram矩阵对任意局部双线性形式呈块带状，内部为块Toeplitz，其特征值谱由矩阵值符号函数决定。
AI.result: 两种形式表现迥异：$L^2$回归中符号有正下界，比值与窗口数无关，匹配模型规模下频率学习速率离散度由$1.9\times10^{5}$降至$4.5$；$H^1$刚度矩阵的符号在零频处消失，门控保留了$\Theta(N^2)$条件数并反转频率次序而非消除偏置。基于同一内部模板构造的预条件子可修复谱偏置。一维回归与Poisson问题实验验证该二分性，且在隐层参数也参与训练时回归效果依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 门控局部字典能有效缓解$L^2$回归的谱偏置，但无法消除$H^1$能量型损失的谱偏置；架构选择本身不足以解决问题，需配合匹配的预条件子。分析框架统一了回归与变分损失两类情形。

title: Public Perceptions of Public Participation in Local Government Mediated through a GenAI Tool
summary: City council meetings offer a site for direct democracy through public comment periods. Yet, this process can lack transparency, and research on local political participation has documented that people who speak at public meetings are often unrepresentative of their communities. However, a lack of representation does not establish whether other people view these participants as advocates for their concerns. In fact, little is known about how they are perceived. To address this gap and improve transparency into this democratic process, we built a generative AI (GenAI) tool, VoicesView, that allows individuals to retrieve and read public comments. We deploy this tool, along with a novel survey, in a study with 72 participants in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and Seattle, Washington, in order to understand people's perceptions of public commenters. We find that participants generally viewed public commenters favorably, and that these views became more positive after using VoicesView. For example, the share who agreed that public commenters advocate for issues they care about rose from 49% to 62%. Knowledge of how public comment works in their city was moderate and also improved: the proportion of participants who correctly answered a procedural knowledge question about council meetings increased from 53% to 74%. Participants viewed public commenters more favorably than local government, yet their sense of being heard by local government also grew: agreement that their own voice is heard rose from 28% to 46%. These findings suggest that giving residents opportunities to engage with and learn from records of local political participation can foster positive civic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文构建生成式AI工具VoicesView，让居民检索阅读市议会公众评论，并在安娜堡与西雅图72人研究中发现：使用后受访者对评论者与地方政府的正面感知、程序性知识与"被听见感"均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 市议会公众评论期是直接民主的重要渠道，但过程缺乏透明度；既有研究显示发言者往往不能代表社区构成。然而"代表性不足"并不等同于其他居民不把这些发言者视为自身诉求的代言人，公众对评论者的感知几乎未被研究。作者希望提升该民主过程的透明度并填补这一感知研究空白。
AI.method: 设计并部署生成式AI工具VoicesView，使个人可检索并阅读公众评论记录；结合一份新型问卷，在密歇根州安娜堡与华盛顿州西雅图开展72名参与者的研究，测量使用前后对公众评论者的态度、对市议会程序的知识及对地方政府回应性的感知。
AI.result: 参与者总体对评论者持正面看法，使用VoicesView后更为正面：认同"评论者为自身关心议题发声"的比例由49%升至62%；能正确回答市议会程序知识题的比例由53%升至74%；参与者对评论者的评价高于对地方政府的评价，同时"自己的声音被听见"的认同由28%升至46%。
AI.conclusion: 为居民提供接触并学习地方政治参与记录的机会，可带来积极的公民参与结果——提升政治知识、对参与者的信任与对政府的被倾听感，说明技术中介的透明化工具具有促进地方民主参与的潜力。

title: Topological Deep Learning Challenge 2026: Bridging the Gap
summary: This paper describes the 2026 edition of the Topological Deep Learning Challenge: Bridging the Gap, hosted at the second Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) Conference. Where previous editions grew the modelling and data ecosystem of Topological Deep Learning (TDL), this edition set out to place Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) side by side under a single evaluation pipeline. Participants implemented recent state-of-the-art architectures in TopoBench, with Track 1 covering GNNs and Track 2 covering TNNs. They evaluated these implementations on shared synthetic benchmarks generated with GraphUniverse, which independently controls homophily, average degree and degree-distribution heaviness. The challenge yielded 68 qualifying submissions from 34 teams, spanning the graph, simplicial, cellular, hypergraph and combinatorial domains. For the first time, submissions were also tracked on a public leaderboard, which we summarize and analyze here. Our analysis finds that the differences between the submitted tracks are strongly task-dependent: the mean accuracy gap is modest on community detection, while on triangle counting the Track 1 mean error is 1.85 times the Track 2 mean. Several structurally informed GNNs also outperform the Track 2 mean on triangle counting.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了2026年Topological Deep Learning Challenge（Bridging the Gap）的举办情况：首次将GNN与TNN置于统一评估流程，在TopoBench中实现并在GraphUniverse生成的可控合成基准上评测，共获34支团队68份有效提交，并首次引入公开排行榜；分析表明两类模型差异高度依赖任务，社区检测上差距小，三角形计数上Track 1平均误差为Track 2的1.85倍，部分结构增强GNN甚至优于Track 2均值。
AI.motivation: 以往届次的挑战赛主要扩充TDL的建模与数据生态，但缺乏GNN与TNN在同一评估流程下的公平、可控对比，难以判断拓扑方法相对图神经网络的真实增益来源与适用条件。
AI.method: 在TopoBench中实现近期SOTA架构（Track 1为GNN，Track 2为TNN），覆盖图、单纯复形、胞腔复形、超图与组合复形等域；使用GraphUniverse生成可独立控制同配性、平均度与度分布重尾程度的共享合成基准进行评测；首次设置公开排行榜并对结果进行汇总分析。
AI.result: 共收到34支团队的68份合格提交，覆盖多类拓扑域。任务依赖性显著：社区检测上两Track平均精度差距较小；三角形计数上Track 1平均误差为Track 2均值的1.85倍，且若干结构信息增强的GNN在该任务上优于Track 2均值。
AI.conclusion: GNN与TNN的优劣不能一概而论，取决于任务的结构需求；TNN在高阶结构相关任务（如三角形计数）上具优势，但结构感知的GNN可弥合部分差距。统一基准、可控数据生成与公开排行榜为TDL与GNN的公平比较提供了可复现的评估范式。

title: Veterans' Mental Health Crisis Severity Annotation: Do LLMs Agree More Than Human Experts?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach for annotating mental health and crisis-related social media content, but their reliability in safety-critical tasks remains unclear. This study evaluates LLM-based crisis-severity annotation of veteran-related social media posts against annotations from eight Veteran Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Using 149 tweets and five severity categories, we evaluate 15 open-source and 10 proprietary LLMs across eight prompt variants, examining annotation performance, inter-model agreement, prompt sensitivity, and high-severity crisis detection. Human reviewers showed higher ordinal than nominal agreement (α = 0.494), indicating that disagreements often occurred between neighboring severity levels. In contrast, selected LLMs demonstrated substantially higher inter-model consistency, with ordinal agreement (α) reaching 0.8336 under the baseline prompt. Proprietary models generally showed better agreement with expert annotations and greater stability than open-source models. GPT-5.6-Terra achieved the best overall performance, while the open-source Qwen2.5-7B showed the strongest performance in identifying Acute Crisis with Suicidal Ideation cases. However, higher model consistency did not necessarily correspond to agreement with human judgments or reliable detection of rare high-severity cases. Label-flipped demonstration experiments also revealed model-specific sensitivity to misleading in-context examples, while explanatory demonstrations did not consistently improve performance. Overall, LLMs show promise as scalable complements to expert annotation, but require careful evaluation before use in high-stakes mental health applications.

AI.tldr: 评估25个LLM在退伍军人社交媒体危机严重度标注任务上的可靠性与提示敏感性，并与8位领域专家对比，发现模型间一致性远高于人机一致性，且高一致性不等于与人类判断吻合或罕见高危案例的可靠检出。
AI.motivation: LLM被视为心理健康与危机相关内容标注的可扩展方案，但其在安全攸关任务中的可靠性尚不明确，需系统检验其与专家标注的一致性、模型间一致性、提示敏感性及高危危机识别能力。
AI.method: 使用149条推文、5个严重度类别，对15个开源与10个专有LLM在8种提示变体下进行危机严重度标注；以8位退伍军人领域专家（SME）标注为参照，分析标注性能、模型间一致性、提示敏感性及高严重度危机检出；并开展标签翻转与解释性示例的演示实验。
AI.result: 人类评审者序数一致性高于名义一致性（α=0.494），分歧多发生于相邻严重度等级；基线提示下模型间序数一致性α最高达0.8336。专有模型与专家标注一致性及稳定性总体优于开源模型；GPT-5.6-Terra综合表现最佳，开源Qwen2.5-7B在识别伴自杀意念的急性危机病例上最强。但模型间高一致性并不必然对应与人类判断的吻合或罕见高危案例的可靠检出；标签翻转示例引发模型特异性敏感，解释性示例未带来稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为专家标注的可扩展补充手段，但在用于高风险心理健康应用前须经严格评估；模型间一致性不能替代人机一致性与关键类别检出能力的检验。

title: SepLRM: A Foundation Model Paradigm for Recommendation
summary: Large recommendation models (LRMs) improve recommendation performance by scaling behavior sequence length, model capacity, and training compute. However, the return on investment (ROI) of continued scaling deteriorates as marginal gains diminish and long-sequence encoding costs rise, especially when this computation is repeatedly executed by distinct models for diverse recommendation stages and business scenarios. To address this issue, we propose SepLRM, a recommendation foundation model (RFM) paradigm that identifies reusable sequence encoding and reorganizes multiple end-to-end (E2E) LRMs into one RFM and multiple independently optimized vertical models (VMs). The RFM adopts an encoder-decoder architecture and exports its final-layer encoder state as the shared key-value (KV) cache that is independent of downstream task-offered candidates. Unlike candidate-specific logits or aggregated user embeddings, the KV cache preserves fine-grained behavioral information. Separation at this native KV interface also allows each VM to construct candidate-conditioned queries while retaining the same query-KV interaction as its E2E counterpart, enabling high-fidelity capability transfer. To ensure both transfer effectiveness and system efficiency, we co-design cache compression, the training and serving workflows, and LG-Store, a distributed storage system for KV caches. Experiments on three large-scale datasets show that SepLRM achieves state-of-the-art offline performance with a transfer rate of approximately 100%. It also demonstrates strong transferability across model iterations, recommendation stages, and business scenarios. Deployment in two large-scale industrial scenarios substantially improves the ROI of sequence scaling and delivers consistent gains in online A/B tests at ByteDance.

AI.tldr: 提出SepLRM推荐基础模型范式，将多个端到端大推荐模型的序列编码解耦为可复用的RFM与独立优化的垂类模型，通过KV cache接口实现约100%能力迁移并提升序列扩展ROI。
AI.motivation: 大推荐模型（LRM）通过扩大行为序列长度、模型容量和训练算力提升效果，但持续扩展的ROI递减：边际收益下降、长序列编码成本上升，且不同推荐阶段和业务场景的多个模型重复执行相同的序列编码，造成算力浪费。
AI.method: 提出SepLRM范式：将多个端到端LRM重组为一个RFM加多个独立优化的垂类模型（VM）。RFM采用encoder-decoder架构，导出最终层编码器状态作为与下游候选无关的共享KV cache，保留细粒度行为信息；各VM在原生KV接口上构造以候选为条件的query，保持与E2E模型一致的query-KV交互以保证迁移保真度。同时协同设计缓存压缩、训练与serving流程，以及分布式KV cache存储系统LG-Store。
AI.result: 在三个大规模数据集上取得SOTA离线性能，迁移率约100%；在模型迭代、推荐阶段和业务场景间展现强迁移性。在ByteDance两个大规模工业场景部署，显著提升序列扩展ROI，并在线上A/B测试中获得稳定收益。
AI.conclusion: 以KV cache为原生解耦接口的RFM范式可在保证高保真能力迁移的同时复用序列编码，使长序列扩展的ROI显著改善，为推荐系统基础模型化提供可行路径。

title: Improving Analytic Constants via Interpretable AI-Guided Lean Proof Refinement
summary:
AI agents are increasingly capable of discovering new mathematical results, yet their reasoning and generated proofs can be difficult to understand and verify. We introduce an interpretable framework for AI-guided mathematical discovery, focused on improving quantitative bounds on analytic constants. Our key insight is that existing proofs often contain slack in intermediate lemmas, which can be tightened without reconstructing the entire argument. To exploit this structure, we represent proofs as partially-formalized Lean blueprints: human-interpretable dependency graphs of definitions, lemmas, and theorems. An AI agent then iteratively refines the Lean code while preserving the blueprint's dependency structure, allowing local improvements to automatically propagate to a verified final bound. This interpretable structure allows humans to inspect the agent's refinements and understand how local improvements propagate to the final theorem. For Grothendieck's constant ($\mathcal{K}_G$), we obtain $$
  \mathcal{K}_G \leq
  \fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt{2})} - 10^{-17}, $$ an explicit numerical improvement over Krivine's 1977 bound. For Korenblum's constant ($\mathcal{K}_K$), we obtain $$
  \mathcal{K}_K \geq 0.356565, $$ improving Wang's 2025 bound of $0.3554$. Our experiments demonstrate the potential of both partial formalization and iterative agentic refinement for interpretable mathematical discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释的AI数学发现框架，将证明表示为部分形式化的Lean蓝图（依赖图），由AI代理在保持依赖结构的前提下迭代精化代码，实现局部改进并自动传播到经验证的最终界，成功改进了Grothendieck常数与Korenblum常数的最佳已知界。
AI.motivation: AI代理已能发现新的数学结果，但其推理过程与生成的证明难以被人类理解和验证；同时，现有证明的中间引理往往存在"松弛"（slack），可在不重构整个论证的前提下被收紧。
AI.method: 1) 将证明表示为部分形式化的Lean蓝图，即定义、引理与定理构成的人类可读依赖图；2) AI代理在保持蓝图依赖结构不变的情况下迭代精化Lean代码；3) 局部改进沿依赖图自动传播，最终得到一个经形式化验证的界；4) 人类可沿该结构检查代理的精化过程。
AI.result: Grothendieck常数：K_G ≤ π/(2log(1+√2)) − 10^{-17}，对Krivine 1977年界的显式数值改进；Korenblum常数：K_K ≥ 0.356565，优于Wang 2025年的0.3554。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，部分形式化结合迭代式代理精化，对可解释的数学发现具有潜力。

title: The Challenge of Modeling the Complexity of Use for the Measurement of Digital Maturity in Education
summary: Measurement of teachers' digital maturity can be useful in diagnosing technology adoption in education and in supporting teachers' professional development. However, there is a lack of easily usable tools in the existing literature. By investigating the most effective ways to measure teachers' digital maturity, our research aims to fill this gap. The focus of this article is on a data-driven approach to the assessment of digital maturity in education. Following a process similar to teaching analytics (data collection, data modeling, data understanding and visualization, and contextual understanding), we draw on diary data collected from 12949 French primary school teachers using a virtual learning environment (VLE) during the 2022--2023 school year. Specifically, the paper presents results related to modeling and visualizing data. To this end, we propose a critical analysis of two automatic classification techniques, one supervised rule-based and the other unsupervised (hierarchical clustering). In addition to providing different scales to measure, we have proposed a new approach to diagnose and visualize digital maturity. In this way, the method provides insight into the diversity and intensity of technology use, contributing to a better understanding of digital maturity and providing a practical tool for assessing day-to-day teaching practices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的方法来测量与可视化法国小学教师的数字成熟度，基于12949名教师在虚拟学习环境（VLE）中的日记数据，比较了监督式规则分类与无监督层次聚类两种自动分类技术。
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏易于使用的教师数字成熟度测量工具，而该测量对诊断教育技术采纳状况和支持教师专业发展具有价值，研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用类似教学分析（teaching analytics）的流程——数据采集、数据建模、数据理解与可视化、情境化理解；数据为2022–2023学年12949名法国小学教师使用VLE产生的日记数据；文章重点呈现建模与可视化环节，对基于规则的监督分类与层次聚类（无监督）两类自动分类技术进行批判性分析。
AI.result: 除提供不同的测量量表外，作者提出了一种诊断并可视化数字成熟度的新方法，能够揭示技术使用的多样性与强度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有助于更好地理解数字成熟度，并为评估日常教学实践提供了实用工具。

title: Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions
summary: When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-δ$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $γ$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.

AI.tldr: 提出 Selective-Risk Calibration (SRC) 框架，针对代用约束下优化器的返回决策直接校准约束裕度，并给出在给定目标分布上"选择风险"（返回决策不可行的概率）的可证明界限。
AI.motivation: 优化问题中代用约束下的可行解未必对真实约束可行。现有做法（split conformal 的随机输入覆盖保证、feedback covariate shift 的似然比重加权）都只能约束随机输入层面的覆盖，无法约束优化器"选出的决策"的不可行概率，因此需要一种以返回决策为对象的校准方法。
AI.method: SRC 以优化器针对从给定目标分布抽取的目标所返回的决策为校准对象，对学习到的约束进行校准；在最坏情况式的有限样本界下，以至少 1-δ 的概率保证：对留出目标上被认证的任意裕度，其选择风险（返回决策不可行概率）≤ γ。作者还从理论上证明 split conformal 的随机输入覆盖保证不能界定选择风险，且当学习约束在返回决策处处于激活状态时，feedback covariate shift 的似然比重加权不适用。
AI.result: 实验中，覆盖约 90% 随机输入的 conformal 裕度，对返回决策的覆盖率最低仅 17%；而每个被认证的裕度在未见目标上的违约率均低于其目标值。在同等成本下，62 组比较中有 57 组 SRC 的修正带来的不可行解数量少于或等于基线。
AI.conclusion: 选择风险与随机输入覆盖之间存在显著差距，直接面向返回决策校准是必要的；SRC 提供有保证且实用的校准，适用于任何"代用模型选决策、且样本实例的可行性可被验证"的场景。

title: LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
summary: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead. We ask the research question: Do all requests need their adapters throughout the whole generation process? Our motivational study reveals that employing LoRA adapters at every decoding step is unnecessary, releasing them early has limited impact on accuracy while substantially accelerating generation. Although skipping adapters early offers theoretical workload reduction, translating these computational savings into concrete throughput gains requires tailored GPU kernels. We present LoRazor, a multi-LoRA serving framework that combines early adapter release with active-row aware GPU kernels. LoRazor determines when to permanently release a request's adapter and continue decoding with the backbone alone. By dynamically resizing LoRA kernel launches as adapters are released, LoRazor trims idle GPU blocks. Across two backbones and four tasks, LoRazor achieves up to 3.02x request throughput and 2.53x output-token throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA, with a mean relative task-accuracy decrease of 2.89%.

AI.tldr: LoRazor 提出提前释放 LoRA 适配器并结合 active-row aware GPU 内核的多 LoRA 服务框架，实现最高 3.02x 请求吞吐与 2.53x 输出 token 吞吐。
AI.motivation: 并发服务多个不同 LoRA 适配器会带来大量计算与显存管理开销；作者提出疑问：是否每个请求在完整生成过程中都需要其适配器？动机研究显示每个解码步都使用适配器并非必要，提前释放对准确率影响有限却能显著加速生成。但仅跳过适配器只能带来理论上的负载下降，要转化为实际吞吐收益需定制 GPU 内核。
AI.method: 提出 LoRazor，将早期适配器释放与 active-row aware GPU 内核相结合：判定何时永久释放某请求的适配器并仅用骨干模型继续解码；随着适配器释放动态调整 LoRA 内核启动规模，裁剪空闲 GPU 块。
AI.result: 在两个骨干模型与四类任务上，相比 vLLM multi-LoRA，LoRazor 达到最高 3.02x 请求吞吐与 2.53x 输出 token 吞吐，平均任务准确率下降 2.89%。
AI.conclusion: 解码阶段全程使用 LoRA 适配器并非必要；通过提前释放适配器并配合内核级动态缩减，可将理论计算节省转化为实际吞吐提升，代价是较小的精度损失，为多 LoRA 高效服务提供了可行方案。

title: LEGIT: Live Eligibility Gating over Identifier Tries for Constrained Decoding of Heterogeneous Pages
summary: A generative recommender names each candidate with a short token sequence, a Semantic ID, and recommends by generating those tokens. Some generative recommenders, including the Uber Eats search engine we are building, write a whole results page, stores with their menu items, in one decoding pass. Every Semantic ID on such a page must name a real store or item that is eligible for the search, such as a store that delivers to the user's location, and that is not already on the page. Each item must also belong to the store above it. A trie over the catalog keeps identifiers real, but eligibility and repetition change with every request and token, and the grammar-constrained decoder we tried could not enforce these changing rules exactly and quickly. We call this constraint LEGIT, for live eligibility gating over identifier tries. Numbering trie leaves depth first turns each rule into a range lookup over one store trie and one item trie, and every generated page passes an independent catalog check. On one NVIDIA B200 GPU with one or two requests per decode step, a direct implementation that walks the trie on the GPU makes each token about 5 times as slow as unconstrained decoding. Across 36 implementations, hardware counters and ablations are consistent with kernel launches and CPU-GPU waits as the source of this slowdown. Our fastest implementation walks the trie on the CPU while the GPU runs the model, needs no custom kernel, and cuts time per output token by 65.9 percent against the direct GPU implementation, to about 1.7 times the unconstrained cost. This implementation is also the fastest on a page layout that puts each item before its store.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LEGIT（live eligibility gating over identifier tries），通过对trie叶子深度优先编号，将"实时资格过滤"与"去重"约束转化为对store trie与item trie的区间查询，从而在生成式推荐系统的页面级解码中高效地强制页内每个Semantic ID真实、可用且不重复。
AI.motivation: Uber Eats搜索等生成式推荐器一次性解码整页结果（店铺及其菜品项）。页面上每个Semantic ID必须指向真实且对本次请求有资格（如可配送到用户位置）的店铺/菜品，不得重复，且菜品须归属其上方店铺。仅靠catalog trie可保证ID真实，但资格与重复性随请求和每个token动态变化。已有的语法约束解码器无法既精确又快速地强制执行这些动态规则。
AI.method: 提出LEGIT约束：对trie叶子做深度优先编号，使每条规则（资格、去重、归属）都等价于在一个store trie和一个item trie上的区间查询。对生成页面进行独立catalog校验。对比实现包括GPU上直接遍历trie的实现与CPU遍历trie、GPU并行跑模型的实现，并进行硬件计数器分析与消融研究（共36种实现）。
AI.result: 在单块NVIDIA B200 GPU、每解码步1–2个请求的设置下，GPU直接遍历trie使每token耗时约为无约束解码的5倍。硬件计数器与消融实验表明瓶颈来自kernel启动与CPU-GPU等待。最快实现（CPU遍历trie与GPU模型执行重叠、无需自定义kernel）相比直接GPU实现将每输出token时间减少65.9%，约为无约束成本的1.7倍；且在"菜品先于店铺"的页面布局下同样最快。
AI.conclusion: 约束执行的瓶颈主要来自同步开销而非计算量；将trie遍历放在CPU与GPU计算重叠进行，可在无需自定义kernel的前提下以较低开销精确满足动态资格、去重与层级归属约束，是页面级生成式推荐解码的实用方案。

title: On the Global Convergence of Stochastic Adam for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: The Adam optimizer is widely used to train neural networks with highly nonlinear and nonconvex objective functions. Remarkably, Adam often drives the empirical training loss nearly to zero. This phenomenon has been partially explained by neural tangent kernel (NTK) analyses of gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD). However, analyzing Adam presents additional challenges. Its first-moment momentum couples stochastic gradients across iterations, while its adaptive second-moment preconditioner depends on the same stochastic gradient used in the update. In this paper, we establish linear convergence guarantees for Adam in training sufficiently wide two-layer neural networks with either full-batch or minibatch gradients. For full-batch Adam, we construct a Lyapunov function to control the effect of historical momentum. For minibatch Adam, our analysis builds on an exact virtual-iterate representation, a conditional analysis of the dependence between stochastic gradients and adaptive preconditioners, and uniform concentration bounds for the second-moment estimates. We prove geometric decay of the empirical loss for full-batch Adam and geometric decay in restricted expectation on a high-probability event for minibatch Adam. Beyond regression, we extend our convergence analysis to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving the Poisson equation, where differential operators and separate sampling of interior and boundary points introduce additional challenges. We establish analogous global convergence guarantees for both deterministic and stochastic Adam under explicit conditions on network width and Adam's parameters, characterizing the effects of minibatch size on convergence. These results help bridge the gap between Adam's empirical success and its theoretical understanding, providing sharper convergence guarantees for PINNs than existing analyses.

AI.tldr: 该论文在NTK框架下为Adam训练足够宽的两层神经网络建立了线性收敛保证，涵盖全批量与minibatch梯度，并推广到PINN求解Poisson方程。
AI.motivation: Adam在非线性非凸目标上常使训练损失近乎降为零，但现有NTK分析多针对GD/SGD；Adam的一阶动量跨迭代耦合随机梯度、自适应二阶预条件子又依赖同一次随机梯度，给理论分析带来额外困难。
AI.method: 全批量Adam：构造Lyapunov函数控制历史动量影响；minibatch Adam：采用精确虚拟迭代表示、对随机梯度与自适应预条件子依赖关系做条件分析、以及对二阶矩估计建立一致集中界。进一步将分析扩展到PINN求解Poisson方程，处理微分算子与内部/边界点分离采样带来的挑战。
AI.result: 证明全批量Adam下经验损失的几何衰减，minibatch Adam在高概率事件上受限期望意义下的几何衰减；对确定性与随机Adam求解PINN给出类似全局收敛保证，明确网络宽度与Adam超参条件，并刻画minibatch规模对收敛的影响，收敛保证比现有PINN分析更紧。
AI.conclusion: 结果为Adam的经验成功提供更精细的理论解释，缩小了理论与实践差距，并为PINN训练提供更锐利的收敛刻画。

title: Police Behavior Patterns Through Radio Analysis
comment: 10 pages (14 with SI), 6 figures (8 with SI)
summary: In the United States, most police departments communicate using police radio, which allows for officer-to-officer and officer-to-dispatch communication without depending on cellular network or WiFi availability. While some departments use encrypted digital radio, many continue to transmit in the clear, and are legally monitored by public citizens with `police scanners.' Because police radio is intended for internal police use and represents real-time communication, it may offer valuable insight into patterns of law enforcement activities without the potential bias and filtering introduced by a press release after the fact. In this study, we collect and examine over 14 million radio transmissions representing over 100,000 hours of speech by officers in 34 cities across the United States from July 2025 through July 2026; to our knowledge the largest scale analysis of Broadcast Police Communication (BPC) to date. We highlight both typical patterns of police communication and categorize anomalous activity that represents incidents including protests and major weather events. We present this dataset as a starting point for an array of police communication studies, conduct our own preliminary analysis, and propose several further areas of inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并分析美国34个城市、1400余万条警用无线电通信（BPC）的大规模数据集（约10万小时语音，2025年7月至2026年7月），刻画警用通信的典型模式并识别抗议、极端天气等异常事件，作为警用通信研究的起点。
AI.motivation: 警用无线电用于内部实时通信，不经新闻稿等事后过滤，可无偏地反映执法活动的真实模式；但此前缺乏大规模、系统性的公开广播警用通信数据与分析。
AI.method: 采集34个美国城市公开（未加密）警用无线电传输数据，规模超1400万条、10万余小时语音；进行典型通信模式统计刻画，并对异常活动（抗议、重大天气事件等）进行分类与初步分析，同时提出后续研究方向。
AI.result: 获得迄今已知规模最大的BPC数据集（34城市、1400万+条传输、10万+小时语音）；识别并分类出抗议与重大天气事件等异常通信活动，并归纳出警用通信的典型模式。
AI.conclusion: 公开警用无线电可作为研究执法活动的高价值、低偏倚数据源；该数据集为警用通信研究提供基础，并为后续多方向探究（如事件检测、通信模式建模等）奠定起点。

title: All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning
summary: Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a Hölder bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs and regularizers recovering the kernels of transformers, FNO, Flowers, their hybrids, and beyond. This variational formulation provides a systematic approach to architecture design, together with sufficient conditions for uniform discretization stability.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“一致离散化稳定性”的定量刻画，并证明所有此类算子可精确表示为稳定的马尔可夫核网络，从而统一FNO、Transformer、Flowers等架构并给出系统化架构设计方法。
AI.motivation: 算子学习需要在输入离散化改变时保持稳定（离散化不变性），但缺乏定量的稳定性刻画，也缺乏统一的理论框架来解释和设计具有该性质的算子架构。
AI.method: 将输入函数及其离散化统一表示为概率测度，用测度间Wasserstein距离对输出变化给出Hölder型界，定义“一致离散化稳定性”；进而证明表示定理：此类算子可精确写成稳定马尔可夫核网络；并证明读核可表示为正则化变分问题的解。
AI.result: 得到表示定理，表明稳定马尔可夫核网络是Transformer、FNO、Flowers等的联合推广；通过选择不同代价函数与正则项，可恢复这些架构的核及其混合形式，并给出一致离散化稳定性的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 一致离散化稳定算子恰对应稳定马尔可夫核网络，架构设计转化为“参数化马尔可夫核网络的哪一部分及如何参数化”的问题；变分形式提供了系统化的架构设计与稳定性充分条件。

title: AYO: A Safe and Privacy-Preserving Platform for Studying Children's Interaction with LLMs
comment: Accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Child Safety in AI
summary: Children and adolescents are increasingly interacting with generative AI and large language models (LLMs), yet little is known about how these interactions may influence their development, beliefs, and behavior. Existing research has relied heavily on surveys, while direct study of children's interactions with LLMs presents substantial challenges related to safety, privacy, consent, and experimental control. We introduce AYO (AI Youth Open Science), an open-source platform designed for safe and systematic research on children's interactions with conversational AI. AYO provides a child-friendly interface, configurable age-based safety guardrails, researcher monitoring, and privacy-preserving data practices. These capabilities enable cross-sectional, longitudinal, and experimental research on how children use and respond to LLMs and how AI design may shape trust, epistemic judgment, curiosity, and other aspects of development. AYO provides the infrastructure to generate evidence that guides safer AI systems, educational practices, and policies for children growing up with AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源平台AYO，用于安全、系统性地研究儿童与对话式AI/大语言模型的交互，涵盖儿童友好界面、可配置的年龄分级安全防护、研究者监控与隐私保护数据实践，以支持横断面、纵向与实验研究。
AI.motivation: 儿童与青少年日益频繁地与生成式AI和LLM交互，但其对儿童发展、信念与行为的影响尚不清楚。现有研究主要依赖问卷，而直接研究儿童与LLM的交互面临安全、隐私、知情同意与实验控制等多重挑战，缺乏可用的研究基础设施。
AI.method: 设计并开源AYO（AI Youth Open Science）平台：提供儿童友好的交互界面、可配置的基于年龄的安全防护机制、研究者实时监控，以及隐私保护的数据采集与处理实践。
AI.result: 平台能力支持开展横断面、纵向和实验性研究，考察儿童如何使用和回应LLM，以及AI设计如何塑造信任、认知判断、好奇心等发展性指标。
AI.conclusion: AYO为生成指导更安全AI系统、教育实践及相关政策提供了研究基础设施，有助于为在AI环境中成长的儿童积累实证依据。

title: Yuanbao-Reranker: Document-Grounded Synthesis and Preference Distillation for Text Reranking
summary: High-precision text reranking is a critical component in modern search, recommendation, and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. We present Yuanbao-Reranker, a family of general-purpose dense rerankers spanning 0.6B, 4B, and 8B parameter scales built upon the Qwen3 backbone. To construct diverse and reliable ranking supervision at scale, we pair answer-first and query-type-guided document-grounded synthesis with a three-stage curation funnel that verifies positive support, eliminates semantic redundancy, and enforces balanced source-by-length quotas. For each curated pair, we screen real retrieval pools with a teacher score margin to filter out potential false negatives and sample Hard, Medium, and Moderate negative tiers, yielding 2.75M $1{:}3$ ranking groups. We train the models by jointly optimizing pointwise relevance cross-entropy and a bounded minimum-gap hinge objective over both positive--negative and negative--negative pairs. This formulation transfers fine-grained teacher preferences across candidate tiers without over-constraining well-separated predictions, supporting both cross-scale and same-scale distillation followed by layerwise adaptive model merging. Across five comprehensive benchmarks spanning Chinese (CMTEB-R), multilingual (MMTEB-R), English (BEIR), long-document (MLDR), and code (MTEB-Code) retrieval, Yuanbao-Reranker consistently leads every parameter tier: the 0.6B variant reaches 70.96 Avg. to surpass 1B--4B active-parameter baselines, the 4B variant reaches 73.63 Avg. to outperform the 8B teacher (72.68), and the 8B variant achieves a state-of-the-art 74.21 Avg., with substantial gains generalizing across distinct first-stage retrievers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Yuanbao-Reranker，一个基于 Qwen3 主干的 0.6B/4B/8B 通用稠密重排器系列，通过可扩展的数据合成与三阶段筛选构建 2.75M 排序组，并结合逐点相关性与有界最小间隔 hinge 联合优化训练，在五大检索基准各参数档位均取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现代搜索、推荐与 agentic RAG 系统对高精度文本重排需求强烈，但大规模构建多样、可靠且无假负例的排序监督数据困难，且小模型难以逼近大模型的重排性能。
AI.method: 基于 Qwen3 构建 0.6B/4B/8B 稠密重排器；采用 answer-first 与 query-type 引导的文档接地合成，配合三阶段筛选漏斗（正例支持验证、语义冗余剔除、源-长度配额的均衡控制）；用教师分数间隔筛查真实检索池剔除潜在假负例，采样 Hard/Medium/Moderate 负例层级，得到 2.75M 的 1:3 排序组；训练时联合优化逐点相关性交叉熵与有界最小间隔 hinge 目标（覆盖正-负与负-负对），支持跨尺度与同尺度蒸馏，并进行逐层自适应模型融合。
AI.result: 在 CMTEB-R、MMTEB-R、BEIR、MLDR、MTEB-Code 五大基准上各参数档位全面领先：0.6B 达 70.96 Avg.，超过 1B–4B 激活参数基线；4B 达 73.63 Avg.，超过 8B 教师（72.68）；8B 达 74.21 Avg. 的 SOTA，且在更换一阶段检索器时仍具显著泛化增益。
AI.conclusion: 高质量、可扩展的数据合成与筛选流程配合精细的间隔感知损失设计，可显著提升稠密重排性能，并使小模型超越更大规模的教师模型，验证了该训练范式的有效性与可迁移性。

title: From Dialogue to Task: How Cognitive Engagement With Generative Artificial Intelligence Relates to Post-Dialogue Activity and Task Outcomes
comment: 31 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Computer Assisted Learning
summary: Generative AI is increasingly embedded within learning tasks, yet interaction frequency reveals little about cognitive engagement in student-AI dialogue. Little is known about how such engagement is situated within task workflows or how dialogue characteristics and subsequent task activity relate to students' behaviour and task outcomes. This study examined cognitive engagement in student-AI dialogue, its position within task workflows, and associations of dialogue and task-process characteristics with post-dialogue activity and task outcomes. Data were collected from 1,681 students across 40 university courses using three AI companions embedded in resource creation, peer moderation, and practice. Cognitive engagement in 829 conversation threads was coded with a dialogue-oriented Interactive-Constructive-Active-Passive (ICAP) framework, and 2,969 task sequences were modelled with first-order Markov models. Regression models linked dialogue and task-process characteristics to behavioural re-engagement, peer-rated artefact quality, and practice performance. Passive and Active engagement predominated, although resource creation involved more Constructive and Interactive dialogue, peer moderation more Passive, and practice more Active, while higher-engagement dialogue was less often followed by session termination. In resource creation, student-composed messages were associated with more dialogue-to-task returns than template-only requests at the same Passive level, whereas deeper cognitive engagement was associated with higher final artefact quality independent of return frequency; in practice, AI dialogue after an incorrect attempt was associated with fewer further attempts but higher next-attempt correctness among continuers. Post-dialogue activity and task outcomes are distinct aspects of AI use that interaction frequency cannot capture and evaluations should assess separately.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察学生与生成式AI对话中的认知投入及其在任务流程中的位置，发现被动与主动投入占主导、各任务类型对话投入分布不同，且对话特征与任务过程特征对后续行为（再投入/继续尝试）与任务成果（作品质量、下次正确率）的影响相互独立。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI日益嵌入学习任务，但交互频率难以反映认知投入；现有研究不清楚认知投入在任务工作流中的位置，以及对话特征与后续任务活动、任务成果之间的关系。
AI.method: 收集40门大学课程共1,681名学生在资源创作、同伴互评、练习三类AI伙伴中的数据；用面向对话的ICAP框架对829条对话线程的认知投入编码，用一阶马尔可夫模型建模2,969条任务序列，并用回归模型将对话与任务过程特征关联到行为再投入、同伴评定的作品质量和练习表现。
AI.result: 被动与主动投入占主导；资源创作中建构性与互动性对话更多，同伴互评中被动更多，练习中主动更多；高投入对话后更少终止会话。资源创作中，同等被动水平下学生自拟消息比仅用模板请求带来更多"对话—任务"回返，而更深认知投入与更高最终作品质量相关且独立于回返频率；练习中，错误尝试后的AI对话与更少后续尝试相关，但在继续尝试者中与下次尝试正确率更高相关。
AI.conclusion: 对话后的任务活动与任务成果是AI使用的两个不同方面，交互频率无法捕捉，评估时应分别测量。

title: fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification
summary: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark to support more robust and cumulative progress in machine learning for fNIRS data. Our code and data can be found at https://fnirsatlas.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 fNIRSAtlas——迄今最大规模的开源 fNIRS 分类基准，包含来自 19 个公开数据集集合的 23 个分类任务，覆盖运动执行、运动想象、心算、工作记忆与情绪识别等范式，并提供从原始数据到评估的全自动流水线与跨被试/被试内标准化任务，用于可复现的方法比较。
AI.motivation: fNIRS 在脑机接口与认知状态解码中具有潜力，但机器学习研究受制于数据集规模小且孤立、评估协议不一致，导致方法间难以进行公平、累积式的比较。
AI.method: 构建统一基准：整合 19 个公开数据集合、23 个分类任务；设计从原始数据预处理到模型评估的全自动流水线；定义跨被试与被试内两类标准化基准任务；并在其上系统评测来自 fNIRS、相关神经影像及时间序列机器学习文献的多种基线模型（含深度学习方法）。
AI.result: 不同任务间性能差异显著；在有限数据上验证有效的方法（尤其是深度学习）往往难以泛化到原始评估设定之外。
AI.conclusion: fNIRSAtlas 作为可扩展、开放且可复现的基准，为 fNIRS 机器学习提供统一评测平台，推动更稳健、累积性的研究进展；代码与数据已公开。

title: META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia & Expo (ICME 2026), Bangkok, Thailand. Source code: https://github.com/Miraj-Rahman-AI/Meta-IR. Supplementary material is included in the ancillary files
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 META-IR 元内省推理框架，通过双层循环（SI-MCTS 内省循环 + 元学习外循环）与动态越狱模拟，实现LLM在演化攻击分布下的快速自适应安全对齐。
AI.motivation: LLM仍易受越狱攻击与有害提示影响，在对抗性分布偏移下静态对齐流程难以泛化；STAIR等内省方法依赖固定自评估策略，无法快速适应不断演变的操纵手段。
AI.method: 双层架构：内层内省循环经SI-MCTS完成结构化风险分析、自评估与反思性修正；外层元学习循环在多样越狱任务族上优化内省策略，以实现对未见攻击的快速泛化；并引入动态越狱模拟模块，逐步暴露更难对抗提示，实现无人工监督的持续自我改进。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen-2-7B-Instruct 上，以及安全性、有用性、泛化性与内省性等多维指标上，META-IR 相较全部基线在适应速度、鲁棒性和推理稳定性方面均有实质性提升。
AI.conclusion: META-IR 为构建在动态演化威胁环境下具备持续自适应安全对齐能力的LLM提供了有效路径。

title: When Greedy Is Sorting: Exact and Certified Ideal Rankings for Novelty Metrics
summary: The ideal ranking that normalizes novelty metrics is NP-hard to compute in general, so widely used $α$-nDCG evaluators approximate its denominator with a greedy rule that rescans every remaining document at each rank. We identify a regime in which this ideal ranking is exact and cheap for both $α$-DCG and intent-aware expected reciprocal rank (ERR-IA). When each document is positively judged for at most one intent, each metric reduces to the classical allocation of a fixed budget across chains of decreasing marginal gains. A metric-specific virtual-score transformation followed by a multiway merge, which we call ChainMerge, returns the globally optimal top-$K$ ranking in $O(G+K\log G)$ time from $G$ preordered intent groups, or in $O(n+K\log G)$ time from $n$ globally preordered candidates, instead of the $Θ(nK)$ of the greedy rule. When intent judgments overlap, exact $α$-DCG optimization is NP-hard under the standard logarithmic discount and $α=0.5$, even when every document has three intents and every intent occurs in two documents. For arbitrary overlap, a polynomial-size LP over nested ranking prefixes upper-bounds the ideal score and certifies the optimality gap of any feasible ranking. In the official TREC Web 2009-2012 judgments, 64.8% of positive documents serve a single intent, yet only 20 of 198 complete queries do so throughout. Beyond this exact regime, the LP certifies 189 of the 198 greedy denominators as globally optimal, and the resulting score intervals preserve the winner in all eight matched comparison groups. On 65,238 MIND-small candidates, ChainMerge returns identical optimal objectives 17-1,011 times faster than the greedy rule. For $α$-DCG, these results trace the hardness of the ideal ranking to intent overlap.

AI.tldr: 论文研究α-nDCG与ERR-IA理想排序的计算复杂性：识别出"每个文档至多属于一个意图"的可解区域，证明此时指标可化归为预算分配问题，并提出ChainMerge算法在O(G+K log G)或O(n+K log G)时间求得全局最优top-K；当意图重叠时证明α-DCG精确优化在标准对数折扣与α=0.5下即NP-hard，并用嵌套前缀LP给出上界与最优性间隙证书。TREC与MIND-small实验验证了效率与最优性。
AI.motivation: 业界广泛使用的α-nDCG等评估器用贪心重扫描规则近似理想排序分母，每计算一个rank需重扫全部剩余文档，复杂度Θ(nK)，且缺乏最优性保证；理想排序本身一般NP-hard。作者希望定位一类理想排序既精确又可廉价计算的情形，并刻画意图重叠对难度的影响。
AI.method: 1) 在"每文档至多被一个意图正向判定"的条件下，将α-DCG与ERR-IA归约为在递减边际收益链上分配固定预算的经典问题；2) 提出指标特定的虚拟分数变换+多路归并算法ChainMerge，从G个预排序意图组以O(G+K log G)、或从n个全局预排序候选以O(n+K log G)求全局最优top-K；3) 对有重叠意图的情形，在标准对数折扣、α=0.5下用三意图/每意图两文档的构造证明NP-hard；4) 对任意重叠，构建嵌套排序前缀上的多项式规模LP，给出理想分数上界并对任意可行排序认证最优性间隙。
AI.result: TREC Web 2009-2012官方判定中64.8%的正向文档只服务单一意图，但198个完整查询中仅20个整体满足该条件；在可解区域外，LP将198个贪心分母中的189个认证为全局最优，所得分数区间在全部8个配对比较组中保持胜者不变；MIND-small的65,238个候选上，ChainMerge与贪心规则返回相同最优目标值，速度快17–1,011倍。
AI.conclusion: α-DCG理想排序的困难性可溯源至意图重叠：单意图归属时存在精确、线性–近线性的算法，重叠时则NP-hard；LP证书为实际评估提供可用的最优性保证。建议在评估器中以ChainMerge替代Θ(nK)贪心规则，并用LP间隙报告评估不确定性。

title: Rules, Choice, and Chance: A Welfare Evaluation Framework for Student-School Matching
comment: 42 pages, 26 figures, with 14 page main section
summary: Centralized student-school matching systems, adopted in the United States, Chile, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, assign students to schools based on their submitted preference rankings and schools' priority policies. Yet welfare in these systems is typically measured through a narrow lens: a few aggregate statistics published by education authorities, such as the share of students unmatched or assigned to a top-ranked choice. A single aggregate cannot reveal how outcomes vary across students, or why. Welfare depends on three interacting forces: the rules policymakers set (algorithm, tie-breaking, list length limits); the choices students make (which and how many schools to rank); and chance (lottery draws and students' residential location). A rule that reduces unmatched rates may simultaneously lower top-ranked assignment rates for specific groups, and evaluating such trade-offs in advance is challenging because individual-level preference data are rarely available. We present Trace (Trade-offs in Rules, Agency, Chance, and Equity), an open-source framework that synthesizes individual-level preference profiles from aggregate data using mixtures of Mallows models and evaluates alternative rules across multiple welfare metrics, disaggregating outcomes by choice and chance. We apply Trace to two real-world systems: NYC high school matching, where we study minimum list length requirements, and Chilean school assignment, where we compare the current multiple tie-breaking rule with a counterfactual single tie-breaking rule. Both reveal substantial, heterogeneous welfare trade-offs, underscoring the value of simulation-based evaluation before implementing school choice reforms.

AI.tldr: 提出开源框架Trace，用Mallows混合模型从聚合数据合成个体偏好，并在多福利指标下按"规则-自主-随机"分解评估择校匹配规则的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有集中式学生-学校匹配系统的福利评估依赖少数聚合统计（未匹配率、前列志愿命中率），无法揭示结果在个体间的异质差异及成因；福利由规则、学生选择行为与随机性（抽签、居住位置）三股力量交互决定，而个体层面偏好数据稀缺，难以预先评估规则权衡。
AI.method: Trace开源框架：基于Mallows模型混合，从聚合数据合成个体层面偏好剖面；随后对备选规则在多个福利指标上评估，并将结果按choice（选择）与chance（随机）维度解耦分解。应用于两个真实系统：纽约高中匹配（研究最短志愿列表长度要求）与智利学校分配（比较现行多重并列打破规则与反事实的单一并列打破规则）。
AI.result: 两个应用均揭示出显著且异质的福利权衡：单一聚合指标掩盖了不同群体间的相反效应，规则改变在不同子群体上产生方向不一致的得失。
AI.conclusion: 基于仿真的评估可在政策实施前显性化规则权衡，对择校改革具有重要价值；开源框架为在个体偏好数据缺失条件下开展反事实规则分析提供了可行工具。

title: Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer
summary: Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, transfer learning with 20 target simulations gave errors similar to or lower than training from scratch with 80 target simulations for about half of the targets. With the same 80 target simulations, transfer learning reduced errors for 95% of targets. The effect of the global geometry on transfer was studied with four parameter-free geometric descriptors and controlled variations across 4 corner subclasses. The benefit of transfer decreased with increasing surface distance and high-curvature change between source and target, and for targets shallower than the source. These trends were also seen in other corner types with a different magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基线条件残差代理模型R-BiLoGo，将局部特征效应与全局几何部分解耦：先在单一全局几何上学习局部特征，再通过迁移学习推广到其他全局几何，从而显著减少仿真需求。
AI.motivation: 钣金件的全局几何（如圆角半径、成形深度）与附加局部特征共同影响材料流动，若让代理模型学习所有组合需要大量训练数据；但同一局部特征类型常被用于多种全局几何，因此有解耦并复用局部特征知识的空间。
AI.method: 以热冲压转角件侧壁加强筋为对象，构建"基线条件残差"代理模型R-BiLoGo：输入为基线响应与加强筋引起的几何扰动，输出为相对基线的位移与减薄变化；先在源几何上学习局部特征效应，再通过迁移学习迁移到目标几何，并与分层图模型、Transolver类模型对比；用4种无参数几何描述子、在4个转架子类上做受控变化分析全局几何对迁移的影响。
AI.result: R-BiLoGo在源几何及3个目标几何中的2个上误差低于分层图模型与Transolver类模型；在22个目标几何上，20次目标仿真的迁移学习对约半数目标可达到或优于80次仿真的从头训练；在同样80次仿真下，迁移学习使95%的目标误差降低。迁移收益随源-目标表面距离增大、高曲率变化增大以及目标比源更浅而下降，该趋势在其他转角类型中以不同幅度重现。
AI.conclusion: 局部特征效应可在不同全局几何间迁移复用，从而以更少仿真获得可比或更优的代理精度；源-目标几何相似性（表面距离、曲率变化、深度关系）是决定迁移收益的关键因素。

title: The Infrastructure Divide: Analyzing Community Stance on Data Center Development via Reddit
summary: The rapid expansion of AI-driven data center construction has outpaced public engagement: an estimated $64 billion in U.S. data center projects were blocked or delayed by local opposition between May 2024 and March 2025, yet the concerns driving this resistance remain poorly characterized. Prior engagement methods such as surveys and hearings are introduced late in the planning process, and no study has systematically mined social media to measure community stance at scale. To address this gap, this study presents an LLM-powered opinion-mining framework and applies it to 798 Reddit posts and 102,328 associated comments spanning a decade. An open-source large language model, guided by a Chain-of-Stance prompting framework and three domain-specific labeling rules, classified stance at 83% of the human inter-reviewer agreement ceiling. Opposition dominated discourse volume rather than disapproval: against posts outnumbered favor posts 2.6:1 and generated 8.5 times more comments, and this gap widened significantly over 86 weeks. Topic modeling of opposition arguments resolved into four reproducible clusters, resource consumption and scarcity (42.8%), contested siting processes and secrecy (34.2%), political opposition to data centers (13%), and political and corporate accountability (8%). Engagement analysis revealed that posts with emotional or provocative political framing attracted the most engagement, while key technical concerns (e.g., water, power) were dispersed across lower-engagement comment threads. These findings give local leaders, developers, and policy makers a quantified, continuously updatable basis for prioritizing concerns and policy levers, supporting a shift from opposition to negotiated, verifiable partnership for data center development.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出LLM驱动的观点挖掘框架，对近十年798条Reddit帖子和102,328条评论进行立场分类与主题建模，量化了美国数据中心建设遭遇的社区反对意见。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心建设快速扩张但公众参与滞后：2024年5月至2025年3月约640亿美元美国数据中心项目因地方反对被阻挠或延期，而驱动反对的核心关切尚缺乏系统刻画；传统调查、听证会等手段介入过晚，且尚无研究系统挖掘社交媒体以大规模测量社区立场。
AI.method: 构建LLM驱动的意见挖掘框架：采用开源大语言模型，结合Chain-of-Stance提示框架与三条领域专属标注规则进行立场分类，并以人工评审者间一致性上限为基准评估；随后对反对意见进行主题建模，并开展参与度分析。
AI.result: 立场分类达到人工评审者一致性上限的83%。反对帖数量为支持帖的2.6倍，评论量高出8.5倍，且该差距在86周内显著扩大。反对论点聚类为四类：资源消耗与稀缺(42.8%)、选址程序争议与保密性(34.2%)、对数据中心的政治性反对(13%)、政治与企业问责(8%)。情绪化或挑衅性政治框架的帖子获得最高参与度，而水、电等关键技术关切分散于低热度评论串中。
AI.conclusion: 研究为地方决策者、开发商与政策制定者提供了可量化、可持续更新的依据，用于排序关切重点与政策杠杆，推动数据中心开发从对立走向可协商、可验证的合作关系。

title: Formalizing Patient-Set Semantics for OMOP CDM-Based Clinical Trial Feasibility Assessment:A Neuro-Symbolic Methodology for Traceable Site-Feasibility Patient Counts
summary:
This study examines the interpretation and execution of natural-language eligibility criteria for clinical trial site-feasibility patient-count estimation using the OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). It treats each count as the size of a patient set produced under explicitly declared choices about clinical concepts, temporal conditions, exclusions, proxies, and available data.
  The study presents NS-CoT, a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses an LLM to interpret and structure criteria, followed by symbolic processing and deterministic SQL compilation. Intermediate representations and execution records document how criteria are translated into patient sets and counts.
  Evaluation uses synthetic OMOP CDM data, controlled benchmarks, and a multi-site simulation. Comparisons with a direct-SQL baseline examine execution success, count agreement, patient-set agreement, and preservation of reference-defined site-feasibility labels and rankings. Performance varies across evaluation settings. Layer-wise inspection also supports the identification of implementation and policy errors, followed by correction and re-evaluation.
  The work investigates the reviewability and fidelity of cohort computation relative to declared reference definitions. It does not establish that these definitions capture a unique clinical ground truth or demonstrate improved recruitment, site selection, or trial outcomes in practice.

AI.tldr: 该文提出神经符号流水线NS-CoT，用LLM解析临床试验自然语言入排标准并结合符号处理与确定性SQL编译，在OMOP CDM上估算各中心可行患者数；评估关注可审查性与对参考定义的一致性，而非临床真值或实际招募效果。
AI.motivation: 临床试验站点可行性评估需要按自然语言入排标准估算患者数，但标准中的临床概念、时间条件、排除项、代理指标与数据可得性存在多种解释选择，直接转SQL难以显式记录这些选择，导致结果不可审查、难以比较。
AI.method: NS-CoT：LLM负责解释并结构化标准，随后进行符号处理并编译为确定性SQL；将每个计数视为在显式声明的选择下生成的病人集合大小；用中间表示与执行记录留痕。评估采用合成OMOP CDM数据、受控基准与多站点模拟，并与直接SQL基线比较执行成功率、计数一致性、病人集合一致性及参考站点可行性标签与排序的保持程度。
AI.result: 性能随评估设置变化；分层检查可支持识别实现错误与策略错误，并据此修正后重新评估。
AI.conclusion: 工作聚焦队列计算相对于所声明参考定义的可审查性与保真度，未证明这些定义对应唯一临床真值，也未证明能改善实际招募、站点选择或试验结局。

title: Known Good, Known Bad: A Ground-Truth Calibration Protocol for AI Judgment in Science
summary:
Scientific use of generative AI requires evaluation against cases with independently checkable answers. We present a ground truth calibration protocol that compares a verified reference case with reference deviant variants through neutral evaluation, an authority framed recheck, and a line by line audit. Human adjudication distinguishes deviation detection, premise accommodation, unsupported doubt, and correctness of the resulting calculation.
  An instructor generated organic chemistry demonstration comprises six conversations and 18 responses from an unidentified backend served through the free logged out ChatGPT interface in July 2026. Neutral evaluation detected three of five intended deviations. Both initial misses, involving oxidant stoichiometry and experimental scale, were detected at the authority framed second turn; all five detections persisted at the third turn audit. The fixed sequence supports a descriptive account of recovery across turns. In the scale case, the model initially produced a locally coherent peroxide limited yield. After recognizing the unit problem, it incorrectly retained that limiting reagent conclusion for the corrected scale. Detection and numerical repair therefore require separate assessment. The verified reference attracted speculative concerns while retaining its correct yield calculation.
  The protocol connects documentary verification of scientific claims and citations with empirical verification of laboratory interpretations. It supplies inspectable transcripts, reference calculations, behavior codes, and a reusable calibration architecture for AI literacy instruction. The pilot demonstrates the protocol's measures in one case family; replicated model evaluation and learner assessment are the next validation steps.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种"真值校准协议"，通过中立评估、权威框架复检与逐行审计，对比已验证参考案例与其偏差变体，用于评估生成式AI在有机化学演示中的表现。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的科学使用需要以"答案可独立核验"的案例进行评估，而现有评估缺乏可复用的校准架构与可检查的判定标准。
AI.method: 设计真值校准协议：将已验证参考案例与参考偏差变体对照，采用三层递进评估（中立评估、权威框架复检、逐行审计），并由人工裁定区分四类行为：偏差检出、前提顺应、无依据质疑、结果计算正确性。案例为2026年7月免费未登录ChatGPT界面后端产生的6段对话、18条回答的有机化学演示。
AI.result: 中立评估检出5个预设偏差中的3个；两个漏检（氧化剂化学计量、实验规模）在权威框架第二轮被检出，且5项检出在第三轮审计中均保持。规模案例中模型先给出局部自洽的"过氧化物限量"产率，识别单位问题后仍错误沿用该限量试剂结论；参考案例则引发推测性质疑但仍保持正确产率计算。
AI.conclusion: 协议将科学主张与引文文献核验同实验室解释的经验核验相衔接，提供可检查的对话记录、参考计算、行为编码及可复用的校准架构，适用于AI素养教学；当前仅为单一案例族的试点，复制化模型评估与学习者测评是下一步验证工作。

title: Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies independently ignores differences in agents' precision needs, potentially degrading collective reasoning. We introduce Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization (CoMixKV), which combines online sensitivity estimation with joint agent-layer bit-width allocation under a shared memory budget. To our knowledge, CoMixKV is the first mixed-precision KV-cache quantization framework to jointly allocate precision across simultaneously resident agent caches under such a budget. The estimator derives sensitivity from a local attention-error bound using recent queries, keys, and values, without calibration data, trial quantization, or additional model passes. A shared controller combines these scores with remaining quantizable capacity and byte-level storage costs to minimize total estimated error. Allocations are refreshed as agents start or finish and new observations become available. Selected widths apply only to newly quantized blocks; recent states retain native precision and previously quantized blocks remain unchanged. Across four benchmarks and three LLM backbones at average 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit settings, CoMixKV achieves strong accuracy against the evaluated quantization baselines. At the average 3-bit setting on Gemma-4-31B-it, it achieves 68.35% average accuracy, exceeding the strongest quantized baseline by 0.59%. On Qwen3-32B, it reduces peak KV-cache memory by 32.08% and achieves a 1.38x inference speedup over FullKV.

AI.tldr: CoMixKV 是首个在共享内存预算下、对同时驻留的多智能体 KV 缓存进行跨智能体联合混合精度量化分配（协同精度分配）的框架，基于在线敏感度估计，无需校准数据或额外前向。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统通过协作完成复杂任务，但同时驻留的 KV 缓存不断累积，形成内存瓶颈。若对每个模型独立套用单一量化策略，会忽略不同智能体对精度需求的差异，可能损害群体推理质量。
AI.method: 核心为两点：1）在线敏感度估计器，基于局部注意力误差界，利用最近的 query/key/value 推导敏感度，无需校准数据、试量化或额外模型前向；2）共享控制器，将敏感度分数与剩余可量化容量、字节级存储开销结合，在共享内存预算下求解智能体—层级的比特宽度联合分配以最小化总估计误差。分配随智能体启停与新观测到来而刷新；所选位宽仅作用于新量化的块，近期状态保持原生精度，已量化块保持不变。
AI.result: 在四个基准、三个 LLM 骨干、平均 2/3/4-bit 设置下均取得优于所比较量化基线的精度。Gemma-4-31B-it 平均 3-bit 时平均精度 68.35%，比最强量化基线高 0.59%。Qwen3-32B 上峰值 KV 缓存内存降低 32.08%，相比 FullKV 推理加速 1.38 倍。
AI.conclusion: 在多智能体共享内存预算场景下，跨智能体协同的混合精度 KV 缓存量化可在不依赖校准的情况下兼顾精度与内存/速度收益，优于独立单一策略的量化方案。

title: Homeopathic Learning: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect
summary: We study homeopathic learning, a phenomenon where poisoned training data with little effect on its own can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added. In our experiments, a model fine-tuned only on a "poison" dataset associated with a trait T (such as speaking German or being misaligned) does not learn T. Surprisingly, adding similarly formatted "clean" data not associated with T causes the model to learn T. This effect requires that the poison data have an identifying "trigger" feature that is absent from the clean data. We demonstrate this effect in a variety of settings: subliminal learning of backdoor behaviors, inoculation prompting of reward hacking transcripts, generalization from archaic bird names, and an MNIST classifier with mislabeled data. We propose a simple regression model as an explanation. In the poison data, the task and trigger always co-occur, and regularization favors attributing T to the task. Clean data without the trigger causes T to be attributed to the trigger instead. Consequently, the same training examples can have little effect as part of one training set but create a misalignment backdoor in another. This finding exposes a potential limitation of safety methods that audit or filter training data in isolation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"顺势学习"(homeopathic learning)现象:单独对目标任务影响极小的毒化数据,在与格式相似的干净数据混合训练后,会形成隐藏后门。
AI.motivation: 现有安全方法通常孤立地审计或过滤训练数据。作者希望揭示:单独看无害或无效的毒化数据,在特定数据组合下可能产生后门,从而暴露这类审计范式的潜在局限。
AI.method: 实验覆盖多种设定:后门行为的潜意识学习、对奖励黑客记录的"接种式"提示、古鸟名泛化、以及标签错误的MNIST分类器。核心条件是毒化数据须含一个干净数据中不存在的可识别"触发"特征。作者并提出了一个简单回归模型来解释机理。
AI.result: 仅用与特质T(如说德语或被对齐失当)相关的毒化数据微调时,模型不学会T;加入格式相似的干净数据后,模型反而学会T。同一批训练样本在一个训练集中几乎无效果,在另一个训练集中却能制造失对齐后门。
AI.conclusion: 在毒化数据中任务与触发总是共现,正则化倾向于把T归因于任务;当加入无触发的干净数据后,T被转而归因于触发特征,从而形成后门。这说明孤立审计/过滤训练数据的安全方法存在根本性局限,需考虑数据组合效应。

title: From User Behaviors to Satisfaction Judgments: Reasoning about User Satisfaction with AI Overviews
summary: The growing presence of AI overviews in everyday search makes their effective evaluation essential. Response quality has been the primary focus of existing evaluation research, with only a small number of studies examining the user perspective. These evaluations rely on queries and response content, leaving the information conveyed by user behavior insufficiently utilized. This work investigates satisfaction prediction for AI overviews from a user-centered perspective and incorporates behavioral signals into the prediction process. Applying existing behavior-based satisfaction prediction methods from traditional information retrieval to this setting, however, presents limitations. We address these limitations with STaRS, an LLM-based approach designed specifically for predicting satisfaction with AI overviews. At its core is a structured reasoning procedure: individual behavioral signals are interpreted first, and their implications then inform the prediction of user satisfaction. Reinforcement learning further optimizes this procedure, while a reward shaping mechanism alleviates reward sparsity during training. Evaluation on two real-world datasets demonstrates that STaRS outperforms the comparison methods in satisfaction prediction, providing search providers with a practical means of accurately estimating users' satisfaction with AI overviews.

AI.tldr: STaRS：一种基于大语言模型的AI概览满意度预测方法，通过结构化推理与强化学习融合用户行为信号，在两个真实数据集上优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: AI概览在日常搜索中日益普及，其有效评估至关重要。现有评估研究主要聚焦响应质量，仅有少量工作关注用户视角，且这些评估依赖查询与响应内容，用户行为所传达的信息未被充分利用。此外，将传统信息检索中基于行为的满意度预测方法直接迁移到该场景存在局限。
AI.method: 提出STaRS，一种专为AI概览满意度预测设计的LLM方法。核心是结构化推理流程：先逐一解释单个行为信号，再以其含义指导用户满意度预测；采用强化学习优化该流程，并引入奖励塑形机制缓解训练中的奖励稀疏问题。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的评估表明，STaRS在满意度预测上优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: STaRS为搜索服务提供方提供了准确估计用户对AI概览满意度的实用手段，并凸显了以用户为中心、融合行为信号进行AI概览评估的价值。

title: Silinx: An Open, Browser-Based HDL Design Platform for Teaching Digital Systems on FPGA Boards
summary: Many digital systems courses teach on FPGA boards whose vendor tool is no longer maintained: the Digilent Basys2 and Nexys2 (Xilinx Spartan-3E) and Nexys3 and Atlys (Spartan-6) need Xilinx ISE 14.7, discontinued since 2013 and hard to install on the computers and tablets students use today. The author presents Silinx, a free (AGPL-3.0) HDL design platform for teaching that keeps ISE's Project Navigator workflow but runs in a web browser with nothing to install. A module can be written in VHDL or Verilog, in C or C++ through Silinx HLS, which is compatible with AMD's Vitis HLS and passes all 73 of its introductory examples, or drawn as a schematic, an ASM chart, a state diagram, a Boolean function with its Karnaugh map, or a Petri net, from which its HDL is generated. Designs are checked with explanations written for beginners, simulated, run on an emulated board, built, and programmed onto a real board over WebUSB. The implementation flow is open and runs in the browser: Yosys and nextpnr compiled to WebAssembly, with Silinx's own device data, timing model and bitstream writer for the Spartan-3E and Spartan-6, built by black-box observation of ISE's documented tools; Lattice iCE40 boards use the existing open iCE40 tools, and further families are planned. ISE is the oracle: Silinx's bitstreams are byte-identical to those ISE writes for the same placed and routed design, and pass ISE's design rule check. Against ISE at the same optimization goal, the open flow uses 15% fewer slices with 14% shorter critical paths when optimizing for area, and 21% fewer slices with 8% shorter critical paths when optimizing for speed (geometric means over 45 open-source designs built by both flows). The author also describes how the platform was developed with AI coding agents under test-first project rules.

AI.tldr: Silinx 是一个免费（AGPL-3.0）的浏览器内 HDL 教学平台，保留 ISE Project Navigator 工作流、无需安装，支持多语言/多入口设计输入、WebUSB 上板，并以 Yosys+nextpnr（WebAssembly）自建 Spartan-3E/-6 后端，比特流与 ISE 逐字节一致且面积/时序优于 ISE。
AI.motivation: 许多数字系统课程仍使用 Digilent Basys2/Nexys2（Spartan-3E）与 Nexys3/Atlys（Spartan-6）等 FPGA 板卡，其依赖的 Xilinx ISE 14.7 已于 2013 年停止维护，难以在学生当前的电脑与平板上安装；需要一种免安装、保留原有教学流程的可替代平台。
AI.method: 提出 Silinx：浏览器内运行、无安装的教学用 HDL 设计平台，沿用 ISE Project Navigator 的工程流程。设计输入支持 VHDL/Verilog、经 Silinx HLS（兼容 Vitis HLS，通过其全部 73 个入门示例）的 C/C++，以及原理图、ASM 图、状态图、带卡诺图的布尔函数、Petri 网并自动生成 HDL。具备面向初学者的解释性检查、仿真、仿真板运行、综合实现与经 WebUSB 对真实板卡编程。实现流程开源并在浏览器内执行：Yosys 与 nextpnr 编译为 WebAssembly，配合自研的 Spartan-3E/-6 器件数据、时序模型与比特流写入器（通过对 ISE 文档化工具的黑盒观测构建）；iCE40 板卡复用现有开源工具。
AI.result: 以 ISE 为基准：相同布局布线设计下比特流与 ISE 输出逐字节一致，并通过 ISE 的 DRC 检查。在相同优化目标下，对 45 个两流程均构建的开源设计取几何平均：面积优化时切片少 15%、关键路径短 14%；速度优化时切片少 21%、关键路径短 8%。文中还描述了在测试先行的项目规则下使用 AI 编码代理开发该平台的过程。
AI.conclusion: Silinx 证明可在浏览器中以免安装方式复现并超越 ISE 的教学流程：开源 WebAssembly 实现流程在比特流层面与 ISE 完全等价，同时在面积与关键路径上均优于 ISE，为老旧 Spartan 教学板卡提供了可持续的替代方案。

title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening
summary: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: 提出 TrialJev：基于 LoRA 微调的 Qwen 模型加指针头，单次前向传播对自然语言选项打分，实现临床试验筛选的高效、本地化初筛，准确率优于生成式微调基线且推理快 2.45–2.70 倍。
AI.motivation: 临床试验筛选需评估大量患者-试验配对以优先排序，且常受患者记录不可外传的隐私限制，需要可本地部署、高效且隐私友好的打分器。
AI.method: 采用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型（9B–27B）加指针头，单次前向传播直接对自然语言答案选项打分，无需自回归解码；在 TREC Clinical Trials 2021 上训练，并在 50 名未见 TREC 2022 合成患者的 6,975 个合格/排除配对上评估；含 A/B-logit 消融与统一的决策校正实验。
AI.result: 准确率 80.97%（Qwen3.5-27B）与 81.84%（Qwen3.8-27B），高于同数据微调的生成式判定模型（79.87%/79.93%）；batch-1 匹配测量下生成式耗时为一趟推理的 2.45–2.70 倍；经决策校正后两模型达 80.99%/81.88%，与专有 Jev API 的 81.28% 差异的配对置信区间含零；27B 单卡本地运行约 178 ms/对；消融表明效率优势主要来自避免解码而非指针头本身。
AI.conclusion: TrialJev 可作为候选试验的一线优先级排序工具，补充而非替代可解释模型与人工临床审查；局限在于仅用合成患者、计时依赖具体实现、临床有效性未验证；适配器、指针头与模型卡已开源发布于 Hugging Face。

title: What Is the Value of AI-Involved Art? Evidence From a Juried In-Person Exhibition
summary: What is the value of AI-involved art, and to whom does it belong? We begin to answer these questions using data from an in-person, juried AI art exhibition.
