Our study involved artists, lawyers, and computer scientists (N=209) as either creators or evaluators of AI-involved artworks. We found that nearly half of evaluators reported willingness to buy an artwork, with pricing correlating with perceived artistic value---creativity and visual appeal---as well as the effort necessary to create it. In contrast, three-quarters of creators reported willingness to sell at prices correlating only with effort rather than artistic value. Both groups viewed prompting users and AI developers as deserving rewards and rights, leaving training data artists behind. Disciplinary training shaped these views: participants with legal training favored distributed reward models. These findings have implications for future research on human-AI creative collaboration and policy debates regarding AI-involved works.

AI.tldr: 基于一场线下评审制AI艺术展的数据（N=209，含艺术家、律师、计算机科学家作为创作者或评估者），考察AI参与艺术品的价值来源与权利归属。
AI.motivation: 回答两个核心问题：AI参与艺术的价值由什么决定，以及这一价值应归属于谁；为AI参与创作的价值评估与权利分配提供实证依据。
AI.method: 线下评审制AI艺术展实地研究；209名具备艺术、法律、计算机科学背景的参与者分别担任创作者或评估者，收集购买/出售意愿、定价与奖励及权利归属判断，并比较学科训练的影响。
AI.result: 近半数评估者表示愿意购买，其定价与感知艺术价值（创造力、视觉吸引力）及创作所需努力相关；约四分之三创作者愿意出售，但其定价仅与努力相关、与艺术价值无关。两类群体均认为提示词使用者与AI开发者应获得回报与权利，而训练数据艺术家被忽视；法律背景者更倾向分布式回报模型。
AI.conclusion: 创作者与评估者对AI艺术价值的判断标准存在系统性错配（努力 vs. 艺术价值），且权利归属认知普遍偏向提示者与开发者、边缘化训练数据来源艺术家；学科训练塑造上述观念。研究为人机创造性协作研究与AI作品政策讨论提供启示。

title: A Tool for Anonymized Clinical Knowledge Retrieval and Speaker Interaction Analysis of Healthcare Tele-mentoring Sessions
summary: We present a tool for anonymized retrieval of clinical knowledge and analysis of multi-speaker interactions in tele-mentoring sessions of Project ECHO (Extension for Community Healthcare Outcomes). Our tool's novel design includes: (a) a compound metadata filter that enforces strict speaker- and session-level isolation during retrieval, preventing cross-session context contamination; (b) MedGemma-4B as a locally-hosted language model for clinically grounded answer generation across three query modes; (c) interaction graphs to compute betweenness centrality, PageRank influence, and turn-taking patterns to quantify participation equity; and (d) a consistent alias-based anonymization scheme that prevents real participant names from appearing in any rendered output. During the demo, a healthcare provider (user) will interactively query multi-year ECHO sessions, explore participation dynamics through interaction graphs, compare sessions side-by-side, and assess answer quality via six reference-free RAG metrics, all without any cloud API dependency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于Project ECHO远程导师会议的工具：在本地部署MedGemma-4B，实现匿名化临床知识检索与多说话人互动分析，包含会话级隔离过滤、互动图参与公平性度量与别名匿名化，全程无需云API。
AI.motivation: 远程导师（tele-mentoring）场景下的多年度会议音视频蕴含丰富临床知识与参与动态，但直接复用面临跨会话上下文污染、参与者隐私泄露以及依赖云端API的合规与成本问题，缺少一个可一体化完成知识检索与参与公平性分析的工具。
AI.method: 工具设计包含四部分：(a) 复合元数据过滤器，在检索时强制说话人与会话级双重隔离，防止跨会话上下文污染；(b) 本地托管的MedGemma-4B语言模型，支持三种查询模式生成临床依据充分的答案；(c) 构建互动图，计算介数中心性、PageRank影响力与轮次转换模式以量化参与公平性；(d) 一致的别名匿名化方案，确保任何渲染输出中不出现真实姓名。演示中以六项无参考RAG指标评估答案质量。
AI.result: 演示中医疗从业者可交互式查询多年ECHO会话、通过互动图探索参与动态、并排比较不同会话，并用六项无参考RAG指标评估答案质量，全流程无云端API依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工具将匿名化检索、本地化临床LLM生成与多说话人互动分析集成于单一系统，在保障隐私与数据隔离的前提下支持远程导师会议的临床知识复用与参与公平性评估。

title: AI and Mathematical Work on Mastodon: Attention, Topics, and Target-Specific Evaluations
summary: How does a mathematical community discuss AI on a federated social platform? We study 24,920 public posts from January--September 2026 by 272 accounts in a fixed roster of 1,002 Mastodon accounts whose profiles indicate mathematical research or study. LLM-assisted extraction identifies 1,191 AI-for-mathematics posts by 101 accounts. Their share of all posts rises from 1.1\% in January to 11.5\% in September, with contributing accounts increasing from 10 to 59. We represent discussion through linked target--aspect--stance triples, separating what is discussed from the property assessed and the author's evaluation. From July to September, capability and usefulness decline as a share of related discussion, while social and institutional concerns increase; changing contributors account for much of the latter shift. Among 38 accounts evaluating both technical quality or utility and communication, credit, or verification procedures, the procedural negative-component fraction is 19.4 percentage points higher on average (95\% account-bootstrap interval: 3.8--35.1). Matching targets within posts gives a similar direction. Repeated extraction varies substantially at the level of individual triples, although replacing the repeated sample preserves the aggregate contrast. Around OpenAI's October 6 mathematics release, related-post share rises from 9.6\% to 13.6\%, and contributing accounts increase from 13 to 28. Post-release discussion includes appreciation of the results' potential mathematical value and applications alongside criticism of promotion centered on result counts, limited methodological disclosure, and verification arrangements.

AI.tldr: 基于Mastodon数学社群24,920条公开帖，用LLM辅助抽取1,191条AI-for-mathematics讨论，以"目标—方面—立场"三元组建模，揭示讨论重心从能力/实用性转向社会与制度性关切，且对程序性维度的评价显著更负面。
AI.motivation: 既有关于AI与科学的公共讨论研究多集中于通用社交平台或职业社群整体，缺乏对数学这一特定学科社群在联邦式（去中心化）平台上如何讨论AI的系统刻画；同时需要区分"讨论什么"、"评估哪个属性"与"持何立场"，以避免把话题流行度误当作态度。
AI.method: 选取固定名册的1,002个Mastodon账号（简介表明从事数学研究或学习），采集2026年1—9月24,920条公开帖；用LLM辅助抽取AI-for-mathematics帖（1,191条，来自101个账号）。将讨论表示为"目标—方面—立场"三元组，把讨论对象、被评估属性与作者评价分离。比较7—9月各方面占比变化并做贡献者更换分解；对38个同时评价技术质量/效用与沟通、署名、验证程序的账号做配对比较，采用账号bootstrap给出区间；用帖内目标匹配做稳健性检验；重复抽取评估稳定性；考察OpenAI 10月6日数学发布前后的变化。
AI.result: AI-for-math帖占比从1月1.1%升至9月11.5%，贡献账号由10增至59；7—9月能力与实用性占比下降，社会与制度性关切上升，后者变化很大程度由贡献者更替解释。38个账号中，程序性（沟通/署名/验证）的负面成分比例平均高19.4个百分点（95%账号bootstrap区间3.8—35.1），帖内目标匹配方向一致。重复抽取在单个三元组层面波动较大，但替换重复样本后聚合对比仍成立。10月6日发布前后，相关帖占比由9.6%升至13.6%，贡献账号13增至28；发布后讨论既肯定结果的潜在数学价值与应用，也批评以成果数量为核心的宣传、方法披露不足与验证安排。
AI.conclusion: 数学社群对AI的讨论正从能力/实用性叙事转向社会与制度性关切，且贡献者构成变化是重要驱动；对可验证性与署名等程序性维度，同一批账号给出的评价系统性更负面。目标—方面—立场三元组是有用的细粒度分析框架，但LLM抽取在个体层面不稳定，结论应建立在聚合与配对设计上。

title: Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness
summary: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向异质特征空间的分组鲁棒学习框架：以“最差分组超额损失”替代最差分组损失作为优化目标，并用分组专属编码器映射到共享隐空间、以可学习高斯锚点按结局聚类，实现跨分组知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 临床中不同患者接受不同检查组合，形成异质甚至完全不相交的特征空间。现有方法（如对高损失患者加权）存在两个问题：一是高损失可能仅源于特征信息量不足而非模型不佳，盲目加权会误导优化；二是当各组特征空间完全不相交时退化为独立训练，无法跨组迁移知识。
AI.method: 将“组”定义为共享同一特征空间的患者集合。优化目标从最差分组损失改为最差分组超额损失（组损失与其可达最优值估计之差），以剔除特征本身不可分性带来的不可约损失。为促进组间协作，为每组配备专属编码器并映射至共享隐空间，在隐空间中以可学习的高斯锚点按结局对患者进行聚类。
AI.result: 在表格与影像医学数据集（含特征完全不相交的设置）上，当各组最优损失不同或单组无法训练出良好模型时，优于现有最先进方法：最差分组损失最多降低79%，超额损失最多降低95%，参数量最多减少18倍。
AI.conclusion: 以超额损失为鲁棒优化目标并结合共享隐空间的高斯锚点对齐，是应对异质特征空间下分组鲁棒性与跨组知识迁移的有效方案，且参数效率更高。

title: WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have continuous deficiency in spatial reasoning tasks that require \emph{mental spatial transformation}, such as reasoning under hypothetical changes in viewpoint or position, known as perspective-taking tasks. Existing approaches either scale linguistic reasoning or augment VLMs with static geometric representations, but neither directly enables active transformation of the represented scene. World models offer this capability, yet existing systems typically communicate through synthesized RGB images, introducing a latent-to-pixel-to-latent bottleneck. We introduce \emph{WorldMind}, a framework for test-time scaling of spatial reasoning through latent world simulation. Given a query and observation, the VLM selects useful spatial transformations, while a world model executes them and exposes aligned intermediate latent features directly to the VLM. The resulting latent evidence is incorporated into subsequent reasoning steps, enabling iterative spatial simulation without repeatedly decoding imagined states into pixels. To optimize this interaction, WorldMind further employs process-verifiable reinforcement learning that rewards reasoning progress only when the associated action and latent transition are valid. WorldMind thus scales spatial reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation to active world simulation rather than generating more language or pixels. Across VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and MindCube-Tiny, WorldMind achieves an average improvement of 16.0% over the base VLM and 8.3% over the strongest RGB-based world simulation.

AI.tldr: WorldMind通过隐空间世界模型在测试时模拟空间变换，将中间隐特征直接注入VLM推理，避免隐-像素-隐瓶颈，并结合过程可验证强化学习优化交互。
AI.motivation: VLM在心智空间变换（如视角/位置假设变化下的视角采择）上持续存在缺陷；现有方法仅靠语言推理扩展或注入静态几何表示，均无法主动变换场景表示；已有世界模型多通过合成RGB图像通信，带来latent-to-pixel-to-latent瓶颈。
AI.method: WorldMind框架：给定查询与观测，VLM选择有用的空间变换，世界模型执行变换并将对齐的中间隐特征直接暴露给VLM，作为潜证据进入后续推理步骤，实现迭代式空间模拟而无需反复将想象状态解码为像素；采用过程可验证强化学习，仅在动作与隐状态转移均有效时奖励推理进展。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench与MindCube-Tiny上，平均较基座VLM提升16.0%，较最强RGB-based世界模拟方法提升8.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将额外推理期计算分配给主动世界模拟而非生成更多语言或像素，WorldMind有效提升了VLM的空间推理能力。

title: DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback
summary: Reliable function calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to select appropriate functions and generate arguments consistent with user intent. However, syntactically valid calls may still be semantically incorrect due to inappropriate function selection or mismatched arguments. In this paper, we propose Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling (DM-Call), a framework that combines local schema validation with separate decision-model verification of function selection and argument correctness. For rejected candidates, DM-Call accumulates verification probabilities, binary judgments, and schema errors across attempts. A hybrid feedback representation further combines numerical probabilities with verbal correctness labels to guide iterative refinement without executing external tools. Extensive evaluation across BFCL and API-Bank (first-call) demonstrates DM-Call boosts function-calling accuracy versus direct generation, at modest additional cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 DM-Call 框架，结合本地 schema 校验与独立决策模型对函数选择及参数正确性的验证，累积跨尝试的验证概率、二元判断与 schema 错误，并用数值概率与语言标签的混合反馈引导迭代精化，在 BFCL 与 API-Bank 上以较小额外开销提升函数调用准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM 函数调用中，语法合法的调用仍可能因函数选择不当或参数与用户意图不匹配而在语义上出错，仅靠格式校验无法保证调用正确性。
AI.method: DM-Call：1）本地 schema 校验；2）由独立的决策模型分别验证函数选择与参数正确性；3）对被拒绝的候选累积验证概率、二元判断和 schema 错误；4）采用数值概率与语言正确性标签结合的混合反馈表示，在不执行外部工具的前提下引导迭代精化。
AI.result: 在 BFCL 和 API-Bank（首调用场景）上的大量评测显示，DM-Call 相比直接生成提升了函数调用准确率，且额外开销适中。
AI.conclusion: 将校验与生成解耦、引入独立决策模型验证并配合混合反馈的迭代机制，可在低成本下有效改善函数调用的语义正确性。

title: Perils and opportunities of AI for public climate services
summary: The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly generative and machine-learning systems, in climate services development and provision is transforming how climate information is produced, accessed, and interpreted. AI-enabled climate services offer significant opportunities for process automation, optimisation, tailoring, and the translation of complex climate data into actionable knowledge for diverse users. However, the growing reliance on privately controlled algorithms, data infrastructures, and computing facilities raises critical concerns related to governance, transparency, equity and economic sustainability, among others. While the technical architecture of climate services increasingly relies on advanced machine learning and large-scale climate models, their legitimacy as public services may be weakened in the absence of arrangements that prioritise public value and long-lasting societal benefit over profit maximisation. The tension between the public mandate of climate services and the private nature of AI infrastructure challenges traditional notions of openness. Using a consensus-based elicitation method coupled with the PESTLE framework, we analyse the political, economic, social, technological, legal, and environmental risks and opportunities shaping the co-production value chain of AI-enabled climate services. We draw policy-relevant conclusions for data, model and infrastructure supporting the next generation of upstream and downstream climate services as critical applications for society. Our work presents potential and plausible challenges and benefits for a pan-European, decentralised public climate service built on sovereign AI infrastructure and open governance principles.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式与机器学习系统在气候服务中的快速渗透所带来的治理、透明、公平与经济可持续性挑战，并基于共识启发式方法与PESTLE框架，梳理AI赋能气候服务协同生产价值链中的风险与机遇，进而提出面向泛欧、去中心化、基于主权AI基础设施与开放治理原则的公共气候服务的政策建议。
AI.motivation: AI（尤其是生成式与机器学习系统）正深刻改变气候信息的生产、获取与解读方式，带来流程自动化、优化、定制化与复杂数据可行动化等机遇；但对私有算法、数据基础设施与算力的依赖引发治理、透明度、公平与经济可持续性等关切。气候服务的公共属性与AI基础设施的私有属性之间存在张力，威胁其作为公共服务的合法性与开放性。
AI.method: 采用基于共识的启发式征询方法（consensus-based elicitation），结合PESTLE框架，系统分析影响AI赋能气候服务协同生产价值链的政治、经济、社会、技术、法律与环境维度的风险与机遇。
AI.result: 识别并归类了AI赋能气候服务价值链中跨PESTLE六维的潜在与可能挑战及收益，涵盖数据、模型与基础设施层面，并指出在缺乏以公共价值和长期社会效益优先于利润最大化为导向的制度安排时，气候服务作为公共服务的合法性可能被削弱。
AI.conclusion: 为支撑下一代上下游气候服务这一关键社会应用，需在数据、模型与基础设施层面制定政策相关结论；论文提出泛欧、去中心化、依托主权AI基础设施与开放治理原则的公共气候服务路径，以在公共使命与私有AI基础设施之间重建开放性与公共价值。

title: Projected Neural Additive Models as Universal Approximators
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Neural additive models (NAMs) offer interpretability but lack expressivity due to their rigid additive structure, whereas multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) achieve universal approximation at the cost of transparency. We establish the first theoretical foundation for projected neural additive models (PNAMs), which augment NAMs with a learnable linear transformation $\boldsymbol{T}$ to capture cross-variable interactions. While standard NAMs cannot approximate even the simplest interaction term $χ_1 χ_2$ because their cross-derivatives are identically zero, we prove that PNAMs are universal approximators and characterize the minimum number of projections required for exact polynomial representation. Furthermore, we derive an approximation rate of $\mathcal{O}(M^{-s / (N - 1)})$ for $\mathcal{C}^s$ functions (i.e., functions with $s$ continuous derivatives), where $M$ denotes the number of projections and $N$ the input dimension; this rate is known to be optimal for ridge function approximation. To recover interpretability from the projected inputs, we introduce structured sparsity regularizers and post-hoc symbolic regression techniques that enable global input ranking, parameter pruning, and the conversion of learned bases into compact analytical expressions. Experiments on knot theory invariants, MNIST, and phase field fracture mechanics demonstrate that PNAMs match or surpass similar architectures in accuracy while discovering salient features and yielding symbolic models with orders of magnitude fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文为投影神经加性模型（PNAMs）建立首个理论基础：引入可学习线性变换 T 捕捉跨变量交互，证明其具备通用逼近性、给出精确多项式表示所需最少投影数，并推导最优逼近率 O(M^{-s/(N-1)})；同时借助结构化稀疏正则与事后符号回归恢复可解释性，在多个任务上精度不降且参数更少。
AI.motivation: 神经加性模型（NAMs）可解释但刚性加性结构限制表达力，甚至无法逼近最简单的交互项 χ₁χ₂；多层感知机（MLPs）具通用逼近能力却缺乏透明性。作者希望在保留可解释性的同时获得交互建模与通用逼近能力。
AI.method: 在 NAM 基础上增加可学习线性变换 T（投影），构建 PNAM；理论上分析其交叉导数、通用逼近性、精确多项式表示所需最少投影数，并推导 C^s 函数逼近率。可解释性方面采用结构化稀疏正则实现全局输入排序与参数剪枝，并用事后符号回归将学习到的基函数转化为紧凑解析表达式。
AI.result: 证明标准 NAM 因交叉导数恒为零而无法逼近 χ₁χ₂；PNAM 为通用逼近器，并刻画精确多项式表示所需的最小投影数；对 C^s 函数得到 O(M^{-s/(N-1)}) 的逼近率（该速率在岭函数逼近中已知最优）。在纽结理论不变量、MNIST 与相场断裂力学实验中，PNAM 精度匹配或超过同类架构，同时发现显著特征并给出参数量少几个数量级的符号模型。
AI.conclusion: PNAM 在保持可解释性的前提下突破 NAM 的表达力瓶颈，兼具理论保证（通用逼近、最优速率）与实用可解释性工具（稀疏正则、符号回归），实现了精度与紧凑性的兼顾。

title: DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report
summary: Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepResearch RewardBench，首个面向深度研究报告的奖励建模评测基准，含成对/三元/四元偏好数据，发现现有奖励模型在评估研究报告时性能显著下降，而生成式LLM作为评判者更具优势。
AI.motivation: 深度研究系统结合多步网络检索与信息综合生成研究报告，其长上下文、高信息密度、领域特异性使人类评估成本过高，需以AI评估替代；但现有奖励模型或LLM能否有效理解并评估此类报告缺乏研究。
AI.method: 从多个智能体或工具增强LLM收集多样化候选报告，依据查询特定的黄金评分细则（golden rubrics）打分；通过多轮过滤与人工校验保证数据质量与难度；构建成对、三元组、四元组三种格式的偏好数据集，以测试不同难度下的排序能力；开展大量实验对比奖励模型与生成式LLM评判者。
AI.result: 现有奖励模型虽能较好处理一般连贯性，但在评估研究报告时性能显著退化；生成式LLM作为评判者在该领域展现出全面优势，且比较式评估优于直接打分方式。
AI.conclusion: DeepResearch RewardBench可作为评估与推进研究型智能体发展的重要测试平台。

title: Slim Foundation Models for Latency-Critical Recommendation Serving
summary: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is a core component of recommendation and advertising systems. Large language models (LLMs) offer rich semantic priors that improve prediction quality, particularly in cold-start and long-tail settings. Injecting a full-scale LLM into a CTR pipeline is, however, prohibitively expensive at inference time: existing LLM-enhanced CTR methods avoid this cost by caching LLM outputs offline rather than serving the LLM online. We propose a resource-efficient pipeline, SlimFM, that makes online LLM-based semantic modeling practical: (1) dependency-aware structured pruning compresses LLaMA3-8B by 44% to a 4.5B-parameter backbone; (2) LoRA-based field-aware fine-tuning trains the pruned model to produce discriminative field-level semantic embeddings from lightweight textual prompts; (3) a semantic-guided fusion module injects these embeddings into the feature interactions of a conventional CTR model. Across four datasets and six CTR backbones, SlimFM retains over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy while reducing inference latency by up to 3.4x relative to existing LLM-enhanced baselines.

AI.tldr: SlimFM 提出一套资源高效的 CTR 预测流程：通过结构化剪枝将 LLaMA3-8B 压缩至 4.5B 参数（−44%），再用 LoRA 领域感知微调生成字段级语义嵌入，并由语义引导融合模块注入传统 CTR 模型的特征交互中，从而在保持 99% 以上精度的同时将在线推理延迟降低至多 3.4 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 的语义先验能显著提升 CTR 预测，尤其在冷启动与长尾场景；但在线部署全尺寸 LLM 推理成本过高，现有 LLM 增强方法只能离线缓存 LLM 输出，无法在线服务 LLM。因此需要让在线 LLM 语义建模变得可行且经济。
AI.method: 三步流程：(1) 依赖感知的结构化剪枝，将 LLaMA3-8B 压缩 44% 得到 4.5B 参数骨干；(2) 基于 LoRA 的字段感知微调，使剪枝后模型能从轻量文本提示中生成具有判别性的字段级语义嵌入；(3) 语义引导融合模块，将这些嵌入注入传统 CTR 模型的特征交互中。
AI.result: 在四个数据集、六种 CTR 骨干模型上，SlimFM 保留了未压缩模型 99% 以上的精度，相对现有 LLM 增强基线将推理延迟降低至多 3.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过剪枝、LoRA 微调与语义融合的组合，SlimFM 使在线 LLM 语义建模在工业级成本约束下变得可行，兼顾精度与效率，为 LLM 增强的 CTR 预测提供了实用化路径。

title: Hidden Distances: How Likert-Scale Spacing Shapes Algorithmic Voting Advice
summary: Voting Advice Applications (VAAs) are algorithmic recommenders that match voters with political candidates on policy preferences. They are widely adopted across many multi-party democracies; in Denmark, 62\% of eligible voters used a VAA ahead of the 2022 general election, and 45\% of VAA users reported following its advice. VAAs typically ask voters and candidates to respond to policy statements on a Likert scale, from ``strongly disagree'' to ``strongly agree'', and recommend candidates whose responses are closest to the voter's. Computing these distances requires assigning numbers to response options, a design choice without an empirical basis, since it is unknown how people perceive the distances between options. Here we show that this seemingly technical choice substantially changes whom voters are matched with. We parameterize the distance between ``(dis)agree'' and ``strongly (dis)agree'' relative to the distance between ``neutral'' and ``(dis)agree'' as $α$, and quantify how it changes recommendations for a popular Danish VAA. We find that moving from equidistant options to doubling this distance can change $37.7\%$ of top candidate matches and $21.9\%$ of top party matches, although no answers change. Low $α$-values favor candidates with strong positions, with some parties receiving up to $ 19.6\%$ more recommendations, while high $α$-values favor moderates. Similarly, female candidates receive fewer recommendations at low $α$ and more at high $α$-values. Our findings demonstrate that undisclosed quantification choices in algorithmic recommenders can carry considerable electoral consequences, and they call for transparency and sensitivity analysis in VAA design. As Likert-based matching also underpins dating platforms and roommate allocation systems, these implications extend well beyond elections.

AI.tldr: 投票建议应用（VAA）将Likert选项赋值为数字时的“技术性”距离选择会显著改变候选人/政党匹配结果，且不改变任何回答。
AI.motivation: VAA广泛使用（丹麦2022年大选62%合格选民使用，45%用户遵从建议），但其计算距离时对Likert选项赋值缺乏实证依据，人们如何感知选项间距离未知，该设计选择的影响未被量化。
AI.method: 将“(不)同意”与“强烈(不)同意”之间的距离相对于“中立”与“(不)同意”之间的距离参数化为α，对一个流行的丹麦VAA量化α变化对推荐结果的影响，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 从等距选项到该距离加倍，可改变37.7%的首选候选人匹配和21.9%的首选政党匹配，而回答完全不变；低α偏向立场强烈者，部分政党获最多19.6%更多推荐，高α偏向温和者；女性候选人在低α下获更少推荐、高α下更多。
AI.conclusion: 算法推荐器中未公开的量化选择可带来可观的选择性后果，呼吁VAA设计中的透明度与敏感性分析；该问题亦适用于约会平台和室友分配等基于Likert匹配的场景。

title: Fast Accurate Quantum Monte Carlo without Metropolis Adjustment
summary: In quantum systems, physical quantities of interest can be expressed as expectation values of a probability distribution, which allows their estimation by Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. This approach, an instance of Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC), plays a central role in obtaining predictions of system properties relevant to condensed matter and high energy physics. The use of Hamiltonian dynamics to design a Markov kernel, known as Hybrid or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), is widespread in quantum applications. In this context, it is standard to use an HMC kernel that is ``adjusted'' with the Metropolis-Hastings (MH) criterion, so that estimates of expectations converge to their true value in the limit of infinite sample size. However, recent work in computational statistics suggests that an \emph{unadjusted} HMC kernel can be significantly more efficient, while safely maintaining an asymptotic bias which is small relative to the error arising from the variance of the finite sample size. We adapt this approach to the QMC setting, focusing on a challenging and high-dimensional \emph{spin-fermion} model of a quantum phase transition. We find that unadjusted methods outperform adjusted HMC in terms of effective sample size per gradient call, while retaining accurate results.

AI.tldr: 将计算统计中的无调整HMC（unadjusted HMC）引入量子蒙特卡洛，在自旋-费米量子相变模型上验证其每梯度调用有效样本量优于经MH调整的HMC，且结果仍然准确。
AI.motivation: 量子系统的物理量可写成概率分布的期望，可用QMC/MCMC估计；HMC在量子应用中常用，但通常需Metropolis-Hastings调整以保证渐近无偏，计算开销大。近期统计文献表明无调整HMC效率更高，其渐近偏差相对有限样本方差误差很小，作者希望将这一结论迁移到QMC场景并加以检验。
AI.method: 以哈密顿动力学构造马尔可夫核（HMC），去除MH接受/拒绝步骤得到无调整HMC核；将其应用于高维、难处理的自旋-费米量子相变模型，以每次梯度调用的有效样本量（ESS per gradient call）为指标，与标准调整型HMC对比，并检查结果准确性（偏差是否在可接受范围）。
AI.result: 在自旋-费米量子相变模型上，无调整HMC在每梯度调用有效样本量方面优于调整型HMC，同时保持结果准确，即偏差相对有限样本方差误差可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 无调整HMC可作为QMC中替代调整型HMC的高效采样方案，适用于高维量子多体与量子相变问题的期望值估计。

title: AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement
summary: Existing LLM post-training quantization techniques determine precision before inference begins, yet the precision a model requires varies dynamically across prompts, layers, and inference phases. We present AutoEMatic, a full-stack co-design that adapts the precision of weights, activations, and the KV cache at runtime. A lightweight policy selects each layer's precision at every prefill and decode step from two runtime signals: the entropy of the next-token distribution and the magnitude of each layer's update to its hidden states. This runtime adaptation is made practical by AutoFP, a multi-scale floating-point format that derives 2-, 4-, and 6-bit precisions from a single NVFP4 base format. We realize AutoEMatic on two targets: GPU kernels that execute AutoFP on NVFP4 Tensor Cores, and an accelerator whose vector MAC datapath executes all AutoFP formats natively. Across reasoning and agentic benchmarks, AutoEMatic improves accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 and matches group-scaled FP6 accuracy on most benchmarks, using 4.9 bits per weight versus 4.5 for NVFP4. On GB300 GPUs, AutoEMatic retains approximately 90-98% of NVFP4 decode throughput across the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, the AutoEMatic accelerator reduces latency by 1.6-2.3x and energy by 7-23% compared to an accelerator with NVFP4-only datapath at iso-accuracy.

AI.tldr: AutoEMatic：面向LLM推理的运行时动态精度量化全栈协同设计，依据每步熵与隐状态更新量逐层自适应选择2/4/6-bit精度，通过AutoFP多尺度格式在GPU与专用加速器上实现。
AI.motivation: 现有训练后量化在推理前即固定精度，而模型所需精度随提示、层和推理阶段动态变化，静态精度分配造成精度或效率损失。
AI.method: 提出AutoEMatic全栈协同设计：轻量策略在每个prefill与decode步，基于两个运行时信号（下一token分布熵、各层隐藏状态更新幅度）为每个层选择精度，覆盖权重、激活与KV cache；并设计AutoFP多尺度浮点格式，从单一NVFP4基格式派生2/4/6-bit精度。实现两条路径：在NVFP4 Tensor Core上执行AutoFP的GPU kernel，以及向量MAC数据通路原生支持全部AutoFP格式的加速器。
AI.result: 在推理与智能体基准上，相较NVFP4精度最多提升21.7%，多数基准达到分组缩放FP6精度水平，平均每权重4.9 bit（NVFP4为4.5 bit）。GB300 GPU上保留约90-98%的NVFP4解码吞吐。AutoEMatic加速器在同精度下相较仅NVFP4数据通路的加速器延迟降低1.6-2.3倍，能耗降低7-23%。
AI.conclusion: 运行时自适应混合精度是突破静态PTQ瓶颈的有效途径；配合硬件友好的AutoFP格式，可在几乎不损吞吐的前提下显著提升精度与能效，验证了算法-格式-硬件协同设计的价值。

title: RoutingTrie: Metadata Routing for Constrained Generative Retrieval
summary: Advances in large language models and semantic IDs (SIDs) have brought generative retrieval (GR) into industrial applications. These systems must return items that satisfy request metadata constraints as well as relevance requirements. A catalog trie ensures SID validity, but filtering metadata only after generation wastes computation on rejected candidates and may leave too few eligible results. We propose RoutingTrie to incorporate metadata constraints before beam selection. RoutingTrie maintains one shared SID trie and builds a compact index for each metadata field using Dense Bitset or Sparse List. We derive a storage cost formula to guide the choice between these index representations for different field distributions. During decoding, field probes determine whether requested values occur below candidate edges and produce a combined mask that guides beam selection. Experiments on ShopTrie, our configurable synthetic benchmark, demonstrate compact storage and efficient CPU and GPU probing across diverse metadata distributions. In a production replay, RoutingTrie raises Hit@100 from 67.5\% to 96.1\%, a gain of 28.6 percentage points, with only 1.1 ms latency increase. We will release the ShopTrie generator, benchmark scripts, and RoutingTrie CPU and Triton GPU implementations to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: RoutingTrie 在 beam selection 之前引入元数据约束，通过共享 SID trie 加每字段紧凑索引（Dense Bitset 或 Sparse List）实现解码期掩码，生产回放 Hit@100 从 67.5% 提升至 96.1%，仅增加 1.1 ms 延迟。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索需同时满足相关性与请求元数据约束；仅靠目录 trie 保证 SID 有效性，若在生成后再做元数据过滤，会造成被拒候选的算力浪费，且可能剩余合格结果不足。
AI.method: 提出 RoutingTrie：维护一个共享 SID trie，并为每个元数据字段构建紧凑索引（Dense Bitset 或 Sparse List 两种表示）；给出存储代价公式以按字段分布选择表示。解码时通过字段探测判断请求值是否出现在候选边之下，生成组合掩码引导 beam selection。另构建可配置合成基准 ShopTrie。
AI.result: 在 ShopTrie 上验证紧凑存储与 CPU/GPU 高效探测；生产回放中 Hit@100 由 67.5% 升至 96.1%（+28.6 个百分点），延迟仅增加 1.1 ms。
AI.conclusion: 将元数据约束前移至解码阶段可显著提升合格结果召回且开销极小；存储代价公式为索引表示选择提供依据；将开源 ShopTrie 生成器、基准脚本及 CPU/Triton GPU 实现以支持可复现。

title: Do Machine Learning Models Predict?
summary: Machine learning (ML) models are said to predict. Philosophers draw a line between accommodation and prediction, depending on whether or not the evidence a theory succeeds on was used in constructing it. Does this distinction survive when a theory is replaced by an ML model? We argue so, yet the dividing line becomes fuzzy. Whether an output of an ML model counts as an accommodation or as a prediction hinges upon the relationship between the patterns the input instantiate and those on which the model was selected through its training. Once this relation is taken into account, most successful outputs of ML models, we suggest, bear a strong accommodation character. We further trace the consequences of our account for confirmation, novelty, and scientific realism.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"容纳(accommodation)与预测(prediction)"的区分在机器学习模型中依然成立，但界限变得模糊；其判定取决于输入所体现的模式与模型经训练被选中时所依据的模式之间的关系，而按此标准，ML模型多数成功输出具有强烈的容纳性质。
AI.motivation: 哲学上以"证据是否参与理论建构"来区分容纳与预测，但该区分能否在理论被ML模型取代后继续适用尚不清楚，作者希望澄清并推进这一科学哲学争论。
AI.method: 概念/哲学分析：将容纳—预测区分的判定标准重构为"输入实例所例示的模式"与"模型通过训练被选择所依据的模式"之间的关系分析。
AI.result: 区分在ML模型语境下仍可维持，但分界线变得模糊；据此，ML模型的大多数成功输出被判定为强烈偏向容纳而非预测。
AI.conclusion: 该分析对确证(confirmation)、新颖性(novelty)与科学实在论(scientific realism)具有启示：ML模型的"预测性"成功可能被高估，其确证力与新颖性地位需重新审视。

title: BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach
summary: Stochastic bilevel optimization provides a general framework for many machine learning applications, such as hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, language model alignment, and actor-critic reinforcement learning. However, most existing bilevel optimization methods treat matrix-valued gradients as flattened vectors and perform optimization in the resulting vectorized space, ignoring the matrix structures common in modern neural networks. Moreover, the lower-level (LL) problem curvature can induce significant spectral imbalance in the upper-level (UL) geometry. Such limitations of existing bilevel optimization methods motivate us to develop BiMuon, a geometry-aware stochastic bilevel optimization method that integrates implicit hypergradient estimation in bilevel optimization with Muon-style orthogonalized updates at the UL. To our knowledge, BiMuon is the first stochastic BLO method with Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates and an $O(ε^{-4})$ iteration-complexity guarantee, matching the best-known rates achieved by Muon-type methods based on matrix parameterizations. To improve computational and parallel efficiency for models with multiple matrix parameters, we further study BiMuon for blockwise diagonal matrix approximation and derive a relative stepsize allocation rule based on UL progress and blockwise LL sensitivity. We evaluate BiMuon on representation learning and blockwise bilevel optimization, providing empirical support for our methods.

AI.tldr: BiMuon：首个将Muon式正交化矩阵更新引入随机双层优化的几何感知方法，具O(ε^{-4})复杂度保证，并提出分块对角近似与相对步长分配规则。
AI.motivation: 现有双层优化方法将矩阵梯度展平为向量、在向量化空间中更新，忽略了现代神经网络中普遍存在的矩阵结构；同时下层问题的曲率会在上层几何中造成显著的谱不平衡。
AI.method: 将双层优化中的隐式超梯度估计与上层Muon式正交化矩阵更新相结合；针对多矩阵参数模型，进一步研究分块对角矩阵近似下的BiMuon，并基于上层进展与分块下层敏感性推导相对步长分配规则。
AI.result: 理论上给出O(ε^{-4})的迭代复杂度，与基于矩阵参数化的Muon类方法已知最优速率相匹配；在表示学习与分块双层优化任务上进行了实证验证，为所提方法提供经验支持。
AI.conclusion: 保持矩阵结构并进行正交化上层更新可有效缓解谱不平衡、提升双层优化的几何适应性；分块近似与步长分配规则有助于提升多矩阵参数模型的计算与并行效率。

title: Key Institutional Considerations for Designing Effective Independent Verification Organizations
summary: Independent verification organizations (IVOs) have emerged as a popular, bipartisan solution for facilitating high-quality independent evaluations of AI technologies. But momentum is outpacing design: there is emerging consensus on the necessary operating conditions for robust IVOs, but little discourse on institutional and policy specifications to ensure those conditions are met. IVOs are currently envisioned primarily as a mechanism operating at the AI frontier and model level to evaluate catastrophic risks. Little work has yet been done on how to establish or enforce an IVO ecosystem that is equipped to handle myriad risks (i.e., beyond catastrophic ones) and operate at the system and application level across the deployment and use stages of the AI lifecycle. This paper argues that IVO design should ensure the capacity for evaluating AI models, systems, and applications in context for both frontier companies and enterprise companies & AI-adopting organizations. Additionally, this paper provides early considerations to advance IVO discourse from normative to operative, and from existential to everyday risks. Drawing from existing institutional constructs in financial services, education, public health, and science, we outline key considerations on whom IVOs serve, what access they require, how they interact with external governing structures, how they are funded, and how they fit into the wider assurance ecosystem. Much of the structure and knowledge necessary to holistically design IVOs and their ecosystem does not yet exist, even as companies rush to ink agreements with their chosen evaluators.

AI.tldr: 本文主张AI独立验证组织（IVO）的设计不应局限于模型层面的灾难性风险，而应覆盖模型、系统与应用层面，贯穿全生命周期并兼顾前沿与企业用户；作者借鉴金融服务、教育、公共卫生与科学领域的制度先例，提出关于服务对象、访问权限、外部治理互动、资金模式与生态定位的操作性设计考量。
AI.motivation: IVO被视为高质量AI独立评估的两党共识方案，但制度设计落后于实践推进：现有讨论集中于运营条件的规范共识，缺乏确保这些条件落地的制度与政策细则；且IVO多被设想为仅在前沿模型层面评估灾难性风险，鲜有研究涉及覆盖多元风险、面向系统与应用层面的生态系统如何建立与执行。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性政策分析。作者提出现有IVO视野的扩展框架（模型—系统—应用×前沿企业—企业及AI采用组织），并以金融服务、教育、公共卫生和科学领域的既有制度构造为类比来源，围绕五个维度展开设计考量：IVO的服务对象、所需访问权限、与外部治理结构的互动方式、资金机制、以及在更广泛保障生态中的定位。
AI.result: 论文提出IVO应具备在具体情境中评估模型、系统与应用的能力，并覆盖前沿公司与企业/AI采用组织；同时指出，整体性设计IVO及其生态所需的大量结构与知识尚不存在，而企业已在加速与自选评估方签约，形成制度空白与实践先行之间的张力。
AI.conclusion: IVO讨论需从规范性层面推进到操作性层面，从存在性风险扩展到日常风险；需在服务对象、访问权限、治理接口、资金与生态定位等方面进行制度化设计，以填补当前的结构性知识缺口，避免评估实践在缺乏制度基础的情况下无序固化。

title: PCG-RAG: Progressive Compositional Grounding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Complex Web Question Answering
summary: Complex Web question answering requires retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to identify target entities from multi-clue descriptions and connect evidence scattered across long Web pages. Individual pages often support only some of the required semantic constraints, while clues discovered on one page guide subsequent searches on others. However, premature reliance on partially supported entity hypotheses can divert retrieval from the original information need. RAG systems must therefore use partial evidence to guide further searches while seeking the evidence needed to establish the intended entities. We propose PCG-RAG, a novel RAG framework based on Progressive Compositional Grounding (PCG). Progressive Evidence Acquisition directs subsequent searches toward missing evidence for candidate attributes and relations. Compositional Reasoning separates candidate-guided retrieval from evidence-based answering along a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of subquestions. Provisional names make dependent searches specific, while answering tasks use accepted results and unresolved identifying conditions, assessed against the original question. New passages connect the identifying clues to the requested relations, supporting evidence-based downstream answers. Evidence Grounding combines identifying and relational source passages with supported intermediate answers, connecting evidence across Web pages to the original conditions during final generation. On BrowseComp-Plus and WebWalkerQA, PCG-RAG improves accuracy over the leading compared baselines by 5.43 and 5.15 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PCG-RAG框架，通过渐进式组合接地（渐进证据获取、组合推理DAG、证据接地）解决复杂Web问答中多线索实体识别与跨长页面证据连接问题，在BrowseComp-Plus和WebWalkerQA上分别较最优基线提升5.43与5.15个百分点。
AI.motivation: 复杂Web问答需从多线索描述中识别目标实体，并连接分散在长网页中的证据。单页通常仅支持部分语义约束，而某页发现的线索会引导后续检索；过早依赖仅部分支持的实体假设会使检索偏离原始信息需求。因此系统需在利用部分证据引导搜索的同时，继续寻找确立目标实体所需的证据。
AI.method: 基于渐进式组合接地（PCG）的RAG框架，含三部分：(1) 渐进证据获取，针对候选属性与关系的缺失证据引导后续检索；(2) 组合推理，沿子问题有向无环图（DAG）将候选引导的检索与基于证据的作答分离，用暂定名称使依赖检索具体化，作答任务使用已接受结果与未解决的识别条件并对照原始问题评估；(3) 证据接地，在最终生成时结合识别性与关系性源段落及受支持的中间答案，将跨网页证据与原始条件相连。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus与WebWalkerQA上，PCG-RAG相较最强对比基线准确率分别提升5.43和5.15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过将部分证据用于引导检索、以DAG结构解耦候选检索与证据作答，并在生成阶段进行跨页证据接地，可有效提升复杂Web问答的准确性，验证了渐进式组合接地范式的有效性。

title: Frontier AI Safety and Governance 2026: Risk Understanding and Coordinated Governance
summary: Frontier AI Safety and Governance 2026: Risk Understanding and Coordinated Governance is a key outcome of the AI Safety and Governance Program of World Internet Conference Specialized Committee on AI in 2026. Drawing on the latest developments in frontier AI capabilities and applications, the report systematically examines the evolving risk landscape, analyzing key risk areas, their severity and response priorities. Building on a review of existing global governance practices and an assessment of frontier AI governance readiness, it identifies key governance gaps and weaknesses and proposes directions and practical mechanisms for coordinated responses. The report provides a reference for government departments, international organizations, businesses, research institutions and other stakeholders. It aims to strengthen the international community's understanding of and consensus on frontier AI risks, enhance preparedness and collective response capacity, and advance the safe, reliable and responsible development of frontier AI to better serve the common well-being of humanity.

AI.tldr: 该报告系统梳理前沿AI的风险图景与严重程度，评估全球治理实践与治理就绪度，识别治理缺口，并提出协同应对的方向与可操作机制。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI能力与应用快速演进导致风险格局持续变化，国际社会对前沿AI风险的认识与共识不足，现有治理实践存在缺口与薄弱环节，亟需为政府部门、国际组织、企业、研究机构等利益相关方提供参考，以提升预防与集体应对能力。
AI.method: 基于前沿AI能力与应用的最新进展，系统审视风险态势，分析关键风险领域及其严重性与应对优先序；梳理评述既有全球治理实践，并对前沿AI治理就绪度进行评估，据此识别关键治理缺口与弱项。
AI.result: 形成对关键风险领域、严重性排序与应对优先级的系统判断，归纳出全球治理实践与就绪度的差距清单，并提出协同应对的方向与务实机制建议。
AI.conclusion: 报告旨在增进国际社会对前沿AI风险的理解与共识，增强预防与集体应对能力，推动前沿AI安全、可靠、负责任发展，以更好服务人类共同福祉。

title: BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation
summary: High-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (HDBO) is an increasingly crowded field with new methods proposed at every major conference, making it ever harder to answer a deceptively simple question: "Which method is currently state-of-the-art?" In this paper, we question the efficacy of benchmarking practices in the field, and find them to be systematically ineffective: multiple published works fail to benchmark against the strongest available baselines, or even include incorrect implementations of key methods. Without a shared reference implementation, such errors are difficult to detect during peer review. We therefore introduce BO-Arena, an actively maintained and extensible package providing canonical implementations of state-of-the-art algorithms, which allows researchers to develop new methods and benchmark them rigorously. Using BO-Arena, we find that what currently drives performance in HDBO is even simpler than previously thought. We use these insights to propose a new algorithm which is competitive with the state of the art on problems with many observations, without resorting to the complex GP approximations used in recent methods. Finally, we question whether there is currently sufficient evidence that any more complex method outperforms a simple Gaussian process baseline for HDBO.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑高维贝叶斯优化（HDBO）领域的基准测试实践，指出其系统性失效（缺乏最强基线、存在错误实现），据此提出可扩展的标准化实现包 BO-Arena，并借助它发现驱动 HDBO 性能的核心因素比以往认知更简单，进而提出一个不依赖复杂 GP 近似、在大样本问题上具有竞争力的新算法，并质疑更复杂方法优于简单 GP 基线的证据是否充分。
AI.motivation: HDBO 领域新方法层出不穷，但"当前哪个方法最优"难以回答；已发表工作中存在未对齐最强基线、关键方法实现错误等问题，且因缺乏统一参考实现，同行评审难以发现此类错误。
AI.method: 1) 实证审查并质疑现有 HDBO 基准测试实践；2) 提出 BO-Arena——主动维护、可扩展、提供 SOTA 算法规范实现的软件包，支持新方法开发与严格基准评测；3) 基于 BO-Arena 的实验洞察，设计一个新算法，避免近期方法所采用的复杂 GP 近似。
AI.result: 发现驱动 HDBO 性能的关键因素比此前认为的更简单；新算法在观测数较多的问题上可与 SOTA 竞争，且无需复杂 GP 近似。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据不足以证明任何更复杂的方法显著优于简单高斯过程基线；领域亟需统一参考实现与严谨基准测试规范。

title: AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind
comment: 36 pages (with appendix), 17 figures, 24 tables. Code and corpus: https://github.com/fardinsaad/_AVCORP_ . Dataset and detector: https://huggingface.co/collections/fardinsaad/avcorp
summary: Today's LLM-based agents are vulnerable to deception by users and other agents. Defending against deception requires Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning to infer the beliefs and goals of others as well as modeling tactics based on communication theory. To enable training models to detect deception, we adopt the well-known deception game, Avalon. We present a corpus, AVCORP, of 5,000 annotated utterances from 250 games of Avalon. AVCORP includes (1) 37 tactics mapped to a 4x4 behavior matrix, and (2) reasoning traces capturing abductive hypotheses, suspicion levels, and nested ToM beliefs. We train Qwen3-8B on AVCORP and evaluate it on 25 held-out games and 20 games played by humans. On held-out games, our best trained detector outperforms its untrained baseline and frontier models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro), matching Claude Opus 5.5. On human games, every trained detector exceeds the untrained model in F1 score across all rounds.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了AVCORP语料（250局Avalon中5,000条标注话语，含映射到4x4行为矩阵的37种战术与含溯因假设、怀疑度及嵌套ToM信念的推理链），并基于此训练Qwen3-8B进行欺骗检测。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的智能体易被用户与其他智能体欺骗；防御欺骗需要心智理论（ToM）推理以推断他人信念与目标，并结合传播理论建模其策略，但缺乏用于训练欺骗检测模型的标注数据。
AI.method: 以经典欺骗博弈Avalon为平台构建标注语料AVCORP；采用(1)映射到4x4行为矩阵的37种战术标注、(2)记录溯因假设、怀疑等级与嵌套ToM信念的推理链；在AVCORP上微调Qwen3-8B训练检测器，并在25局留出对局与20局人类对局上评估。
AI.result: 在留出对局上，最佳训练检测器优于未训练基线及前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek-V4-Pro），与Claude Opus 5.5持平；在人类对局上，所有训练检测器在各轮次的F1均超过未训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 将战术标注与显式ToM推理链结合可有效提升LLM智能体的欺骗检测能力，并在跨人类对局场景中保持稳定的性能增益。

title: Dhara: Evidence-Oriented Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
comment: 19 pages. Supplementary material (24 pages) is provided as a separate ancillary PDF
summary: Relevant evidence in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) collections may be distributed across passages in different parts of a work, including verses, translations, and commentaries. Locating it requires matching natural-language questions and partially remembered verse fragments to source passages. We present Dhara, a retrieval engine combining hybrid search, chapter- and book-level Entity Notes (EN), Fuzzy Verse Retrieval (FVR), and neural reranking. Five comparisons on the 325 questions in Dhara Bench examine retrieval representations against BM25, EN's contribution, reranker quality and computation time, FVR, and Gemini. BGE-M3 single-vector retrieval exceeds BM25 in nDCG@10, Recall@20, and MRR@20 across all categories. Its scores are broadly comparable to ColBERTv2, with mean retrieval times of 0.108 s and 0.962 s under the same hardware configuration and a smaller memory footprint for chunk storage on disk. Adding EN to a direct branch with a matched candidate count improves nDCG@10 in all twelve categories with Qwen and ten with BGE; the combined ranking is capped at the same candidate count. Qwen improves nDCG@10, Precision@5, and MRR@20 over BGE in every category, at approximately 6.72 times the overall estimated serial computation time. FVR increases Verse-category nDCG@10 by approximately 20 percentage points with either reranker. Gemini is evaluated after source mapping and manual review with relevance annotations visible. The Qwen pipeline with EN and FVR has higher Recall@20 than Gemini in ten categories and stronger complete-evidence retrieval in Multi-hop questions, while Gemini retains early-relevance advantages in several categories. The results inform retrieval choices according to evidence requirements and resource budgets.

AI.tldr: Dhara 是面向印度知识体系（IKS）文献的检索引擎，融合混合检索、章节/书籍级实体笔记（EN）、模糊偈颂检索（FVR）与神经重排；在 Dhara Bench 的 325 个问题上优于 BM25，并在多数类别上比 Gemini 具有更高的 Recall@20。
AI.motivation: IKS 文献中的相关证据分散于不同部分的偈颂、译文与注疏中，需将自然语言提问与部分记忆的偈颂片段匹配到原文段落，因此需要专门的检索方案。
AI.method: Dhara 引擎结合混合检索、章节级与书籍级 Entity Notes、Fuzzy Verse Retrieval 与神经重排。基于 Dhara Bench 的 325 个问题开展五组对比实验：检索表示对比 BM25、EN 的贡献、重排器质量与计算时间、FVR、以及 Gemini。
AI.result: BGE-M3 单向量检索在 nDCG@10、Recall@20、MRR@20 上全类别超过 BM25，与 ColBERTv2 大致相当，检索时延 0.108 s vs 0.962 s 且磁盘分块存储占用更小。在候选数对齐的直接分支中加入 EN，Qwen 在全部 12 类、BGE 在 10 类提升 nDCG@10。Qwen 在所有类别上优于 BGE（nDCG@10、P@5、MRR@20），计算时间约为其 6.72 倍。FVR 使 Verse 类 nDCG@10 提升约 20 个百分点。Qwen+EN+FVR 流程在 10 个类别上 Recall@20 高于 Gemini，并在多跳问题上完整证据检索更强；Gemini 在若干类别保留早期相关性优势。
AI.conclusion: 检索方案的选择应依据证据需求与资源预算权衡：BGE 高效、Qwen 重排更优但耗时显著，FVR 对偈颂类证据关键，整体流程在完整证据召回上优于 Gemini。

title: Beyond Falsehoods 2026: Global Trends in the Regulation of Misinformation and Disinformation
summary:
This report examines global legislative and regulatory responses to misinformation, disinformation, and mal-information (MDM) between 1995 and 2025. Drawing on an expanded and updated dataset of 409 coded regulatory and policy entries, including hard and soft law, policy measures, and proposed or draft instruments, it analyses their growth, geographic distribution, substantive focuses, and regulatory designs, which represent the various approaches taken against MDM, as well as early evidence of their implementation.
  The central finding is sustained and accelerating regulatory growth. Annual activity increased from 11 instruments in 2016 to 46 in 2023, 67 in 2024, and 71 in 2025. The number of instruments currently in force has reached 282, despite 34 measures having been repealed, withdrawn, or judicially invalidated. This growth has also been accompanied by a shift in regulatory focus. Earlier measures relied heavily on broad prohibitions of "false information," whereas more recent measures increasingly target specific harms, including deepfakes, election interference, non-consensual intimate imagery, and child safety. Regulatory responsibility is also increasingly being placed on platforms rather than solely on individual creators and users.

AI.tldr: 本文基于409条编码的全球规制与政策条目（1995–2025），系统考察针对错误信息、虚假信息与恶意信息（MDM）的立法与监管回应，发现规制活动持续且加速增长，并伴随从宽泛禁止"虚假信息"向针对深度伪造、选举干预等具体危害、以及向平台责任转移的焦点转变。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对全球MDM规制在长时段（1995–2025）、跨硬法与软法、跨已生效与草案工具的统一定量刻画，亟需一个扩展更新的编码数据集来呈现规制的增长轨迹、地理分布、实质焦点与制度设计，并评估其早期实施证据。
AI.method: 构建并更新包含409条经编码的规制与政策条目数据集，覆盖硬法、软法、政策措施及拟议或草案工具；对其增长趋势、地理分布、实质焦点与监管设计（反映不同MDM应对路径）进行描述性与比较分析，并结合实施情况的早期证据。
AI.result: 规制呈持续且加速增长：年度活动由2016年11项增至2023年46项、2024年67项、2025年71项；尽管有34项措施被废止、撤回或经司法认定无效，当前生效工具仍达282项。规制焦点亦发生转移：早期依赖对"虚假信息"的宽泛禁止，近期日益针对深度伪造、选举干预、非自愿亲密影像与儿童安全等具体危害；监管责任亦更多落在平台而非仅由个人创作者与用户承担。
AI.conclusion: 全球MDM规制体系在规模与严格程度上持续扩张，并呈现从笼统内容禁令向危害导向、平台责任导向的精细化转型；废止与司法否定案例表明制度存在调整与纠错机制，未来研究需进一步跟踪实施效果与跨法域差异。

title: Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws
summary: We demonstrate that transformer architectures trained with discrete denoising diffusion and decoded via guided test-time beam search can learn to recover the prime factors of semiprime integers directly from data. Our approach establishes a new frontier for learning-based semiprime factorization, successfully factoring 68-bit integers-a substantial advance over the prior 56-bit state of the art. While computationally less efficient than classical factoring algorithms, our model requires no domain-specific number-theoretic priors and learns purely from training examples. In practice, the diffusion model acts as a generative prior, identifying promising factor candidates where exact verification or lattice-based post-processing can complete the factorization. Furthermore, we derive empirical scaling laws relating approximation quality to training data volume, model size, and test-time computation. In contrast to language, problem size is the key driver of scaling behavior. Achieving a fixed accuracy on a held-out test set requires compute that scales exponentially with bit length. Consequently, our findings pose no threat to security, as the projected compute cost required to factorize cryptographically relevant integers remains prohibitive.

AI.tldr: 用离散去噪扩散训练的Transformer配合引导式测试时束搜索，可从数据中直接学习半素数分解，成功分解68位整数（此前SOTA为56位），但所需算力随位长指数增长，对密码安全无威胁。
AI.motivation: 探索生成式模型（离散扩散+束搜索）能否在不引入数论先验的前提下，纯从训练样本中学习半素数因式分解，并刻画其规模扩展规律，评估其对密码学的实际影响。
AI.method: 采用离散去噪扩散训练Transformer架构；解码阶段使用引导式测试时束搜索（guided test-time beam search）；将扩散模型作为生成先验提出候选因子，再结合精确验证或格基后处理完成分解；并推导近似质量与训练数据量、模型规模、测试时计算之间的经验缩放律。
AI.result: 成功分解68位半素数，较此前56位的最先进结果显著提升；模型无需领域特定的数论先验，仅从训练样本学习；计算效率低于经典算法；缩放行为由问题规模（位长）主导，而非语言式缩放，达到固定精度所需算力随位长指数增长。
AI.conclusion: 学习式半素数分解在方法上取得新前沿，但由于算力需求随位长指数增长，分解密码相关规模整数所需成本仍不可行，因此对安全不构成威胁；扩散模型在此主要充当筛选候选因子的生成先验。

title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
summary: Medical ultrasound (US) enables real-time, non-invasive diagnosis, yet building US-based AI systems is limited by data scarcity, costly expert annotation, and limited cross-center generalizability. Privacy constraints and instance-level reporting hinder the collection of diverse abnormal cases and frame-level labels, while repeated retraining for new centers increases computational cost. We introduce EvoDiff, a generative active learning framework that integrates diffusion modelling with information-theoretic objectives, evolutionary search, and curriculum-based sampling to select informative samples across heterogeneous US datasets. EvoDiff formulates sample selection as a generate-to-retrieve process, in which diffusion-based optimization in feature space guided by information gain produces synthetic probes, and only the real unlabeled samples retrieved by these probes are annotated and used for downstream training. Across six benchmarks covering fifteen datasets and 16,696 images, we evaluate EvoDiff on convolutional network and transformer-based foundation model. EvoDiff approaches fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels, outperforms active learning baselines, and improves foundation model generalization under cross-domain external validation on unseen cohorts. A reader study with six radiologists indicates the potential to support clinical annotation workflows, with a model-based estimated 24% to 84% reduction in annotation workload at matched downstream performance.

AI.tldr: EvoDiff：将扩散模型与信息论目标、进化搜索和课程采样结合的生成式主动学习框架，把样本选择表述为“生成-检索”过程，在6个基准、15个数据集、16,696张超声图像上以更少标注接近全监督性能，并提升跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 医学超声AI系统受限于数据稀缺、专家标注昂贵、跨中心泛化差；隐私约束与实例级报告机制导致多样异常病例和帧级标签难以收集，而为新中心反复重训练又增加算力成本。
AI.method: 提出EvoDiff生成式主动学习框架：整合扩散建模、信息论目标、进化搜索与课程式采样，在异构超声数据集上选择高信息量样本。核心是将样本选择建模为"生成-检索"（generate-to-retrieve）过程——在特征空间中以信息增益为引导进行扩散优化生成合成探针，仅对探针检索到的真实无标注样本进行标注并用于下游训练。在卷积网络与Transformer基础模型上验证。
AI.result: 在覆盖15个数据集、16,696张图像的6个基准上，EvoDiff以显著更少标签逼近全监督性能，优于主动学习基线，并在未见队列的跨域外部验证中提升基础模型泛化能力。六名放射科医师的读者研究表明其可支持临床标注流程，模型估计在同等下游性能下可减少24%–84%的标注工作量。
AI.conclusion: EvoDiff通过生成-检索式主动学习有效缓解超声AI的数据稀缺与标注瓶颈，兼具标注效率与跨域泛化优势，具备辅助临床标注工作流的潜力。

title: An Adaptive, Context-Aware, and Stacked Attention Network-Based Recommendation System to Capture Users' Temporal Preference
comment: 12 pages. Accepted version of the article published in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering. Code: https://github.com/solitude6060/An-Adaptive-Context-Aware-and-Stacked-Attention-Network-Based-Recommendation-System
summary: Recommendation systems have become more important since the widespread use of the Internet. The large amount of information means that it is difficult for users to discover they really need. However, users' preferences can change over time because of the age and the impact of social networks. Recommendation systems must capture users' preferences and recommend suitable items, which is a difficult challenge. This study proposes a novel recommendation system that adapts to the changing preferences of users. By learning and adapting to users' changing preferences better recommendations are provided. This study uses context factors as additional information to model users' preferences more precisely. For the proposed recommendation system, the context is based on users' interaction items within each defined time interval. This study proposes two novel attention mechanisms for the recommendation system. The contextual item attention module captures contextual information, changing pattern in users' preference and the importance of items. The multi-head attention module extends the diversity of users' preferences and adapts to changing preferences. The recommendation performance is improved using additional item's temporal information to model the contextual item's representation. Experiments compare the proposed algorithm with several state-of-the-art recommendation methods using three real-world datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed context-aware recommendation model outperforms traditional methods and demonstrate the effectiveness with which contextual information is captured by the attention mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于上下文项注意力与多头注意力机制的自适应推荐系统，用于建模用户随时间变化的偏好，并在三个真实数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 随着互联网普及，信息过载使用户难以发现真正需要的物品；同时用户偏好会随年龄和社交网络影响而随时间变化，推荐系统需持续捕捉动态偏好，这构成重要挑战。
AI.method: 将上下文因素作为附加信息以更精确建模用户偏好，其中上下文基于各定义时间区间内用户交互的物品构建。提出两种注意力机制：上下文项注意力模块捕捉上下文信息、偏好变化模式及物品重要性；多头注意力模块扩展偏好多样性并适应偏好变化。同时引入物品的时间信息建模上下文物品表示。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上与多种先进推荐方法对比实验，所提上下文感知推荐模型性能优于传统方法，验证了注意力机制捕捉上下文信息的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力机制与时序上下文建模可有效适应用户偏好变化并提升推荐性能，上下文信息对动态推荐具有关键作用。

title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
comment: 100 pages: 30 page main text and references, 70 page appendix. 7 figures, 2 tables. Results explorer: https://mindbench.ai/audits/interventions
summary: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.

AI.tldr: 本文对41个语言模型进行心理健康建议审计，基于临床医生、照护者、当事人三种立场及19个案例、5个问题，收集35,055条自由文本回复并用验证过的判定器提取干预措施，再由29个模型对同一病例的完整选项清单做七点李克特评分，以比较推荐行为与评分的一致性及立场差异。
AI.motivation: 用户越来越多地向语言模型提出心理健康问题并接受其回答，但模型在不同提问立场下推荐何种干预、其推荐与自身评价是否一致尚不清楚，需要系统审计以保证建议质量与一致性。
AI.method: 构建三立场（临床医生描述患者、照护者描述亲人、当事人自述）审计设计；覆盖19个临床案例小故事和5个问题；收集41个模型的35,055条自由文本回复，用经验证的判定器提取所有被提及的干预措施；并让29个模型对相同案例的完整选项清单进行七点李克特量表评分。
AI.result: 模型总体上推荐其评分较高的选项，但推荐行为随立场而异；许多模型对临床医生给出咨询式回答，对非专业用户则给出带保留、简化的建议；当被问及特定干预类型的推荐时，模型更常将自身评分低于零的选项列为首选，且通常附带条件。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的心理健康推荐在立场间存在系统性差异，且推荐与自身评分存在不一致（尤其涉及特定干预类型时的首选低于阈值的选项），提示需持续审计；作者将在发表时以"活体审计"形式公开工具、代码与完整语料。

title: DisMUSE: An Efficient Distributed Singular-Spectrum-Based Optimization Approach with Theoretical Convergence Guarantee
summary: In recent years, singular-spectrum-based optimizers have attracted increasing attention due to their ability to preserve the matrix structure of neural network gradients, thereby enabling geometry-aware optimization. However, most singular-spectrum-based (SSB) approaches remain centralized, limiting their use in distributed learning infrastructures that exploit massive parallelism. Distributed SSB optimization is still at an early stage, with open questions about convergence guarantees and communication efficiency. To fill this gap, we propose the Distributed Momentum-based Spectral Estimator (DisMUSE), an efficient distributed SSB optimization framework for both data-center and federated settings. Using Muon-style exact orthogonalized momentum as the spectral update, DisMUSE integrates a recursive variance-reduced momentum estimator and achieves an $O((KT)^{-1/3})$ convergence rate, where $K$ and $T$ denote the number of nodes and local iterations per node, respectively. This rate matches the best-known rates for variance-reduced nonconvex distributed optimization. Building on this variance-reduced framework, we study two extensions. First, our DisMUSE method with finite Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations preserves the same convergence order under a uniform normalized support-spectrum condition, up to a multiplicative factor. Second, we develop a communication-efficient variant based on low-rank (LR) momentum transmission and quantify the error it introduces to the stationarity bound, characterizing the trade-off between accuracy and communication cost.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式奇异谱优化框架DisMUSE，用于数据中心与联邦场景，达到O((KT)^{-1/3})收敛率，并在有限Newton-Schulz迭代与低秩通信两方向扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有基于奇异谱（SSB）的优化器多为集中式，难以适配大规模并行分布式学习；分布式SSB优化尚处早期，收敛保证与通信效率问题未明。
AI.method: 以Muon式精确正交化动量作为谱更新，结合递归方差缩减动量估计器构建DisMUSE；进一步分析有限Newton-Schulz迭代下的收敛性（均匀归一化支撑谱条件下），并提出基于低秩动量传输的通信高效变体并量化其引入的平稳性界误差。
AI.result: DisMUSE收敛率为O((KT)^{-1/3})（K为节点数，T为每节点本地迭代数），与方差缩减非凸分布式优化的已知最优速率相当；有限NS迭代在均匀归一化支撑谱条件下保持同阶收敛（至多相差常数因子）；低秩传输变体给出了精度与通信开销的权衡刻画。
AI.conclusion: DisMUSE为分布式SSB优化提供了具收敛保证且通信可控的统一框架，适用于数据中心与联邦场景，并明确了近似实现与通信压缩对收敛性的影响。

title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.

AI.tldr: 提出提示自适应、成本感知的路由方法 PISA（单模型）与 PISA-E（集成），在四个路由基准的 ID/OOD 条件下取得更优的成本—性能权衡。
AI.motivation: Web 服务中的 LLM 需在异构请求下平衡响应质量与推理成本；传统单模型路由每个提示只选一个模型，固定集成又无法按请求调整组成与开销，二者都难以适配个体请求。
AI.method: PISA 将软聚类隶属度与模型特定预测器结合，估计各模型能力；PISA-E 在此基础上联合选择集成组成与规模，遵循可在推理时调整而无需重训的显式成本—质量偏好，并借助可处理的集成成功替代指标与高效候选选择，无需针对集成的专门训练。
AI.result: 在四个 LLM 路由基准上，PISA 在 ID 与 OOD 条件下均取得单模型路由器中最高的宏平均成本—性能超体积；PISA-E 在优先响应质量时取得集成类方法中最高的宏平均任务性能，ID 与 OOD 下分别超出最强竞争者 2.09 与 2.87 个百分点；在部分更低成本工作点上，其宏平均任务性能仍超过最强集成竞争者，同时平均推理成本分别降低约 36% 与 25%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，提示自适应的能力估计对单模型路由与选择性集成均有效。

title: IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning
summary: As intelligent personal assistants are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios, recommendation paradigms are shifting from passive preference matching to inferring user intent from underspecified multimodal inputs. In practical interactions, users typically issue a reference image paired with a vague natural language query, keeping key visual attributes, personalized preferences, and item-side constraints implicit. Existing recommendation methods either leverage historical user interactions augmented with multimodal item features or assume fully articulated textual queries; both paradigms struggle to resolve underspecified multimodal queries for accurate item matching. To address this limitation, we propose IntentLens, a tool-augmented recommendation framework that grounds ambiguous multimodal queries into query-relevant evidence prior to user-item matching. IntentLens follows a ground-then-rank pipeline: a shared multimodal LLM leverages visual tools, user memory modules, and item attribute retrieval tools to (i) infer latent user intent from image-text inputs and (ii) augment each candidate item with fine-grained, query-conditioned evidence. Subsequently, a lightweight ranker scores candidates based on the grounded representations. To facilitate research in this novel setting, we construct two benchmarks with underspecified multimodal queries, namely \textsc{GoogleReview-MMTool} and \textsc{Yelp-MMTool}. Extensive experiments on these benchmarks demonstrate that IntentLens outperforms competitive MLLM and retrieval baselines, and exhibits strong generalization to unseen categories and datasets.

AI.tldr: IntentLens：面向欠指定多模态查询的"先接地后排序"工具增强推荐框架
AI.motivation: 现实场景中用户常以"参考图片+模糊自然语言"方式表达需求，视觉属性、个性化偏好与物品侧约束均隐含未明。现有方法或依赖历史交互+多模态物品特征，或假设查询文本完全明确，均难以解析欠指定多模态查询并精确匹配物品。
AI.method: 提出工具增强推荐框架IntentLens，采用ground-then-rank流水线：由共享多模态LLM调用视觉工具、用户记忆模块与物品属性检索工具，(i)从图文输入推断潜在用户意图；(ii)为每个候选物品补充细粒度、以查询为条件的证据；随后由轻量排序器基于接地后的表示打分。并构建GoogleReview-MMTool与Yelp-MMTool两个欠指定多模态查询基准。
AI.result: 在两个基准上的大量实验表明，IntentLens优于竞争的MLLM与检索基线，并对未见类别与数据集展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将模糊多模态查询显式接地为可验证证据，再交由轻量排序器决策，是解决欠指定多模态推荐的有效范式；配套基准为该新设定提供评测基础。

title: Do large language models rank moral values? A transitivity test of moral competence
summary: LLMs are increasingly used to support decisions that require moral consideration. While LLMs perform well on morality benchmarks from psychology and philosophy, producing appropriate outputs on these benchmarks (moral performance) does not establish that an LLM weighs competing moral values at stake in a decision (moral competence). We test a minimal, necessary condition for such weighing: that an ordinal ranking can represent LLM moral choices. Such a ranking requires transitivity. To assess transitivity, we presented LLMs with pairwise trade-offs among moral value violations in vignette choice sets and extracted resulting choice probabilities from first-token distributions. Tested against three stochastic transitive choice models, most choice sets admitted weak or unstable orderings. Aggregating an LLM's responses, a common practice in LLM moral evaluation, produced transitive structure that matched no individual choice set. Evaluations of AI morality should establish that choices are structured before asking whether they are aligned.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，LLM在道德评测中的良好表现不等于其具备权衡多项道德价值的道德能力；作者以传递性作为可排序性的最小必要条件，通过价值违逆的成对权衡抽取选择概率并检验三种随机传递选择模型，发现多数选择集仅呈弱或不稳定序，且汇总后得到的传递结构与任何单一选择集都不匹配。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与需要道德考量的决策；现有心理学与哲学道德基准只衡量"道德表现"，无法说明模型是否真正权衡相互冲突的道德价值。作者希望建立一个最小且必要的检验条件：若模型具有道德权衡，其选择应可被序数排序（即满足传递性）。
AI.method: 以情境选择集构造道德价值违逆之间的成对权衡，从首个token分布中提取选择概率；将数据对照三种随机传递选择模型检验传递性，并考察聚合模型回答（LLM道德评测的常见做法）所产生的结构。
AI.result: 多数选择集只呈现弱或不稳定的序关系；聚合LLM回答后得到的传递结构不与任何单一选择集相匹配。
AI.conclusion: AI道德性评测应先确认选择具有可排序结构，再讨论其是否与人类价值对齐；否则基于基准表现的对齐结论缺乏依据。

title: Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators
summary: Neural operators learn mappings from PDE inputs, such as initial conditions and coefficient fields, to the corresponding solutions. Once trained, they can rapidly predict solutions for new inputs. However, obtaining input-solution pairs for supervised training often requires expensive numerical simulations, whereas PDE inputs and governing equations provide inexpensive physical information. This raises a question: how can cheap physical information reduce the need for labeled solutions? A natural approach is to use physics to select inputs for labeling, but our acquisition experiments show no consistent advantage over random sampling. This observation motivates exploring an alternative: using cheap physics to improve neural operator initialization before supervised training. We propose Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init), a simple yet effective method that pretrains neural operators on unlabeled inputs using physics-informed losses and retains the learned parameters for supervised fine-tuning on the labeled dataset. A linearized analysis shows that pretraining can improve downstream prediction accuracy by reducing initialization errors that limited labeled data cannot effectively correct. Experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks and neural operator architectures demonstrate improvements in predictive accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and label efficiency. Representative results show error reductions of up to 62.7% at the same label budget and comparable or better accuracy with 90% fewer labels, relative to supervised-only training.

AI.tldr: 提出PI-Init：用无标签输入上的物理损失预训练神经算子，再在少量有标签数据上微调，从而以廉价物理信息降低对标注解的需求。
AI.motivation: 神经算子监督训练依赖昂贵的数值求解器生成输入-解对，而PDE输入与方程本身是廉价的物理信息；作者发现用物理信息"挑选输入去标注"（主动学习式采集）并不优于随机采样，因此转而用物理信息改进神经算子的初始化。
AI.method: Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init)：在无标签输入上以物理信息损失（PDE残差等）预训练神经算子，保留所学参数，再用有标签数据集做监督微调；并通过线性化分析刻画预训练通过减小初始误差来提升下游精度、而该误差在标签稀缺时难以被纠正。
AI.result: 在多种PDE基准与多种神经算子架构上，预测精度、分布外泛化与标签效率均提升；相同标签预算下误差最多降低62.7%，使用少90%标签即可达到相当或更优精度（相对于纯监督训练）。
AI.conclusion: 用廉价物理信息改善初始化比用于输入选择更有效，PI-Init简单通用，可作为提升神经算子标签效率的实用范式。

title: Multi-GPU MoE Inference with Adaptive Expert Offloading
summary: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference is constrained by GPU memory. This constraint is mitigated by expert offloading, which stores part of the model's weight in host memory and executes on demand. Though MoE architecture has computation sparsity, more GPUs are needed for serving increasingly larger frontier models. However, existing expert offloading systems overlook this need and fail to scale performance with additional GPUs. We present AdaOffload, a general and efficient multi-GPU hybrid expert execution framework that effectively handles heterogeneous hardware and workloads. We co-design GPU-CPU parallelism and GPU-CPU co-execution for decode and prefill with online workload observation that adapts to different hardware, workload, and batch size heterogeneity. We evaluated AdaOffload on five different platforms with varying GPU capability (L4, Pro6000, B200), number of GPUs, CPU capability, and NUMA topology on three different frontier open-weight models (284B to 753B). AdaOffload achieves $1.9\times$ to $15.5\times$ throughput speedups across different models over state-of-the-art systems.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaOffload，一个面向多GPU的专家卸载（expert offloading）混合执行框架，通过在线负载观测协同设计GPU-CPU并行与联合执行，在大模型上取得1.9×–15.5×吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: MoE推理受GPU显存限制，专家卸载可缓解该问题；但现有卸载系统忽视了多GPU扩展需求，性能无法随GPU数量增加而线性提升，而已有稀疏性仍不足以支撑越来越大的前沿模型。
AI.method: 面向异构硬件与负载设计多GPU混合专家执行框架：针对decode与prefill分别协同设计GPU-CPU并行策略与GPU-CPU联合执行，并结合在线负载观测，自适应不同硬件、负载与batch size的异构性。
AI.result: 在5个平台（L4、Pro6000、B200，不同GPU数量、CPU能力与NUMA拓扑）和3个284B–753B前沿开源模型上评测，相较SOTA系统吞吐提升1.9×–15.5×。
AI.conclusion: AdaOffload可通用、高效地实现可扩展的多GPU专家卸载混合执行，显著提升大模型MoE推理吞吐。

title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?
summary: Decision models such as Jev are a new kind of relevance scorer. Their typed score primitive takes a question, an ordered set of textual relevance levels and a state, and returns a probability for each level directly, rather than token likelihoods or generated labels. Jev's vendor promises that these probabilities are calibrated. This motivates revisiting 'Beyond Yes and No', which improved zero-shot pointwise LLM reranking using likelihood-derived scores over fine-grained relevance labels but left calibration against human assessors as future work. In this paper, we first reproduce its open-model FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, confirming its ranking trends, and then run Jev and two open-weight decision models with the same protocol. Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. We then compare Jev's native probabilities with the human assessors' labels and find them overconfident: of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant. Since this is mostly an error of scale, a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of it and transfers to DL21. After calibration, Jev has a lower DL21 Brier score than FLAN-UL2 and the three cross-encoders, mainly because it separates relevant from non-relevant pairs better. Finally, with calibrated probabilities, choosing each query's cut-off by expected F1 needs no parameter of its own, beats a fixed top-10 cut and matches a cut-off threshold tuned on DL19.

AI.tldr: 本文复现 'Beyond Yes and No' 的 FLAN-UL2 点式重排设置，并新增评测 Jev 与两个开放权重决策模型；发现 Jev 原生概率过度自信（DL21 上打分 >0.9 的对仅 66% 相关），用 2,257 对 DL19 数据做两参数校准可迁移至 DL21，校准后 Brier 分数优于 FLAN-UL2 与三个 cross-encoder，并支持按期望 F1 自适应选择截断。
AI.motivation: Jev 等决策模型通过 typed score 原语直接输出各相关性等级的概率，且厂商声称概率已校准。原工作 'Beyond Yes and No' 用似然导出分数改进零样本点式 LLM 重排，但将"针对人工标注的校准"留作未来工作。本文旨在填补这一空白并检验厂商的校准承诺。
AI.method: 在八个 BEIR 集合上复现 FLAN-UL2 开放模型设置以确认排序趋势；随后以相同协议评测 Jev 及两个开放权重决策模型（含 27B pplx-decider）；再将 Jev 原生概率与人工相关性标签对比以检验校准性，并用 DL19 的 2,257 个查询-文档对拟合两参数校准，验证其向 DL21 的迁移效果；最后基于校准概率按期望 F1 逐查询选择截断。
AI.result: 排序性能上，Jev 与 27B pplx-decider 平均优于 FLAN-UL2 及三个 cross-encoder。校准检验显示 Jev 过度自信：DL21 中打分 >0.9 的对仅 66% 为相关。两参数校准大幅消除该偏差并可迁移至 DL21；校准后 Jev 的 DL21 Brier 分数低于 FLAN-UL2 与三个 cross-encoder，主要源于更强的相关/非相关区分度。基于校准概率的期望 F1 截断无需额外超参，优于固定 top-10，并与在 DL19 上调优的阈值相当。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型的概率需经校准才能可靠用于阈值与效用决策；一个简单的两参数校准即可显著改善概率质量且具跨集合迁移性，使期望 F1 截断成为无需调参的有效方案。这补足了 'Beyond Yes and No' 的校准缺口，说明校准应作为决策模型重排的标准评估环节。

title: A Computational Map of the Disaster Mental Health Research Landscape
summary: When disasters strike, they not only damage infrastructure, buildings, and the economy, but also affect the mental health of affected populations. Research on the mental health effects of disasters has expanded rapidly and has become an important, well-funded area of psychology, public health, and related social sciences. However, the overall structure of this research landscape has not been systematically characterized. Using large language models, we conducted a review of all articles related to terms 'disaster' and 'mental health' indexed in PubMed. 7,859 articles' metadata were retrieved using the NCBI API, and then Claude Sonnet was used to extract structured variables from the abstracts. The results indicated that earthquakes and epidemics were the most commonly studied disasters while many other disasters such as heat and cold waves have received less attention. PTSD, depression, and anxiety were well investigated but many other mental health issues (e.g., aggression, suicide) are relatively ignored. Despite enjoying relatively large sample sizes (median = 452, IQR = 142 - 1,568), the field rarely utilizes machine learning algorithms. Hypothesis significance testing, reviews, qualitative methods, and structural equation modeling are respectively most common methods while agent-based modeling, machine learning, casual inference, and NLP each appear in less than 1% of articles. Studies are limited to a small number of countries, particularly the United States, Japan, and China, while many disaster-prone regions remain substantially underrepresented. This LLM-assisted computational map provides a broad overview of the disaster mental health literature while highlighting important methodological gaps, with particular emphasis on the underutilization of computational methods that could help advance the field.

AI.tldr: 利用大语言模型对PubMed中7,859篇灾害与心理健康文献进行自动化梳理，揭示灾害类型、心理健康议题、研究方法和地域分布的结构性失衡与方法学缺口。
AI.motivation: 灾害不仅造成基础设施与经济损失，也影响受灾人群心理健康；该领域研究快速扩张且资金充足，但整体研究格局尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 通过NCBI API检索PubMed中含"disaster"与"mental health"的文献，获取7,859篇文献的元数据，并使用Claude Sonnet从摘要中抽取结构化变量，进行LLM辅助的计算性文献计量与主题映射。
AI.result: 地震与流行病研究最多，热浪、寒潮等灾害关注不足；PTSD、抑郁、焦虑研究充分，而攻击行为、自杀等问题相对被忽视；样本量较大（中位数452，IQR 142–1,568），但机器学习算法极少使用；假设检验、综述、质性方法与结构方程模型最常用，而基于主体建模、机器学习、因果推断与NLP各占比不足1%；研究集中于美国、日本、中国等少数国家，多灾害多发地区代表性不足。
AI.conclusion: 该LLM辅助的计算性图谱勾勒了灾害心理健康研究的总体格局，凸显了主题覆盖、方法学与地域分布上的重要缺口，尤其强调计算方法在该领域的利用不足。

title: Lower-Level Agnostic Bilevel Optimization
summary: Bilevel optimization is a fundamental framework for machine learning problems, where an upper-level (UL) objective depends on the solution of a nested lower-level (LL) problem. Existing bilevel algorithms typically assume that the LL objective is available for evaluation, differentiation, or unrolling. However, this assumption can fail when the LL response is produced by a black-box solver, simulator, adversary, or learned predictor. In this paper, we study LL agnostic bilevel optimization, where the UL learner has access only to an approximate LL solution $\bar{\mathbf{y}}(\mathbf{x})$ and cannot query the LL objective, its gradients, Hessian/Jacobian information, or the procedure that generates the LL response. We propose LeGo-BiO, a coordinate-wise pseudo-hypergradient method that estimates the missing Jacobian $\nabla _{\mathbf{x}}\bar{\mathbf{y}}(\mathbf{x})$ using finite differences of $\bar{\mathbf{y}}(\cdot)$. For each UL coordinate, LeGo-BiO constructs a decision vector subject to 1-sparse updates, thereby isolating the corresponding Jacobian column needed in the UL gradient computation. This avoids the directional-projection limitation of full-parameter response differences and, unlike derivative-free/zeroth-order approximations of the entire UL gradient, preserves the available first-order gradient information with respect to the UL variables for more accurate UL gradient evaluation. We establish convergence guarantees for LeGo-BiO in both deterministic and stochastic settings under an LL error-bound/Polyak-Lojasiewicz-type condition, without requiring LL strong convexity. Our bounds yield an $O(T^{-1})$ rate in the deterministic setting and an $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate in the stochastic setting when the LL approximation error decreases geometrically. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance of LeGo-BiO despite being agnostic to the LL objective.

AI.tldr: 提出LeGo-BiO，一种坐标级伪超梯度方法，仅利用下层近似解构造1-稀疏更新，用有限差分逐列估计缺失的Jacobian，实现下层目标不可知的二层优化，并在确定性/随机设定下给出收敛率。
AI.motivation: 现有二层优化算法普遍假设下层(LL)目标可评估、可求导或可展开(unrolling)，但当下层响应来自黑盒求解器、仿真器、对手或学习得到的预测器时，该假设失效，因此需要研究下层完全不可知的二层优化设定。
AI.method: LeGo-BiO采用坐标级伪超梯度(coordinate-wise pseudo-hypergradient)。对上层每个坐标构造服从1-稀疏更新的决策向量，从而隔离上层梯度计算所需的对应Jacobian列 ∇_x ȳ(x)，并以 ȳ(·) 的有限差分估计该列；此做法避免全参数响应差分的方向投影局限，且不同于对整个上层梯度做无导数/零阶近似，保留了上层变量已有的一阶梯度信息。
AI.result: 在下层误差界/Polyak-Łojasiewicz型条件下（不要求下层强凸），确定性设定获得 O(T^{-1}) 收敛率，随机设定在下层近似误差几何衰减时获得 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛率；实验表明尽管对下层目标不可知，LeGo-BiO仍具备有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: LeGo-BiO为下层不可知二层优化提供了可行且理论可证的方案：逐坐标有限差分精确恢复所需Jacobian列并保留上层一阶信息，收敛性仅依赖较弱的误差界条件，实验验证了其有效性。

title: ProofDiff: Auditable Argument-Level Comparison of AI-Generated Mathematical Proofs
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. An earlier version of this work was accepted by the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding. Code and artifacts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23930759
summary:
Mathematical understanding depends on the route from hypotheses to conclusion: how the parts of a proof function and which dependencies carry the argument forward. This structure can persist when wording or notation changes, while a small alteration to a hypothesis or inference can produce a different argument beneath similar prose. Formal verification can establish that a rewrite proves the same theorem, but not whether it follows the same mathematical route. Comparing informal proofs, especially those produced or revised by generative models, therefore requires reconstructing which claims, dependencies, and reasoning steps are preserved, reorganized, or replaced.
  We present ProofDiff, a system for comparing informal mathematical documents. It is designed to support human review, not to certify mathematical correctness. Given two documents, ProofDiff independently constructs a source-grounded argument map for each and proposes correspondences between the resulting maps. Each map captures the document's claims and reasoning steps and records the typed relations that connect them. An integrated human-review layer allows reviewers to revise the maps and correspondences while preserving an auditable history. Comparing the two argument maps provides a basis for inspecting whether the documents follow the same mathematical route and where their claims or dependencies differ. We demonstrate ProofDiff on four illustrative pairs of AI-generated proofs, ranging from a detailed proof and its concise revision to proofs using different mathematical strategies.

AI.tldr: ProofDiff 通过为两份非形式数学文档分别构建"论证地图"并提出地图间对应关系，支持人工审查两份证明是否沿同一数学路径推进。
AI.motivation: 数学理解取决于从假设到结论的路径（证明各部分如何起作用、哪些依赖支撑论证）。该结构可在措辞或记号变化时保持不变，而对假设或推理的小改动可能在相似文字下产生不同论证。形式化验证只能确认改写后证明的是同一定理，无法判断是否走同一数学路径；因此比较非形式证明（尤其生成模型产出或修改的证明）需要重建哪些断言、依赖与推理步骤被保留、重组或替换。
AI.method: 提出 ProofDiff 系统：给定两份文档，独立地为每份构建有原文依据（source-grounded）的论证地图，捕捉其断言与推理步骤，并记录连接它们的类型化关系；随后在两张地图之间提出对应关系。系统内置人工审查层，允许审查者修改地图与对应关系，同时保留可审计的历史记录。系统定位为辅助人工审查，而非证明数学正确性。
AI.result: 通过比较两张论证地图，可据以检查两文档是否遵循同一数学路径、以及在何处断言或依赖存在差异。在四组 AI 生成的证明对上进行了演示，涵盖从详细证明到其精简修订版，以及采用不同数学策略的证明等情形。
AI.conclusion: ProofDiff 提供了一种以论证结构（而非仅定理等价性）为中心的非形式证明比较范式，并通过可审计的人机协同审查支持对生成式模型产出证明的路径级差异分析。

title: Not All Branches Are Equal: Adaptive Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation models represent items as sequences of discrete tokens known as semantic IDs. Existing approaches derive these identifiers using residual or hierarchical vector quantization, assuming that tokens carry independent semantic meaning across quantization levels. Revisiting this assumption, we argue that semantic IDs should behave as hierarchical paths where each token's meaning is conditioned on its prefix. This highlights a mismatch between conventional fixed-codebook quantization and the hierarchical structure implicitly learned by generative recommenders. Motivated by this insight, we propose Adaptive Silhouette Tree (AST), a top-down divisive clustering method that constructs semantic IDs as paths within a tree structure. Unlike prior methods with fixed branching factors, AST dynamically determines the number of branches at each node by maximizing the silhouette coefficient, enabling finer partitions in dense regions and compact groupings in homogeneous ones. We further introduce constrained variants that enforce minimum probability mass during splitting to improve supervision for long-tail items.
