Extensive experiments on five Amazon Review datasets of varying sizes and domains show that AST significantly outperforms strong baselines. These results demonstrate that aligning semantic ID construction with the inherent hierarchical structure of generative recommenders leads to more effective recommendations.

AI.tldr: 将语义ID构造为树上的层级路径，用自适应轮廓系数决定分支数的自顶向下分裂聚类方法AST，在五个Amazon数据集上显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐模型用离散token序列（语义ID）表示物品，现有方法基于残差/层次向量量化，假设各量化层级上的token语义独立。作者认为语义ID应表现为层级路径，token语义以其前缀为条件，即存在"前缀条件化"的层级结构；这与固定码本的量化方式存在不匹配。
AI.method: 提出Adaptive Silhouette Tree（AST）：自顶向下的分裂式聚类，将语义ID构造为树中的路径。不同于固定分支数的先验方法，AST在每个节点通过最大化轮廓系数（silhouette coefficient）动态确定分支数量，使稠密区域划分更细、同质区域更紧凑。此外引入约束变体，在分裂时强制最小概率质量（minimum probability mass），以改善长尾物品的监督。
AI.result: 在五个规模与领域各异的Amazon Review数据集上，AST显著优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 让语义ID的构造与生成式推荐器内在的层级结构对齐，可获得更有效的推荐效果。

title: Towards Identity-Preserving LLM Agents under Model Transition
summary: When an LLM agent's backend model is upgraded or replaced, operators typically reload the same persona, memory, and rules onto the new model and assume the agent will behave as before. We show this assumption requires empirical validation-and that whether identity is preserved depends on the specific model pairing. Across 5,760 compliance-testing runs in 12 regulated domains with three open-weight models, we find that some transitions produce significant behavioral drift while others do not, even when the agent's external state remains identical. Crucially, this drift is invisible to verbal verification: every model claims full policy compliance, yet actual decisions under pressure differ across models. The same external state can reorder which model is most compliant-a large positive effect on one substrate, negligible on the other two. Practitioners should treat model transitions as behavioral changes requiring action-level empirical testing, not as transparent infrastructure operations.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体更换后端模型后，即便外部状态（人格、记忆、规则）完全不变，行为也可能发生显著漂移，且此类漂移无法通过语言化合规声明检测，需以行动级实验验证身份是否保持。
AI.motivation: 实践者普遍假设：升级或替换LLM智能体后端模型后，只需重载相同的人格、记忆与规则即可保持行为一致，即把模型迁移视为透明的基础设施操作。作者质疑这一假设，旨在检验模型迁移后智能体"身份"是否被保留，并揭示该假设所需的经验验证前提。
AI.method: 在12个受监管领域开展5,760次合规测试运行，使用三个开源权重模型；对外部状态进行严格控制（保持一致），比较模型迁移前后的行为差异，并对照模型的语言化自我报告（声称完全合规）与实际压力情境下的决策行为。
AI.result: 部分模型配对出现显著行为漂移，另一些则无显著变化；漂移对语言验证不可见——所有模型均声称完全遵守政策，但压力下的实际决策因模型而异；相同外部状态会改变"最合规模型"的排序，即某模型上呈现大幅正向效应，而在另外两个基座上可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 身份保持取决于具体模型配对，不能默认成立；应把模型迁移视为需要行动级实证测试的行为变更，而非透明的基础设施操作。

title: RAD-TFM: Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models
summary: The development of tabular foundation models (TFMs) has accelerated in recent years, outperforming traditional ML methods on many tabular benchmarks. A key finding is that TFMs can be pretrained entirely on synthetic datasets, opening opportunities to design data generators that encourage desirable model properties. Prior work has mainly focused on crafting high-quality priors over generators to improve overall pretraining performance. Our key insight is that parameterizing the generator distribution enables an adversarial, distributional robustness perspective: during training, we can adapt the generator to emphasize datasets that are particularly challenging for the model, which we formalize by introducing an optimality gap measure. Further, we develop a method to align the synthetic data generation with real-world datasets from a given domain, constraining the adversary to generate realistic data. Together, these algorithms comprise the Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models (RAD-TFM) pipeline, a model-agnostic adversarial training framework. Applied to the TabPFN V2 classifier, RAD-TFM improves performance across 6 diverse tabular benchmarks, with up to a 10.8 percentage-point improvement in mean normalized AUC over the strongest baseline, using fewer than 100k additional synthetic training datasets, less than 0.1% of the original pretraining data. Applying the same pipeline to TabICL V2 also improves performance across three major benchmarks, demonstrating the generality of the framework. These results highlight a promising new direction for targeted adversarial continued training of TFMs using synthetic data alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAD-TFM，一种模型无关的对抗式续训框架：将合成数据生成器分布参数化，使"对抗方"自适应地强化对模型困难的合成数据集，并以最优性差距（optimality gap）度量，同时约束生成器生成与目标域真实数据对齐的样本，实现通用性与领域适配兼具的表格基础模型训练。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）可完全依赖合成数据预训练，但现有工作主要靠人工设计高质量先验来提升整体预训练性能，缺少针对模型薄弱环节与目标域分布的定向优化手段。作者希望把生成器分布视为可调节变量，从分布鲁棒性角度主动挖掘困难样本，并将合成数据与真实领域数据对齐。
AI.method: 1）参数化合成数据生成器分布，构造对抗训练：训练过程中调整生成器以偏重当前模型表现差（最优性差距大）的合成数据集；2）引入最优性差距度量量化"困难程度"；3）设计领域对齐方法，将生成分布约束到给定领域的真实数据分布附近，使对抗方只能生成"真实可信"的数据；4）将上述算法组合为 RAD-TFM 流水线，属模型无关框架，可作用于 TabPFN V2、TabICL V2 等不同分类器。
AI.result: 在 TabPFN V2 分类器上，RAD-TFM 在 6 个多样化表格基准上全面提升，平均归一化 AUC 相比最强基线最多提升 10.8 个百分点；仅使用不足 10 万个额外合成训练数据集（不到原始预训练数据的 0.1%）。将同一流水线应用于 TabICL V2，在三个主要基准上同样获得提升，验证了框架的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠合成数据的定向对抗式续训是提升表格基础模型性能的有效新方向；将生成器分布参数化可实现困难样本挖掘与领域对齐的统一，且以极小的数据代价获得显著增益，并具备跨模型的可迁移性。

title: ScreenProof: Where Is This Screen Wrong? Finding UI Faults Without a Reference
summary: A phone screen can be wrong in ways that need no reference: a label that runs off the screen, letters that touch, a line that breaks one character before its end, one button with sharp corners among round ones. We ask whether a model can box every such fault on a screenshot, given no target design and no reference image. Such a critic could serve as a cheap first pass over generated pages before a designer reviews them, but only if it stays silent on clean pages. ScreenProof poses this target-free critique over three families of faults: general faults, local style faults (one element breaks the style its page sets) and text layout faults (letter spacing, line height, line breaks). A data engine makes each fault in page code and records the changed element's box, and hard negatives change every sibling alike. No frontier judge is reliable: frontier models flag 18-62% of clean real screenshots and 18-82% of clean generated pages, find 47-72% of text layout faults, and rarely find a foreign icon (5-19%). Our small critic ProofJudge (Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA), trained on code-made pages with one to four faults each and keeping a finding only when it is confident, reaches F1 0.48, the highest of all judges (Gemini 4 Argon 0.37; open models at most 0.15; 0.46 even without the confidence cut), and is the only fault-finding judge within 15% false alarms on clean pages (2% real, 9% generated), the property such a first pass needs, at about a hundredth of Argon's cost. It finds the most general faults (59%) but fewer local style faults than Argon (25% against 41%) and fewer text layout faults than the API judges (43%; Gemini 4 Argon 47%). Against a named brand the task is harder still: models know a design language about as well as its public documentation states it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免参考（target-free）的 UI 截图缺陷定位任务 ScreenProof，要求模型在无目标设计、无参考图条件下框出截图中的每处缺陷；并训练小型评论模型 ProofJudge（Qwen3.5-9B + LoRA），以 F1 0.48 超越所有前沿判别模型，且是唯一在干净页面上误报率低于 15% 的模型。
AI.motivation: 手机屏幕存在无需对照即可判定的缺陷（标签溢出、字符粘连、断行错位、圆角不一致等）。若模型能在无参考设计的情况下定位这类缺陷，并保持对干净页面的沉默，便可作为生成页面在设计评审前的廉价初筛。现有前沿模型判别不可靠：对干净真实截图误报 18–62%，对干净生成页面误报 18–82%，对外来图标检出率仅 5–19%。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenProof 基准，覆盖三类缺陷：通用缺陷、局部样式缺陷（某元素违反页面自身风格）、文字布局缺陷（字距、行高、断行）。数据引擎在页面代码中注入缺陷并记录被改元素的边界框；硬负样本对同级元素同步改动以抑制伪相关。训练小型评论模型 ProofJudge（Qwen3.5-9B 加 LoRA），训练数据为每条含 1–4 处缺陷的代码生成页面，推理时仅保留高置信度的发现。
AI.result: ProofJudge 取得 F1 0.48，为所有判别模型最高（Gemini 4 Argon 0.37，开源模型最高约 0.15；去除置信度筛选后仍达 0.46）；是唯一在干净页面上误报低于 15% 的检出模型（真实页面 2%，生成页面 9%），成本约为 Argon 的百分之一。分项：通用缺陷检出最高（59%），局部样式缺陷 25%（Argon 41%），文字布局缺陷 43%（Gemini 4 Argon 47%）。面对指定品牌时任务更难，模型掌握的设计语言水平与公开文档所述相当。
AI.conclusion: 免参考的截图缺陷定位可行且价值明确：小型专用模型经代码合成数据训练与置信度过滤，能在极低误报与极低成本下超越前沿通用判别模型，适合作为设计评审前的初筛。但其在局部样式与文字布局缺陷上仍落后于大模型，品牌特定设计规范下的泛化仍是开放挑战。

title: Proactive Dimension-Adaptive Denoising for Graph Collaborative Filtering via Representation Coherence
summary: Implicit feedback in recommender systems contains noisy interactions (e.g., accidental clicks, impulse purchases) that propagate through user-item graphs and contaminate learned representations. Existing explicit denoising methods uniformly rely on training loss to estimate interaction reliability. However, loss is a fundamentally passive signal: it detects noise only after it has caused prediction errors, and it is heavily confounded by training stage, negative sampling, and hard positives. We propose Noise-aware Dimension Learning (NDL), a proactive dimension-adaptive denoising framework. NDL introduces Representation Coherence Detection (RCD), which evaluates the coherence between an interaction representation and the user's historical preference centroid in embedding space, providing an active noise signal independent of loss. RCD and the loss signal are fused via activity-aware weighting (active users rely more on coherence while cold-start users automatically fall back to loss), and the fused estimate drives an interaction-level dimension-adaptive mask that limits the effective representation capacity of unreliable interactions. A lightweight contrastive regularizer further improves embedding uniformity, stabilizing the geometry on which RCD discriminates. On three public benchmarks NDL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art denoising methods, lifting Recall@5 by +17.95% on Amazon-book, +12.33% on Yelp, and +5.63% on MovieLens-1M over the strongest baseline DAR; the core variant without contrastive learning already surpasses DAR on sparser datasets, confirming representation coherence as the primary driver of these gains. NDL is confined to the training loop and is serving-compatible with LightGCN-based production pipelines, adding no online latency or parameters at inference time. Code: https://github.com/GordonDongZHAO/NDL

AI.tldr: 提出 Noise-aware Dimension Learning (NDL)，用"表示一致性"这一主动信号弥补训练损失作为噪声判别依据的被动性，实现交互级、维度自适应的去噪，在不增加推理开销的前提下显著超越 DAR。
AI.motivation: 隐式反馈中的噪声交互（误点、冲动购买）会沿用户-物品图传播并污染表示。现有显式去噪方法统一依赖训练损失估计交互可靠性，而损失是"被动"信号：只有噪声已造成预测误差后才被察觉，且严重受训练阶段、负采样和难正样本混杂影响。
AI.method: NDL 框架包含：(1) Representation Coherence Detection (RCD)，在嵌入空间衡量交互表示与用户历史偏好质心的一致性，提供独立于损失的主动噪声信号；(2) activity-aware weighting，按用户活跃度融合 RCD 与损失信号——活跃用户更依赖一致性，冷启动用户自动回退到损失；(3) 由融合估计驱动交互级维度自适应掩码，限制不可靠交互的有效表示容量；(4) 轻量对比正则项提升嵌入均匀性，稳定 RCD 判别所依赖的几何结构。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上一致优于 SOTA 去噪方法：Recall@5 相对最强基线 DAR 提升 Amazon-book +17.95%、Yelp +12.33%、MovieLens-1M +5.63%；不含对比学习的核心变体在更稀疏数据集上已超过 DAR，表明表示一致性是性能增益的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 表示一致性可作为有效的主动去噪信号，与损失信号互补；NDL 仅作用于训练循环，与基于 LightGCN 的生产流水线兼容，推理阶段不增加在线延迟与参数。

title: Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions
summary: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.

AI.tldr: 将基于排队的MDP出院决策与周期性重训练的再入院风险预测器结合，证明"capacity-aware"的discharge-up-to策略能在无显式公平约束下自然实现无偏风险估计，学习误差较阈值策略降低24%-25%，再入院成本差异降低38%-63%。
AI.motivation: 预测算法日益用于指导出院决策，但因历史数据不足或既往出院决策影响，模型对弱势患者存在censoring bias；当有偏的再入院风险预测器指导出院时，决策产生的训练数据在重训练中会延续甚至放大偏见，形成恶性循环。作者希望找到一种运营决策策略，在无显式公平约束下打破该循环。
AI.method: 将用于出院决策的排队论Markov决策过程扩展为纳入周期性重训练的再入院风险预测器；核心洞察是成本最优的"capacity-aware"决策策略会自然使患者结局被观测的住院时长多样化，从而可一致地估计再入院风险。理论上证明在well-specification下，discharge-up-to策略下反复重训练收敛到无偏风险估计；实验上用合成数据及基于合作医院患者级数据校准的模拟，与常规的threshold-on-risk等status quo策略对比。
AI.result: 常用threshold-on-risk策略可能持续存在偏差；discharge-up-to策略相较status quo决策策略将学习误差降低24%-25%；估计改善同时缓解部分偏见，使按人口学分组基线风险差异调整后的再入院成本差异降低38%-63%。
AI.conclusion: capacity-aware决策策略通过解决censoring bias，可同时提升预测性能与公平性；无需显式公平约束即可在成本最优运营策略中内生地获得无偏风险估计，为预测与决策的闭环反馈提供了理论依据与实践路径。

title: Implicit Bias in State Space Models and Linear Autoregressive Training
summary:
Linear State Space Models (SSMs) and linear autoregressive sequence models reuse the same parameters across a sample-dependent number of steps. As a result, different examples impose constraints through different predictors, even though all predictors share the same weights. We study this phenomenon through a general model of multiple non-homogeneous polynomial predictors with shared parameters, in a classification setting. Under standard interpolation and directional-convergence assumptions, together with a trajectory-dependent effective-degree condition, we show that gradient descent on the exponential loss converges in direction to a KKT point of an effective-degree max-margin problem. In this problem, only examples with minimal effective degree impose hard margin constraints; examples with faster-growing margins are asymptotically inactive except for feasibility.
  Our result provides a first-order characterization of the implicit bias in linear SSMs and linear autoregressive models. It exposes a mechanism of length bias: a longer input sequence or additional autoregressive steps may increase the example's effective degree, and the examples with the smallest effective degree dominate the limiting classifier. Our result highlights how non-homogeneity and parameter sharing alter classical homogeneous implicit-bias results.

AI.tldr: 该文研究线性状态空间模型（SSM）与线性自回归模型中参数在样例相关步数上复用所导致的隐式偏置，证明梯度下降方向收敛于一个"有效次数最大间隔问题"的KKT点，仅有效次数最小的样例构成硬间隔约束，从而揭示长度偏置机制。
AI.motivation: 线性SSM与线性自回归模型对每个样例在样本相关的步数上重复使用同一组参数，导致不同样例经由不同的预测器施加约束，即便这些预测器共享权重。经典同质模型的隐式偏置结论无法直接解释该现象，作者希望从一阶角度刻画这种非均匀、参数共享结构下的隐式偏置，尤其关注序列长度如何影响极限分类器。
AI.method: 在分类设定下建立一般模型：多个共享参数的非同质多项式预测器。在标准插值假设与方向收敛假设、以及依赖轨迹的有效次数（effective degree）条件下，分析指数损失上的梯度下降的渐近方向，并将其与有效次数最大间隔问题的KKT点建立对应。
AI.result: 证明梯度下降在方向上收敛到有效次数最大间隔问题的KKT点；该问题中仅有效次数最小的样例施加硬间隔约束，而间隔增长更快的样例渐近不起作用（除可行性外非激活）。由此给出线性SSM与线性自回归模型隐式偏置的首个一阶刻画，并揭示长度偏置：更长输入序列或更多自回归步会提高样例的有效次数，有效次数最小的样例主导极限分类器。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明非同质性与参数共享如何改变经典同质隐式偏置结果，将隐式偏置从"全局同质范数最小化"推广到"按有效次数分层的最大间隔选择"，为理解序列模型中长度相关的归纳偏置提供理论工具。

title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
comment: Paper Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
summary: Context selection can reduce input length during long-input inference but can remove evidence required to answer a query. We introduce CoRA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation under shared token budgets. We compare head and tail truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, dense retrieval with reranking, LLMLingua-2, and Provence across BABILong, LOONG Financial Spotlight, a custom NoLiMa diagnostic, and LongMemEval. Evidence-preservation results reveal task-dependent tradeoffs: BM25 achieves 0.921 supporting-fact recall on BABILong at 128K, dense retrieval and dense reranking each achieve 0.908 needle recall on NoLiMa at 64K, and dense retrieval achieves 0.993 answer-bearing-turn recall on LongMemEval at 64K. Evidence, token retention, and complementary reader evaluations use the same selected contexts. Reader evaluations use dataset-native answer metrics and three runs on the same questions, with paired bootstrap confidence intervals. At a 32K budget, BM25 achieves 46.20% BABILong answer accuracy and dense retrieval achieves 71.13% LongMemEval accuracy. The results show that method rankings vary across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoRA-Bench，在共享 token 预算下系统评测多种上下文选择方法对证据的保留能力，发现方法间存在任务依赖的权衡，且证据召回排名与下游答案准确率排名并不一致。
AI.motivation: 长输入推理中，上下文选择虽能缩短输入长度，却可能删除回答查询所必需的证据；现有工作缺乏在统一 token 预算约束下对"证据保留"的公平评估。
AI.method: 构建 CoRA-Bench 基准，在相同 token 预算下对比头/尾截断、BM25、稠密检索、稠密检索加重排序、LLMLingua-2 与 Provence；在 BABILong、LOONG Financial Spotlight、自建 NoLiMa 诊断集与 LongMemEval 四个数据集上同时测量证据召回、token 保留率与阅读器答案指标，阅读器评测采用数据集原生答案指标、同一问题重复三次并用配对 bootstrap 置信区间。
AI.result: 证据保留：BABILong 128K 下 BM25 支持事实召回 0.921；NoLiMa 64K 下稠密检索与稠密重排序针召回各为 0.908；LongMemEval 64K 下稠密检索答案承载轮次召回 0.993。下游准确率：32K 预算下 BM25 在 BABILong 达 46.20%，稠密检索在 LongMemEval 达 71.13%。
AI.conclusion: 上下文选择方法的最优性随证据类型而变，且证据召回与下游准确率之间的排序不一致，说明单一证据指标不足以代表最终效果，需在统一预算下对证据保留与端到端性能联合评估。

title: Multi-Modal Agricultural Document Understanding at the DAGRI Task
summary: Agricultural documents, such as prefectural technical reports and crop calendars, are critical knowledge resources. However, their complex table layouts, significant variations in document length, and dense multi-modal elements pose substantial challenges for automated understanding. To address these issues, the NTCIR-19 DAGRI (Data Analytics for aGRicultural Information) task introduced three subtasks focusing on different dimensions of document intelligence. In the Table Information Extraction (TableIE) task, we developed a multi-stage pipeline combining structure-preserving parsing via MinerU, region-adaptive segmentation for long documents, and a dual-modal (vision-text) extraction strategy for complex work schedules. This approach achieved first place with an exact match score of 0.6566. For Multi-Table Multi-Hop Question Answering (MTMH-QA) over interrelated JSON tables, we adopted an agentic search framework utilizing DCI-Agent to iteratively explore directories via bash commands, reinforced by a cross-model validation mechanism. This yielded a revised accuracy of 0.8444, initially ranked first. In the Figure and Table Question Answering (FiT-QA) task, which requires comprehending single large composite images, we implemented a dual-modal VLM pipeline enhanced by deterministic answer normalization, securing the highest BLEU score. Together, our system effectively addresses regional structural variations, dynamic cross-file evidence discovery, and multi-modal alignment, providing a robust framework for complex agricultural document understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文为NTCIR-19 DAGRI任务的系统报告，针对农业文档的复杂表格布局、长度差异与多模态密集性，提出覆盖TableIE、MTMH-QA、FiT-QA三个子任务的多阶段方案，分别在精确匹配、修订准确率与BLEU上取得领先成绩。
AI.motivation: 县级技术报告与作物日历等农业文档是关键知识资源，但其复杂表格版面、显著的文档长度差异和密集多模态元素给自动理解带来巨大挑战；为此NTCIR-19设立DAGRI任务，从表格抽取、跨表多跳问答与图表问答三个维度考察文档智能。
AI.method: TableIE：采用多阶段流水线，MinerU保持结构的解析、针对长文档的区域自适应切分，以及面向复杂作业计划的视觉-文本双模态抽取策略。MTMH-QA：面向相互关联JSON表的多表多跳问答，采用基于DCI-Agent的智能体检索框架，通过bash命令迭代探索目录，并辅以跨模型验证机制。FiT-QA：面向单一大型复合图像的图表问答，构建双模态VLM流水线，并引入确定性的答案规范化处理。
AI.result: TableIE以0.6566的精确匹配分数位列第一；MTMH-QA修订后准确率为0.8444，初评排名第一；FiT-QA取得最高BLEU分数。
AI.conclusion: 该组合系统有效应对区域版式结构差异、动态跨文件证据发现与多模态对齐三类问题，为复杂农业文档理解提供了稳健框架。

title: Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification
comment: 43 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, supplementary material included. Tobias Penzkofer and Jawed Nawabi share last authorship. Code: https://github.com/ibrarad/radiology-agent-safeguards
summary:
Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors.
  Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks.
  Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision.
  Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.

AI.tldr: 该模拟研究显示，仅靠权限设置的LLM智能体在放射学文书任务中有19.4%（汇合）的回合出现高严重度临床相关错误；叠加确定性规则与本地LLM检查器可分别降低2.8与6.2个百分点，但无法消除错误。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型LLM智能体正被引入放射学文书与流程管理，但其是否会记录临床上错误或无依据的信息、以及逐动作前置防护措施能降低多少此类错误，此前缺乏量化证据。
AI.method: 模拟研究（2026年10月）：48个经放射科医师审核的合成基础情景（涵盖所见沟通、肿瘤委员会准备、随访管理），其中43个另设误导信息变体，共91个变体；6个LLM智能体在三种防护条件下完成任务——仅权限、确定性规则、规则＋本地LLM检查器，共1638个回合。主要结局为每回合至少一次已执行的高严重度违规；以基础情景层级估计各智能体风险差并探索性跨智能体汇合，另分析文档访问与被阻断动作。
AI.result: 仅权限条件下高严重度违规率7.3%–27.1%（汇合19.4%）；加规则后为16.7%（−2.8个百分点，95% CI：−6.1, 0.5）；规则＋LLM检查器为13.2%（−6.2，95% CI：−9.5, −3.0）；在规则之上再加LLM检查器增益为−3.5（95% CI：−6.3, −0.7）。未检出智能体间差异（P=0.43），任务成功率未见可检测下降。误导变体中，83%的回合打开了被篡改文档（无论是否出错），58%的错误陈述引用了该文档；被阻断动作中64%–68%本不会导致违规且被退回修改。
AI.conclusion: 分层防护可减少但不能阻止高严重度错误；误导信息后的错误源于对信息的误判而非遗漏获取。

title: PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate sessions of up to millions of tokens, far more key-value (KV) cache than one GPU holds, so serving systems keep a small budget of tokens and evict the rest. Eviction methods differ in which tokens they keep but share one goal: that the tokens a later step needs are still cached. We show this is not enough. In 100K-token coding sessions on Qwen3-8B with a 2,048-token budget, a planner-guided policy that keeps over 99% of the needed tokens resident still fails late steps increasingly often: its accuracy falls from 93% to 64% as the gap between a definition and its use grows from 2K to 90K tokens, at residency 0.996. The needed tokens are resident but unretrievable: what grows is their rotary-position distance to the query. We present PACE (Planner-Aware Context Engine), a KV-cache engine that couples plan-aware retention, in which the agent's planner tells the cache which context future steps will read, with bounded positions, which renumber kept tokens so their rotary distance to the query stays below 8K at any session length. In a pre-registered evaluation on fresh tasks, PACE passes 97% of hidden unit tests at 100K tokens, against 42% for H2O and 3% for SnapKV under the same budget, and needs both components: either alone reaches 63% (the combination beats each, p < 10^-4). The result holds with length: in 1M- and 2M-token sessions on one 24 GB GPU, with definitions written 0.9M and 1.8M tokens before use, PACE passes 99% and 100% of checks and recalls every session fact, while bounded positions without foresight falls from 33% to 13%; PACE holds under 0.7 GB of KV state where the full cache would need 147-295 GB. Renumbering is exact, costs no measurable perplexity, and adds 9% wall time. On Mistral-7B, whose coding ability caps it at 40% even with nothing evicted, PACE stays at that ceiling while retention alone falls below it.

AI.tldr: 论文指出长时程 LLM 智能体的 KV 缓存淘汰仅保证"所需 token 常驻"并不充分：真正的瓶颈是这些 token 与查询之间的旋转位置距离过大而变得不可检索。作者提出 PACE，将"计划感知保留"与"有界位置重编号"耦合，在 2K 预算下 100K 会话隐藏单测通过率达 97%（H2O 42%、SnapKV 3%），并扩展到 1M/2M token 会话。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体会话可达数百万 token，KV 缓存远超单 GPU 容量，服务系统只能保留小预算 token 并淘汰其余。现有淘汰方法的分歧在于"保留哪些 token"，但共享同一目标假设：只要后续步骤需要的 token 仍在缓存中即可。作者通过实验证伪该假设：在 Qwen3-8B、100K 编码会话、2,048 token 预算下，计划引导策略的常驻率达到 0.996（保留超过 99% 所需 token），准确率仍随"定义—使用"间距从 2K 增至 90K 而从 93% 跌至 64%。说明所需 token 虽常驻却不可检索，随间距增长的是它们相对查询的旋转位置距离。
AI.method: PACE（Planner-Aware Context Engine）包含两个耦合组件：(1) 计划感知保留——由智能体 planner 告知缓存未来步骤将读取哪些上下文，据此决定保留；(2) 有界位置——对被保留 token 重新编号，使其相对查询的旋转位置距离在任意会话长度下均低于 8K。二者被论证为缺一不可。重编号是精确的（exact），不引入可测的困惑度损失，仅增加 9% 墙钟时间。
AI.result: 在新任务的预注册评测中，100K token 下 PACE 通过 97% 隐藏单测，H2O 为 42%，SnapKV 为 3%（同等预算）；消融显示任一组件单独仅达 63%，组合显著优于各自（p < 10^-4）。长上下文同样成立：单张 24 GB GPU 上 1M 与 2M token 会话（定义早于使用 0.9M / 1.8M token），PACE 分别通过 99% 与 100% 的检查并召回全部会话事实，而无前瞻的有界位置从 33% 降至 13%；PACE 仅占 0.7 GB 以下 KV 状态，完整缓存需 147–295 GB。Mistral-7B 上其编码能力上限为 40%（即使不淘汰），PACE 保持在该上限，仅保留策略则低于上限。
AI.conclusion: KV 缓存淘汰的正确目标不是"所需 token 常驻"而是"所需 token 可检索"：在固定预算下，常驻率接近 1 仍会因旋转位置距离随会话增长而失效。将前瞻性保留与位置重编号结合，可在极小 KV 占用（<0.7 GB）下把有效上下文扩展到百万级 token，且重编号近乎无代价。结论亦具边界性：PACE 不会超越模型自身能力上限，只保证不因缓存机制而损失。

title: Is Recursive Self-Improvement Safe?
comment: To appear in IEEE Intelligent Systems
summary: The phrase recursive self-improvement (RSI) refers to the idea of an AI system designing and creating another, better AI system, which in turn designs and creates an even better one, and so on. While the idea has a long history, it has always been an abstract, futuristic idea -- until recently. Today's frontier AI has attained a set of abilities, including in programming, mathematics, research, tool use, and working coherently over extended periods of time, that make RSI seem plausible. AI companies are starting to pursue it, but many of the involved people are also expressing concerns, asking whether humanity should really set this in motion and under what conditions. I will discuss the situation, argue that we do not even have clear frameworks for thinking about the likely outcomes of RSI, and do a quick game-theoretic analysis of how to choose whether to initiate RSI when another party is making the same choice.

AI.tldr: 该文讨论递归自我改进（RSI）从抽象构想变为现实可能性的现状，指出当前缺乏评估RSI可能后果的清晰框架，并对"在他人同样面临是否启动RSI抉择时如何决策"进行简要博弈论分析。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI在编程、数学、研究、工具使用及长时段连贯工作等方面已具备使RSI看似可行的能力，AI企业开始追求RSI，同时相关人士表达担忧，追问人类是否应启动RSI及在何种条件下启动，因此需要厘清现状与决策逻辑。
AI.method: 概念界定与现状评述相结合；论证当前缺乏思考RSI可能结果的清晰框架；采用简化博弈论模型分析两方在"是否启动RSI"上的策略选择。
AI.result: 论文为主张性/分析性工作，未给出实证结果；核心论断是RSI已由远期抽象设想转为具现实可能性的议题，而现有分析框架不足以判断其可能结果，博弈论分析揭示单方决策受他方行为影响的结构性困境。
AI.conclusion: RSI的启动决策不宜孤立看待，需在缺乏成熟评估框架的条件下审慎权衡，并重视多方竞争互动带来的决策外部性。

title: CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?
summary: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「上下文提示优化（CHO）」问题，并构建CHO-Bench，系统评估7种提示生成策略及统一策略在LLM广告排序中的效果。基于五个数据集、超过119万次配对评估显示：上下文提示可提升离线排序表现，但单一维度策略平均收益相近、统一策略并无稳定优势；提升预算可继续改善排序但边际递减。
AI.motivation: LLM广告依据用户对话选广告，用户需求常超出显式商品搜索。ChatGPT Ads允许广告主提供自然语言"上下文提示"（说明提供什么、谁适用、何时适用）作为排序补充信息，但如何有效构建这些提示尚无明确方法，缺乏系统性的生成策略与评测基准。
AI.method: 将CHO形式化为在给定预算下构造上下文提示以提升广告排序的问题；借鉴营销框架设计覆盖What、Who、When的七种提示生成策略，并设一个融合七维度的统一策略；构建CHO-Bench，在五个数据集上使用基于嵌入与基于LLM的两类排序器进行超过1.19百万次配对评估，并考察生成-排序配置与提示预算的影响。
AI.result: 在所评估的离线排序器上，上下文提示普遍提升广告排名；各单一策略平均增益相近，统一策略无一致优势；在特定生成-排序配置下策略差异显著，嵌入型与LLM型排序器偏好不同的信息维度；增加提示预算可进一步改善排序但边际收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了研究LLM广告中广告侧排序优化的离线基准，揭示了模型特异性提示选择与预算感知的生成与聚合的机会，为后续面向真实在线环境的方法设计提供依据。

title: FraudBench: A Legal Evaluation of AI Deception
summary: We introduce FraudBench, an evaluation of large language models' (LLMs) propensities to recommend, assist, or directly take actions that would constitute fraud under U.S. law. Our evaluation contains a novel dataset of 159 scenarios based on real-world U.S. court cases and validated by legal experts. We present each scenario to LLMs via three tasks at varying levels of autonomy: advising users, drafting messages for users to send, and acting directly on behalf of users (477 tasks total). In each scenario, FraudBench re-enacts the facts of a court case to give LLMs an opportunity, but no explicit instruction, to either misrepresent or conceal a material fact in a high-stakes commercial setting--e.g., whether to describe company-funded product testing as "independent" to customers (misrepresentation) or whether to hide unfavorable regulatory investigations from clients (concealment). We evaluate 20 LLMs across 25 experimental conditions (totaling >300,000 generations) and include a preregistered human baseline ($n_{\texttt{annotations}} = 2{,}957$, $n_{\texttt{humans}} = 996$). We score a response as fraudulent when it engages in, assists with, or recommends misrepresentation or concealment. Key findings include: (1) across LLMs, fraud rates ranged from near 0% to over 40%; (2) LLM fraud rates increased with autonomy, with overall rates of 3.0% when advising, 14.7% when drafting, and 21.4% when acting directly, without applying pressure; (3) LLMs sometimes engaged in fraud despite recognizing legal risks; (4) LLMs more often engaged in fraud by concealment than by misrepresentation; and (5) prompt-based interventions substantially affected fraud rates, with a prompt to obey the law reducing fraud rates, while prompts to maximize profits and act agentically increased fraud rates.

title: Can Time Series Foundation Models Serve as Surrogates for Power Systems Dynamic Simulation?
comment: Accepted for publication at NeurIPS 2026 Foundation Models for Temporal Systems Workshop
summary: High-fidelity dynamic simulation is essential for scientific and engineering applications, but its computational cost limits large-scale scenario screening. We investigate the use of pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as computationally efficient surrogates to address this limitation. In-context learning and post-training strategies, including retrieval-augmented reference sample selection and physics-informed regularization, are considered in the investigation. Results are benchmarked against a traditional AI model representative of the state-of-the-art in the domain. Experiments using an open-source TSFM and data from a simulated 9-bus power system indicate promising results. Retrieval augmentation improves in-context learning performance, and fine-tuning leads to superior results compared to the traditional AI model, especially when including physics-informed regularization. The fine-tuned TSFMs achieve lower errors and improved computational costs compared to the traditional AI model, and a 563$\times$ speedup compared to the original physics-based simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）作为高保真动态仿真的高效代理模型，比较上下文学习与后训练（检索增强参考样本选择、物理信息正则化）策略，并在9节点电力系统数据上验证其优于传统AI模型且较原物理仿真加速563倍。
AI.motivation: 高保真动态仿真对科学与工程应用至关重要，但其计算成本限制了大规模场景筛选，因此需要计算高效的代理模型来替代或加速仿真。
AI.method: 以开源TSFM为对象，采用上下文学习与后训练两类策略；后训练中引入检索增强的参考样本选择与物理信息正则化；以该领域代表性传统AI模型作为基准，在仿真9节点电力系统数据上进行对比实验。
AI.result: 检索增强可提升上下文学习的性能；微调后TSFM优于传统AI模型，尤其在加入物理信息正则化时表现更佳；微调TSFM误差更低、计算成本更优，相较原始物理仿真实现563倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 预训练TSFM可作为高保真动态仿真的高效代理，且检索增强与物理信息正则化的微调是有效策略，为大规模场景筛选提供了可行途径。

title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
summary: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.

AI.tldr: 提出TS-GEAR统一生成式检索框架，用于按需配送场景，通过地理-语义ID、查询-地理目标注意力与GMPO集合级优化，解决可达性、兴趣估计偏差与候选冗余三个问题，并在淘宝闪购在线广告检索中每日服务超1.5亿次查询。
AI.motivation: 按需配送平台（如DoorDash、Uber Eats）存在传统电商没有的硬约束：超出用户配送范围的商家是无效候选而非仅排名靠后。将生成式检索迁移到该场景面临三方面挑战：(1)现有语义ID仅将地理作为软信号，可达性只能依赖生成后不可微的硬截断；(2)用户偏好在地域与查询维度差异显著，不结合地理与当前查询聚合历史行为会产生有偏兴趣估计；(3)候选集按整体价值评估，而自回归训练逐序列独立打分，缺乏集合级信号抑制近重复冗余。
AI.method: 提出统一框架TS-GEAR，包含三个组件：(1) Geo-Semantic ID：将商家标识拆分为地理前缀与语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非事后过滤；(2) Query-Geo Target Attention：以实时查询与位置为双目标聚合历史行为，并将每条行为自身位置编码进注意力键；(3) GMPO（Group Marginal Policy Optimization）：在GRPO框架内用去重组奖励与边际优势重写优势函数，无需辅助多样性目标即可抑制冗余。
AI.result: 以0.1B轻量骨干模型在线部署，在淘宝闪购搜索广告链路中日均服务超1.5亿次查询；在HitRate与地理有效性指标上持续优于SOTA生成式检索方法，广告曝光提升3.8%，广告收入提升4.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将地理可达性内化为生成目标、以查询-地理双目标条件化行为建模、并用集合级策略优化替代逐序列打分，可有效将生成式检索适配到强地理约束的按需配送场景，并在大规模在线系统中获得显著业务收益。

title: FedLoVA: Value-Only Aggregation for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method for fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), especially in federated learning, due to its strong performance and communication efficiency. In practice, LoRA is applied to the query and value projections of transformer layers without considering the distinct roles of these components. In this work, we analyze the impact of these projections in federated fine-tuning of LLMs using LoRA and observe that the value projection converges significantly faster than the query projection. Motivated by this finding, we propose FedLoVA, a federated fine-tuning framework that trains LoRA adapters on both query and value projections locally while sharing only the value projection with the server. This approach reduces communication overhead while improving convergence efficiency. Experiments on natural language understanding, multilingual sentiment analysis, and generation tasks show that FedLoVA reduces the communication cost by up to $7.8\times$ compared to existing federated LLM fine-tuning baselines while achieving comparable or better performance. The code is available at: https://github.com/EnsiehKhazaei/FedLoVA.

AI.tldr: 提出FedLoVA联邦微调框架：本地同时训练query与value投影上的LoRA适配器，但仅将value投影适配器上传服务器共享，从而降低通信开销并提升收敛效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA联邦微调对transformer层的query和value投影一视同仁地应用LoRA，忽略二者角色差异。作者观察到value投影的收敛速度显著快于query投影，据此认为可对二者区别对待以优化通信与收敛。
AI.method: 先在联邦LoRA微调中分析query/value投影收敛行为差异；再设计FedLoVA：本地在query和value投影上均训练LoRA适配器，但仅将value投影的LoRA适配器与服务器共享、聚合，query投影适配器保留在本地。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解、多语言情感分析和生成任务上，相较现有联邦LLM微调基线，通信成本最高降低7.8倍，同时性能相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 利用query与value投影收敛速度的不对称性，仅共享value投影LoRA即可在联邦微调中实现通信效率与性能的良好权衡，为联邦PEFT提供简洁有效的设计。

title: Adversarial Evaluation of Large Language Models for Patient-Friendly Radiology Report Summarization
comment: This work has been submitted to Radiology: Artificial Intelligence for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary:
Purpose: To develop and validate a scalable adversarial evaluation framework for assessing the robustness of large language models (LLMs) that generate patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports.
  Methods: We introduced a clinically grounded adversarial framework that uses controlled term substitutions and impression removals across intensity levels. Using a radiologist-validated adversarial dictionary, we generated adversarial variants of CT and MRI reports. Six LLMs summarized original and adversarial impressions using 2 prompt styles, yielding 18,000 evaluation pairs. Robustness was evaluated with an automated LLM-as-a-judge framework scoring factual faithfulness, sensitivity to adversarial edits, certainty fidelity, and hallucination rate. Failure mode analysis quantified vulnerabilities in incorporating clinical modifiers. Agreement with two radiologists was assessed on 105 cases.
  Results: GPT-5-mini achieved the highest factual faithfulness and certainty fidelity under both adversarial edits. Under term substitution, hallucinations occurred in 28.1-30.1% of GPT-5-mini summaries, compared with 35.3-36.4% for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 41.4-41.9% for MedGemma. Impression-removal edits were handled more robustly than term substitutions. Even for the highest-scoring summarizer, substitutions of anatomical terms were not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, and descriptor terms (e.g., "substantial") in 21.2%. Judge-radiologist agreement (macro-F1: 0.55-0.56) was comparable to inter-radiologist agreement (0.53).
  Conclusions: Adversarial evaluation exposes clinically meaningful failure modes, including missed anatomical modifiers, altered diagnostic certainty, and omitted severity descriptors.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了一个临床对抗评测框架，用于评估LLM生成放射报告患者友好摘要的鲁棒性；GPT-5-mini表现最佳但在解剖、确定性与程度描述词替换上仍存在显著漏检。
AI.motivation: LLM被用于将放射报告改写为患者友好摘要，但其在临床相关扰动（如术语替换、印象删除）下的鲁棒性缺乏可扩展、有临床依据的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建经放射科医师验证的对抗词典，对CT/MRI报告印象进行多强度受控术语替换与印象删除，生成对抗变体；6个LLM、2种提示风格，共18,000个评测对；采用自动化LLM-as-a-judge评分事实忠实度、对抗编辑敏感性、确定性保真度与幻觉率，并进行失败模式分析与双放射科医师一致性评估（105例）。
AI.result: GPT-5-mini在两类对抗编辑下事实忠实度与确定性保真度最高；术语替换下幻觉率28.1–30.1%，Claude Sonnet 4.5为35.3–36.4%，MedGemma为41.4–41.9%；印象删除比术语替换更易稳健处理；最高分模型仍分别有23.7%（解剖术语）、22.3%（诊断确定性）、21.2%（程度描述词）未在摘要中体现；判官与放射科医师一致性macro-F1为0.55–0.56，与医师间一致性（0.53）相当。
AI.conclusion: 对抗评测可揭示具临床意义的失败模式，包括遗漏解剖修饰、改变诊断确定性及省略严重程度描述；该框架可扩展且与专家判断一致性合理。

title: NIFT-SQL: Customer-Supervised Table Scoring for Enterprise Text-to-SQL Retrieval
summary: Enterprise text-to-SQL starts with finding the tables a question needs, which is hard when a schema spans several databases and hundreds of cryptic tables. We ask whether models trained separately on each customer's example questions, reading only table names, column names, and declared keys, improve table retrieval. NIFT-SQL (Necessity-Informed Fusion for Text-to-SQL) fuses hybrid search over a retriever fine-tuned on the customer's questions with a fine-tuned 560M cross-encoder that scores every table for whether the query needs it, through a logistic regression fitted on held-out questions. On BEAVER, LiveSQLBench, and LiveSQLBench-Large (244 to 971 tables; four splits, three trainings), NIFT-SQL places every reference table in the top 15 for 69.2%, 89.5%, and 85.6% of test questions, against 30.4%, 41.0%, and 21.8% for hybrid search and 61.1%, 81.7%, and 70.4% for the fine-tuned retriever with the same labels. With off-the-shelf search, the cross-encoder without fine-tuning is 21 points lower. A zero-shot 8B reranker needs no labels and, routed by database, shows no resolved complete@15 difference on two collections; adding its scores as two fusion features gives a high-accuracy mode that reaches 72.4%, 92.5%, and 88.6%, ahead of the validation-selected zero-shot reranker variant on two collections, with no resolved difference on the third. Rank fusion of the two trained parts, grouped by database, shows no resolved difference from the learned fusion. Scored once on a newer BEAVER release, NIFT-SQL beats search and leads the label-matched retriever at top 8 on the synthetic test, but trails it at top 15 on real questions.

AI.tldr: NIFT-SQL通过客户示例问题分别微调检索器与560M交叉编码器，并用逻辑回归融合两路得分，从而在大规模跨库schema上显著提升表检索的complete@15准确率。
AI.motivation: 企业text-to-SQL的首要难点是从跨多个数据库、数百张晦涩表名的schema中找出问题所需的表；作者想验证：仅在每个客户自身的示例问题上单独训练、且只读取表名、列名与声明主外键的模型，能否改善表检索效果。
AI.method: NIFT-SQL（Necessity-Informed Fusion）：一路是对客户问题微调的检索器做混合检索，另一路是微调的560M交叉编码器对每张表判定“查询是否需要它”并打分；两路通过在一部分留出问题上拟合的逻辑回归进行融合。另设零样本8B重排器（无需标注、按数据库路由）作为对照与可加特征，并比较按数据库分组的秩融合。
AI.result: 在BEAVER、LiveSQLBench与LiveSQLBench-Large（244–971张表，四个划分、三次训练）上，NIFT-SQL的complete@15分别为69.2%、89.5%、85.6%；混合搜索为30.4%、41.0%、21.8%；同标签微调检索器为61.1%、81.7%、70.4%。未微调交叉编码器配现成搜索下降约21个百分点。零样本8B重排器在两集合上无显著差异，将其分数作为两个融合特征的高精度模式达到72.4%、92.5%、88.6%。按数据库分组的秩融合与学习式融合无显著差异。新版BEAVER上，top-8合成测试优于搜索并领先同标签检索器，但真实问题上top-15落后于该检索器。
AI.conclusion: 在客户级标注上微调必要性判定交叉编码器并与混合检索学习式融合，是提升企业大规模schema表检索的有效方案，且零样本重排器可作为免标注增强特征；但优势依赖于标签质量与测试分布，在真实问题上top-15仍可能不及同标签检索器，泛化边界需谨慎评估。

title: TORNADO: Adaptive Latent Stochastic Transport for Calibrated Probabilistic PDE Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic neural surrogates for PDEs enable ensemble forecasting, but often exhibit miscalibration when used for uncertainty quantification, especially in compute-constrained, few-step inference regimes. Existing generative approaches typically rely on fixed global stochasticity, which cannot adapt predictive uncertainty to the local dynamical state. We propose TORNADO, a latent probabilistic forecasting framework that formulates next-step prediction as stochastic transport between VAE encoder posteriors. Unlike existing approaches with globally prescribed stochasticity, TORNADO learns a SDE with state-dependent diffusion, enabling the predictive uncertainty to adapt to the local latent dynamics. The model is trained using analytic conditional endpoint targets derived from a Gaussian interpolant, enabling simulation-free learning. An additional energy distance regularization term improves distributional alignment. Empirically, TORNADO improves uncertainty calibration over representative generative baselines, including stochastic interpolants, diffusion models, and flow matching, while maintaining comparable predictive accuracy. Our results show that adapting stochasticity to the latent state, rather than prescribing it globally, is an effective mechanism for improving calibration in practical neural PDE forecasting settings. Project page: https://tornado-sde.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出TORNADO，将PDE下一步预测建模为VAE编码器后验间的随机传输，学习状态依赖扩散的SDE以实现自适应不确定性，并以解析条件端点目标实现无仿真训练，再辅以能量距离正则；在保持精度相当的同时改善校准。
AI.motivation: 概率神经代理模型常用于PDE集合预报，但在计算受限的少步推理下不确定性量化校准较差；现有生成式方法采用固定的全局随机性，无法根据局部动力学状态调节预测不确定性。
AI.method: 潜空间概率预测框架：把下一步预测表述为VAE编码器后验之间的随机传输；学习带状态依赖扩散项的SDE，使预测不确定性随局部潜动力学自适应；利用高斯插值导出的解析条件端点目标进行无仿真训练；并加入能量距离正则项改善分布对齐。
AI.result: 相比随机插值、扩散模型与流匹配等代表性生成基线，TORNADO在不确定性校准上更优，同时预测精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 将随机性适配到潜状态而非全局预设，是提升实际神经PDE预测校准的有效机制。

title: Restoring General and Improving Domain-Specific Safety in Fine-Tuned LLMs Without Retraining
summary: Safety-aligned language models are known to suffer degradation in refusal behavior following domain-specific fine-tuning, even when the fine-tuning data is entirely benign. The predominant mitigation strategy, preference optimization on the fine-tuned model, is computationally expensive and requires domain-specific preference data that is often unavailable in practice. We propose SPECTRA, a training-free, weight-level method that restores refusal behavior by transferring the base model's refusal direction into the fine-tuned model's weights via an activation-aware, low-rank update, requiring no gradient-based optimization or domain-specific safety data. The low-rank design restricts the intervention to the subspace most causally active on harmful inputs, leaving benign behavior largely undisturbed by construction. Empirically, SPECTRA substantially improves refusal behavior across a comprehensive safety evaluation, while preserving general coherence, domain-specific knowledge, and producing negligible change in false refusal rates.

AI.tldr: 提出SPECTRA：无需训练、权重级别的干预方法，将基座模型的拒绝方向以激活感知的低秩更新迁移到领域微调模型中，从而恢复拒答行为，且不损害领域性能与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐的语言模型在领域微调（即使数据完全无害）后会出现拒答行为退化。主流缓解方案是在微调模型上做偏好优化，但计算代价高，且通常缺乏领域特定的偏好数据。
AI.method: SPECTRA为免训练、权重级方法：提取基座模型的"拒绝方向"并将其注入微调模型的权重，采用激活感知（activation-aware）的低秩更新，无需梯度优化、无需领域特定安全数据；低秩结构将干预限制在对有害输入最具因果作用子空间内，从构造上减少对良性行为的影响。
AI.result: 在全面的安全评测上显著提升拒答行为，同时保持通用连贯性、领域知识与原性能，误拒率（false refusal）变化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 权重级、免训练的方向迁移是恢复领域微调模型安全对齐的高效可行替代方案，兼具安全性与实用性。

title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出 SituRecBench：在高保真 3D 物理环境中评估前沿 VLM 作为"具身推荐助手"的交互基准，将推荐重构为共享用户第一视角的具身辅助过程，统一评测对话质量、推荐效用与导航有效性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统正从静态检索引擎转向具身环境中的交互式助手，但现有研究普遍忽视空间导航、视觉 grounding 与多轮社交交互三者的叠加复杂性，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 构建高保真 3D 交互式基准（如超市、家居卖场），要求助手在共享用户 egocentric 视角下通过多轮对话引导偏好、将推荐 grounding 到环境实体，并指引用户到相关位置；采用统一交互协议同时评测对话质量、推荐效用与导航有效性。
AI.result: 大量实验显示模型在空间 grounding 与偏好引导上仍存在持续困难，反映出其难以将全局上下文信息与局部观测有效整合。
AI.conclusion: SituRecBench 为真实世界具身推荐助手的发展提供了严谨的评测基础，并揭示 VLM 在空间推理与多轮偏好交互方面的关键瓶颈。

title: Match the Geometry Before the Surrogate: Extreme Low-Budget Optimization in High Dimensions
comment: NeurIPS 2026 (camera-ready). 10 pages of main text plus appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist, 38 pages in total. Code and result files: https://github.com/michalprusek/geometry-before-surrogates-neurips2026 . Project page: https://staff.utia.cas.cz/novozada/geo
summary: Low-budget molecular optimization is often framed as Bayesian optimization in a learned latent space, but standard benchmarks typically allow hundreds or thousands of evaluations, whereas a realistic wet-lab round may allow only a few dozen. We revisit this regime using a SELFIES molecular variational autoencoder (VAE) with a Gaussian prior and GuacaMol objectives at N = 30 evaluations. The main finding is not a new surrogate model, but an interaction in candidate generation. The encoder means of a reference set of molecules concentrate near a narrow spherical shell, while many high-dimensional optimizers propose candidates from boxes or box-shaped trust regions. We study a simple constraint, the on-sphere scaffold, that restricts candidate generation to this shell. We then introduce two minimal optimizers to probe what remains useful once the support is fixed. GeoWalk performs geodesic local search on the shell without a surrogate. After 30 evaluations, it shows no detected difference from a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate on the shell, which is ahead earlier in the budget. GeoCMA adds covariance learning in a random subspace. It does not improve on GeoWalk in the molecular benchmark. On LassoBench it has a lower mean loss than GeoWalk, but full-dimensional CMA-ES remains stronger on most tasks. A factorial experiment with a single GP crosses the candidate support (shell or box) with the acquisition maximizer (a finite candidate set or a continuous optimizer). In this benchmark, shell candidates outperformed box candidates when acquisition was maximized over a candidate set, but not with continuous maximization by L-BFGS-B. These results come from a controlled study of one Gaussian-prior VAE benchmark and do not recommend VAEs for molecular optimization. The practical lesson is to control the candidate support and the acquisition maximizer before attributing a gain to the surrogate.

AI.tldr: 在仅30次评估的低预算分子优化中，作者发现关键不在替代模型，而在候选生成的支撑集：编码器均值集中于狭窄球壳上，故提出on-sphere scaffold约束，并配以GeoWalk与GeoCMA两个极简优化器；结果显示壳内候选在有限候选集最大化采集函数时优于箱式候选。
AI.motivation: 真实湿实验一轮仅允许几十次评估，而主流基准允许数百至数千次，低预算这一区间缺乏研究；同时作者希望厘清性能增益究竟来自替代模型本身，还是来自候选生成方式（支撑集与采集函数最大化方式）等常被忽略的环节。
AI.method: 采用高斯先验的SELFIES分子VAE隐空间，在GuacaMol目标上做N=30评估的贝叶斯优化研究。观察到参考分子编码均值集中于狭窄球壳，遂提出on-sphere scaffold约束将候选限制在该球壳；基于此提出GeoWalk（球面测地局部搜索，无替代模型）与GeoCMA（随机子空间协方差学习）。另在LassoBench上验证，并做单GP因子实验，交叉候选支撑（壳/箱）与采集最大化方式（有限候选集/连续优化）。
AI.result: 30次评估后，GeoWalk与球壳上的GP替代模型无可检测差异（GP在预算早期更优）；GeoCMA在分子基准上未优于GeoWalk；LassoBench上GeoCMA平均损失低于GeoWalk，但全维CMA-ES在多数任务上更强。因子实验表明：在有限候选集上最大化采集时壳状候选优于箱状候选，而用L-BFGS-B连续最大化时无此优势。
AI.conclusion: 结论基于单一高斯先验VAE基准的受控研究，并不推荐用VAE做分子优化；实践启示是在把增益归因于替代模型之前，应先控制候选支撑集与采集函数最大化器。

title: Conformal Fair Decoding for Large Language Model Recommenders
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate personalized recommendations without task-specific training, but changing a protected attribute while holding interaction history fixed can alter the semantic content of recommended items. We study fairness control when model weights and full-vocabulary logits are unavailable. We propose Fair- Rec, an item-level decoding framework that uses an offline-calibrated semantic-disparity threshold and controls candidate selection as recommendation lists are generated. A hard variant filters candidates against the threshold; a soft variant trades off candidate likelihood and disparity while adapting a penalty using observed violations. Under an explicit uniform enforceability assumption, we establish a pathwise O(1/T) upper bound on the excess empirical violation rate of the soft decoder. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and Amazon Movies & TV using Qwen3-8B and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct show that the soft variant lowers measured counterfactual disparity relative to zero- =shot recommendation, UP5, and FACTER, while retaining competitive HR@10 and NDCG@10.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fair-Rec，一种在无法访问模型权重与全词表 logits 的黑箱条件下、针对 LLM 推荐进行项目级解码的公平性控制框架，通过离线下校准的语义差异阈值在生成过程中约束候选选择。
AI.motivation: LLM 可在无任务微调下生成个性化推荐，但在固定交互历史、仅改变受保护属性时，推荐条目的语义内容会发生变化，即存在反事实差异；而实际部署中权重与全词表 logits 往往不可得，限制了既有公平性方法的应用。
AI.method: Fair-Rec 采用条目级解码：预先离线校准语义差异阈值，并在推荐列表逐项生成时进行候选控制。硬约束变体直接以阈值过滤候选；软约束变体在候选似然与语义差异间做权衡，并依据观测到的违规情况自适应调整惩罚项。在显式的“均匀可执行性”假设下，给出软解码器超额经验违规率的逐路径 O(1/T) 上界。
AI.result: 在 MovieLens-1M 与 Amazon Movies & TV 数据集上，使用 Qwen3-8B 与 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的实验表明，软约束变体相较 zero-shot 推荐、UP5 与 FACTER 降低了实测反事实差异，同时保持具有竞争力的 HR@10 与 NDCG@10。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖解码阶段的可控性即可在黑箱 LLM 推荐中实现有效公平性约束，且不显著牺牲推荐准确性，为无权重访问场景提供了可理论分析的公平性控制方案。

title: Clinical Evidence-Guided Residual Learning for Medication Recommendation with Dynamic DDI Regularization
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Supplementary PDF and detailed result tables are included as ancillary files. Code: https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/EviDrug
summary: Medication recommendation must combine patient-specific treatment evidence with the interaction structure of a prescription. The central challenge is to determine which evidence supports each medication and how strongly to regularize interactions while preserving predictive quality. We propose EviDrug, a clinical evidence-guided residual learning framework. Its clinical-memory backbone integrates a self-trained visit-aware encoder, training-case memory and one medication-set interaction block to establish a patient-specific prescription. A gated refinement head combines the backbone states with clinical associations and history-conditioned medication identities through bounded logit corrections. Drug-drug interaction (DDI) feedback adapts regularization strength using training-query predictions. Across MIMIC-IV, NWICU and SICdb, EviDrug leads twelve published-method baselines in AP, F1 and Jaccard, improving AP by 2.26, 2.06 and 1.71 percentage points over the strongest comparator. These gains come at lower parameter and runtime costs than MetaDrug. Matched controls demonstrate DDI reductions with stable predictive quality. Code is available at https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/EviDrug.

AI.tldr: EviDrug：以临床证据为引导的残差学习框架，用于用药推荐，通过记忆骨干+门控精修头+按预测自适应调节的DDI正则，在三个数据集上领先12个基线且参数/运行成本更低。
AI.motivation: 用药推荐需同时结合患者个体化治疗证据与处方内部的交互结构；核心难点在于判定"哪些证据支持哪一药物"，以及在保持预测质量的前提下以多强力度正则化药物-药物交互（DDI）。
AI.method: 提出EviDrug：(1) 临床记忆骨干——自训练的访视感知编码器 + 训练病例记忆 + 单一用药集合交互模块，生成患者特异性处方；(2) 门控精修头——将骨干状态与临床关联、历史条件化的药物身份结合，通过有界的logit修正进行残差精修；(3) DDI反馈——利用训练查询的预测自适应调整正则化强度。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV、NWICU、SICdb上于AP、F1、Jaccard三项指标全面超越12个已发表基线；AP较最强对比方法分别提升2.26、2.06、1.71个百分点；相比MetaDrug参数与运行时间成本更低；对照实验显示DDI显著减少且预测质量稳定。
AI.conclusion: 证据引导的残差学习可在低计算成本下兼顾预测性能与处方安全性，DDI正则强度的预测驱动自适应调节是可行且有效的设计。

title: Transit-Oriented Land Use Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) is a key strategy for advancing sustainable urban development by promoting high-density, mixed-use land development within walking distance of public transit stations. However, traditional TOD planning often relies on heuristic methods, making it difficult to efficiently identify quantitatively optimized transit-oriented land use patterns. This paper presents DRL4TOD, a deep reinforcement learning framework that automatically optimizes land use types and floor area ratios (FARs) around transit stations in alignment with TOD principles. DRL4TOD incorporates a graph neural network to capture spatial interdependencies among land parcels, road networks, and metro stations, and uses a DRL-based optimization strategy to assign land-use types and FARs to selected parcels. It jointly optimizes multiple objectives, including land use density, land use diversity, and transit capacity utilization, while minimizing reconstruction costs to account for development feasibility. Applied to two real-world station areas in Shanghai, DRL4TOD consistently outperforms rule-based approaches and genetic algorithms, achieving more effective TOD outcomes with lower reconstruction costs. By adjusting objective weights, the framework enables flexible prioritization, such as placing greater emphasis on cost minimization when financial feasibility is a concern. These results demonstrate DRL4TOD's potential as a decision-support tool for generating coordinated land-use and FAR configurations under planner-specified priorities, rather than prescribing a single fixed design. For policymakers, the framework provides parcel-level, constraint-aware alternatives that make trade-offs among competing objectives explicit and support targeted decisions about development intensity and feasibility.

AI.tldr: DRL4TOD：基于图神经网络与深度强化学习的地块用地类型与容积率联合优化框架，用于公交导向开发规划。
AI.motivation: 传统TOD规划依赖启发式方法，难以高效获得定量优化的公交导向土地利用方案。
AI.method: 构建深度强化学习框架DRL4TOD，用图神经网络刻画地块、路网与地铁站点间的空间依赖关系，并以DRL策略为选定地块分配用地类型与容积率；联合优化土地利用密度、多样性与公交运能利用率，同时最小化改造成本以兼顾开发可行性。
AI.result: 在上海两个真实站点区域的实验中，DRL4TOD在TOD成效与改造成本上均优于规则方法与遗传算法；通过调整目标权重可实现成本优先等灵活取舍。
AI.conclusion: DRL4TOD可作为规划者指定优先级下的决策支持工具，输出地块级、约束感知的用地与容积率协同配置备选方案，显式呈现多目标权衡，而非给出单一固定设计。

title: TripleGrader: A Web-Based Platform Supporting Collaborative Triple Annotation with Quality Grading and Inter-Rater Agreement Assessment
summary: Knowledge graphs need validated relational triples, and gold benchmarks of such triples are often built by several annotators. Most text annotation platforms focus on span tagging and compute agreement on categorical labels. They are not designed for ordinal quality grading of triples that have already been extracted. We present TripleGrader, an open-source web platform for grading subject-predicate-object triples on a 0 to 10 ordinal scale. In TripleGrader, each triple is scored independently, and peer scores stay hidden until the grader has rated it. Graders then discuss entries in threaded comments and propose revisions, which the session owner approves and publishes as new versions. For agreement, the platform computes quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa for two raters and a quadratic-weighted Fleiss-type kappa for three or more. Graded sessions and the final benchmark are exported in common formats. We evaluated the platform in three ways. We ran 72 automated tests, including 18 workflow scenarios through the REST API. We also injected 10 error types to check whether prescribed corrections could be applied while preserving unaffected triples. On two small corpora with existing gold benchmarks, we then used the platform to curate the triples extracted by four large language models into each benchmark. Only 10% to 32% of the candidate triples could be kept unchanged, and 53% to 71% needed corrections, partly to match the benchmarks' naming conventions. Per model, 11 to 29 missing triples had to be added. On these corpora, the extracted triples therefore needed substantial human review. The source code is available at https://github.com/razz0n/triple-grader-tool.

AI.tldr: TripleGrader：一个开源的 Web 平台，用于对已抽取的主-谓-宾三元组进行 0–10 序数质量评级，支持盲评、讨论修订、加权 kappa 一致性计算与基准导出。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱需要经过验证的关系三元组，而金标准基准通常由多名标注者构建。现有文本标注平台主要面向跨度标注与类别标签一致性，缺乏针对已抽取三元组的序数质量分级支持。
AI.method: 构建开源 Web 平台 TripleGrader：每个三元组独立评分，同伴评分在评分者完成评分前隐藏；评分者通过线程化评论讨论并提出修订，由会话负责人审批发布为新版本。一致性方面，两名评分者使用二次加权 Cohen's kappa，三名及以上使用二次加权 Fleiss 型 kappa。评估方式包括：72 项自动化测试（含 18 个 REST API 工作流场景）、注入 10 类错误以检验定向修正能否在保持未受影响三元组不变的前提下应用，以及在两个带现有金标准的小型语料上，用该平台将四个大语言模型抽取的三元组整编入对应基准。
AI.result: 仅有 10%–32% 的候选三元组可直接保留，53%–71% 需要修正（部分是为匹配基准命名规范），每个模型还需补入 11–29 条缺失三元组。错误注入与自动化测试表明平台具备稳定的工作流与修正能力。
AI.conclusion: 现有平台不适配该任务，TripleGrader 填补了序数质量分级与一致性统计的空白；实验表明大模型抽取的三元组仍需大量人工审核。源码已开源。

title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG

AI.tldr: Lightfoot: 一种将图索引完全定义为"逐段落抽取 + 块级溯源"的确定性函数的 GraphRAG 系统，索引阶段每段落仅一次 LLM 调用、检索零调用、删文档为纯数据库操作；在 MuSiQue 上验证删除 10% 文档后图与重建索引完全一致，索引成本最低，检索/问答表现部分优于 HippoRAG 2 但在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上更差。
AI.motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 研究比较普遍只关注问答精度，而忽视了部署中两项真实成本：(1) 建图成本（需大量 LLM 抽取调用）；(2) 图维护成本，尤其是文档删除后如何更新图。多数系统缺乏可验证的删除一致性机制，删除往往需重跑抽取或根本无法删除（如 fast-graphrag 无删除路径）。因此需要一种成本可测、可维护、删除可验证的 GraphRAG 方案。
AI.method: 设计 Lightfoot：将实体、链接、事实与同义边全部定义为每个段落抽取结果的确定性函数，并携带 chunk 级溯源信息。索引阶段对每个段落仅做一次 LLM 调用，检索阶段不调用任何模型，删除文档仅通过数据库操作完成、无需模型调用。在完整 11,402 段落 MuSiQue 语料上验证删除一致性：删除 10% 文档后，图与对存活文档重新建索引的结果完全相同。与 HippoRAG 2、LightRAG、fast-graphrag 在 MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA 三个数据集上，使用相同的抽取模型、回答模型与嵌入模型进行受控对比。
AI.result: 索引成本：Lightfoot 在三个数据集上均构建最廉价索引，比 HippoRAG 2 低 26–31%，比 LightRAG 与 fast-graphrag 低 3–6 倍。相对 HippoRAG 2：MuSiQue 检索显著更优（留出集 recall@5 +2.8、recall@10 +4.3），HotpotQA 答案显著更优（EM +7.7）；但在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上显著更差（recall@2 −3.9、F1 −8.4）。删除成本：删除相同文档 LightRAG 需 2,187 次模型调用、3.7 小时；fast-graphrag 无删除路径；Lightfoot 为零模型调用。
AI.conclusion: GraphRAG 的构建与删除成本是可测量且可大幅优化的关键维度，确定性、带溯源的图构造能在保持或提升部分任务精度的同时显著降低索引与维护开销，并实现可验证的删除一致性。但方法并非全面占优（2WikiMultiHopQA 上劣于 HippoRAG 2），说明确定性抽取对多跳、大规模实体混淆型数据集仍存在精度权衡；未来需在各数据集间平衡成本与效果，并推进删除/更新一致性的标准化评测。

title: A Clinical Evaluation of Conformal Prediction for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved automated radiology report generation, they remain prone to hallucinations, necessitating clinically meaningful risk-control methods. Conformal prediction (CP) provides statistical guarantees, yet existing CP approaches rely on uncalibrated automated extractors and fail to account for the clinical relevance of errors. We introduce clinical admissibility criteria (CLARITY), a framework for evaluating radiology reports that explicitly distinguishes clinically consequential errors from minor deviations. To eliminate reliance on automatic judges, we collected radiologist annotations of MLLM-generated reports using CLARITY. By benchmarking CP strategies and automatic evaluation metrics against these expert annotations, we demonstrate that commonly used admissibility proxies systematically fail to detect clinically relevant errors. Our findings reveal that automated admissibility judgments are largely decoupled from true clinical admissibility.

AI.tldr: 提出CLARITY临床可接受性标准，用放射科医生标注检验证明常用自动评判指标与共形预测策略无法可靠识别临床重要错误，自动可接受性判断与真实临床可接受性基本脱钩。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型生成的放射报告存在幻觉，需要具备临床意义的风险控制方法；现有共形预测(CP)方法依赖未校准的自动抽取器，且未考虑错误在临床上的相关性与严重程度差异，缺乏区分"临床重大错误"与"无关紧要偏差"的评估依据。
AI.method: 构建CLARITY（clinical admissibility criteria）框架，显式区分临床后果性错误与次要偏差；采集放射科医生基于CLARITY对MLLM生成报告的标注，以剔除对自动评判器的依赖；将多种CP策略与自动评价指标同专家标注进行基准对比。
AI.result: 常用可接受性代理指标系统性地无法检出临床相关错误；各类CP策略与自动指标的表现与专家判断不一致，自动可接受性判定与真实临床可接受性之间解耦明显。
AI.conclusion: 现有自动评判与CP风险控制流程不足以支撑临床可信的报告生成风险控制，须引入经专家校准、以临床相关性为核心的评估标准；CLARITY为构建临床有意义的不确定性量化与保障机制提供基础。

title: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
summary: LLM agents increasingly drive systems research and rely on simulators to evaluate candidate designs at scale. Simulators are imperfect by design: their modeling limitations can distort predictions yet leave the recommended design correct, or change which design should be selected. We introduce Siris to test whether LLMs can tell these cases apart, judging from their systems understanding when a limitation invalidates the simulator's recommendation. By perturbing a simulator, Siris constructs workload pairs with the same candidates, limitation, and simulator recommendation. The perturbation changes predictions on both workloads, yet a reference simulator supports the recommendation on only one. Evaluating thirteen frontier LLMs on LLM serving design problems, we find that identifying a limitation does not ensure a correct choice, and even the strongest models sometimes abandon valid recommendations. Self-correction through a review turn helps these models restore valid choices but introduces new errors in several others. These findings motivate evaluating systems understanding through design decisions under imperfect simulators.

AI.tldr: 提出 Siris 基准，检验 LLM 能否判断模拟器建模缺陷是否使推荐设计失效，发现识别缺陷≠做出正确设计决策。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 日益用于系统研究并依赖模拟器大规模评估候选设计，但模拟器本身存在固有建模局限：它可能扭曲预测却仍得出正确推荐，也可能改变应选的最优设计。现有评测未考察 LLM 是否具备这种"系统理解"层面的判别能力。
AI.method: Siris 通过对模拟器施加扰动，构造"工作负载对"：两者共享相同候选集、相同局限与相同模拟器推荐，扰动同时改变两个工作负载上的预测，但只有其中一个在参考模拟器下仍支持该推荐。据此区分"局限无害"与"局限导致推荐失效"两类情形。在 LLM serving 设计问题上评测 13 个前沿 LLM。
AI.result: 识别出模拟器局限并不保证做出正确选择；最强模型有时会错误放弃有效推荐；引入一轮"审查/自我纠正"能帮助部分模型恢复有效选择，但在另一些模型上引入新的错误。
AI.conclusion: 应通过"不完美模拟器下的设计决策"来评测 LLM 的系统理解能力，而非仅考察缺陷识别能力。

title: Hybrid Product Search Without the Copy: Lexical, Semantic and Filtered Retrieval Served Directly from a Data Lake
comment: 6 pages. Submitted to ISIR-eCom 2026 (workshop at IEEE BigData 2026)
summary: E-commerce catalogs increasingly live in lakehouse tables: Apache Iceberg metadata over Parquet files in object storage. Product search, however, still runs on copies of that catalog, in a lexical engine and a vector database, each with its own ingestion pipeline, schema, staleness window and bill. We show that search applications can be hosted directly on the data lake, with the lakehouse table as the single system of record. We extend Apache Pinot, a real-time OLAP engine that already serves Iceberg tables in place, with BM25 relevance scoring over its Lucene text index, corpus-wide term statistics so that scores are comparable across files, and reciprocal rank fusion in plain SQL; a real-time table fed by a stream can sit behind the same table, merged by the broker. On the Amazon ESCI benchmark (1.2M US products, 22,458 test queries), hybrid search served from the lake matches exact retrieval (nDCG@10 .361). The lake table is queryable 149 s after its files are registered, and a lake commit is searchable in 3.8 s, close to indexing directly into a search engine. On a brand-sorted lake of 277M products (0.8 TB), one 16-vCPU node answers brand-scoped vector, BM25 and client-fused hybrid searches in 6.5-9 ms (p50), sustains 1,100 vector and 635 BM25 searches per second at under 180 ms p99, and makes a commit searchable in 4.3 s. Search adds only its indexes: no copy of the catalog, no sync pipeline and no second schema, which cuts storage, rebuild time and the operational work of keeping copies consistent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出直接在湖仓表（Iceberg on Parquet）上托管电商搜索，将湖仓表作为唯一事实来源；通过扩展Apache Pinot实现Lucene上的BM25、语料级词项统计和SQL内的RRF，从而免去词法引擎与向量数据库各自的副本、同步管道与额外schema。
AI.motivation: 现有电商目录日益以湖仓表形式存储（Iceberg元数据+对象存储Parquet），但商品搜索仍运行在目录副本上：一个词法引擎加一个向量数据库，各自拥有独立的摄取管道、schema、陈旧窗口和成本账单，导致存储冗余、重建耗时与一致性运维负担。
AI.method: 扩展实时OLAP引擎Apache Pinot（其已可就地服务Iceberg表）：1）在其Lucene文本索引上实现BM25相关性打分；2）引入语料级（corpus-wide）词项统计，使跨文件分数可比；3）用纯SQL实现reciprocal rank fusion（RRF）；4）流式feed的实时表可由broker与湖表合并共存。
AI.result: Amazon ESCI基准（120万美国商品、22,458条测试查询）：湖上混合搜索达到精确检索水平（nDCG@10 = .361）；湖表在文件注册后149秒可查询，一次湖提交3.8秒可搜索。277M商品品牌排序湖（0.8 TB）：单台16 vCPU节点上品牌限定向量、BM25与客户端融合混合搜索p50为6.5–9 ms，可维持1,100向量/s与635 BM25/s且p99低于180 ms，提交4.3秒可搜索。
AI.conclusion: 搜索仅增加索引本身：无目录副本、无同步管道、无第二套schema，从而降低存储、重建时间及维护副本一致性的运维成本，验证了以湖仓表为单一系统记录的搜索托管方案可行。

title: Plug-and-Play Verifier for Decoupling Process Reward in Stabilizing Long-Horizon Agentic Reasoning
summary: Stabilizing long-horizon reasoning requires intelligent agents to sustain useful progress across successive reasoning steps and tool interactions. Such agents are typically trained with reinforcement learning (RL), where actor-critic RL uses a learnable critic network to estimate step advantages, while critic-free methods such as GRPO eliminate critic models and rely mostly on the group variants of sparse outcome-only rewards. Both reward types leave partially useful failed trajectories either implicit or indistinguishable from entirely unproductive ones, and as reasoning horizons grow, it becomes difficult to maintain consistent reasoning trajectories. In this work, we propose a \textit{plug-and-play verifier} framework for stabilizing long-horizon reasoning through explicit verification of intermediate reasoning artifacts. Specifically, the framework decouples process verification through a unified interface that extracts intermediate reasoning artifacts from agent running trajectories, evaluates them using domain-specific verifiers, and aggregates the verification scores as bounded process reward. Then, we combine our dense verified process rewards and the sparse outcome rewards through a two-stage post-training schedule. We showed that with plug-and-play verifiers, we further stabilize the reasoning steps as last-mile self-reflection and self-consistency. Typical evaluation on HotpotQA using Qwen3.5-4B achieves a superior accuracy (60.18\%), outperforming the standard GRPO baseline (57.73\%). Our results suggest that plug-and-play verifiers provide a modular approach to learn more stable and reliable reasoning behaviors over long horizons.

AI.tldr: 提出可插拔验证器（plug-and-play verifier）框架，通过对中间推理产物的显式验证生成有界过程奖励，并与稀疏结果奖励分两阶段结合，以稳定长程推理。
AI.motivation: 长程推理中，critic-based RL 依赖可学习价值网络，GRPO 等无 critic 方法主要依赖稀疏结果奖励的组内变体；两者都会把"部分有用"的失败轨迹隐含处理，或与完全无产出的轨迹混为一谈，导致推理步难以保持一致性。
AI.method: 统一接口从智能体运行轨迹中抽取中间推理产物，交由领域专用验证器打分，聚合为有界过程奖励；再通过两阶段后训练调度，将稠密验证过程奖励与稀疏结果奖励结合使用。
AI.result: 在 HotpotQA 上以 Qwen3.5-4B 评测，准确率达 60.18%，优于标准 GRPO 基线 57.73%；验证器还进一步稳定了末程自我反思与自我一致性等推理行为。
AI.conclusion: 可插拔验证器为长程推理提供模块化手段，可学到更稳定可靠的推理行为，且具备即插即用的通用性。

title: Evaluating classification and explainability in multimodal petrographic image analysis
summary: Automated thin-section classifiers increasingly combine plane-polarised and cross-polarised light (PPL and XPL), two complementary views central to petrographic identification. Classification accuracy alone does not reveal whether model errors reflect mineralogical relationships, how predictions depend on each optical view, or whether attribution maps identify regions that influence model decisions. Here, we examine these complementary aspects of the released LITHOS dual-stream vision transformer using outputs from an earlier evaluation of 105,802 expert-annotated grains across 25 categories. Classification errors frequently followed the label taxonomy: 72.6\% of misclassified plagioclase, microcline and sanidine grains were assigned the generic Feldspar label, while 87.1\% of quartz-family grains received a label within that family, compared with 66.6\% assigned their exact label. Replacing the XPL input with its per-channel spatial means produced a greater reduction in true-class probability than equivalent PPL replacement in 20 of 25 categories, but not in the three quartz categories. Five explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) attribution procedures generated visually distinct maps for identical inputs. In a superpixel-deletion analysis involving 30 grains from 29 thin sections, method-minus-random contrasts ranged from $-0.043$ to $0.057$, with all 41 simultaneous 95\% confidence intervals including zero. Together, these findings show that error structure, modality sensitivity and attribution behaviour capture distinct aspects of model performance that cannot be established from classification accuracy or visual inspection of attribution maps alone.

AI.tldr: 对LITHOS双流ViT的分析表明：分类错误沿矿物学分类层级聚集，XPL通道对多数矿物类别更关键（石英族除外），而五种XAI归因方法生成的显著性图差异显著且与随机基线无统计显著差别。
AI.motivation: 薄片自动分类器普遍融合PPL与XPL两种互补光学视图，但仅凭分类准确率无法揭示错误是否反映矿物学关系、预测对各视图的依赖程度，以及归因图是否真正定位了影响决策的区域。
AI.method: 基于已发布的LITHOS双流视觉Transformer，使用105,802颗专家标注颗粒（25类）的既有评测输出；分析错误混淆结构与标签分类学的一致性；通过将XPL或PPL输入替换为逐通道空间均值来量化模态敏感性；比较五种XAI归因方法的图，并在29张薄片30颗粒上进行超像素删除实验，计算"方法减随机"对比及其95%置信区间。
AI.result: 72.6%的误分斜长石、微斜长石和透长石被归为泛称"长石"，石英族颗粒87.1%落在族内标签，而精确标签仅66.6%；在25类中的20类，替换XPL导致的真类概率下降幅度大于替换PPL，但三个石英类别例外；五种XAI方法对同一输入生成视觉上明显不同的图；超像素删除的"方法减随机"对比介于−0.043至0.057，全部41个同时95%置信区间均包含零。
AI.conclusion: 错误结构、模态敏感性与归因行为刻画了模型性能的不同侧面，三者均无法仅由分类准确率或归因图的人工视觉检查得出；XAI图的视觉合理性不能作为其忠实性的证据。

title: Calibrating Document-Local Boundaries for Contextual Chunk Retrieval
summary: Late Chunking encodes an entire document before pooling at chunk boundaries, preserving document context in local retrieval units. Chunk-level post-training improves context-dependent retrieval, but shared context can make semantically similar same-document negatives difficult to distinguish. We study the local decision boundary between a gold chunk and its hardest sibling. Starting from InSeNT, we analyze InSeNT's within-document gradients and show that the entropy of the conditional negative allocation decreases monotonically with the scaling factor at fixed logits. We propose a two-part framework for calibrating document-local chunk boundaries. The first component adapts the discriminative scale from within-document margins, while the second exposes chunk partitions to attention during document encoding. Experiments on ConTEB and NanoBEIR show that the resulting model improves contextual chunk retrieval across the evaluated encoder settings while retaining competitive passage-level retrieval quality; ablations further characterize the distinct roles of adaptive scaling and chunk-aware routing.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Late Chunking中同文档难负例难以区分的问题，从InSeNT的文档内梯度分析出发，提出文档局部chunk边界校准的两部分框架：自适应判别尺度与chunk感知路由。
AI.motivation: Late Chunking先编码整篇文档再在chunk边界池化，使局部检索单元保留文档上下文；但共享上下文会让同文档内语义相近的chunk负例难以区分，即gold chunk与其最难同文档兄弟chunk之间的局部决策边界不清晰。
AI.method: 以InSeNT为起点分析文档内梯度，证明在固定logits下条件负例分配的熵随缩放因子单调递减；据此构建两部分框架：第一部分从文档内margin自适应调整判别尺度，第二部分在文档编码时使chunk划分参与注意力（chunk-aware routing）。
AI.result: 在ConTEB与NanoBEIR上的实验表明，所得模型在所评估的编码器设置下提升了上下文chunk检索效果，同时保持有竞争力的段落级检索质量；消融实验进一步区分了自适应缩放与chunk感知路由的不同作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过校准文档局部的chunk决策边界，可有效缓解同文档难负例混淆，且自适应尺度与chunk感知路由各自承担互补角色。

title: How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests
summary: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. Calibrating each model against models from other families removes most flags while isolating a consistent Qwen2.5-specific signal at every prefix length. We recommend length-stratified reporting, prefixes of at most 60%, style-matched post-cutoff controls, and cross-family calibration.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计"部分提示补全"这一基准污染检测方法，发现其结果强烈依赖剩余文本长度、在真阴性上有显著假阳性、且漏检上游蒸馏污染，并提出长度分层报告、≤60%前缀、风格匹配的后截止对照与跨家族校准等改进建议。
AI.motivation: 部分提示补全（partial-prompt completion）被广泛用于检测基准污染，但其可靠性缺乏系统审计；作者需要在缺少"真阴性"金标准的情况下检验该测试的假阳性、敏感性及失效条件。
AI.method: 在七个开放权重模型上审计该测试，使用 MATH-500 与模型发布之后的 AIME 2025/2026 作为真阴性；采用不同前缀比例（40%–80%）与剩余词数分层，比较 ROUGE-L（≥0.75）与精确匹配的标记率，并考察以 Qwen2.5-Math 蒸馏的模型与跨家族校准的效果。
AI.result: 标记率强依赖剩余文本长度：剩余≤8词的问题被标记的频率是≥25词问题的数倍（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为 31.5% vs. 5.5%），一半到四分之三的 ROUGE 标记来自短尾巴。真阴性上，60%前缀时 ROUGE-L≥0.75 标记最多达 6.7%；80%前缀时精确匹配也标记 8.6%（合并模型；AIME 2026 为 6.2%），而 40–60% 前缀为 0%。该测试亦漏检上游污染：蒸馏自 Qwen2.5-Math 的模型几乎不显示出模型特异性的召回。以其他家族模型校准可去除大部分标记，并在所有前缀长度上分离出一致的 Qwen2.5 特异信号。
AI.conclusion: 部分提示补全测试存在长度偏差、真阴性假阳性与上游污染漏检等缺陷；建议采用长度分层报告、不超过60%的前缀、风格匹配的后截止对照以及跨家族校准。

title: IdealCache: Rethinking Cache Scheduling in Diffusion Transformers via Ideal Trajectories
comment: accepted 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Feature caching accelerates Diffusion Transformers by reusing intermediate computations across denoising timesteps, yet existing methods share a fundamental blind spot: they treat the standard reference denoising trajectory as the optimisation target, approximating its per-step states and thus inheriting its output as an implicit quality ceiling. We argue that this target is arbitrary -- what truly matters is the ideal result, not the intermediate path taken to reach it. We propose IdealCache, a training-free framework that abandons step-wise imitation of the reference trajectory. Instead, it anchors caching on a per-input ensemble of ideal trajectories constructed from candidate target results, aggregates their geometry into a single graph, and discovers optimal non-uniform schedules via a constrained shortest path on this graph. By decoupling from the reference process, IdealCache breaks the performance bottleneck of trajectory-approximation; our schedules can attain near-lossless fidelity in generation and even surpass on task-specific metrics (e.g., maintaining higher semantic consistency in image editing). Without retraining, IdealCache achieves 6.35x speedup on Qwen-Image, 5.84x on Qwen-Image-Edit, and 4.32x on HunyuanVideo, with competitive or superior quality across tasks.

AI.tldr: IdealCache：以“理想结果”而非参考去噪轨迹为缓存优化目标的免训练特征缓存框架，通过构建理想轨迹集成图并做约束最短路搜索得到非均匀缓存调度。
AI.motivation: 现有特征缓存方法把标准参考去噪轨迹当作优化目标，逐步逼近其中间状态，因而继承了参考轨迹的输出作为隐式质量上限。作者认为该目标是任意的，真正重要的是理想结果而非达成它的中间路径。
AI.method: 提出 IdealCache：完全放弃对参考轨迹的逐步模仿。对每个输入，由候选目标结果构造理想轨迹集成（ensemble），将其几何聚合为单一图，并在图上以约束最短路问题求解最优非均匀缓存调度；全程免训练。
AI.result: 调度可在生成中达到近乎无损的保真度，并在任务特定指标上超过参考轨迹（如图像编辑中保持更高语义一致性）。免训练情况下 Qwen-Image 加速 6.35x、Qwen-Image-Edit 5.84x、HunyuanVideo 4.32x，质量持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 与参考过程解耦可打破轨迹逼近的性能瓶颈，表明缓存调度的优化目标应 anchored 于理想结果而非参考轨迹，为 DiT 免训练加速提供了新范式。

title: Multi-objective drift-aware MLOps agent for model retraining
summary: Deployed ML models face non-stationary data and delayed labels, yet most retraining strategies rely on fixed schedules or brittle drift thresholds that ignore operational cost.
