title: InfoOrgBench: Can Agents Turn Scattered Information into Coherent Hierarchies?
summary: When agents organize records into folders, they may correctly group the excerpts of a design proposal yet place the proposal under the wrong owning group. Existing agent benchmarks do not directly measure such higher-level errors. We introduce InfoOrgBench, a benchmark of 150 tasks in which agents organize scattered records from meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Integrity checks verify that every record is preserved, and a Structure Score measures agreement with the source hierarchy at every level, independent of folder names and order. We evaluate 45 systems that pair nine models with five agent harnesses. The best system scores 83.2 out of 100, but no system exceeds 78 on meeting recaps or issue threads. Model choice affects scores far more than harness choice: model means span about 27 points, whereas the average effect of each harness is below one point. More importantly, parent-level relations have higher error rates than leaf-level relations in all three domains. In design proposals, nearly half of the outputs analyzed by level make exactly this kind of error. These results show that evaluating information organization requires measuring higher-level relations separately from record preservation and local grouping.

AI.tldr: 提出 InfoOrgBench——150 个任务的层级信息组织基准，要求智能体把散落记录整理成文件夹层级，用完整性检查与结构评分（Structure Score）在各层级衡量与源层级的吻合度；评测 45 个系统（9 模型×5 框架），最佳仅 83.2 分，且父级关系错误率在所有领域都高于叶级。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准无法直接度量"高层归属错误"：智能体能正确聚类记录片段，却把整份方案放入错误的所属组。记录保留与局部聚类指标无法捕捉这种高层关系错误，因此需要一个显式分层评估的方案组织基准。
AI.method: 构建 InfoOrgBench，含 150 个任务，记录来源为会议纪要、issue 讨论串与设计方案，要求智能体整理为层级结构。采用两项度量：(1) 完整性检查确保每条记录都被保留；(2) Structure Score 在与文件夹名称、顺序无关的前提下，在每一层级衡量与源层级的吻合度，并按层级分析错误类型。评测 45 个系统：9 个模型 × 5 个 agent harness。
AI.result: 最佳系统得分 83.2/100，但在会议纪要与 issue 讨论串上均无系统超过 78 分。模型选择的影响远大于框架选择：模型均值跨度约 27 分，而每个框架的平均效应不足 1 分。在三个领域中，父级关系的错误率均高于叶级关系；在设计方案中，按层级分析的输出里近一半恰好犯此类错误。
AI.conclusion: 评估信息组织能力必须将高层关系单独度量，与记录保留、局部聚类分开考量；当前智能体的主要短板在于高层归属/父级关系而非记录保存。

title: CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
summary: 1-bit key-value (KV) cache compression can combine quantizer calibration with selective high-precision storage to reduce reconstruction error. We propose Calibration and Fisher-guided Anchors for KV cache compression (CALFA-KV). Offline, we jointly fit a key center, radial normalization parameters, and K/V vector codebooks to match the frozen model's projected attention output. We also estimate channel-wise Fisher-type sensitivities from squared gradients of a reference next-token cross-entropy loss. Online, we use these sensitivities to weight the squared reconstruction errors of each KV state. Here, a KV state is one token's key-value pair within one layer and KV head. We retain the highest-scoring states at high precision under a per-layer, per-KV-head budget. Under exact restoration, we bound the excess risk of score-based anchor selection relative to the optimum at the same anchor budget, where risk is the conditional mean square of the first-order loss change. With a budget of 56 additional FP16 anchors per layer and KV head, CALFA-KV (d8b8) outperforms all evaluated nominal 1-bit baselines on the mean score across seven benchmarks for each of the three models. At the same anchor budget, CALFA-KV (d8b10) uses a nominal index rate of 1.25 bits per channel and narrows the gap to BF16 to 0.90--2.01 points on the same metric.

AI.tldr: 提出CALFA-KV：离线联合校准码本与径向归一化参数、以Fisher敏感性加权重构误差，在线按每层每KV头预算保留高分KV状态为高精度锚点，实现1-bit KV cache压缩。
AI.motivation: 1-bit KV cache压缩需将量化器校准与选择性高精度存储结合以降低重构误差，关键在于如何选出最值得保留为高精度的KV状态。
AI.method: 离线联合拟合key中心、径向归一化参数及K/V向量码本，以匹配冻结模型投影后的注意力输出；并由参考下一token交叉熵损失平方梯度估计通道级Fisher型敏感度。在线以敏感度加权各KV状态（单层单KV头内单token的键值对）的平方重构误差，在每层每KV头预算下保留得分最高者为FP16锚点。
AI.result: 在精确恢复条件下，给出了基于得分的锚点选择相对于同预算最优选择的超额风险上界（风险为一阶损失变化条件均方）。每层每KV头56个额外FP16锚点时，CALFA-KV(d8b8)在三个模型上均以七基准平均分超过所有标称1-bit基线；同预算下d8b10名义索引率1.25 bit/通道，与BF16差距缩小至0.90–2.01分。
AI.conclusion: Fisher加权校准码本加预算化高精度锚点保留，可在近1-bit索引率下有效逼近BF16性能，且具理论风险界支撑。

title: Agentic discrete-event simulation for manufacturing system design: an open 3D simulator, a benchmark and an industrial case
comment: 55 pages, 15 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Manufacturing Systems (special issue AI for Manufacturing). Software: https://github.com/simulean/SimuLean (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23565564)
summary: The design of manufacturing systems relies on discrete-event simulation (DES) models that experts still build in tool-specific interfaces. AI agents can now write simulation code, but every model they write from scratch is new, unverified software. We present SimuLean, an open-source 3D DES simulator on the Unity engine designed to be programmed by AI agents: its modelling semantics are verified once, in the platform, and the agent builds and studies one model through domain-level commands, in the 3D scene or headless; physically simulated durations are calibrated for fast headless studies. We evaluated it on 18 manufacturing modelling tasks, from single machines to published production lines. A frontier agent built valid models in 93 of 108 attempts (86%), in about two minutes each; on the benchmark's interface version, two frontier agents built 105 of 108 models through domain commands alone, so that each comes with a record of how it was built. Every residual failure was silent - a model that builds and runs but answers wrongly - and only comparison with reference models revealed them all. In an industrial case, one agent working alone rebuilt, verified and studied a robotised welding workshop from a published study, in SimuLean and in SimPy. Comparing them with the published, expert-built model exposed an error in it; against the corrected model, the agent-built models agree within 1%. One agent can already build complete, realistic and traceable models for the design of manufacturing systems; independent reference models are what make them trustworthy.

AI.tldr: 提出可在Unity引擎上由AI智能体编程的开源3D离散事件仿真器SimuLean，其建模语义在平台层面一次性验证；用18个制造建模任务评测，前沿智能体成功构建86%的模型，但残余失败均为"静默错误"，需借助独立参考模型比对才能发现。
AI.motivation: 传统制造系统设计依赖专家在特定工具界面中手工构建离散事件仿真（DES）模型；尽管AI智能体已能编写仿真代码，但从零生成的每个模型都是未经验证的新软件，缺乏可信性。因此需要一个让建模语义被集中验证、智能体仅通过领域级命令构建模型的平台。
AI.method: 构建开源3D DES仿真器SimuLean（基于Unity引擎）：建模语义在平台内一次性验证；智能体通过领域级命令在3D场景或无头模式下构建并研究单一模型；物理仿真时长经过标定以支持快速无头实验。在18个制造建模任务（从单机到已发表的产线）上评测前沿智能体，并在工业案例中让智能体分别用SimuLean和SimPy重建、验证并研究机器人焊接车间的已发表模型。
AI.result: 前沿智能体在108次尝试中成功构建93个有效模型（86%），每个约需两分钟；在基准的接口版本上，两个前沿智能体仅通过领域命令构建了105/108个模型，且每个模型都带有构建过程记录。所有残余失败均为静默错误（模型可构建、可运行但结果错误），只有与参考模型比对才能全部识别。工业案例中，智能体独立重建并研究了已发表的机器人焊接车间，比对发现原专家模型存在错误；对修正后的模型，智能体构建的模型误差在1%以内。
AI.conclusion: 单个智能体已能为制造系统设计构建完整、真实且可追溯的仿真模型；但模型的可信性依赖于独立的参考模型进行验证，静默错误无法靠模型自身运行加以排除。

title: FADE: Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation for Training-Free Diffusion Transformers Acceleration
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as the preeminent paradigm for high-fidelity generative modeling across various modalities, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the severe computational overhead of iterative sampling. While recent feature-caching methods mitigate this latency through feature reuse or forecasting based on integer-order operators, they remain limited in adapting to the non-stationary and highly curved dynamics of DiT latent trajectories. In this work, we reveal that DiT feature evolution exhibits anomalous diffusion characteristics and a certain degree of spatiotemporal heterogeneity, rendering static, integer-order forecasting operators inadequate and prone to error accumulation. To address this, we propose Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation (FADE), a unified framework for training-free diffusion transformers acceleration. FADE models DiT feature evolution via anomalous diffusion and employs a Mittag--Leffler fractional operator to better adapt to high-curvature and non-linear latent trajectories of DiTs. Leveraging the empirical observation that these complex dynamics maintain cross-sample stability, we further construct a Look-Up Table with multiple dimensions through offline profiling. This enables negligible LUT-retrieval overhead, spatiotemporally adaptive parameter retrieval during online inference. Extensive evaluations across diverse architectures and modalities demonstrate that FADE achieves state-of-the-art acceleration, preserving exceptional generation fidelity under aggressive skip intervals with negligible latency overhead. Our project page is available at https://youngkinlon.github.io/fade-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出 FADE：基于异常扩散建模与 Mittag-Leffler 分数阶算子的免训练 DiT 特征缓存加速框架，结合离线 LUT 实现时空自适应参数检索，在激进跳步下保持生成保真度。
AI.motivation: DiT 迭代采样计算开销大；现有特征缓存方法基于整数阶算子进行特征复用或预测，无法适应 DiT 潜轨迹的非平稳、高曲率动态，导致误差累积。
AI.method: 1) 揭示 DiT 特征演化呈现异常扩散特性与一定时空异质性；2) 用异常扩散模型刻画特征演化，采用 Mittag-Leffler 分数阶算子提升对高曲率、非线性轨迹的适应性；3) 利用复杂动态的跨样本稳定性，离线剖析构建多维查找表（LUT），在线推理时以极小检索开销获得时空自适应参数。
AI.result: 在多种架构与模态上的广泛评测显示达到 SOTA 加速效果，在激进跳步间隔下仍保持优异生成保真度，附加延迟开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 整数阶特征预测不足的根源在于 DiT 潜动态的分数阶/异常扩散本质；将分数阶算子与离线 LUT 结合，可在免训练条件下实现高效、低开销且高质量的 DiT 加速。

title: An LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Modal Chatbot for Tomato Disease Consultant
comment: 14th International Conference on Multidisciplinary Research (ICMR 2026), ISBN: 978-974-474-120-2, Thaksin University Publisher, pp. 37-50, 2026 (Published)
summary: This paper introduces a chatbot developed to assist in diagnosing common diseases in tomato plants through natural language interaction. Users can describe symptoms in text. Then, the chatbot responds with the most likely disease, and basic treatment suggestions and related image-based reasoning. The system leverages pre-trained Mistral and Llama 3.2 large language models. The system is also built using LangChain and Streamlit to provide a lightweight and offline-friendly interface. This work targets to support tomato growers a fast and accessible tomato plant health guidance when the technical expertise is not available nearby, especially in the remote areas. The experimental results are promising and encourage further improvement of the chatbot for future real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于自然语言交互的番茄常见病害诊断聊天机器人，用户以文本描述症状，系统返回最可能的病害、基础防治建议及图像推理结果，依赖预训练 Mistral 与 Llama 3.2 大模型，并使用 LangChain 与 Streamlit 构建轻量、可离线运行的界面，面向缺乏技术支持的偏远地区番茄种植者。
AI.motivation: 番茄种植者在缺乏就近技术专家的情况下难以及时获得病害诊断与防治指导，偏远地区尤为突出，需要一种快速、易得、低门槛的健康诊断辅助工具。
AI.method: 构建文本症状输入的对话式诊断系统：以预训练 Mistral 与 Llama 3.2 作为推理与生成骨干，结合 LangChain 组织流程、Streamlit 提供轻量且可离线友好的交互界面；输出包含最可能病害、基础治疗建议及相关的基于图像的推理。
AI.result: 摘要仅给出定性结论，称实验结果具有前景，并能激励后续改进以面向真实场景部署，未报告具体准确率、数据集规模或对比指标。
AI.conclusion: 该聊天机器人为番茄病害诊断提供了一种可访问的自然语言辅助方案，具备低成本、可离线部署的潜力，但尚处于原型阶段，需进一步改进与验证后方可实际落地。

title: Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation: Evaluating Hierarchical Policies from Non-Hierarchical Data
summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the expected return of a target policy from previously collected data without additional environment interaction. While OPE methods for flat Markovian policies are well studied, little work has addressed evaluating hierarchical policies in which a high-level policy selects temporally extended options that generate primitive actions until a termination condition is met. The primary existing approach applies per-decision importance sampling at the option level, but requires option-annotated trajectories and exhibits variance that still grows with the horizon. For non-hierarchical policies, fitted Q-evaluation (FQE) typically achieves lower error than importance sampling by leveraging the classic Bellman equation for policy evaluation; however, a naive extension of FQE to hierarchical policies results in a biased policy value estimate. In this paper, we introduce Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation (IO-FQE), which estimates a value function in the augmented state-option space; this approach enables OPE of hierarchical policies even when we lack annotations of what option was run in the data. We develop two continuous-action instantiations of IO-FQE and show on long-horizon hierarchical continuous control tasks (AntMaze navigation and OGBench Puzzle manipulation) that IO-FQE eliminates the bias incurred by a naive application of FQE to hierarchical policies and substantially lowers mean squared-error compared to option-level importance sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出 Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation (IO-FQE)，在增广的状态-选项空间中估计价值函数，实现无需选项标注的分层策略离策略评估。
AI.motivation: 分层策略（高层策略选择时序扩展选项）的离策略评估研究不足。现有方法（选项级逐步重要性采样）需选项标注轨迹，且方差随视野增长；而朴素地将 FQE 扩展到分层策略会产生有偏估计。
AI.method: 在增广的状态-选项空间上估计价值函数，利用选项内部（intra-option）贝尔曼结构，从而可在缺乏数据中选项标注的情况下进行评估；并给出两种连续动作下的实例化实现。
AI.result: 在长视野分层连续控制任务（AntMaze 导航、OGBench Puzzle 操作）上，IO-FQE 消除了朴素 FQE 的偏差，并相较选项级重要性采样显著降低均方误差。
AI.conclusion: IO-FQE 为分层策略提供了一种低偏差、低方差且无需选项标注的离策略评估方法。

title: Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is undergoing rapid growth and large-scale deployment, motivating us to rethink how the inference process itself can be leveraged to enable efficient task-specific LLM adaptation. In this paper, we propose a forward-only approach for efficient LLM adaptation with forward-only passes in LLM inference serving. We exploit the angle concentration of activations induced by each singular value decomposition (SVD) component to measure its contribution-dispersed or concentrated-to the angle concentration of the hidden states. Based on this, our forward-only search then efficiently identifies the weight matrix with the highest dispersion that merits rank reduction. We then selectively remove the higher-order components and retain the lower-order components in SVD. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate the competitive accuracy of our forward-only approach, while theoretical analysis shows lower peak memory and greater speedup than the gradient-based approach and greater speedup than the exhaustive search approach. The experiments further present the robustness and generalization of our forward-only approach to various LLMs with up to 57B parameters. The code is included in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅需前向传播的LLM适配方法，利用激活角度集中度度量SVD分量的贡献，识别最值得降秩的权重矩阵并选择性剔除高阶分量，实现高效任务特定适配。
AI.motivation: LLM推理服务快速增长并大规模部署，促使重新思考如何利用推理过程本身来高效实现任务特定的LLM适配；现有梯度方法或穷举搜索在显存与速度上代价高。
AI.method: 基于SVD各分量所诱导激活的角度集中度（angular concentration）度量该分量对隐状态角度集中度的贡献是分散还是集中；据此用前向搜索高效定位"分散度最高"、最值得降秩的权重矩阵；再在SVD中选择性移除高阶分量、保留低阶分量。仅用前向传播，无需反向梯度。
AI.result: 多数据集实验显示精度具竞争力；理论分析表明相比梯度方法峰值显存更低、加速更大，相比穷举搜索加速更大；实验验证了对多种LLM（最大57B参数）的鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 前向式适配可作为推理服务中高效、低显存、可扩展的任务特定LLM适配方案，兼具精度与效率优势。

title: Dual-Granularity Learning for Regression with Continuous Noisy Labels
summary: Learning with noisy labels has been extensively studied for classification, yet its regression counterpart remains relatively underexplored. Unlike classification, regression involves continuous-valued targets where label noise exhibits heterogeneous magnitudes across instances, which poses conflicting requirements on the model: correcting small-to-moderate deviations requires sensitivity to label values for instance-level refinement, whereas large deviations caused by corrupted or outlying annotations render exact label values unreliable, necessitating reduced reliance on exact labels and instead leveraging ordinal structure among samples. These requirements call for methods that capture both global structure and sample-specific deviations in a unified manner. To this end, we propose GRAIN, a dual-granularity framework for robust noisy regression. At the fine-grained level, we derive an explicit residual learning mechanism from a robust loss formulation, introducing instance-specific auxiliary variables to decouple label noise from predictive signals. At the coarse-grained level, we introduce a binning-based contrastive regularization that enforces an order-preserving feature structure aligned with label proximity, addressing noise beyond the capacity of local residual refinement. The two levels are coupled via a histogram-based bridging mechanism that enables bidirectional information flow: coarse-grained structural guidance establishes a well-ordered feature space that anchors residual learning, while fine-grained residual refinement corrects instance-level deviations that structural regularization alone cannot resolve. Experimental results show that GRAIN consistently improves robustness and generalization under diverse noise conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAIN双粒度框架处理噪声标签回归：细粒度用稳健损失导出的残差学习解耦标签噪声，粗粒度用分箱对比正则保持序结构特征，二者通过直方图桥接双向耦合。
AI.motivation: 分类噪声标签研究充分，但回归场景研究不足。回归为连续目标，噪声幅度异质：中小的偏差需对标签值敏感以做实例级精修；而由错标/离群造成的大偏差使精确标签值不可靠，应降低对精确标签的依赖、转而利用样本间的序结构。两类需求相冲突，需要统一捕捉全局结构与样本特异偏差的方法。
AI.method: 双粒度框架：细粒度层面从稳健损失形式推导出显式残差学习机制，引入实例特异辅助变量，将标签噪声与预测信号解耦；粗粒度层面引入基于分箱的对比正则化，构建与标签邻近性一致、保序的特征结构；两者通过基于直方图的桥接机制耦合，实现双向信息流——粗粒度结构引导为残差学习提供有序特征空间锚点，细粒度残差精修纠正结构正则无法处理的实例级偏差。
AI.result: 实验表明GRAIN在多种噪声条件下持续提升稳健性与泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度残差精修与粗粒度保序对比正则的双向耦合，可在统一框架内同时兼顾全局结构与实例级偏差，有效应对回归中异质幅度的标签噪声。

title: Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) trains agents to adapt to novel tasks from test-time experience, but requires diverse training environments and reward functions. While environments are becoming cheaper to generate, it remains difficult to anticipate every objective an agent may be asked to pursue at test time. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) learn policies from reward-free data and support zero-shot RL (ZSRL): adaptation to new objectives at test time using a large reward-labeled dataset. Recent work has shown that BFM task inference can instead be performed online without prior task-specific data. We note that this capability positions BFMs and meta-RL as alternative approaches for online adaptation to new reward functions in a fixed environment. We then ask whether we can extend BFMs to compete with meta-RL more broadly, including in novel environments, and identify four challenges: environment identification, online data collection, test-time exploration, and learning from mixed reward supervision. We study each individually, then propose MetaBFM, a hybrid method that addresses all four. During training, it combines supervised reward-following with unsupervised learning; at test time, it can interpolate between exploration, exploitation, and ZSRL-style reward inference. We demonstrate that MetaBFM can recover the in-distribution performance of supervised meta-RL while generalizing to reward functions outside the training set. Our work suggests that BFMs and meta-RL are complementary research directions whose combined strengths allow adaptive agents to learn more diverse behaviors from a fixed set of supervised objectives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MetaBFM，将行为基础模型（BFM）与元强化学习（meta-RL）结合，用无监督奖励配对数据增强监督元RL，实现对新环境与新奖励函数的在线自适应。
AI.motivation: Meta-RL需要多样化环境与奖励函数训练，但测试时的目标难以预先穷举；BFM可从无奖励数据学习并支持零样本RL，但此前主要用于固定环境下的在线奖励适应。作者希望让BFM扩展到新环境，从而覆盖meta-RL的更广场景。
AI.method: 先指出四个挑战：环境识别、在线数据收集、测试时探索、混合奖励监督学习，逐一研究；再提出MetaBFM混合方法——训练时结合监督式奖励跟随与无监督学习，测试时可在探索、利用与ZSRL式奖励推断之间插值。
AI.result: MetaBFM能恢复监督meta-RL的分布内性能，同时泛化到训练集之外的奖励函数。
AI.conclusion: BFM与meta-RL是互补方向：二者优势结合可使自适应智能体从固定监督目标集合中学到更多样化的行为。

title: DFT-Agent Bench: Scaffold Effects and Execution Provenance in Autonomous DFT
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for first-principles materials simulation. We report empirical findings from DFT-Agent Bench, a benchmark of 200+ Quantum ESPRESSO tasks spanning relaxation, electronic structure, equation-of-state, and elastic-tensor pipelines over multiple material tiers. Each task carries a QE-derived ground truth with public-reference cross-checks where available, and a provenance audit checks whether the required QE execution contract was met. Under one execution harness, we compare a near-bare ReAct baseline with a bundled v5.1 scaffold on two models. The complete scaffold improves bands+DOS by +0.08/+0.11 and d-electron vc-relax by +0.17 on both models, while high-scoring relaxation and equation-of-state cells leave little room for improvement. The elastic result is model-dependent (0.18 to 0.40 for deepseek-v4-pro and 0.62 to 0.59 for claude-opus-4-8). A fixed 100-task analysis with retrieval disabled supports the aggregate pattern: the fully frozen DeepSeek comparison gains +0.17, while the Opus comparison gains +0.10 against a historical pool baseline (p < 0.001). The provenance gate catches incomplete or unmarked executions that can receive high rubric scores; it is an execution-contract check, not a test for intentional fraud. These results characterize the evaluated DFT workflows. The anonymous review artifact contains the frozen diagnostic slice, prompts, scorer, and solver revisions: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/231e31re91287h/README.md.

AI.tldr: 提出DFT-Agent Bench基准（200+ QE任务），在同一执行框架下对比ReAct基线与v5.1脚手架，并用溯源门控检查QE执行契约。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被用作自主智能体执行第一性原理材料模拟，但缺乏标准化基准来量化其实际能力与执行合规性。
AI.method: 构建DFT-Agent Bench，涵盖结构弛豫、电子结构、状态方程、弹性张量四类QE流水线，任务附带QE真值与公开参考交叉校验；在同一执行harness下，对两个模型比较近裸ReAct基线与打包v5.1脚手架；并设置溯源审计判断是否满足QE执行契约。
AI.result: 完整脚手架在bands+DOS上提升+0.08/+0.11，d电子vc-relax提升+0.17（两模型一致）；弹性结果依赖模型（deepseek-v4-pro 0.18→0.40，claude-opus-4-8 0.62→0.59）；固定100任务、关闭检索的分析支持整体趋势（DeepSeek +0.17，Opus +0.10，p<0.001）；溯源门控可识别获高评分但执行不完整或未标记的情况。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了所评估的DFT工作流能力边界；溯源门控是执行契约检查而非舞弊检测；提示词、评分器与求解器版本已匿名开源。

title: Confronting Uncertainty in Mechanism-AI Coupled Dynamical Systems via Optimal Transport and Information Geometry: Part I. Distribution Learning
summary: Mechanism-AI coupled dynamical systems are increasingly used to study complex biological systems. However, uncertainty associated with noisy, sparse, and partially observed data limits their reliability. This paper presents a systematic mathematical formulation for treating these uncertainties from the perspective of optimal transport and information geometry. We formulate the uncertainty quantification problem as the minimization of an energy functional on a probability density space equipped with a Riemannian metric, with the loss evaluated through a differential equation, and give a unified description of the gradient flows of the energy functional under specific metrics, such as the Wasserstein and Fisher-Rao metrics. Furthermore, we present corresponding numerical methods for solving these gradient flows using abstract adjoint sensitivity analysis. The formulation connects a range of Bayesian inference methods for dynamical systems; numerical experiments compare posterior approximation and predictive uncertainty under a common computational budget. Moreover, it also provides a geometric perspective on dynamical modeling and the study of heterogeneity evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文从最优传输与信息几何视角，为机制-AI耦合动力系统的参数/状态不确定性建立统一的数学框架：将UQ写为黎曼度量下概率密度空间上的能量泛函极小化，用微分方程评估损失，并给出Wasserstein与Fisher-Rao度量下梯度流的统一描述及基于抽象伴随灵敏度的数值解法，从而统一多种贝叶斯推断方法并提供动力系统几何视角。
AI.motivation: 机制-AI耦合动力系统广泛用于复杂生物系统研究，但噪声、稀疏与部分观测数据带来的不确定性限制其可靠性；现有动力系统贝叶斯推断方法彼此割裂，缺乏统一的理论刻画与可比的计算框架。
AI.method: 在赋予黎曼度量的概率密度空间上，将UQ表述为能量泛函的极小化问题，损失通过微分方程（动力系统）评估；统一刻画特定度量（如Wasserstein度量、Fisher-Rao度量）下能量泛函的梯度流；并借助抽象伴随灵敏度分析给出求解这些梯度流的数值方法。
AI.result: 该形式化框架将一系列面向动力系统的贝叶斯推断方法纳入统一表述；数值实验在相同计算预算下比较了不同方法的后验近似与预测不确定性。此外，框架还提供了动力系统建模与异质性演化的几何视角。
AI.conclusion: 最优传输与信息几何可为机制-AI耦合动力系统的不确定性量化提供统一、可计算的几何框架，连接并统一多种贝叶斯推断方法，并为动力系统建模与异质性演化研究提供新的几何解释。

title: SLA-Aware Task Offloading in the IoT Edge-Cloud Continuum: Class-Weighted Deep Reinforcement Learning Against an Exact Optimum
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to decide where Internet of Things (IoT) tasks with different latency limits run in the edge-cloud continuum, yet some methods give every missed task the same penalty and few compare their agents with an optimal policy. This benchmark study builds four offloading systems small enough to solve exactly by dynamic programming and measures reward and learner against the optimum. A bonus for a met limit makes each miss cost its penalty plus the bonus, which shifts the class weights of published per-class rewards. A class-blind penalty stays 65% to 118% above the optimal cost even with a perfect learner, while a corrected per-class penalty comes within 0.13% of the optimum. With a per-class reward, tuned proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents come within 9% to 11% of the optimum in the smallest system, and the corrected one beats a tuned reservation rule in 9 of 10 seeds. In larger systems the agents stay 41% to 76% above the optimum, and a tuned rule beats their mean. Training ten times longer does not close this gap, and a PPO-Lagrangian agent with reachable targets does no better than the per-class reward.

AI.tldr: 该基准研究用动态规划求得四个可精确求解的卸载系统最优解，衡量深度强化学习智能体的奖励与学习质量。结论：类盲惩罚即使学习者完美也高于最优成本65%–118%；修正的按类惩罚可逼近最优0.13%；PPO仅在最小系统接近最优（差9%–11%），较大系统中高于最优41%–76%，且不及调优规则，延长训练无法弥合差距。
AI.motivation: 现有深度RL卸载方法对每个超时任务施加相同惩罚，且少有工作将智能体与最优策略对比，导致难以判断性能差距源于奖励设计、学习还是问题本身。作者希望建立可精确求解的小规模基准，将奖励质量与学习器质量分离衡量。
AI.method: 构建四个规模足够小、可用动态规划精确求解的IoT任务卸载系统；在此基础上分别评估奖励设计与学习器：(1) 分析"类盲惩罚"与"按类惩罚"（含满足时延上限的奖励加成，使每次超时成本=惩罚+加成，从而改变已发表按类奖励的类权重）；(2) 训练调优的PPO智能体与PPO-Lagrangian智能体；(3) 与调优的预留规则（reservation rule）在多个随机种子下对比。
AI.result: 类盲惩罚即使配完美学习器，成本仍高于最优65%–118%；修正的按类惩罚可控制在最优的0.13%以内。带按类奖励的调优PPO在最小系统中距最优9%–11%，修正版在10个种子中9个优于调优预留规则。较大系统中智能体高于最优41%–76%，调优规则优于其均值；训练时长增至十倍未能缩小差距；目标可达的PPO-Lagrangian并不优于按类奖励。
AI.conclusion: 奖励设计（尤其是按类惩罚的正确加权）对能否逼近最优至关重要，甚至比学习器质量更关键；然而在较大系统中，即便奖励修正、训练加长或采用拉格朗日约束方法，PPO仍显著落后于最优，且不及简单调优规则，说明纯深度RL在该类时延约束卸载问题上存在实质差距。

title: Predictive Modelling of Solid Waste Generation through Time Series Analysis
summary:
Reliable forecasting of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) production is pivotal for sustainable urban management, as it enables efficient resource planning, optimized collection schedules, and reduced environmental impacts. Existing works on MSW forecasting have some limitations, such as unavailability of granular data from lower administrative units, small datasets, limited or sometimes no consideration of important factors that can affect MSW generation, including holidays, weekends, seasonality, changes in temperature or humidity.
  This work presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four popularly used time series forecasting models, namely Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Prophet, Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), using a real-world MSW dataset from Sri Lanka spanning 2012-2018. A detailed factor-wise analysis is conducted to examine waste generation behaviour considering holidays, weekday-weekend variations, seasonal patterns, temperature and humidity. The results show lower waste generation during holidays and weekends, higher generation during Summer and Winter, and comparatively lower generation during Monsoon and Post-Monsoon. Temperature and humidity do not exhibit a direct linear relationship with waste generation, although their seasonal variations are associated with the changes in waste generation across different seasons. All model performances are evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and the coefficient of determination (R2). Among the evaluated models, LSTM and SARIMAX achieve the best overall forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: 本文基于斯里兰卡2012–2018年真实城市固废数据，系统比较SARIMAX、Prophet、LSTM与GRU四种时间序列模型，并做节假日、周末、季节、温湿度等因素分析，结果显示LSTM与SARIMAX整体预测性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 城市固废产量的可靠预测对资源规划、收运调度与降低环境影响至关重要；既有研究存在下层行政单元细粒度数据缺失、数据集规模小、以及假日/周末/季节性/温湿度等关键影响因素考虑不足等缺陷。
AI.method: 采用斯里兰卡2012–2018年真实MSW数据，对SARIMAX、Prophet、LSTM、GRU四种常用时间序列模型进行对比分析；并开展逐因素分析，考察节假日、工作日—周末差异、季节模式及温湿度对垃圾产生行为的影响。
AI.result: 节假日与周末垃圾产生量较低，夏冬两季较高，季风期与季风后较低；温湿度与垃圾产生量无直接线性关系，但其季节变化与不同季节垃圾产生量变化相关联。以MAE、MAPE、RMSE和R²评价，LSTM与SARIMAX整体预测性能最佳。
AI.conclusion: 多因素分析与多模型对比可提升MSW预测的合理性与准确性；综合指标下LSTM与SARIMAX为该数据集上优选模型，可为城市固废管理决策提供参考。

title: MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs
summary: Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent.

AI.tldr: 提出MMGraph-Agent，一个基于缓存启发的多模态知识超图统一多模态RAG框架，以零API成本轻量构建超图并结合动态记忆检索，统一离线与在线知识源。
AI.motivation: RAG已从文本管线扩展到多模态，涵盖知识组织与检索增强两个维度，但现有方法存在构建成本高、上下文窗口受限、离线与在线知识源缺乏统一训练三大问题。
AI.method: 以缓存启发的多模态知识超图为载体构建统一框架：实现零API成本、极轻量的超图构建，并采用基于动态记忆的检索机制缓解长上下文问题，同时统一离线与在线检索。
AI.result: 在离线、在线及联合检索三类设置下，实验显示在性能、效率与架构统一性方面均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: MMGraph-Agent验证了超图+动态记忆检索在多模态RAG中的有效性，代码与数据已开源。

title: Detent: Batch-Invariant LLM Serving and RL Rollouts at Near-Stock Speed
summary: Reproducible evaluation, verifiable inference and on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) need an LLM engine to give a request the same output bits whichever requests share its batch. Batch-invariant kernels exist, but engines still select each kernel and its parameters from the batch. Two kernels that compute the same sum can round it differently. The engines' deterministic modes remove the choice by keeping one conservative kernel per operator and pay for it in latency. Many fast kernels are batch-invariant by themselves, so it is enough to fix the few batch-dependent values that kernel selection reads. Detent expresses kernel selection as a program that the engine executes. It finds the fewest values in this program that must be fixed and tunes them for the workload before deployment. On multi-GPU deployments of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-30B-A3B in vLLM and SGLang, Detent is batch-invariant. Tuned per load, it serves at 1.04-1.17x the latency per output token of Stock (each engine with its standard settings), against 1.67-10.3x for the deterministic modes. In SGLang it matches the GSM8K accuracy of SGLang's deterministic mode. Detent covers multiple deployment combinations, including multiple engines, GPU generations, tensor-parallel degrees, and dense and MoE models. Seeded RL rollouts of models up to Llama-3.1-70B replay bit for bit under other batches and cache splits. A trainer on Detent's kernels and values matches every rollout logprob bit for bit at 1.03x Stock's rollout time per token. BF16 GRPO then stays stable where Stock's run collapses.

AI.tldr: 提出 Detent：把内核选择表达为程序，仅固定其中少数批次依赖取值，从而实现批次不变推理，延迟仅为 Stock 的 1.04-1.17 倍。
AI.motivation: 可复现评测、可验证推理与 on-policy RL 要求同一请求的输出比特不受同批次其他请求影响；现有引擎的确定性模式通过为每个算子只保留一个保守内核来消除不确定性，代价是显著延迟。
AI.method: 观察到许多快速内核本身即批次不变，只需固定内核选择所读取的少数批次依赖值；将内核选择建模为引擎执行的程序，自动搜索需固定值的最小子集，并在部署前按负载调优这些值。
AI.result: 在 vLLM 与 SGLang 上部署 Llama-3.1-70B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 多卡实例实现批次不变；每 token 延迟为 Stock 的 1.04–1.17 倍（确定性模式为 1.67–10.3 倍）；SGLang 下 GSM8K 精度与确定性模式持平；覆盖率多引擎、多 GPU 代际、多 TP 度及稠密与 MoE 模型；种子化 RL rollout 可逐比特重放，训练端 logprob 逐比特一致、rollout 耗时 1.03 倍，BF16 GRPO 训练稳定而 Stock 崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 以“最小固定值集”替代“单保守内核”是兼顾批次不变性与性能的有效途径，可支撑可复现推理与稳定 on-policy RL。

title: The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies
summary: Cellular world models aim to predict how cells respond to genetic perturbations, analogous to world models in reinforcement learning. Perturbation response models are evaluated almost exclusively by global Pearson correlation between predicted and observed transcriptomes. We show this metric is dominated by thousands of non-responsive genes and severely inflates apparent performance. On the Replogle K562 screen (509 unseen perturbations, 5000 genes), GEARS achieves global Pearson 0.977, but its delta Pearson is only 0.076. A trivial baseline predicting mean training delta achieves 0.267, which is 3.5x better than GEARS. Our primary contribution is methodological: we identify and quantify this delta gap as a systematic evaluation artifact, and propose delta-space evaluation as the primary benchmark. We provide two post-hoc corrections (RWR on co-expression graphs and kNN matching) and show that 2.8x of the remaining gap lies in perturbation representation geometry, not decoder capacity. We further show the gap is partially addressable end-to-end: delta-aligned training (lambda = 3.0) raises delta Pearson to 0.179 on Replogle (2.35x over GEARS) and surpasses the trivial baseline on direction accuracy (0.680 vs 0.567) and gene recovery (1.52 vs 1.19); combined with kNN it reaches 0.217. An amplitude-calibration variant (eta = 0.3) further raises gene recovery to 2.16 while reaching 0.218. Critically, these representations transfer zero-shot across cell lines: from Replogle K562 to unseen Norman A549, the delta-aligned model reaches 0.328 on 741 shared genes, 4.7x a trivial baseline and 2.1x standard GEARS. This is the first systematic quantification of the delta gap, and the first diagnostic framework localizing the residual gap to perturbation representation geometry via an oracle upper bound.

AI.tldr: 该文指出扰动响应模型惯用的全局Pearson相关被大量非响应基因主导、严重高估性能，提出以delta空间评估为主基准，并给出两种后处理修正与端到端delta对齐训练方案。
AI.motivation: 细胞世界模型（扰动响应模型）几乎只用预测与观测转录组之间的全局Pearson相关来评估，但该指标被数千个非响应基因主导，掩盖了模型对真实扰动效应的预测能力，因此需要识别并量化这一评估伪影。
AI.method: 在Replogle K562筛选（509个未见扰动、5000个基因）上定量刻画"delta gap"；提出delta空间评估作为主基准；给出两种后处理修正（共表达图上的RWR、kNN匹配）；用oracle上界诊断残差差距来源（扰动表示几何 vs 解码器容量）；提出delta对齐训练（λ=3.0）与幅度校准变体（η=0.3）。
AI.result: GEARS全局Pearson达0.977但delta Pearson仅0.076；预测训练集平均delta的平凡基线达0.267，为GEARS的3.5倍。delta对齐训练将delta Pearson提至0.179（2.35倍于GEARS），方向准确率0.680 vs 0.567、基因恢复1.52 vs 1.19，结合kNN达0.217；幅度校准变体基因恢复升至2.16、达0.218。零样本迁移至未见Norman A549细胞系在741个共享基因上达0.328，为平凡基线的4.7倍、标准GEARS的2.1倍；残差差距中2.8倍位于扰动表示几何而非解码器容量。
AI.conclusion: 全局Pearson评估存在系统性伪影，delta空间评估应作为扰动响应模型的主基准；残差差距主要源于扰动表示几何，可通过delta对齐训练与后处理修正部分解决，且所得表示具备跨细胞系零样本迁移能力。

title: RankShift: Evaluating Ranking Instability Across Benchmark Dimensions in Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing benchmarks are often treated as stable measures of model quality, yet rankings may depend substantially on benchmark design choices. In this work, we present RankShift, a systematic study comparing OCR and vision-language models (VLMs) under controlled variation in dataset composition, matching strategy, and scoring methodology. Using OmniDocBench as a case study, we evaluate the ranking stability of 16 models across 3 dataset configurations, 6 matching strategies, and 3 scoring metrics. We quantify rank stability using pairwise rank correlation, top-k churn, and pairwise reversal rate. Our results show that the interaction between matching strategy and ground truth format is a substantial but understudied driver of instability: scoring against OmniDocBench's JSON annotations versus its Markdown rendering yields a mean Kendall's tau of approximately 0.33 under region-level matching strategies, with individual pairs as low as tau = 0.23, compared with tau = 0.77 when each page is scored as a single concatenated string. Dataset composition produces comparable instability across page-type strata (mean tau = 0.48) and layout-type strata (mean tau = 0.49), while the cross-dataset shift from OmniDocBench to Real5's Scanning reconstruction of the same pages is more stable (tau = 0.80). Metric choice is the most stable dimension, with mean tau of approximately 0.78 across NED, BLEU, and METEOR. These findings indicate that leaderboard position is not solely a property of model capability, motivating leaderboards that report not only headline scores but also the robustness of rankings across reasonable design choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RankShift，系统研究文档解析基准中排名对基准设计的敏感性，并呼吁排行榜同时报告排名稳健性。
AI.motivation: 文档解析基准常被视为衡量模型质量的稳定指标，但排名可能高度依赖基准设计选择，这一不稳定性此前缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 以OmniDocBench为案例，在16个模型上变动3种数据配置、6种匹配策略、3种评分指标；用成对秩相关、top-k变动率、成对反转率量化排名稳定性。
AI.result: 匹配策略与真值格式的交互是不稳定性的主要来源：JSON标注 vs Markdown渲染在区域级匹配下平均Kendall's tau≈0.33（最低0.23），而整页拼接字符串评分为0.77；数据配置（页面类型分层tau=0.48，布局类型tau=0.49）与跨数据集（OmniDocBench→Real5，tau=0.80）居中；指标选择最稳定（NED/BLEU/METEOR平均tau≈0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜名次并非单纯反映模型能力，基准设计选择可显著改变排名；应构建报告排名稳健性的排行榜。

title: What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/mainul3195/collusion-probe-pitfalls ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mainul3195/collusion-probe-pitfalls ; archive: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23636508
summary: Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

AI.tldr: 激活探针（activation probes）看似能近乎完美地监测LLM智能体间的秘密串谋，但实测主要检测的是"智能体被指示串谋"而非"其决定串谋"；仅读投票结果的高AUROC属于评估伪影，真正基于智能体自身选择的探针仍可读出串谋决策。
AI.motivation: 现有工作报告激活探针在线性探针下对秘密串谋近似完美监测（AUROC接近1.00），但这类结论可能混淆了"指令接收"与"决策形成"两个环节；同时缺乏能区分二者的对照基准，以及针对评估伪影的严格检验协议。
AI.method: 构建含2,500个委员会与1,476个代码评审片段的基准，新增"收到串谋指令但拒绝执行"的智能体作为对照，从而将指令与决策解耦；在该对照下重测已发表检测器，并分析投票后评分这一时间点伪影；此外训练基于智能体自身选择的探针，并测试目标被微调进权重的情形；最后将控制条件整理为统一测试协议，并把扫描统计量（scan statistics）改造为适用于任意规模群体的在线监测器。
AI.result: 已发表检测器几乎无法区分串谋者与拒令者；最佳探针在去除指令信息后智能体级AUROC由1.00降至0.61；仅读投票的规则投票后AUROC达0.990而投票前无任何发现；57%的尝试中没有串谋者在公开场合为靶向对象辩护；基于智能体自身选择的探针在无指令时AUROC为0.73，对目标被微调进权重的串谋者AUROC达0.995（预注册）。
AI.conclusion: 表观的高检测性能多为指令识别与评估伪影所致，而非对串谋决策的可靠读取；需以"拒令对照+投票前评分+公开行为核查"等控制构成统一监测协议，并配合在线扫描统计监测任意规模智能体群体。

title: Audit Before You Merge: Provenance, Probing, and Continual LoRA Composition
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables. ICML 2026 Workshop on Continual Adaptation at Scale (CATS). Code: https://github.com/LennyAharon/audit_continual_learning
summary: Post-hoc merging of public LoRA adapters is an attractive gradient-free path to continual adaptation, but reliable measurement of catastrophic forgetting in this setting depends on infrastructure that prior work has not addressed. We treat each adapter merge as a sequential task in a continual-learning setting, with the instruction-tuned base model's capabilities as Task 0, and study forgetting on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Public adapter hubs contain modules that fail basic provenance checks: silent base-version mismatches and near-zero delta norms whose inclusion inflates measured interference by ~10pp. We propose a two-check audit (base-model match, non-trivial delta norm) and a leakage-free probing protocol as preconditions for any forgetting study in this setting. On an audited 4-adapter set, naive merging causes -10.5pp on GSM8K and -18.3pp on HumanEval, while Task Arithmetic at lambda=0.5 sits within a standard error of the unmerged baseline. A coordinate search including negative coefficients identifies the math adapter as probe-optimal at lambda=-0.5, outside the reach of positive-only mergers, suggesting forgetting has structure that negation-aware merging may exploit. The same protocol replicates on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, where 2 of 4 candidate adapters fail the audit and the audited merge reproduces the same merge-method ranking on GSM8K, supporting that our findings are not Llama-specific.

AI.tldr: 论文指出公共LoRA适配器事后合并中存在基础设施缺陷（基座版本不匹配、近零delta），提出两项审计检查与无泄漏探测协议，并在审计后的适配器集上研究灾难性遗忘及合并方法差异。
AI.motivation: 事后合并公共LoRA适配器是免梯度的持续适配路径，但在该设定下可靠度量灾难性遗忘依赖此前工作未解决的基础设施问题：公共适配器中心的模块质量与评测泄漏会显著扭曲测得的干扰。
AI.method: 将每次适配器合并视为持续学习中的一个顺序任务，指令微调基座能力视为Task 0，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上研究遗忘。提出两项审计检查（基座模型匹配、delta范数非平凡）作为前提，并设计无泄漏探测协议；在审计通过的4适配器集合上比较朴素合并与Task Arithmetic，并进行含负系数的坐标搜索；在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上复现。
AI.result: 未审计时，静默基座版本不匹配与近零delta范数的模块会使测得的干扰虚高约10pp。审计后的4适配器集合上，朴素合并使GSM8K下降-10.5pp、HumanEval下降-18.3pp，而lambda=0.5的Task Arithmetic与未合并基线的差距在一个标准误内。含负系数的坐标搜索显示数学适配器在lambda=-0.5时探测最优，超出仅正系数合并的搜索范围。Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上4个候选中2个未通过审计，审计后合并在GSM8K上复现相同的合并方法排序。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下开展遗忘研究须以基座匹配、非平凡delta审计和无泄漏探测为前置条件；审计后度量显示遗忘具有可被负系数合并利用的结构，且结论不限于Llama模型。

title: CONSTRAINER: Promptable Graph-Structured Optimization via Constraint Conditioning
summary: Neural methods for graph-structured optimization have achieved strong performance within individual problem classes, but are typically trained for fixed formulations, limiting reuse across related problem variants. Recent progress in foundation models has motivated shared neural backbones trained across multiple graph-structured optimization tasks; however, existing approaches primarily share instance-level representations while treating feasibility constraints implicitly. A key source of shared structure across constrained optimization problems is the constraint set itself, which often exhibits substantial overlap across tasks. We propose CONSTRAINER, a constraint-conditioned framework for graph-structured optimization that treats constraints as structured inputs. Constraint specifications are parsed into operator graphs and encoded using a graph neural network to produce invariant constraint embeddings, which condition a shared backbone model for solution prediction. We evaluate our approach on power grid optimization and mixed-integer linear programming problems, where it shows improved solution optimality and enables efficient transfer learning and generalization compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 CONSTRAINER：将约束集本身作为跨任务共享结构的来源，把约束规范解析为算子图并用 GNN 编码为约束嵌入，条件化共享骨干网络进行解预测。
AI.motivation: 图结构优化神经方法多针对固定问题形式训练，难以在相关变体间复用；现有跨任务基础模型主要共享实例级表示、隐式处理可行性约束，忽略约束集这一重要共享结构。
AI.method: 约束条件化框架：将约束规范解析为算子图（operator graph），用 GNN 编码得到不变的约束嵌入，以此条件化一个共享骨干模型进行解预测。
AI.result: 在电网优化与混合整数线性规划任务上评估，相比基线方法提升解的最优性，并实现高效迁移学习与泛化。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并共享约束结构可提升跨问题变体的复用性、迁移效率与泛化能力，为图结构优化提供约束级共享范式。

title: RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening
summary: Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RetinaGuard，一个用于眼底图像筛查的智能体式分诊框架：由质量、诊断、不确定性、验证与解释五个智能体收集证据，用学习到的失败预测器估计决策不安全概率，仅在信息期望收益超过成本时调用辅助工具，并以保形风险控制认证接受阈值。在 RFMiD 上，其收益取决于主模型自身不确定性已能揭示多少错误。
AI.motivation: 视网膜筛查项目需要明确哪些自动化决策可以免于人工复核。现有基于置信度或校准不确定性的转诊策略只利用单一信号，可能遗漏可额外获取的证据；同时需要可证明的安全保证与可控的计算成本。
AI.method: 构建智能体式分诊框架 RetinaGuard：质量、诊断、不确定性、验证、解释智能体为每张眼底照片收集证据；学习型失败预测器输出决策不安全的概率；辅助工具仅在其信息期望价值（EVOI）超过调用成本时触发；接受阈值由保形风险控制（conformal risk control）认证。在 RFMiD 测试集上，于相同转诊预算与同等认证安全水平下，与置信度转诊、校准不确定性转诊对比，并使用两个强弱不同的 RETFound 主模型。
AI.result: 弱模型（macro-AUROC 0.896）下，验证器分歧提供显著额外信息：20% 预算时 RetinaGuard 捕获 280 个不安全决策中的 119 个，而最低置信度转诊为 88 个；名义 5% 不安全水平下接受率 37.0% 对 10.3%。强模型（0.925）下，验证器在不确定性之外无增量信息，优势缩小至几个百分点。两种设置下名义 5% 水平的覆盖率均约 37.7%，门控使计算量下降约 30%，质量智能体在多数图像退化下减少不安全接受。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式证据收集的收益取决于主模型自身不确定性对错误的揭示程度：不确定性信息不足时增益显著，不确定性已充分时增益有限。框架可在认证安全水平下稳定保持约 37.7% 覆盖率并降低约 30% 计算量，质量智能体可提升退化图像下的安全性。

title: Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 12 figures, 35 tables
summary: Sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the KV cache, but existing methods are open-loop: the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. The needed signal already exists inside the kernel. The fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens, which we call coverage, satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention (CVSA) turns coverage into a training-free, closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short, with no sampling, no draft model, and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. Quality varies by only $0.14$ points across the threshold sweep; budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. On LongBench at 7B and 70B, CVSA comes within $1.13$ points of dense attention, statistically matching it at 70B, and it loses $0.8$ points on RULER; measured median decode-step speedup reaches $6.21\times$ at 128K context.

AI.tldr: 提出CVSA，利用"覆盖率"（选中token上的softmax质量）作为接受判据与插值权重，实现无需训练的闭环"验证—纠正"稀疏注意力解码，在保持接近稠密注意力质量的同时取得最高6.21倍中位解码加速。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力是开环的：内核提交选择后没有信号判断是否保留了足够的注意力质量，也缺乏未达标时的恢复路径。而所需信号（选中token的softmax质量占比）本就存在于内核内部。
AI.method: 将覆盖率定义为选中token上的softmax质量占比，证明其与每步输出误差满足精确代数等式；以此同时充当接受判据与恢复插值权重，构建无采样、无草稿模型、无投机解码基础设施的训练免闭环解码循环：接受高覆盖率草稿，仅对不达标注意力头进行恢复。
AI.result: 阈值扫描下质量仅波动0.14分；LongBench上7B与70B分别距稠密注意力1.13分以内（70B统计等价），RULER损失0.8分；128K上下文下中位解码步加速达6.21倍。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率是可验证、可复用的内在信号，可将稀疏注意力从开环近似转为闭环可控近似，在不训练、不增加投机解码设施的前提下逼近稠密注意力质量并显著提速。

title: Hallucination-Guided Unlearning: Using Hallucination Traces to Reveal Overfitted Memories
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Selective unlearning is increasingly important for the safety and compliance of large language models. Harmful or memorized content is often entangled with useful knowledge and difficult to enumerate. We use the model's own failures to identify candidates for unlearning. We propose Hallucination-Guided Unlearning (HGU), which uses hallucinations as diagnostic signals. HGU localizes unsupported spans via evidence and internal consensus, traces a sparse set of high-responsibility MLP neurons, and edits them with compact gates under a utility-preserving KL constraint. On TOFU, HGU achieves the best MU-FE trade-off, with Avg scores of 0.7221 (forget05) and 0.7699 (forget10), and the highest SepS H-Avg (0.4382/0.4715) under mixed forget/retain prompts. On the WMDP auxiliary task, HGU yields the strongest forgetting (e.g., 14.2 on Economics) while improving Retain (52.7) and MMLU (57.2). These results suggest that tracing hallucinations enables targeted, post-hoc unlearning that better balances forgetting efficacy and general utility without full retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出幻觉引导遗忘方法HGU，利用模型自身幻觉作为诊断信号，定位高责任MLP神经元并进行门控编辑，在遗忘效果与通用效用间取得更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 选择性遗忘对大模型安全与合规日益重要，但有害或记忆内容常与有用知识纠缠、难以枚举；需要一种无需全量重训、能精准定位遗忘目标的后处理方法。
AI.method: HGU将幻觉作为诊断信号：借助证据与内部一致性定位无支撑片段，追踪少量高责任MLP神经元，并在保持效用的KL约束下用紧凑门控对其进行编辑。
AI.result: TOFU上取得最佳MU-FE权衡（forget05为0.7221、forget10为0.7699），混合提示下SepS H-Avg最高（0.4382/0.4715）；WMDP辅助任务上遗忘最强（如Economics达14.2），同时Retain提升至52.7、MMLU达57.2。
AI.conclusion: 追踪幻觉可支撑有针对性的后处理式遗忘，在无需全量重训的前提下更好平衡遗忘有效性与通用效用。

title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
summary: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM.

AI.tldr: MACaQ是一种MXFP4 W4A4训练后量化方法，逐层独立处理线性层，在线对激活应用逐通道缩放与块Hadamard变换并将逆变换吸收进权重，配合Hessian感知的Flip-Refinement坐标下降优化FP4编码，实现流式量化、低开销且泛化性强的量化方案。
AI.motivation: 现有权重-激活量化方法通常需要昂贵的优化过程，并依赖跨层的基变换传播（architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms），导致实现复杂、存在跨层依赖且难以通用。作者希望设计一种层局部（layer-local）、无需跨层依赖、可流式实现的高效W4A4量化方法。
AI.method: 1）将每个线性层独立处理：对每层激活在线应用逐通道缩放（per-channel scale）和块Hadamard变换，并把相应的逆变换吸收进权重；2）变换保留在在线路径上，避免跨层依赖，从而实现只需单层驻留内存的流式量化；3）提出Flip-Refinement——一种Hessian感知的坐标下降过程，贪心地逐个将FP4编码移动到相邻可表示值，以改进round-to-nearest量化。
AI.result: 在vLLM上对Qwen3-32B，尽管推理时执行激活变换，端到端开销仅比纯MXFP4高2.3%；困惑度低于DuQuant++和MR-GPTQ，并在Llama-3-8B上以11倍的更少量化时间达到其最佳困惑度；无需架构特定修改即可应用于图像扩散模型；在仅32.5GB GPU显存下64分钟完成122B参数模型量化。
AI.conclusion: MACaQ以层局部设计实现了高效、通用、低开销的MXFP4 W4A4训练后量化，兼顾量化质量、速度与内存效率，并可跨架构（LLM与扩散模型）及超大规模模型应用。

title: R-BED: A Consequence-Aware Framework for System-Level AI Evaluation and Continuous Assurance
comment: 22 pages (18 pages main text plus appendices), 8 figures, 11 tables. Specification-level methodology with a synthetic walkthrough; no empirical validation. Companion reproducibility script available from the author
summary: Evaluations of AI systems usually report properties of a model, while decisions to deploy concern a configured system: a model together with prompts, tools, permissions, data, safeguards and an operating context. We ask how evidence about technical failures, deployment-control effectiveness and real-world consequences can be connected to defensible authorization decisions throughout the lifecycle of a deployed system. We present R-BED (Risk-Based Evaluability Design), a specification-level methodology with a fixed 6+4+3 architecture of thirteen diagnostic dimensions (technical failure, deployment controls, consequence and impact); a failure-mediated expected-loss identity that is kept separate from intended-behavior and misuse pathways; bounded evidence statuses with independence levels; a control assurance ladder; five authorization dispositions governed by eight rules; and a Continuous System Evaluation (CSE) layer in which evidence carries a configuration pin, an expiry and declared dependencies, so that a change invalidates evidence in proportion rather than wholesale. We work through a synthetic refund-agent walkthrough, with a deterministic script that reproduces every number, to show how a task-success view can miss a consequential control weakness that the procedure identifies as missing evidence. The contribution is a reproducible methodological specification. Most components are standard practice integrated into one evidence-to-decision record; the Evidence Validity Register, the authority envelope and the tier rules are proposals. None has been empirically validated, and we state seven hypotheses for independent testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R-BED方法学规范，将AI系统的技术失效证据、部署控制有效性与真实后果关联为可辩护的授权决策，采用固定的6+4+3十三维诊断架构与持续系统评估层。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估通常报告模型属性，而部署决策针对的是由模型、提示、工具、权限、数据、防护措施与运行环境构成的配置化系统，二者之间存在证据与决策的断裂。
AI.method: R-BED规范级方法：固定的6+4+3共十三个诊断维度（技术失效、部署控制、后果与影响）；与预期行为及误用路径相分离的失效中介期望损失恒等式；有界证据状态与独立性等级；控制保障阶梯；八条规则治理的五类授权处置；CSE层中证据携带配置锚定、有效期与声明依赖，使变更按比例而非整体失效证据。以合成退款代理案例与确定性脚本复现全部数值。
AI.result: 合成案例显示，仅以任务成功率视角评估会遗漏程序识别为"证据缺失"的重大控制弱点；所有数值均可由确定性脚本复现。
AI.conclusion: 贡献为可复现的方法学规范：多数组件是整合进单一"证据—决策"记录的常规实践，证据有效性登记簿、权限包络与分层规则属新提案；未经实证验证，并提出七项待独立检验的假设。

title: STABLE: A Continual Learning Optimizer with Adaptive Drift Control
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Continual learning suffers from catastrophic forgetting, leading to the loss of past knowledge and unstable adaptation across task streams. Existing approaches typically address this issue through replay buffers, architectural changes, or additional regularization terms. We argue that forgetting is a consequence of unstable learning dynamics, which may benefit from an optimizer-level solution. The main challenge is that learning dynamics are time-dependent, as demonstrated by empirical phenomena such as the stability gap. First, we formally prove that, for distance-based classifiers, bounded parameter drift guarantees bounded margin erosion under a local score-stability condition. Based on this insight, we propose STABLE, a primal-dual optimizer with adaptive drift control. STABLE enforces a drift budget by increasing the dual variable when the budget is violated and decreasing it otherwise. This results in high stability without penalizing plasticity. Experiments on long-horizon unimodal streams and CLIP-based multimodal streams show that vanilla PEFT baselines trained with STABLE match or outperform specialized continual learning methods. In the multimodal setting, STABLE further preserves zero-shot transfer, matching or exceeding dedicated multimodal continual learning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出优化器层面的原始-对偶方法STABLE，通过自适应漂移预算控制实现稳定性与可塑性的平衡，缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要依赖回放缓冲区、结构改造或额外正则项；作者认为遗忘本质上是学习动力学不稳定的结果，应从优化器层面解决。核心难点在于学习动力学具有时间依赖性（如稳定性差距现象），需要时变的稳定控制。
AI.method: 首先形式化证明：对基于距离的分类器，在局部分数稳定条件下，有界参数漂移可保证有界间隔侵蚀。据此设计STABLE——一种带自适应漂移控制的原始-对偶优化器：当漂移预算被违反时增大对偶变量，否则减小，从而在不牺牲可塑性的前提下实现高稳定性。
AI.result: 在长时程单模态任务流和基于CLIP的多模态任务流上，使用STABLE训练的朴素PEFT基线达到或超越专用持续学习方法；多模态场景下还能保持零样本迁移能力，媲美或超过专用多模态持续学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘可被视为学习动力学不稳定问题，优化器级的漂移控制是一种通用、无需额外回放或结构改动的有效方案，同时兼顾稳定性、可塑性与零样本迁移。

title: No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?
summary: Pre-training is where every foundation model begins; bringing recursive self-improvement (RSI) there would let AI improve the process that creates AI. Yet public RSI work has so far targeted only post-training, which starts from an existing base model, runs trials costing GPU-hours, and returns verifiable scores. Pre-training breaks all three conditions at orders-of-magnitude higher cost: a run consumes hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours over months and cannot be repeated; its objective, post-training headroom, cannot be read off any single score; and what must improve is not a model but the whole production system, from data pipelines and training infrastructure to the teams that run them. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply RSI to an entire frontier pre-training run from scratch and to report it in detail. RSI does not stop at frontier pre-training, but it changes form: since no end-to-end loop can close over a single unrepeatable run, we decompose it into smaller loops that can, each repairing a step the full run breaks. The result is 801-30B-A3B-Base, a 30B-A3B MoE trained from scratch on 11.8T tokens in three months by a newly formed team. We release it as a base model; the lightweight SFT reported here (6B tokens, no RL) only probes post-training headroom. As a base model, 801-30B-A3B outperforms Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, trailing only the larger Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and keeps this position under identical SFT; with lightweight SFT alone, it achieves the highest average on four agentic benchmarks against fully post-trained models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Since post-training RSI presupposes a strong base model, bringing RSI into pre-training acts on the foundation every later stage builds on. We open-source 801-30B-A3B-Base and the lightweight SFT data at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B .

AI.tldr: 首次将递归自我改进（RSI）应用于完整的前沿预训练流程，通过分解为可闭合的子循环，三个月内从零训练出 30B-A3B MoE 基座模型 801-30B-A3B-Base。
AI.motivation: 现有公开的 RSI 工作仅针对后训练：它有现成基座模型、可用 GPU-小时反复试错、并有可验证分数。预训练三条前提全部失效——成本高出数个量级（数十万 GPU-小时、历时数月、不可重复）、优化目标（后训练余量）无法由单一分数读出、需改进的是整个生产系统（数据流水线、训练基础设施、团队）而非单个模型。
AI.method: 由于端到端闭环无法在单次不可重复的训练上闭合，将 RSI 分解为多个更小、可闭合的循环，每个循环修复完整流程中某个断裂环节（数据管线、训练基础设施、团队协作等），在新型团队组建下从零开始预训练 30B-A3B MoE，规模 11.8T tokens、历时三个月。仅以轻量 SFT（6B tokens、无 RL）探测后训练余量。
AI.result: 作为基座模型，801-30B-A3B 优于 Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，仅落后规模更大的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B；在相同 SFT 条件下保持该排序。仅用轻量 SFT，在四个智能体基准上取得最高平均分，超过包括 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在内的完整后训练模型。
AI.conclusion: RSI 可延伸至前沿预训练，但形态发生变化：由不可闭合的单一端到端循环转为多个可闭合的子循环。由于后训练 RSI 依赖强基座模型，将 RSI 引入预训练即作用于所有后续阶段所依赖的基础。作者开源了 801-30B-A3B-Base 与轻量 SFT 数据。

title: Causal Heteroscedastic Structure Learning From Incomplete Temporal data
summary: Discovering causal structures in multivariate time series (MTS) is critical in domains such as finance and neuroscience, yet remains challenging in practice due to three distinct obstacles. First, MTS are routinely corrupted by missing values, where naive impute-then-discover pipelines distort the underlying data distribution and yield spurious causal graphs. Second, identifying instantaneous effects is difficult even on complete data, and missingness further entangles imputation with graph recovery. Third, real-world data frequently exhibits heteroscedastic noise with variance driven by both instantaneous and lagged causes, violating the core assumptions of standard discovery methods. Existing approaches fail to address these challenges concurrently, typically presuming complete data, homoscedastic noise, or strictly time-lagged relationships. Crucially, we show through ablation studies that resolving these issues sequentially, rather than jointly, leads to a substantial degradation in performance. To overcome this, we introduce Cheesefill, an optimal transport framework for causal structure learning under missingness and heteroscedastic noise. Cheesefill parameterizes causal mechanisms using conditional normalizing flows and jointly learns a stochastic correction map that refines naive imputations into trajectories consistent with the inferred causal mechanisms. Theoretically, we prove that optimizing over stochastic correction maps is equivalent to a conditional kernel reformulation of the Kantorovich problem, from which our neural parameterization yields a tractable objective. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Cheesefill consistently outperforms existing baselines across diverse missingness regimes.

AI.tldr: Cheesefill：基于最优传输的多元时间序列因果发现框架，在缺失值与异方差噪声下联合学习因果机制与插补校正映射，性能优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列因果发现面临三重障碍：缺失值导致"先插补后发现"流程扭曲数据分布并产生虚假因果图；瞬时效应识别困难，缺失进一步使插补与图恢复纠缠；真实数据存在由瞬时与滞后原因共同驱动的异方差噪声，违背标准方法假设。现有方法无法同时应对，且消融表明"顺序解决"而非"联合解决"会显著降低性能。
AI.method: 提出 Cheesefill，一个最优传输框架：用条件归一化流参数化因果机制，并联合学习随机校正映射，将朴素插补精炼为与推断因果机制一致的轨迹。理论上证明在随机校正映射上的优化等价于 Kantorovich 问题的条件核重构，由此神经参数化得到可处理目标。
AI.result: 在合成与真实基准上，跨多种缺失机制下 Cheesefill 一致优于现有基线；消融实验证实联合建模的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 缺失值、瞬时效应与异方差噪声需联合建模而非分步处理；最优传输视角为因果发现与插补的统一提供了有理论保证且实证有效的方案。

title: The Lagrangian Brain: A Constraint Mechanics of Mind and Machine
summary: A brain is in one state at a time, yet most of what decides its next state is absent from it: the patterns its world never produces, the statistics of a lifetime, a goal that lies ahead. In mechanics a wire acts on a bead only through a force that appears when the bead presses on it, and Lagrange computed such forces with one multiplier for each constraint. We propose that a brain follows the same mechanics. Everything a circuit knows, is told or wants is a constraint on its single state and acts through its own multiplier, which accumulates the violation and pushes the state back. Neurons and synapses carry the multipliers, each with its own time constant: inhibitory interneurons carry what never happens, adaptation the cost of staying in one state, synapses the statistics of experience, and feedback to apical dendrites the future. From this hypothesis follow Dale's law, the reciprocal wiring and balance of excitation and inhibition, the paradoxical responses of cortex and the frequencies of brain rhythms. Belief becomes the time one trajectory spends in each state, learning becomes sleep proposing laws and waking refuting the false ones, and planning becomes a wave from the goal meeting a wave from the present. Connectionism and symbolism are the limits of frozen and of instantaneous multipliers, and between them the time a circuit runs becomes the depth of its computation. A machine built on these principles, trained without gradients on 1000 solved puzzles, solves all 422,786 Sudoku-Extreme test puzzles with one trajectory each. It rediscovers the rules of Sudoku by sleeping and waking, plans shortest paths in mazes of 64 times the training area, and tracks permutations exactly on strings 25 times longer than in training, where Transformers fail. A mind, on this view, is life that learns its own constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"大脑即约束力学"假说：电路所知道、被告知或欲求的一切都是对其单一状态的约束，各自通过一个累积违背量并回推状态的乘子起作用；神经元与突触承载这些乘子，并据此推出Dale定律、E/I平衡、皮层悖论反应与脑节律频率，且在Sudoku-Extreme、迷宫与长序列任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 大脑同一时刻只处于一个状态，但决定其下一状态的大部分信息并不在状态内（世界从不产生的模式、毕生统计、未来的目标）。现有连接主义与符号主义各自只是极限情形，缺少一个统一框架解释约束如何"从外部"作用于单一状态，以及信念、学习、规划如何在同一机制下实现。
AI.method: 类比拉格朗日力学：线只通过珠子施压时出现的力作用于珠子，每个约束配一个乘子。假设每个约束（已知、被告知、所欲）通过各自乘子积累违背量并回推状态。神经元与突触作为乘子载体，各具不同时间常数：抑制性中间神经元承载"从未发生之事"，适应承载停留于某状态的成本，突触承载经验统计，至顶树突的反馈承载未来。连接主义对应冻结乘子极限，符号主义对应瞬时乘子极限，二者之间电路运行的时间成为计算深度。构建无梯度的机器，在1000个已解谜题上训练。
AI.result: 该机器以每条轨迹一个解的方式解出全部422,786个Sudoku-Extreme测试谜题；通过"睡眠—觉醒"重新发现数独规则；在面积为训练区64倍的迷宫中规划最短路；在长度为训练25倍的字符串上精确追踪置换，而Transformer在此失败。
AI.conclusion: 从单一约束力学假说可推出Dale定律、交互布线、兴奋—抑制平衡、皮层悖论反应与脑节律频率；信念=轨迹在各状态停留的时间，学习=睡眠提出法则、觉醒反驳虚假法则，规划=来自目标的波与来自当下的波相遇。心智即学会自身约束的生命。

title: Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning using Behavior Regularisation and Latent Feasibility Guidance
summary: Safe offline reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to learn policies that maximize return while satisfying safety constraints, using a static dataset. To characterize state-wise safety, reachability analysis identifies the feasible region, defined as the set of states from which constraints can be satisfied at every future step. Policies are commonly extracted from learned value functions with advantage-weighted regression (AWR). However, AWR relies on exponentiated weights that amplify value estimation errors, whereas behavior-regularized policy gradient methods directly utilize the action gradient of the value function and often make more effective use of learned critics. We propose Feasibility-Optimized Conditional Actor Learning (FOCAL), a method that incorporates behavior-regularized policy gradients into a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) actor. FOCAL optimizes this policy using a first-order objective partitioned by feasibility, updating the actor to increase return on transitions estimated to be feasible and to reduce constraint violations on transitions estimated to be infeasible. During inference, FOCAL dynamically adjusts the scale of the latent prior according to the estimated feasibility of the state to adjust the conservatism of action sampling. Theoretically, we show that for AWR, the policy update variance depends exponentially on the advantage error, whereas for FOCAL it scales linearly with the variance of the value estimation error. Across the DSRL benchmark, FOCAL satisfies the constraints on all evaluated tasks while achieving competitive or higher returns compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 FOCAL，将行为正则化策略梯度引入 CVAE actor，按可行性划分一阶目标，并在推理时依状态可行性调节潜变量先验尺度，理论上将策略更新方差对值误差的依赖从指数级降为线性，在 DSRL 基准上全部任务满足约束且回报具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 安全离线 RL 中常用可达性分析刻画状态级安全（可行区域），但策略提取多依赖 AWR；AWR 的指数权重会放大价值估计误差，而行为正则化策略梯度直接利用价值函数的动作梯度，常能更有效利用学到的 critic。
AI.method: 将行为正则化策略梯度嵌入条件变分自编码器（CVAE）actor；使用按可行性划分的一阶目标更新 actor——在估计为可行的转移上提升回报，在估计为不可行的转移上降低约束违反；推理阶段依据状态可行性动态调节潜变量先验的尺度，以调整动作采样的保守程度。
AI.result: 理论证明：AWR 的策略更新方差随优势误差指数增长，FOCAL 则随值估计误差方差线性增长。在 DSRL 基准上，FOCAL 在所有评估任务中均满足约束，且回报与基线相当或更高。
AI.conclusion: 以行为正则化策略梯度替代 AWR 的指数加权策略提取，并结合可行性感知的目标划分与自适应潜先验，可在提升值误差鲁棒性的同时兼顾安全约束满足与回报表现。

title: Pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke
summary: Stroke is a disorder of the circulation, yet the haemodynamic state that immediately precedes it has rarely been observed, because continuous physiological recordings before a stroke are seldom available. Photoplethysmography (PPG), recorded by every pulse oximeter and by hundreds of millions of wearable devices, captures the peripheral pulse beat by beat, but its morphology is largely discarded. Here we ask whether pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke. Using in-hospital stroke as a natural experiment that provides continuous PPG before physician-adjudicated stroke recognition, we studied intensive-care (MIMIC-III, $n=176$) and emergency-department (MC-MED, $n=154$) cohorts and described each beat with interpretable descriptors of pulse timing, amplitude, contour and variability. At a nominal 360-min horizon, morphology separated pre-recognition from stable windows with $F_1$ scores of 0.941 and 0.989 (sensitivity 0.998 and 0.980), with models transferred unchanged to the second cohort, and outperformed heart rate alone on identical windows. The signature was dominated by systolic crest time and its change from each patient's own baseline, feature attribution was concordant across cohorts (Spearman $ρ=0.865$), and morphology recorded in the first two hours of care stratified the subsequent clinical course ($F_1$ 0.714 and 0.691). In high-risk patients without stroke, 29% and 14% of windows were positive, but five-window persistence rules limited alerts to 17% and 2% of patients. The results demonstrate that the routinely recorded pulse thus carries haemodynamic imprint of the period preceding stroke, positioning pulse morphology as a candidate continuous cerebrovascular biomarker.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用住院期间卒中发生前的连续PPG信号，证明脉搏波形形态学可编码卒中前的血流动力学特征，在MIMIC-III与MC-MED两队列中360分钟时间窗内以高F1识别卒中前窗口，并将其定位为候选的连续脑血管生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 卒中本质是循环障碍，但其发生前即刻的血流动力学状态极少被观察到，因为卒中前缺乏连续生理记录。PPG由脉搏血氧仪和大量可穿戴设备逐搏采集，但波形形态学信息大多被丢弃。作者据此提出：脉搏波形形态是否编码了卒中临近期的血流动力学特征。
AI.method: 以院内卒中作为"自然实验"，提供医生判定卒中识别前的连续PPG。纳入ICU队列（MIMIC-III, n=176）与急诊队列（MC-MED, n=154）。对每一搏提取可解释的描述子，涵盖脉搏时序、幅值、轮廓与变异性。在名义360分钟时间窗上区分卒中前识别窗口与稳定窗口，并将模型不加修改地迁移至第二队列；同时以心率作为基线对照，进行跨队列特征归因一致性分析，并用入组前两小时的形态学对后续临床病程分层。
AI.result: 在360分钟时间窗下，形态学区分卒中前与稳定窗口的F1为0.941与0.989（敏感度0.998与0.980），模型原样迁移至第二队列仍成立，且在相同窗口上优于单用心率。信号特征以收缩期波峰时间及其相对患者自身基线的变化为主导，两队列特征归因高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.865）。入组前两小时形态学可对后续临床病程分层（F1 0.714与0.691）。在无卒中的高危患者中，阳性窗口分别占29%与14%，但五窗口持续性规则将告警限制在17%与2%的患者。
AI.conclusion: 常规记录的脉搏信号携带卒中前时段的血流动力学印记，脉搏形态学可作为候选的连续脑血管生物标志物。

title: A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics
comment: 29 pages Submitted to Proc Roy Soc A
summary: We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

AI.tldr: 该文基于统计物理构建变分与几何理论，刻画固定模型参数下Transformer注意力和token表示的联合演化。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对固定参数下注意力权重与token表示联合演化动力学的统一理论刻画，作者希望借助统计物理的变分与几何工具填补这一空白。
AI.method: 为注意力引入自由能，用Fisher–Rao梯度流建模注意力权重演化；将表示及其动量用Hamiltonian动力学描述，并与同一能量驱动的注意力松弛耦合；另构造两种含value映射的Hamiltonian。
AI.result: 证明固定表示下softmax矩阵是唯一自由能极小点且任意正注意力轨迹收敛于它；时变表示下注意力动力学在对数几率变量变换后线性化，给出相对瞬时softmax的跟踪界与收敛到固定矩阵的充分条件；耦合系统满足能量耗散律；并证明注意力流及三个耦合系统的全局适定性。
AI.conclusion: 作者建立了注意力与表示联合演化的统计物理解析框架，揭示了softmax的最优性、线性化结构、能量耗散与全局适定性。

title: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, including references, appendix, and checklist. Project page: https://sensetime-fvg.github.io/BlenderFORGE/
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents, yet precise, programmatic 3D graphics editing remains difficult to train because existing systems largely rely on closed-source model APIs and lack deterministic, state-verifiable execution environments. We present BlenderFORGE, a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit explicit Blender scenes through Blender Python (bpy) code generation. BlenderFORGE targets four fundamental state-verifiable editing task families: object placement, shape-key editing, lighting adjustment, and material modification. It integrates three components: (1) a scalable perturbation-based data generation pipeline built from curated assets and large-scale 3D scene repositories; (2) an isolated Blender Sandbox for deterministic code execution, structured state export, and closed-loop reward computation; and (3) a two-stage training pipeline that uses offline teacher trajectories for cold-start Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and sandbox-computed rewards for multi-turn tool-agentic Reinforcement Learning (AgentLoop-RL). Experiments across the four task families show that the resulting open-weight Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE agents substantially improve over their base models and achieve competitive performance with several zero-shot proprietary MLLM baselines on selected metrics. Additional cross-benchmark evaluations and camera-reframing experiments provide evidence of transfer beyond the original training setting.

AI.tldr: BlenderFORGE 是一个面向开放权重 MLLM 智能体的"数据-环境-优化"一体化可训练框架，通过 bpy 代码生成完成可状态验证的 Blender 场景编辑，并在四类任务上显著超越基座模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 作为交互式智能体虽具潜力，但精确的程序化 3D 图形编辑难以训练：一方面依赖闭源模型 API，另一方面缺乏确定性、可验证状态的执行环境，导致缺乏可训练的数据与反馈信号。
AI.method: 提出 BlenderFORGE 框架，聚焦四类状态可验证编辑任务（物体摆放、形态键编辑、光照调整、材质修改），包含三个组件：(1) 基于扰动、由精选资产与大规模3D场景库构建的可扩展数据生成流水线；(2) 隔离的 Blender Sandbox，提供确定性代码执行、结构化状态导出与闭环奖励计算；(3) 两阶段训练：先用离线教师轨迹做冷启动 SFT，再用沙箱奖励进行多轮工具智能体强化学习（AgentLoop-RL）。
AI.result: 在四类任务上的实验表明，基于 Qwen3-VL-8B 与 Qwen3.5-9B 的开放权重 BlenderFORGE 智能体较基座模型大幅提升，并在部分指标上与若干零样本闭源 MLLM 基线达到可比水平；跨基准评测与相机重构图实验进一步显示对原始训练设定的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过可扩展数据生成、确定性可验证沙箱与 SFT+AgentLoop-RL 训练流程的结合，开放权重模型可在程序化3D编辑任务上有效训练并具备一定泛化性，为可验证的 MLLM 智能体训练提供了可行范式。

title: Look Ahead: Search-Driven Reasoning in Embodied AI
summary: Search allows a robotic policy to evaluate candidate futures before committing to an action. Motivated by test-time planning for vision-language action (VLA) models, we study selective search over action chunks in PushT using a frozen Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy. Beam search generates perturbed alternatives around the policy prediction and scores them through rollouts from cloned simulator states. Across 50 evaluation episodes, beam search raises task success from 0% to 18% and increases average cumulative reward from 39.44 to 103.2. We introduce One Step Ahead (OSA), a gate that simulates the nominal policy chunk and invokes full search only when its predicted coverage drop exceeds a threshold. In the reported ablations, OSA preserves or improves success while reducing runtime by approximately 3x relative to full beam search. Ablations over tree depth, branching factor, beam width, and replanning frequency show that larger search budgets do not consistently improve performance. The results support selective test-time search for action-chunking policies; evaluation on language-conditioned VLAs and physical robots remains future work.

AI.tldr: 在PushT任务上，对冻结的ACT动作分块策略施加选择性测试时束搜索，可把成功率从0%提升至18%；提出的One Step Ahead（OSA）门控在保持或提升成功率的同时将运行时间缩短约3倍。
AI.motivation: 受视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型测试时规划的启发，希望让机器人在执行动作前通过搜索评估候选未来，以提升动作分块策略在困难任务上的表现，并避免无差别搜索带来的计算开销。
AI.method: 以冻结的ACT策略为基座，在PushT中对动作块做选择性搜索：束搜索在策略预测周围生成扰动候选，并用从克隆仿真状态出发的rollout打分。进一步提出OSA门控——先仿真名义策略块，仅当预测的coverage下降超过阈值时才触发完整搜索。并针对树深、分支因子、束宽、重规划频率进行消融。
AI.result: 50个评估回合中，束搜索将任务成功率由0%提升至18%，平均累计奖励由39.44提升至103.2；OSA在报告消融中保持或提升成功率，运行时间约为完整束搜索的1/3。消融显示更大的搜索预算并不能稳定带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对动作分块策略采用选择性测试时搜索；面向语言条件VLA及真实机器人的评估仍为未来工作。

title: AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Abductive reasoning is the inference of plausible explanations for observed evidence. Evaluating this capability requires more than a single task: a system may need to generate an explanation, discriminate among competing hypotheses, revise its hypotheses as evidence arrives, or decide what evidence to seek next. Yet these capabilities are typically evaluated through isolated benchmarks with different task formulations and scoring procedures, so claims that a model is ``good at abduction'' may reflect only a narrow aspect of this capability. We introduce AbductionBench, a unified framework whose taxonomy characterizes abductive tasks. We instantiate this framework on 27 datasets spanning ten domains and evaluate eight LLMs from four model families evaluated on single-choice selection tasks. Beyond harmonizing heterogeneous tasks, AbductionBench separates final-answer evaluation from analysis of the observable reasoning traces and interaction histories produced alongside those answers. We analyze written traces as observable model outputs rather than faithful representations of internal computation, characterizing evidence use, hypothesis comparison, uncertainty, contradiction handling, and answer commitment. Jev matches or exceeds small LLMs when selecting among explanations over compact evidence but falls substantially behind on longer cases, suggesting that candidate discrimination and extended evidence integration place different demands on a system. In interactive tasks, the proportion of actions judged relevant declines at later steps, and a relevant first question is associated with a correct final answer; in the passive task, models rarely revise their initial hypothesis as new evidence arrives. Together, these findings highlight the value of evaluating abductive reasoning through both final answers and observable evidence use, hypothesis revision, and information gathering.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架 AbductionBench，用同一分类学刻画溯因推理任务，整合27个数据集、十个领域，并对8个LLM在单选任务上同时评估最终答案与可观测的推理痕迹/交互历史。
AI.motivation: 溯因推理包含生成解释、区分竞争假设、随证据修正假设、决定下一步寻求何种证据等多种能力，但现有评测分散在任务形式与评分方式各异的孤立基准上，导致“擅长溯因”的结论可能只反映某一方面。
AI.method: 构建 AbductionBench 统一框架及其任务分类学；在27个数据集（十领域）上实例化，覆盖八种LLM（四个模型家族）的单选任务；将最终答案评测与对伴随输出的可观测推理痕迹和交互历史的分析相分离，把书面痕迹视为可观测输出而非内部计算的忠实反映，刻画证据使用、假设比较、不确定性、矛盾处理与答案承诺等维度。
AI.result: Jev 在紧凑证据下的解释选择上与小模型持平或更优，但在长案例上明显落后，说明候选区分与长程证据整合对系统要求不同；交互任务中，被判为相关的动作比例随步数增加而下降，且首个问题相关与最终答案正确相关联；在被动任务中，模型很少随新证据到达而修正初始假设。
AI.conclusion: 溯因推理评测应同时覆盖最终答案与可观测的证据使用、假设修正和信息获取过程；单一任务上的高分不足以支撑“擅长溯因”的泛化结论。

title: WARP-JEPA: World-Model-in-the-Loop Amortized Rollout Planning for Frozen Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
summary: Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (H-JEPA) enable long-horizon visual control but rely on costly test-time gradient descent for planning. Our analysis reveals that iterative optimization consumes up to 97.7% of episode runtime and that low predicted rollout costs do not necessarily translate into successful control. We further identify a planning-horizon asymmetry between long-horizon top-level composition and short two-step subordinate planning. To address these challenges, we propose WARP-JEPA, a hierarchical amortized planning framework that replaces online gradient optimization with learned multi-candidate trajectory proposers while keeping the world models frozen. WARP-JEPA combines a lightweight world-model-in-the-loop causal Transformer at the top level with parallel residual MLPs at subordinate levels. The proposers are trained using model-based rollout costs and best-of-K behavior cloning, enabling efficient candidate selection without test-time gradient optimization. Across 30 frozen H-JEPA models on four benchmarks, WARP-JEPA achieves 9.6-18.8x faster episode inference on long-horizon tasks (2.9-3.0x on Cube) and improves task success by up to 33.3 percentage points. These results demonstrate that amortized planning can substantially improve both inference efficiency and control performance without retraining the world models. Code is available at https://github.com/hideinsewer/WARP-JEPA.

AI.tldr: 提出WARP-JEPA，用学习到的多候选轨迹提议器替代H-JEPA测试时的在线梯度优化规划，在冻结世界模型下同时提升推理效率与控制性能。
AI.motivation: H-JEPA支持长程视觉控制，但依赖昂贵的测试时梯度下降规划：迭代优化占单回合运行时间最高97.7%，且预测rollout代价低并不必然带来成功控制；同时存在长程顶层组合与短两步下层规划之间的规划视界不对称问题。
AI.method: 分层摊销规划框架：保持世界模型冻结，用学习到的多候选轨迹提议器取代在线梯度优化。顶层采用轻量级、世界模型在环的因果Transformer，下层采用并行残差MLP；提议器以基于模型的rollout代价与best-of-K行为克隆训练，实现无需测试时梯度的候选选择。
AI.result: 在四个基准的30个冻结H-JEPA模型上，长程任务单回合推理加速9.6–18.8倍（Cube上2.9–3.0倍），任务成功率最高提升33.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 摊销式规划可在不重训世界模型的前提下显著提升推理效率与控制表现；低预测代价与真实控制成功的错位、以及规划视界不对称，是值得针对性设计的核心问题。

title: FedSGN: Federated Sparse Grassmann Newton Learning for IoT Anomaly Detection
summary: Anomaly detection plays a critical role in securing the Internet of things (IoT). Although existing federated principal component analysis (PCA) methods can learn the subspace of normal samples without sharing raw data, they often suffer from feature redundancy that may degrade detection performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel and effective federated sparse Grassmann Newton (FedSGN) learning method for IoT anomaly detection. Technically, our FedSGN leverages the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm constraint on the global projection matrix to eliminate redundancy and introduces an orthogonality penalty to preserve the intrinsic structure.
