Moreover, we develop an augmented Lagrangian solver integrated with a semismooth Newton scheme to enable parallel client updates and Grassmann projection for robustness. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable overall detection performance while reducing communication overhead. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/FedSGN

AI.tldr: 提出联邦稀疏Grassmann牛顿学习方法FedSGN，用于IoT异常检测，通过ℓ_{2,0}范数约束消除特征冗余并引入正交惩罚保持结构，配合增广拉格朗日与半光滑牛顿求解器实现并行客户端更新。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦PCA方法虽能在不共享原始数据的前提下学习正常样本子空间，但存在特征冗余问题，会降低异常检测性能。
AI.method: 对全局投影矩阵施加ℓ_{2,0}范数约束以消除冗余，并引入正交惩罚以保持内在结构；设计增广拉格朗日求解器，结合半光滑牛顿方案，支持客户端并行更新与Grassmann投影以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法在取得良好整体检测性能的同时降低了通信开销。
AI.conclusion: FedSGN有效缓解联邦PCA的特征冗余问题，在IoT异常检测中兼顾检测性能与通信效率，代码已开源。

title: ATHENA: Hypergraph-Based Learning for Toddler Autism Classification from Eye-Tracking
summary: In this work we proposed a architecture designed for the classification of ASD in toddlers using eye-tracking data, addressing the critical need for early and precise detection. The proposed model incorporates FMMix, a feature-level augmentation technique that bolsters the model's learning capacity, and in this work we proposed the ATHENA, which captures intricate feature relationships via an adaptive hypergraph framework. Evaluated on two datasets dataset of gaze coordinates-the model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with AUC scores of 99.80% and 99.86%, respectively. It also exhibits high accuracy of 98.45% and 98.56%, sensitivity 98.01% and 98.10%, and specificity 98.74% and 99.02%, respectively. Demonstrating its superior ability to identify subtle gaze patterns associated with ASD, these results significantly surpass existing methods, highlighting the model's potential for clinical ASD screening. Future efforts will focus on validation across broader populations and integration with multi-modal data to further refine diagnostic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出融合FMMix特征级增强与ATHENA自适应超图框架的架构，基于眼动数据实现幼儿ASD分类，在两个数据集上取得AUC 99.80%/99.86%的SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: ASD（自闭症谱系障碍）的早期、精准检测存在迫切临床需求，而幼儿期细微的注视模式难以被现有方法有效捕捉，因此需要更具判别力的模型。
AI.method: 模型包含两个核心组件：FMMix——一种特征级数据增强技术，用于提升模型学习能力；ATHENA——基于自适应超图（hypergraph）框架，用于捕获复杂的高阶特征关系。输入为注视坐标（gaze coordinates）数据。
AI.result: 在两个眼动注视坐标数据集上均达SOTA：AUC 99.80%与99.86%，准确率98.45%与98.56%，敏感度98.01%与98.10%，特异度98.74%与99.02%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 模型能够识别与ASD相关的细微注视模式，具备临床筛查潜力；未来将面向更广泛人群验证并融合多模态数据以进一步提升诊断精度。

title: Breaking Precision Walls in First-, Second-, and Zeroth-Order Optimizers: One Constant, Set in Advance
summary: Under power-law signal decay across directions, an optimizer can fit strong directions and miss weak ones while average loss hides it. A precision wall measures the steepest decay where the weakest direction recovers within 5% in a fixed budget. On low-rank matrix sensing and quadratics one constant sets the wall: once it dominates the denominator, Adam or grafted Shampoo is momentum descent at step $η/c$, setting the wall; in Shampoo, matching grafting's constant to damping restores the wall after three hypotheses failed. In zeroth-order Adam, $\varepsilon$ acts against $\varepsilon^\ast$ from a mean-square spectral model; below $\varepsilon^\ast$ error hits a noise floor. Set from true curvature or spectrum on new shapes, the rule raised the wall above the same-step default by a forecast amount: on two sensing shapes by $1.96, 1.15$ (Adam) and $1.59, 1.74$ (grafted Shampoo), and on two Hadamard-rotated quadratics by $1.12, 0.73$ (zeroth-order Adam, longer budget), rising on all seeds; fixed-step momentum at that step reaches those walls. A cosine-scheduled default (small constant giving weak modes large steps) is higher on one sensing shape, matched on new seeds of the other, and lower with the rule's constant. A default step retuned per budget catches up on rotated quadratics and population logistic regression, fails at 1 query/step on two diagonal quadratics (catching up at 16), and exceeds the rule on digits logistic regression (full-batch and minibatches, where gradient noise sets the $η= 0.01, 0.1$ default walls). On logistic regression the rule did not raise the first-order wall: same-step default Adam was higher (its wall on 4 new shapes at the forecast stability limit), while in zeroth order on the population loss setting $\varepsilon$ raised the wall by $0.98, 0.88$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"精度墙"(precision wall)指标——在固定预算内最弱方向收敛到5%误差所需的最陡衰减率，揭示平均损失掩盖弱方向失效的问题；并给出一个由单一常数设定的墙位置规则。
AI.motivation: 在幂律衰减下，优化器能拟合强方向却漏掉弱方向，而平均损失曲线无法暴露这一点，因此需要一个能刻画最弱方向恢复能力的量化指标。
AI.method: 定义精度墙衡量最陡衰减；在低秩矩阵感知与二次型上，分析发现Adam或嫁接Shampoo等效为步长η/c的动量下降，该常数主导分母时即设定墙；Shampoo中令嫁接常数等于阻尼可恢复墙；零阶Adam中由均方谱模型给出ε*，低于它误差触底噪声地板。规则常数由真实曲率或谱在新形状上设定。
AI.result: 规则将墙较同一步长默认值提升可预测幅度：两种感知形状上Adam提升1.96、1.15，嫁接Shampoo提升1.59、1.74；两种Hadamard旋转二次型上零阶Adam提升1.12、0.73，且所有种子均上升。余弦调度的默认值在一形状更高、另一形状新种子上持平、配合规则常数时更低。默认步长按预算重调在旋转二次型与总体逻辑回归上追平，1 query/step在两个对角二次型上失败（16时追平），在digits逻辑回归上超过规则。逻辑回归上一阶规则未提升墙，同一步长默认Adam更高，而零阶总体损失下ε将墙提升0.98、0.88。
AI.conclusion: 单一常数主导墙位置的机制得到验证，基于曲率/谱设定的常数能按预测提升精度墙，但优势依赖任务与预算，在部分情形被重调默认值或余弦调度追平甚至超越。

title: Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models have had massive leaps in recent years. Yet, when tested on high-level cognitive tasks like pattern completion, abstract logic, and relational reasoning, they still fall short. This limitation stems from the models' lack of ability to find out underlying rules and maintain constant intermediate steps, rather than merely deciding on the correct option. To research these shortcomings, this study analyzes visual reasoning performance throughout a multilingual evaluation framework encompassing the BİLSEM, MM-IQ, Visual Puzzles, and PuzzleVQA datasets. We evaluate various data mixing strategies and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We observed that a correct answer does not always mean the reasoning chain is valid. Because of this, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to assess the quality of reasoning beyond final answer accuracy. Our experimental results reveal that baseline models often exhibit more stable reasoning compared to fine-tuned counterparts. Most importantly, we observe that SFT can lead to model collapse, manifesting as infinite text loops or empty outputs. The study concludes that current VLMs still struggle with abstract visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建多语言视觉推理评测框架（BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA），结合数据混合策略与SFT，并用LLM-as-a-Judge评估推理链质量，发现基线模型推理常比微调模型更稳定，且SFT可能引发模型崩塌（无限文本循环或空输出）。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在高阶认知任务（模式补全、抽象逻辑、关系推理）上表现不足，其根源在于模型缺乏发现底层规则并稳定维持中间推理步骤的能力，而非仅是选项判别；同时仅看最终答案正确率无法反映推理链是否有效。
AI.method: 在BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA四个数据集构成的多语言评测框架下评测视觉推理性能；比较多种数据混合策略与监督微调（SFT）方法；采用LLM-as-a-Judge对推理链质量进行评估，超越最终答案准确率。
AI.result: 正确答案并不总意味着推理链有效；基线模型的推理稳定性往往优于微调后的模型；SFT可能导致模型崩塌，表现为无限文本循环或空输出。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在抽象视觉推理上仍存在明显不足，且SFT并非总能提升推理能力，甚至可能损害推理稳定性；需在评测中同时关注推理过程质量。

title: Spectrogram-Based CNN Autoencoder for One-Class Anomaly Detection in Machining Vibration Signals
summary: This work presents a one-class anomaly detection framework for vibration-based condition monitoring in machining processes using a convolutional neural network autoencoder. Three-axis vibration signals acquired during industrial broaching are transformed into time--frequency spectrograms and combined into a compact three-channel representation, enabling convolutional feature learning on multivariate time-series data. The autoencoder is trained exclusively on normal process data and detects anomalous strokes based on reconstruction errors. Labeled validation data are used for threshold calibration and an independent test set is reserved for final performance evaluation. To improve sensitivity to short-lived process instabilities such as chatter, a localized residual-based metric termed Segmented Vertical Error (SVE) is introduced. Experimental results on approximately 10{,}000 broaching strokes show a clear separation between normal and anomalous process conditions under strong class imbalance. The processing pipeline is additionally evaluated on an external public turning dataset as a proof of concept, indicating preliminary applicability beyond the original broaching setup. The results suggest that spectrogram-based autoencoder models can provide a practical and scalable basis for one-class anomaly detection in industrial vibration monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于卷积自编码器的一类（单类）异常检测框架，将拉削加工三轴振动信号转为时频谱图并组合为三通道输入，仅用正常数据训练，以重构误差检测异常行程，并提出分段垂向误差（SVE）指标提升对颤振等短时失稳的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 加工过程振动监测中异常样本稀缺、类别极不平衡，且颤振等短时失稳在整段重构误差中被稀释，亟需仅依赖正常数据训练且对短时异常敏感的一类检测方法。
AI.method: 采集工业拉削过程三轴振动信号→时频谱图变换并拼接为紧凑三通道表示，实现多变量时序的卷积特征学习；卷积自编码器仅以正常工况数据训练，以重构误差作为异常分数；用有标签验证集校准阈值，独立测试集做最终评估；引入基于局部残差的分段垂向误差（SVE）指标增强对短时不稳定（如颤振）的敏感性。
AI.result: 在约10,000次拉削行程上，强类不平衡条件下正常与异常工况呈现清晰分离；并在外部公开车削数据集上完成概念验证，初步表明方法可迁移至原始拉削设置之外。
AI.conclusion: 基于谱图的自编码器模型可为工业振动监测中的一类异常检测提供实用且可扩展的基础；SVE等局部分段残差指标有助于提升短时异常检测灵敏度。

title: A Gamified Framework for Conflict-Driven Design: Discovering Strategies for Collaborative Resilience with Multi-Agent Learning
comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, 1 table. Author version of a paper published in the proceedings of ACADIA 2025: Computing for Resilience
summary: Conflicting stakeholder objectives make it difficult to coordinate investments in urban resilience. We model conflict-driven urban design as a non-zero-sum digital board game in which stakeholder agents allocate scarce resources and balance individual payoffs against shared urban development and resilience objectives. We use multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train policies and examine their behavior across three settings. On a 4 x 4 board, learned policies reach about 84% of the total return found by a simulated annealing benchmark. On an 8 x 8 board with spatial and resource constraints, trained agents favor projects that improve resilience in self-play. In a 12 x 12 simulation initialized from historical maps of Tatsumi, Tokyo, trained agents achieve a mean total score of 452.1, compared with 357.3 for a random-policy baseline across 10,000 simulation runs. Gains in adaptability, sustainability, flood resistance, and greenery come with reductions in vitality and density. A human-in-the-loop interface supports replay and lets participants take over stakeholder decisions, providing a testbed for exploring these trade-offs in participatory urban planning.

AI.tldr: 本文将城市韧性投资中的利益相关者冲突建模为非零和数字桌游，用多智能体强化学习(MARL)训练策略，在4×4、8×8与基于东京辰巳历史地图的12×12场景中评估，并结合人在回路界面支持参与式规划。
AI.motivation: 城市韧性投资涉及多方利益相关者的目标冲突，难以协调；需要一个可计算、可交互的实验平台来刻画个体收益与共享城市发展与韧性目标之间的权衡。
AI.method: 构建非零和数字桌游环境，智能体为利益相关者，在稀缺资源约束下分配投资并平衡个体与集体目标；采用MARL训练策略；以模拟退火作为基准；设置4×4、8×8（空间与资源约束）及由东京辰巳历史地图初始化的12×12三种规模；辅以人在回路界面支持回放与决策接管。
AI.result: 4×4棋盘上学习策略达到模拟退火基准总回报约84%；8×8自博弈中智能体偏好提升韧性的项目；12×12场景10,000次仿真平均总分452.1，随机策略基线357.3；适应性、可持续性、防洪与绿化提升伴随活力与密度下降。
AI.conclusion: MARL可在冲突驱动的城市设计博弈中习得有效策略并稳定优于随机基线，但接近而非超越优化基准；韧性收益以活力与密度为代价，体现明确权衡；人在回路界面使该方法可作为参与式城市规划的探索性试验平台。

title: AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has driven substantial improvements across a wide range of tasks, but the cost of acquiring preference labels remains the dominant bottleneck in the alignment pipeline. While many recent alignment methods improve sample efficiency through active exploration over candidate responses, they typically query the oracle uniformly across contexts, even for contexts where the learned reward estimates are already reliable enough to provide synthetic labels. We propose Adaptive Ensemble-disagreement Routing for Oracle feedback (AERO), a fully online RLHF algorithm built on a Dyna-style model-based RL architecture, in which an ensemble-based Epistemic Reward Model (ERM) serves both as a reward posterior for exploration and as a learned preference-feedback model for synthetic labeling. AERO uses ensemble vote entropy, a Query-by-Committee disagreement measure, combined with an adaptive thresholding mechanism to decide which contexts require oracle feedback and which can instead receive ERM-based synthetic preference labels, concentrating expensive labels where they are most informative. Empirical results across different model families and scales show that AERO achieves highly competitive alignment performance while reducing the required oracle-query budget compared to online DPO and strong active-exploration baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出全在线RLHF算法AERO，基于Dyna式模型架构，用集成认知奖励模型(ERM)同时提供探索奖励后验与合成偏好标签，通过集成投票熵+自适应阈值路由，把昂贵oracle查询集中到高信息量上下文，显著降低偏好标签预算。
AI.motivation: RLHF对齐的主要瓶颈是偏好标签获取成本高。现有通过主动探索提升样本效率的方法通常对所有上下文均匀地调用oracle，即便某些上下文的奖励估计已足够可靠、可直接生成合成标签，造成标签浪费。
AI.method: AERO为Dyna风格model-based在线RLHF算法：(1)集成式Epistemic Reward Model(ERM)，既作为探索用的奖励后验，又作为学习到的偏好反馈模型用于合成标注；(2)以集成投票熵(Query-by-Committee分歧度量)结合自适应阈值机制，判定哪些上下文需要oracle反馈、哪些可用ERM合成偏好标签，从而将昂贵标签分配到信息量最大的上下文。
AI.result: 在多种模型家族与规模上，AERO取得极具竞争力的对齐性能，同时相较在线DPO和强主动探索基线显著减少所需oracle查询预算。
AI.conclusion: 基于认知不确定性的上下文自适应查询路由可有效缓解偏好标签瓶颈，在保持对齐质量的前提下提升标签效率，为在线RLHF提供可扩展方案。

title: Factor Rank: A Canonical Algebraic Generalization of Tree Decision Diagrams
summary:
Tree decision diagrams (TDDs), recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026), are representations of Boolean functions. They generalize OBDDs by replacing variable orders with vtrees. The width of a TDD counts the distinct subfunctions across each vtree cut. Counting subfunctions is blind to linear structure. We introduce algebraic tree decision diagrams (ATDDs) by replacing this count with the rank of the cut matrix. The maximum of these ranks over all cuts, the factor rank, is exactly the width of the ATDD. Every TDD can be converted into an ATDD of no greater width. An ATDD is a tree tensor network in canonical form. ATDDs are exponentially more succinct than TDDs, and quasi-polynomially more succinct than structured deterministic DNNFs. Our main result is that this gain in succinctness does not cost canonicity. ATDDs are the first strict canonical form for a rank-based representation over arbitrary vtrees. For each function and vtree there is exactly one ATDD, over the rationals and without any genericity assumption. The canonicity admits a local characterization. Whether a tree tensor network is the ATDD of the Boolean function it computes can be checked in polynomial time from its tensors alone. Equivalence checking becomes a test of syntactic equality. The operation set includes polynomial-time model counting, weighted model counting, and a test whether a tree tensor network represents a Boolean function.
  Capelli et al. asked for the complexity of changing the vtree of a TDD and suggested local vtree changes. We answer the question. After a rotation of the vtree at one node, the new ATDD differs from the old one in two tensors only. Vtree change runs in output-polynomial time both for TDDs and for ATDDs.
  We formalize and verify our core results in Lean. We provide a prototype implementation of TDD and ATDD compilers as a first empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出代数树决策图（ATDD）：用割矩阵的秩替代子函数计数，兼得指数级更强简洁性与严格典范性。
AI.motivation: TDD 以 vtree 取代变量序推广 OBDD，但其宽度依赖"子函数计数"，对线性结构不敏感，因而无法压缩含线性结构的函数；同时 Capelli 等人留悬的 vtree 变换复杂度问题未解。
AI.method: 将每个 vtree 割上的子函数计数替换为割矩阵的秩，定义 factor rank 作为 ATDD 宽度；ATDD 即规范形的树张量网络。给出典范形的局部刻画与多项式时间检验算法，并用 Lean 形式化核心结果，另实现 TDD/ATDD 编译器原型。
AI.result: TDD 可转为宽度不增的 ATDD；ATDD 较 TDD 指数级更简洁，较 structured deterministic DNNF 准多项式级更简洁。对任意 vtree 与函数，在有理数域上存在唯一 ATDD，无需一般性假设，是首个基于秩、适用于任意 vtree 的严格典范形；等价性检验归结为语法相等。支持多项式时间（加权）模型计数与"是否表示布尔函数"检验。解答了 vtree 变换复杂度问题：单节点旋转仅改变两个张量，TDD 与 ATDD 的 vtree 变换均为输出多项式时间。
AI.conclusion: 以秩为基础的 ATDD 在提升简洁性的同时保持了严格典范性，统一了表示紧致性与多项式时间等价检验，并为 vtree 变换给出输出多项式算法；理论结果经 Lean 验证并有原型实现佐证。

title: Constrained Look-ahead Guidance for Interference-Aware Flow Editing
summary: Diffusion and flow models enable powerful generative modeling, but controlled editing remains challenging due to the need to balance source fidelity and edit compliance along the generative trajectory. We propose a principled, inversion-free framework for flow-based image editing from a trajectory centric perspective. Rather than relying on inversion or heuristic guidance, we introduce a one-step look-ahead mechanism that evaluates the effect of candidate updates on both edit and fidelity rewards estimated via denoising, and adjusts the current update based on this evaluation. At each step, our method applies reward-driven corrections guided by the look-ahead evaluation under an explicit fidelity constraint, resulting in stable and coherent trajectory evolution. This look-ahead design mitigates gradient interference between edit and fidelity objectives by anticipating their interaction in future states, leading to improved trade-offs. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves stronger semantic edits while better preserving source content compared to existing strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需反演（inversion-free）的轨迹中心式流模型图像编辑框架，通过单步前瞻（one-step look-ahead）评估候选更新对编辑与保真奖励的影响，并进行奖励驱动校正，从而在编辑合规性与源图像保真之间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型生成能力强，但受控编辑困难：需沿生成轨迹平衡源图像保真与编辑合规；现有方法依赖反演或启发式引导，易产生误差累积与目标冲突（梯度干扰）。
AI.method: 从轨迹视角构建无需求反演的编辑框架；引入一步前瞻机制，通过去噪估计候选更新对编辑奖励与保真奖励的效果，并据此调整当前更新；每步在显式保真约束下施加奖励驱动的校正，前瞻设计提前预判两目标在未来状态中的交互，缓解梯度干扰。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有强基线，该方法实现更强的语义编辑，同时更好地保留源内容，且轨迹演化更稳定连贯。
AI.conclusion: 前瞻式奖励校正可在显式保真约束下稳定轨迹，改善编辑—保真权衡，为基于流模型的图像编辑提供无需反演的有效范式。

title: What Broke & Why: Practical Lessons from Reinforcement Learning Post-Training
summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important way to improve how language models reason, solve problems, and use tools. But getting it to work in practice is not always straightforward. Training can fail because a model receives no useful reward, learns to exploit the reward system, stops exploring, or appears to improve when the evaluation itself is misleading.
  In this book, we give a practical introduction to reinforcement learning post-training for language models, focusing on what works, what fails, and why. We begin with the foundations of post-training, explain GRPO and the training loop step by step, and then follow five training programs covering math reasoning, search agents, training stability, mixture-of-experts models, and software engineering tasks. Each program shows the problems encountered, the changes made, and the lessons learned.
  The book also examines what reinforcement learning actually changes inside a model. The remaining chapters provide a practical reference for reward design, evaluation, training tool-using agents, debugging common failures, reproducibility, rollout engines, and hardware. Written for researchers and practitioners working with open models, the book aims to help readers understand how to train models, recognize when something goes wrong, and decide what to try next.

AI.tldr: 该文是一本关于语言模型强化学习后训练（RLVR）的实用指南，从基础、GRPO与训练循环讲起，涵盖数学推理、搜索智能体、训练稳定性、MoE模型与软件工程五个训练案例，并讨论RL在模型内部实际改变的内容，最后给出奖励设计、评估、工具使用智能体、故障调试、可复现性、rollout引擎与硬件的实践参考。
AI.motivation: RLVR已成为提升语言模型推理、问题求解与工具使用能力的重要途径，但实践中常不顺利：模型得不到有效奖励、学会利用奖励漏洞、探索停滞，或出现评估误导导致的"假进步"。
AI.method: 书籍形式的系统实践综述：先介绍后训练基础，逐步讲解GRPO与训练循环；再以五个训练项目为主线，逐一呈现所遇问题、所做修改与所得经验；并分析强化学习在模型内部实际改变了什么。
AI.result: 形成五个可复用的训练案例（数学推理、搜索智能体、训练稳定性、混合专家模型、软件工程任务），并配套提供奖励设计、评估、工具智能体训练、常见故障调试、可复现性、rollout引擎与硬件的实践参考。
AI.conclusion: 面向开放模型的研究者与从业者，帮助读者掌握训练模型的方法、识别出错信号并决定下一步尝试方向。

title: ConwayNet: Interpretability, Activation Coherence, and Noise Resilience via a Game-of-Life-Inspired Lateral Inhibition in Artificial Neural Networks
summary: Deep neural networks achieve universal function approximation by stacking interconnected nonlinearities, but as a consequence they are sensitive to noise and resist mechanistic interpretation. In contrast, the local update rules of cellular automata, such as Conway's Game of Life, give rise to not merely interpretable but programmable dynamics. We explore a bridge between these worlds: a lateral inhibition in neural networks based on continuous Game-of-Life rules that derives inhibitory and excitatory responses from the layer input and blends them into the activation map in a state-conditioned way. The mechanism is differentiable and architecture-agnostic, and its regulation is imposed rather than learned: the rule's parameters are fixed and are not optimised, while the rule's values and derivatives shape training throughout the network. Wired into fully connected, convolutional, wide-residual and graph convolutional networks, it gives rise to several properties. Activation maps become coherent across space, depth and seeds, with coarse structure persisting through depth while fine detail is renewed at every layer. The co-activation graph of the hidden units departs from an Erdős--Rényi random graph: it is laid out on the image and its giant component grows in steps, as in a spatial graph. Networks started from nearly identical initialisations, under label noise, disagree on thirty times fewer test images. Saliency maps rest on the object rather than the background, and resilience to pixel noise not seen in training is substantially improved.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于连续版生命游戏规则的侧抑制机制，将可微、与架构无关、参数固定的元胞自动式动力学嵌入神经网络，使激活图、共激活与鲁棒性呈现可解释的空间结构。
AI.motivation: 深度网络虽具万能逼近能力，却对噪声敏感且难以机理解释；元胞自动机的局部更新规则可产生可编程动力学。作者希望在两者之间搭桥，用固定的局部规则为网络引入可控的正则化与可解释结构。
AI.method: 设计由连续生命游戏规则导出的侧抑制：由层输入推导抑制性与兴奋性响应，以状态条件方式混合进激活图；规则可微、与架构无关，参数固定不训练，仅其取值与导数在训练中塑造网络。机制接入全连接、卷积、宽残差与图卷积网络。
AI.result: 激活图在空间、深度与随机种子上更一致，粗结构贯穿深度而细节逐层更新；隐藏单元共激活图偏离Erdős–Rényi随机图，呈现图像上的空间布局，巨型连通分量呈阶梯式增长；近乎相同初始化、标签噪声下，网络在测试图像上的分歧减少约三十倍；显著图聚焦目标而非背景；对训练中未见的像素噪声的鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 用固定、可微的元胞自动式局部规则约束网络动力学，可在不增加学习参数的前提下统一提升结构一致性、可解释性与噪声鲁棒性，为神经网络与可编程动力学之间提供一条可行桥梁。

title: Inference for Reasoning Models: Practical Lessons from Evaluation and Serving
comment: 217 pages. Book, first edition, version 1.0 (August 2026). Published on Zenodo
summary:
Running a language model involves more than its trained weights. The same model can receive very different benchmark scores, produce different answers, or cost more to serve depending on how it is evaluated and run. In one experiment in this book, changing only the maximum response length moved accuracy on a math benchmark from 0.08% to 93.18%.
  This book explains how inference settings shape the results we report and the systems we deploy. We begin with evaluation, including generation limits, answer extraction, scoring methods, and quantization. We then examine why outputs can change across batches, attention backends, and caching, even when sampling is disabled. The next chapters cover serving performance, including batching, memory capacity, latency, throughput, and cost. We also study structured outputs, tool calls, reasoning budgets, and long-context tasks, showing what these controls and benchmarks do and do not establish.
  The book concludes with practical guidance for recording inference runs, checking evaluations, estimating capacity, and comparing systems fairly. Written for researchers and engineers working with language models, it aims to make inference results easier to understand, reproduce, and trust.

AI.tldr: 本书系统论述推理（inference）配置如何决定LLM的评测结果与部署表现，涵盖评测细节、输出非确定性来源、服务性能指标，以及结构化输出、工具调用、推理预算、长上下文等控制与基准的适用边界。
AI.motivation: 同一个模型在不同推理与评测配置下会得到截然不同的基准分数、输出答案和服务成本，甚至仅改变最大响应长度就能让数学基准准确率从0.08%升至93.18%，说明"模型能力"报告往往混入了推理配置的影响，亟需厘清这些因素的机制与影响。
AI.method: 以实证和机制分析为主线组织全书：先讨论评测环节（生成长度限制、答案抽取、评分方法、量化），再分析批次、注意力后端与缓存等导致的输出变化（即便关闭采样），随后考察批处理、显存容量、时延、吞吐与成本等服务性能，最后研究结构化输出、工具调用、推理预算与长上下文任务的效果与局限。
AI.result: 揭示了推理设置对报告结果的显著影响（如最大生成长度使数学基准准确率从0.08%变为93.18%）；指出即使禁用采样，输出仍会因批次、注意力实现和缓存而改变；并系统梳理了服务性能与各类推理控制手段的实际作用及其不能证明的结论。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁对推理运行进行规范记录、对评测进行核查、对容量进行估计，并在公平条件下比较系统，从而使LLM推理结果更易理解、可复现且可信；面向使用语言模型的研究者与工程师。

title: Universal Approximation by Equivariant Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks with a Bilinear Readout
summary: We prove universal approximation for the bilinear-readout equivariant message-passing network (BREMP), a reference architecture for equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials. Its layers combine equivariant convolutions with affine maps, and its readout forms invariants from products of the equivariant features. We construct a one-layer feature that determines the local environment up to permutations of atoms of the same type. The construction uses spherical harmonic filters of degree no larger than the largest number of neighbors at a common distance from the center. Iterating the construction recovers the environment reachable in as many hops as there are layers, using the same bound on filter degrees at the layer cutoff. The readout approximates every continuous invariant function of the features uniformly on compact sets. Together these give universal approximation of atomic energies at a prescribed physical range using a shorter layer cutoff. We assume that, throughout the admissible class, message passing reaches all neighbors in each physical environment within a common number of layers. Finally, DPA4, an interatomic potential architecture in production use, inherits this result by approximating the BREMP layers constructed in the proof and realizing the bilinear readout.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了双线性读出等变消息传递网络（BREMP）的通用逼近性，并从理论上说明生产用势函数架构DPA4可继承该结果。
AI.motivation: 等变图神经网络原子间势虽广泛使用，但其表达能力缺乏严格的理论保证；需要为参考架构建立通用逼近定理。
AI.method: 构造单层特征，使其在同类原子置换意义下唯一决定局部环境；使用阶数不超过"中心原子同距离邻居最大数目"的球谐滤波；迭代构造以覆盖层数所及的多跳环境；读出网络对特征的所有连续不变量在紧集上一致逼近。
AI.result: 得到在给定物理范围内、以更短层截断实现原子能量通用逼近的结论（假设消息传递在统一层数内覆盖所有邻居）；DPA4通过逼近所构造的BREMP层并实现双线性读出而继承该结论。
AI.conclusion: BREMP具有通用逼近能力，等变消息传递势的表达力得到理论刻画，且结论可推广至实际部署架构。

title: Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion
summary: Natural images are often conjectured to lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. Recent work leverages this to build self-contained pixel-space diffusion models without specialized machinery or pretrained components. A plain Transformer on raw image patches suffices, provided it predicts the clean image rather than the noise and compresses each patch through an aggressive bottleneck. The mixing operator, however, has remained softmax attention, inherited from sequence modeling rather than derived from denoising. For Gaussian noise, the optimal denoiser admits a canonical expansion in polynomial functionals of the observation, the Wiener--Volterra series. We prove that softmax attention, and any normalized mixing rule (including linear attention), cannot realize any polynomial map beyond an affine one. In contrast, Volterra layers realize this class directly and, on a data manifold, achieve approximation rates governed by the manifold dimension rather than the ambient pixel dimension. We therefore propose the architecture these results prescribe; raw image patches passed through a bottleneck embedding, followed by cascaded low-rank Volterra layers, which carry no activation function because each layer is nonlinear in its own right. To our knowledge this is the first pixel-space diffusion architecture whose mixing operators are Volterra layers throughout, with no attention, no convolution, no pretrained components, and no activation function on the residual path. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and $512 \times 512$, the resulting model is competitive with self-contained pixel-space diffusion at matched parameter and FLOP budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出以Volterra层替代softmax注意力的纯像素空间扩散架构，并证明归一化混合规则无法表示非仿射多项式映射。
AI.motivation: 自然图像位于低维流形，近期纯像素空间扩散模型仅用原始图像块上的Transformer即可工作，但其混合算子仍是继承自序列建模的softmax注意力，而非从去噪问题推导而来，缺乏理论依据。
AI.method: 从高斯噪声下最优去噪器的Wiener–Volterra级数展开出发，证明softmax注意力及任何归一化混合规则（含线性注意力）无法实现除仿射外的多项式映射；而Volterra层可直接实现该函数类，且在数据流形上的逼近速率由流形维数而非像素维数决定。据此构造架构：原始图像块经瓶颈嵌入，接级联低秩Volterra层，残差路径上无需激活函数。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256与512×512上，在参数量与FLOPs匹配条件下，该模型与自包含像素空间扩散模型性能相当；为据所知首个全程使用Volterra层作为混合算子、无注意力、无卷积、无预训练组件、残差路径无激活函数的像素空间扩散架构。
AI.conclusion: 去噪理论直接导出混合算子应为Volterra层而非注意力，所得架构在匹配预算下具备竞争力，为像素空间扩散提供了原理驱动的设计范式。

title: EEGFaceSem: An EEG Benchmark with Paired Generative Latents for Semantic Visual Modeling
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Conference page: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/loc/paris/poster/138993 ; Project page: https://EEGFaceSem.github.io/
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used to measure brain activity for brain-computer interface applications for its non-invasive nature and high temporal resolution. However, progress in modeling the neural responses to visual semantics has been limited by a reliance on fixed image collections that lack the fine-grained control needed to isolate fine-grained changes in visual features and their relation to perception. In this work, we present EEGFaceSem, a large-scale dataset pairing high-quality EEG with photorealistic face images synthesized from a generative model. We provide the generative latent vector for each stimulus, enabling research into the continuous mapping between a visual latent space and neural representations. Each participant's brain responses were recorded while they attended to specific semantic features (e.g., smiling, hair color) in a rapid serial visual presentation paradigm. The dataset contains EEG signals from 30 participants, totaling 67,200 time-locked EEG recordings. We present benchmarks for single-trial semantic classification under single-subject, cross-subject, and subject-adapted settings, as well as for cross-subject voting that aggregates per-stimulus predictions across participants. We further demonstrate the dataset's unique utility with two complementary applications: deriving semantic directions in the latent space for brain-supervised image editing, and conditioning a generative model on brain-decoded labels for brain-supervised image generation. Our dataset paves the way for advancing brain-computer interfaces (BCI) for semantic-level visual saliency detection and brain-supervised generative modeling. Our dataset and code are openly released at OSF (https://osf.io/2guk3/) and at HuggingFace https://huggingface.co/datasets/yefllower/EEGFaceSem.

AI.tldr: EEGFaceSem：大规模EEG-生成式人脸图像配对数据集，提供刺激的生成潜向量，支持视觉潜空间与神经表征的连续映射研究，并给出单试次语义分类基准及脑监督图像编辑/生成应用。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG视觉语义建模依赖固定图像集合，缺乏对细粒度视觉特征及其与感知关系的可控操纵，限制了对神经响应的精细建模。
AI.method: 构建EEGFaceSem数据集：用生成模型合成高逼真度人脸图像并保留每个刺激的生成潜向量；30名被试在快速序列视觉呈现（RSVP）范式下关注特定语义特征（如微笑、发色）时记录EEG，共67,200段时间锁定记录。设置单被试、跨被试、被试自适应三种单试次语义分类基准，以及跨被试投票聚合；并开展潜空间语义方向提取（脑监督图像编辑）与以脑解码标签为条件的生成（脑监督图像生成）。
AI.result: 提供30名被试、67,200段EEG的大规模配对数据及完整基准结果；验证了跨被试投票的有效性，并实现脑监督的图像编辑与图像生成两类应用。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为语义级视觉显著性检测的BCI研究及脑监督生成建模提供了新基础，数据与代码已公开（OSF、HuggingFace）。

title: Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity
summary: Much of the automation handed to language-model agents is procedural: each step needs little intelligence, but a long unattended run must follow a skill or SOP stated once at the start. We show that agents drift from such procedures over long runs, and that restating the instructions or resuming a stopped agent only moves the drift to another shortcut. We study an executable finite-state machine (FSM) that keeps the workflow state outside the model's context and enforces it at three points: tool calls, state transitions and the end of the agent's turn. In a pre-registered experiment on 200-account SOP-Bench batches, Claude Haiku 4.5 with the FSM decided on average 139 accounts correctly and by the procedure, against 48 for the strongest baseline (95% CI of the difference [46, 130]), and kept this rate to the end; across three models, the gain tracked how much the plain agent drifted. Because the runtime, not the model, supplies this long-horizon reliability, the FSM can let small models carry procedural work: Haiku 4.5 with it averaged more such decisions than plain Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 38% of the cost. Analyses on SWE-bench Verified, $τ^2$-bench, and staged and cross-context workflows further suggest that reliable long-horizon automation can come from stronger execution control, not only stronger models.

AI.tldr: 论文指出语言模型智能体在长时无人监督运行中会偏离一次性给定的流程性指令，且"重申指令"或"重启智能体"只是把漂移转移到其他捷径；作者提出用外置的可执行有限状态机（FSM）将工作流状态移出模型上下文，并在工具调用、状态转移与回合结束三处强制约束；在预注册实验中显著提升SOP任务正确率并保持到长程末端。
AI.motivation: 大量委托给智能体的自动化是流程性的：单步所需智能不高，但长时无人值守运行必须遵循开头一次性陈述的SOP/技能。现有智能体在长程运行中会偏离这些流程，而重申指令、恢复被中止的智能体等常见补救仅使漂移发生偏移，无法根治。
AI.method: 将工作流状态外置于模型上下文之外，用一个可执行的有限状态机（FSM）在三个检查点实施强制：工具调用、状态转移、智能体回合结束。在预注册实验中使用200账户规模的SOP-Bench批次评估（模型含Claude Haiku 4.5等三个模型），并辅以SWE-bench Verified、τ²-bench以及分阶段与跨上下文工作流的分析。
AI.result: 在SOP-Bench上，Haiku 4.5+FSM平均正确且依流程决策139个账户，最强基线仅为48（差值95% CI [46,130]），且该比率保持至运行末端；三个模型中增益幅度与原始智能体的漂移程度正相关。Haiku 4.5+FSM的平均此类决策数超过原始Sonnet 4.6，而成本仅为其38%。
AI.conclusion: 长程可靠性由运行时而非模型提供：可靠的长期自动化可以来自更强的执行控制而非仅靠更强的模型，从而允许小模型承担流程性工作。

title: Proximal Preference Optimization: A Unified Framework for Stable and Reward-Free Alignment
summary: We introduce a proximal preference optimization framework that unifies the implicit reward formulation of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with the trust-region stability of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Our framework yields two complementary algorithms. P$^2$O (Proximal Preference Optimization) introduces a clipped importance ratio directly into the DPO preference margin, producing a reward-model-free algorithm that supports safe dataset reuse, bounded policy divergence, and monotonic preference improvement guarantees. PKTO (Proximal Kahneman-Tversky Optimization) extends P$^2$O by replacing the DPO margin with KTO's prospect-theoretic utility margins, adding a self-regulating adaptive baseline that tightens the effective trust region as the policy drifts, and an asymmetric weighting that handles imbalanced or asymmetric preference datasets. We provide a unified theoretical analysis, including Kullback Leibler (KL) trust-region bounds, a policy-improvement lower bound, and convergence guarantees under multi-epoch proximal updates. Empirically, P$^2$O and PKTO match or exceed DPO and KTO in alignment quality while maintaining better stability under repeated dataset reuse across multiple LLMs on three preference benchmarks. The code base is available here.

AI.tldr: 提出近端偏好优化框架，将DPO的隐式奖励与PPO的信任域稳定性统一，衍生P²O与PKTO两种算法，兼具无奖励模型、可安全复用数据、有界策略漂移与单调偏好提升保证。
AI.motivation: DPO类方法源自隐式奖励形式，缺乏PPO式信任域约束，在多轮/重复数据复用下易发生策略漂移与训练不稳定；而PPO虽然稳定却依赖显式奖励模型。作者希望融合二者优点。
AI.method: 在DPO偏好margin中直接引入裁剪的重要性比值，得到P²O；再以KTO的前景理论效用margin替换DPO margin，并加入随策略漂移自收紧有效信任域的自调节自适应基线和非对称加权，得到PKTO。理论侧给出KL信任域界、策略改进下界及多轮近端更新下的收敛保证。
AI.result: 在多个LLM、三个偏好基准上，P²O与PKTO的对齐质量持平或优于DPO与KTO，且在重复数据集复用时稳定性更好。
AI.conclusion: 近端约束可作为通用插件嵌入偏好优化目标，在不引入奖励模型的前提下获得PPO级稳定性与可证明的改进保证，适合数据受限、需多次复用偏好数据的对齐场景。

title: Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures (including appendix). Accepted as a Spotlight at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit approximate recall: they retain coarse associations about past events while losing fidelity on specific details. Past research on LLMs has quantified different models' forecasting ability in real-world events using prediction markets, but has not studied how losing said fidelity impacts their forecasting abilities. For example: while an LLM correctly recalls that the answer to: ''Did Anna Sawai win the Best Drama Actress in the 76th Emmy Awards?'' is ''Yes,'' it incorrectly states the event date as September 22 rather than September 15. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric called the Recall Fidelity Score to study how imprecision in internalized knowledge propagates to forecasting capability on future events. On resolved historical markets, we find that higher local recall fidelity around semantically similar past events predicts lower forecasting error on resolved markets, and the same signal predicts smaller distance from open markets prices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Recall Fidelity Score（回忆保真度分数），研究大模型内部化知识的细节不精确性如何传导至对未来事件的预测能力；结果显示，在语义相似历史事件上的局部回忆保真度越高，对已结算市场的预测误差越低，且与开放市场价格的偏离越小。
AI.motivation: LLM具有"近似回忆"特性：保留对过往事件的粗略关联，却在具体细节上失真。既有研究多用预测市场量化模型的预测能力，但尚未考察这种细节保真度的丢失如何影响预测表现。例如模型能正确回忆某演员获得艾美奖剧情类最佳女主角，却将日期错记为9月22日而非9月15日。
AI.method: 提出新指标Recall Fidelity Score，用以刻画模型对语义相似历史事件的局部回忆保真度；随后检验该指标与预测能力之间的关系，在已结算的历史预测市场上评估预测误差，并比较模型给出的概率与开放（未结算）市场价格之间的距离。
AI.result: 在已结算的历史市场上，围绕语义相似过往事件的更高局部回忆保真度可预测更低的预测误差；同一信号也预测模型输出与开放市场价格之间更小的距离。
AI.conclusion: 回忆保真度是预测能力的一个有效前兆指标：内部知识细节的精确程度会传播并影响下游预测表现，为评估与改进LLM预测能力提供了新的量化视角。

title: Generating Diverse and Verified Synthetic Clinical Notes with Labels by Construction
comment: Accepted at the GenAI for Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages including appendix. Code: https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator
summary: Under strict privacy regulations in the clinical domain, de-identification is necessary to enable the use of clinical data such as for natural language processing. However, we currently lack sophisticated ways to tell which de-identification models actually are suitable. Specifically, we need benchmarks that are challenging, diverse, and clinically plausible, all while ensuring label correctness. To this end, we present SPARCLING, an LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic discharge letters with character-exact PHI span annotations. Our pipeline combines structured attribute sampling, template generation, and red teaming to obtain diverse PHI-labeled discharge letters. In our experiments, we demonstrate this superior content diversity over existing public datasets. Further, we show SPARCLING's downstream utility as a benchmark to uncover failure modes of de-identifiers in the German clinical domain. Finally, our experiments show that training on our synthetic data can yield more capable de-identifiers than training on the scarce public data alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的合成出院小结生成流水线SPARCLING，可产出带字符级精确PHI标注的多样化合成数据，用于评估与训练德语临床去标识模型。
AI.motivation: 临床领域受严格隐私法规约束，去标识化是释放临床数据（如NLP）价值的前提；但现有工作缺乏能够判断去标识模型是否真正适用的基准，理想基准应兼具挑战性、多样性、临床合理性与标签正确性，而公开数据稀缺且标注质量难以保证。
AI.method: SPARCLING以LLM为核心流水线：结构化属性采样（控制PHI类型与分布）＋模板生成＋红队测试（提升难度与覆盖），生成合成出院小结并给出字符级精确的PHI span标注。
AI.result: 实验显示合成数据在内容多样性上优于现有公开数据集；作为基准可暴露德语临床去标识器的失效模式；在合成数据上训练可获得比仅用稀缺公开数据训练更强的去标识器。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的可控合成数据生成可同时解决临床去标识基准的多样性、难度与标签正确性问题，并可作为稀缺真实数据的有效补充用于模型训练。

title: Complementarity without ground truth?
summary: Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.

AI.tldr: 本文将"人-AI互补性"从预测任务扩展到无真值参照的决策支持场景：以依赖情境的"充分性标签"替代真值标签，采用受多准则决策分析启发的两步评分法构造参照，并借助计算可靠论识别支撑其构造的技术、科学与社会因素。
AI.motivation: 现有人-AI互补性研究依赖由参照构造程序生成的真值标签，但许多真实人机交互（如医疗AI给出治疗建议）并非"预测何者为真"，其输出关乎相对实践目标的充分性，取决于多个评价维度，真值并非恰当参照。因此需要考察互补性对真值的依赖，并将其推广到非预测任务。
AI.method: 论证非预测任务仍可存在生成"充分性标签"的参照构造程序；提出扩展路径：用依赖情境的充分性标签取代真值标签，采用借鉴医疗领域多准则决策分析的"两步评分"方法生成标签，并显式化参照构造背后的规范性选择；再以计算可靠论为方法论灵感，识别支持标签构造的技术、科学与社会因素。
AI.result: 建立了一条将人-AI互补性推广至非预测任务的可行路径，使充分性标签的构造过程及其评价性选择透明可查，并明确了保障标签质量的多维支撑因素。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将人-AI互补性的实证研究拓展至预测任务之外，使真值不构成恰当评价参照的决策支持场景也能进行定量评估。

title: Zeroth-Order Riemannian Optimization on Fixed-Rank Manifolds for LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization estimates descent directions from function values alone, which removes the activation storage required by backpropagation and makes it attractive for memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). Existing low-rank ZO methods either parameterize the additive update through Euclidean factors with a non-unique representation, or restrict each finite-difference direction to be low-rank. In this work, we propose to constrain each additive update block to a fixed-rank matrix manifold while keeping the pretrained weights frozen, so the learned update remains rank-constrained throughout fine-tuning. On this geometry, we build a Riemannian ZO gradient estimator that projects a random matrix onto the tangent space, normalizes it to correct the scale mismatch induced by projection, and further propose Zeroth-order Riemannian Gradient Descent (ZO-RGD) and its smoothed variant, ZO-RGD-S. We show that the ambient finite difference matches its retracted counterpart, the normalized estimator recovers the Riemannian gradient in expectation, and ZO-RGD converges under trajectory-regularity conditions. Experiments on LLM fine-tuning tasks show that the proposed algorithms are competitive with strong forward-only baselines across model families and tasks, with gains in several settings.

AI.tldr: 提出固定秩矩阵流形上的黎曼零阶优化方法 ZO-RGD/ZO-RGD-S，使更新全程保持秩约束，并用于大模型内存高效微调。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩零阶方法存在两类问题：一是在欧氏因子空间中参数化加性更新，表示不唯一；二是将每个有限差分方向限制为低秩。二者都未能保证学习到的更新在整个微调过程中始终是秩受限的。
AI.method: 冻结预训练权重，将加性更新块约束在固定秩矩阵流形上。在该几何上构造黎曼零阶梯度估计器：将随机矩阵投影到切空间，并做归一化以校正投影带来的尺度失配；据此给出零阶黎曼梯度下降 ZO-RGD 及其平滑变体 ZO-RGD-S。
AI.result: 理论方面：证明环境有限差分与回缩后的对应量一致；归一化估计器在期望意义下恢复黎曼梯度；ZO-RGD 在轨迹正则条件下收敛。实验方面：在跨模型族、跨任务的 LLM 微调中，所提算法与强前向基线的表现相当，并在若干设置下取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 将低秩零阶微调表述为固定秩流形上的黎曼优化，可在保持全程秩约束的同时兼顾内存效率与性能，是低秩零阶微调的一种有效重构。

title: How Short Is Too Short? Length-Conditional Calibration and Abstention for Detecting AI-Generated Text
summary: Detectors of AI-generated text are usually tuned and tested on passages of several hundred tokens, yet many real cases are short. We study score-based detection as a function of passage length. We give a closed form for how the false-positive rate of a threshold set on long text changes as length falls, and a formula for the number of tokens a detector needs to reach a target true-positive rate. We calibrate thresholds within length bins with conformal p-values, and we add a bin-level rule that abstains when the detector cannot be informative at that length. On synthetic scores the formulas agree with simulation, and binned calibration holds the false-positive rate at its nominal value at every length. On three zero-shot detectors (log-likelihood, log-rank, Binoculars), three corpora and two open-weight generators, binned calibration gives a mean false-positive rate of 5.0% in every detector-length cell from 10 to 200 tokens, averaged over 300 random document-level resplits. A single threshold set at 200 tokens gives 29% for Binoculars at 10 tokens and about 1% for log-likelihood, as the closed form predicts. No detector reaches an 80% true-positive rate, and the best, Binoculars at 200 tokens, reaches 59%, so the rule abstains in every cell at that floor and releases only the 200-token bins at floors of 0.3 and 0.5.

AI.tldr: 该论文将AI文本检测视为文本长度的函数，给出假阳性率随长度缩短变化的闭式解与达到目标真阳性率所需token数的公式，并用基于conformal p值的分箱校准与弃权规则，使各长度上的假阳性率稳定在名义水平。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测器通常只在数百token的段落上调参与测试，而现实中的许多案例是短文本；直接沿用长文本阈值会导致短文本上假阳性率严重失真，因此需要研究基于分数的检测性能如何随段落长度变化，并对短文本给出可靠的校准与决策机制。
AI.method: 把基于分数的检测看作段落长度的函数：推导长文本阈值下假阳性率随长度下降而变化的闭式表达式，以及达到目标真阳性率所需token数的公式；在长度分箱内用conformal p值校准阈值；并加入分箱级规则，当某长度下检测器无法提供有效信息时弃权。
AI.result: 在合成分数上，公式与仿真一致，分箱校准在各长度均使假阳性率保持在名义值。在三种零样本检测器（log-likelihood、log-rank、Binoculars）、三个语料与两个开源权重生成器上，分箱校准在10至200 token的每个检测器-长度单元中平均假阳性率为5.0%（300次随机文档级重划分平均）；而单一200 token阈值使Binoculars在10 token时达29%、log-likelihood约1%，与闭式解预测一致。没有检测器达到80%真阳性率，最佳者Binoculars在200 token为59%，故该门槛下所有单元均弃权，仅在0.3和0.5门槛下放出200 token分箱。
AI.conclusion: 检测性能强烈依赖文本长度，阈值必须按长度校准；所提闭式公式能准确预测长度效应，而分箱conformal校准可将假阳性率稳定在名义水平；同时现有零样本检测器在短文本上真阳性率不足，需通过弃权规则避免过度自信的判定。

title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Internal Computation for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Iterative neural policies usually spend the same computation on every decision, although the benefit of additional processing varies across states. We introduce Adaptive Internal Computation (AIC), an iterative policy that learns when to stop refining its latent representation and act. In AIC, we train action selection and stopping jointly, an expected-depth penalty values computation and intermediate value predictions provide auxiliary supervision. We show that when only some states benefit from further refinement, an ideal state-dependent allocator outperforms every state-independent stopping schedule at the same expected depth. With at most eight refinement steps per decision, AIC executes 3.3 steps on average across twelve benchmark tasks and lowers per-decision latency by 31--44% relative to a fixed eight-step policy on four control and robotics tasks. Its mean reward exceeds the best fixed-depth policy on seven tasks and trails it on four. Ablating adaptive stopping and value supervision separately shows that stopping accounts for most of the reward gain on PickCube and AntMaze, where it also executes more refinement steps and that supervision accounts for most of it on RareEvent.

AI.tldr: 提出Adaptive Internal Computation (AIC)：一种可学习何时停止潜在表征迭代精化的迭代策略，联合训练动作选择与停止决策，以期望深度惩罚和中间价值预测作辅助监督；平均3.3步（上限8步），延迟降低31–44%。
AI.motivation: 迭代式神经策略对每个决策分配相同计算量，但额外处理带来的收益随状态而异，存在计算冗余。理论上，当仅部分状态受益于进一步精化时，状态相关分配器在同期望深度下优于任何状态无关的停止调度。
AI.method: 将动作选择与停止决策联合训练；引入期望深度惩罚以计价计算开销；使用中间价值预测提供辅助监督；策略在每步迭代中自适应决定是否停止精化潜在表征并输出动作（最多8步）。
AI.result: 十二个基准任务上平均执行3.3步；在四个控制与机器人任务上相较固定8步策略延迟降低31–44%；平均回报在7个任务上超过最佳固定深度策略、4个任务上略低；消融显示PickCube与AntMaze的收益主要来自自适应停止（且执行更多精化步），RareEvent的收益主要来自价值监督。
AI.conclusion: 状态相关的计算分配可在保持甚至提升性能的同时显著降低推理延迟；停止机制与辅助监督的贡献具有任务依赖性，需分别设计。

title: Learning Biological Hierarchies in Single-Cell Foundation Models
summary: Cell types are organized by taxonomic relationships that define lineages in the so-called cell ontology. However, most existing foundation models typically ignore cell-type lineages encoded in this cell ontology. We introduce a biologically informed foundation model called scOntoFM, which embeds hierarchical cell ontology into representation learning. Using Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) distances from the ontology graph, our framework pairs efficient offline triplet sampling with hierarchical cell-ontology learning. This approach jointly preserves local neighborhoods and shapes the global embedding geometry to reflect the ontology structure. Across diverse cell- and gene-level benchmarks, the model consistently improves performance, with especially strong gains in zero-shot settings. Our model also balances batch integration with biological structure preservation, providing complementary perspectives to existing embedding evaluation frameworks and supporting scalable biological discovery.

AI.tldr: scOntoFM 将细胞本体（cell ontology）的层次结构嵌入表示学习，通过 LCA 距离进行离线三元组采样，联合保持局部近邻与全局嵌入几何，在多层级基准和零样本任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有细胞基础模型普遍忽略细胞本体中编码的细胞类型谱系（taxonomic/lineage）关系，导致表示缺乏生物学层次结构信息。
AI.method: 提出生物学先验的基础模型 scOntoFM：从本体图计算 Lowest Common Ancestor（LCA）距离，结合高效的离线三元组采样与层次化细胞本体学习，在嵌入空间中同时保持局部邻域并塑造反映本体结构的全局几何。
AI.result: 在多样的细胞级与基因级基准上性能持续提升，零样本（zero-shot）场景增益尤为显著；同时兼顾批次整合（batch integration）与生物结构保持。
AI.conclusion: 将层次化细胞本体嵌入表示学习可为现有嵌入评估框架提供互补视角，并支撑可扩展的生物学发现。

title: Representing Tensors as Compositions for Efficient Computation on Sparse and Structured Data
summary: We propose a new mathematical formalism in which all kinds of tensors and of operations on those tensors are represented as simple function compositions. Tensors are functions from indices to values. An element-wise operation (e.g. an activation function) is a composition with a function applied to values; re-indexing (e.g. reshape, transposition) is a composition with a function applied to indices; and a reduction is a composition with both an index function, mapping each index to several indices, and a reduction operation (e.g. product, sum, max). Combined with tensor stacking, these compositions can represent most interesting kinds of tensors (e.g. dense, jagged, all kinds of sparsity patterns, matrix factorizations), as well as lazy versions of almost every operation available in modern tensor computation frameworks, including einsums between tensors of any kind. Identities between compositions can then be used to rewrite such expressions into equivalent ones, without evaluating them. For instance, the product of two sparse matrices can be rewritten so that only products between non-zero values are computed, turning a sparse problem into a dense one. Using this algebra as the intermediate representation of a tensor computation engine would shift the focus from defining operations on tensors (e.g. einsum between sparse tensors) to defining an algebra on index functions. This should reduce the codebase complexity from $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$, with $m$ the number of binary operations between tensors and $n$ the number of tensor types, to $\mathcal{O}(m + k^2)$, with $k$ the number of types of index functions. A draft implementation of a tensor computation framework based on this algebra is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种将各类张量及其运算统一表示为简单函数复合的数学形式化方法，可支持稠密、稀疏、锯齿等多种张量及惰性运算，并借此实现无需求值的表达式重写，从而降低张量计算引擎的代码复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现代张量计算框架中，二元运算与张量类型的组合导致实现复杂度呈 O(mn²)，需为每类张量（稠密、稀疏、锯齿等）单独定义各种运算（如 einsum）。作者希望找到一种统一表示，将关注点从"张量上的运算"转移到"索引函数上的代数"，以简化代码库。
AI.method: 提出以函数复合为核心的形式化：张量视为从索引到值的函数；逐元素运算视为值与函数复合；重索引（reshape、转置）视为索引与函数复合；归约视为索引函数（将每个索引映射为多个索引）与归约算子（product、sum、max）的复合。结合张量堆叠（stacking），可表示稠密、锯齿、各类稀疏模式、矩阵分解等张量，以及现代框架中几乎所有运算的惰性版本，包括任意张量间的 einsum。
AI.result: 复合之间的恒等式可用于在不求值的情况下重写表达式。例如两个稀疏矩阵的乘积可被重写为仅对非零值计算乘积，从而把稀疏问题转化为稠密问题。采用该代数作为中间表示后，代码库复杂度由 O(mn²)（m 为张量间二元运算数，n 为张量类型数）降至 O(m + k²)（k 为索引函数类型数）。作者已公开该框架的草案实现。
AI.conclusion: 以函数复合代数作为张量计算引擎的中间表示，可将实现重点集中于索引函数代数而非逐类张量的运算定义，显著降低代码复杂度，并支持统一的惰性运算与表达式重写。

title: But It Was True When I Checked: Compiling SHOP-Style Method Preconditions into Partially-Ordered HTN Planning
summary: Method preconditions specify when a method may be applied in hierarchical task network (HTN) planning, but their meaning differs under two established semantics. The SHOP planners, like the classical HTN formalism of Erol, Hendler and Nau, require the precondition to hold immediately before the method's first action. HDDL, the input language of the International Planning Competition's HTN track, instead introduces an auxiliary action to check it; under partial order, unrelated actions may invalidate the precondition before the method starts. HDDL's designers adopted this weaker semantics because the first-action reading could not easily be compiled. Subsequent work has repeatedly identified its compilation under partial order as an open question, with existing transformations limited to total order. We give a compilation of the first-action semantics into standard partially ordered HTN planning without method preconditions using only two additional facts, thereby resolving a longstanding question in the HTN planning community.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了将HTN规划中"首动作语义"（方法前提须在方法第一个动作前成立）编译为标准偏序HTN规划的变换，仅引入两个额外事实，解决了长期悬而未决的问题。
AI.motivation: 方法前提在两种既有语义下含义不同：SHOP与Erol-Hendler-Nau经典HTN要求前提在方法首动作执行前即刻成立；而HDDL（IPC HTN赛道输入语言）通过引入辅助动作检查前提，在偏序下无关动作可能在方法真正开始前使前提失效。HDDL设计者采用这一较弱语义，是因为首动作语义难以编译；后续研究多次指出其在偏序下的编译是开放问题，已有变换仅限全序。
AI.method: 提出一种编译方法，将首动作语义下的HTN规划问题转换为不含方法前提的标准偏序HTN规划问题，编译过程仅引入两个额外事实，无需辅助动作或其它复杂结构。
AI.result: 成功实现首动作语义到标准偏序HTN规划（无方法前提）的编译，仅需两个额外事实，突破了此前只支持全序的局限。
AI.conclusion: 该编译回答了HTN规划社区长期存在的开放问题，表明首动作语义在偏序下可被简洁地归约到标准形式，为统一两种语义及HDDL语义的后续处理提供了基础。

title: Self-contained Data Cleaning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
summary: Training datasets for unsupervised anomaly detection are often assumed to be anomaly-free, but in practice, they frequently contain malicious or anomalous contamination. This contamination severely degrades the dependability and security of downstream detection models. While some contamination-robust methods exist, they rarely generalize across different model architectures and typically rely on a priori knowledge of the contamination ratio\textemdash information that is rarely available in real-world security operations. In this paper, we propose a novel, self-contained preprocessing framework for anomaly detection that identifies and removes training set contamination without relying on known contamination ratios. Our approach performs a dynamic analysis of the cosine similarity between each data point and its reconstruction during the early training stages of an auto-encoder, mapping points into a dynamic space where anomalous regions naturally exhibit lower density. By executing ``hard cleaning''\textemdash removing all identified anomalous candidates from the training pool\textemdash we systematically improve data quality. Because this cleaning occurs at the data level, the security and reliability improvements generalize seamlessly across various downstream anomaly detection architectures. Evaluating our framework across 8 distinct models and 10 security-relevant datasets, our approach achieves up to 100\% contamination reduction, yielding average improvements of 11.2\% in F1 score and 7.3\% in classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自包含的预处理框架，利用自编码器早期训练阶段的余弦相似度动态分析识别并"硬清洗"训练集中的污染样本，无需已知污染比例，且清洗在数据层面完成，可跨多种检测架构泛化。
AI.motivation: 无监督异常检测的训练集常被假设为无异常，但实际含恶意或异常污染，严重削弱下游模型的可靠性与安全性；已有鲁棒方法难以跨架构泛化，且依赖现实中难得的前验污染比例知识。
AI.method: 在自编码器训练早期，动态分析每个数据点与其重构之间的余弦相似度，将样本映射到动态空间，使异常区域呈现较低密度；据此识别异常候选并执行"硬清洗"，将其全部从训练池中移除，从而提升数据质量。
AI.result: 在8种模型与10个安全相关数据集上评估，污染削减最高达100%，F1平均提升11.2%，分类准确率平均提升7.3%。
AI.conclusion: 数据层清洗可无缝泛化到多种下游异常检测架构，在未知污染比例条件下有效提升训练数据质量与检测性能。

title: GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine
summary: Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

AI.tldr: GARP是一个在Godot引擎内实现实时生成式智能体的平台，其完整"规划—记忆—反思+情感+需求+关系"循环可在本地用3B开源模型运行，无需云端；九场景评估中27次运行有25次通过日志检查。
AI.motivation: 原始Generative Agents依赖云端推理与定制模拟环境，难以在本地实时游戏中使用；作者希望让生成式智能体在主流游戏引擎Godot中实时运行、完全本地化，并具备更丰富的角色内部状态（情感、人格、需求、关系）。
AI.method: 提出GARP平台及Character Behavior System：(1) LLM驱动的规划、记忆、反思；(2) 基于LLM appraisal的情感系统；(3) 由Big Five派生的四个分级人格轴，同时决定模拟参数与提示词；(4) 六个紧迫度随时间增长的needs；(5) 每次对话后更新的成对关系；(6) 从50+候选动作收窄到通常3-8个，JSON schema约束输出，决策提示中呈现重要记忆；(7) 分层优化：可调游戏时钟、提前决策、多层缓存、提示压缩、全异步执行。
AI.result: 完整循环在本地3B开源权重模型上实时运行，无云服务；九场景评估中27次运行有25次通过基于日志的检查，两次失败均出现在生日派对场景（一位客人未将事件写入当日计划）。
AI.conclusion: 本地、实时的生成式智能体在游戏引擎中具备可行性，但高层计划的记忆写入/维护（如日程中包含关键事件）仍是可靠性薄弱环节。

title: Structurally Separated DAG Learning with Multi-Scale Normalized Closure
summary: Continuous DAG learning commonly enforces acyclicity through scalar functions of a weighted adjacency that aggregate evidence from weighted closed walks. We add a complementary layer: matrix-valued closure logits---explicit multi-hop structural relation scores for each ordered pair---supervised alongside data fit, sparsity, and a DAGMA-style barrier on the weighted adjacency. The distinction is not scalarization of the overall objective but how path evidence is represented and exposed before aggregation. SMNC (scale-normalized multi-scale closure) builds these scores on a structural gate by repeated squaring in log space and divides each scale by its path-length budget, counteracting product-style attenuation along long cycles; diagonal entries support node-wise cycle supervision and off-diagonals optional pairwise reachability cues. In the linear model, a bounded structure--magnitude factorization ties strong effective edges to strong gates; a nonlinear induced gate offers another construction with the same intent. For sufficiently strong cycles, normalized logits admit a length-independent lower bound; under a unique-active-cycle assumption, the hard final-scale readout yields a polynomial log-gate gradient factor rather than exponential product-style decay. On cue-free, unstandardized Gaussian linear and nonlinear ER benchmarks, these models improve over DAGMA, run with default hyperparameters at a reduced budget, on denser graphs and are close to it on sparse ones.

AI.tldr: 提出SMNC（尺度归一化多尺度闭包），将多跳结构关系以矩阵值闭包logits显式表示并监督，替代仅靠标量无环约束的做法，在稠密图上优于DAGMA。
AI.motivation: 连续DAG学习通常只通过加权邻接矩阵的标量函数（聚合加权闭游走证据）施加无环约束，路径证据在聚合前如何被表示与暴露未被显式建模；且乘积式路径证据沿长环衰减严重，导致对稠密图长环的监督信号弱。
AI.method: 在数据拟合、稀疏性与DAGMA-style加权邻接barrier之外，增加矩阵值闭包logits作为互补监督层：SMNC在结构门（structural gate）上于log空间重复平方构造多尺度多跳得分，并按路径长度预算对每个尺度归一化，以抵消乘积式衰减；对角元用于节点级环监督，非对角元提供可选的两两可达性线索。线性模型采用有界结构—幅值分解，使强有效边对应强门；非线性情形给出同构想的诱导门构造。
AI.result: 对足够强的环，归一化logits具有与长度无关的下界；在唯一活跃环假设下，最终尺度硬读出给出多项式级log-gate梯度因子而非指数式乘积衰减。在无cue、未标准化高斯线性与非线性ER基准上，以默认超参数、缩减预算运行，模型在较稠密图上优于DAGMA，在稀疏图上与之接近。
AI.conclusion: 将路径证据以矩阵值闭包logits形式显式暴露并监督，可作为标量无环约束的有效补充，缓解长环梯度衰减并改善稠密图上的DAG结构学习。

title: When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets
summary: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"专家合并"中基模型相对增益的可组合性，提出以严格联合成功率与最差任务增益衡量的专家对选择形式化，并给出带质量约束的谱选择框架，实验证明其优于Top-1平均及质量/余弦基线。
AI.motivation: 共享检查点附近的随机扰动可产生不同任务的专家，但同源并不能保证各专家增益在组合后仍保留；仅凭参数接近性或正交性不足以判别可组合的专家对，需专门的选择准则。
AI.method: 将专家对选择形式化为联合基相对保留问题，以严格联合成功和考虑无条件弃权的最差任务增益为指标；用精确有限差分分解与任意小的正交反例说明邻近性/正交性不充分；实例化为固定预算的"质量约束谱选择"框架，包含跨任务筛选、逐层成对几何、独立验证与Base回退。
AI.result: 在6个检查点、21个任务对、5个独立扰动池上，该方法全程优于Top-1平均；≥1.5B的五个模型上，质量约束、全局余弦与谱排序联合成功率分别为49.1%、50.5%、53.1%，谱选择器最差任务增益与Weak Pareto率最高、回归率最低；平均最差任务增益+0.61个百分点，回归率17.1%、弃权率13.0%。
AI.conclusion: 谱选择在匹配协议下同时提升联合成功与鲁棒性指标，但可组合性仍是有条件的，尚非普适保证。

title: SWXAI: A Unified Multimodal Explainability Library for Space Weather Forecasting and Heliophysics
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Resource Track), Rome, Italy, November 7-11, 2026. Code: https://bitbucket.org/gsudmlab/swxai Docs: https://swxai.readthedocs.io
summary: Space weather forecasting and heliophysics increasingly rely on machine learning models that process heterogeneous inputs such as multi-viewpoint multi-wavelength solar images and rasters, multivariate time series, spatial annotations, and tabular event-level data. However, explainability workflows remain fragmented across libraries, model interfaces, and output formats, limiting reuse and reproducibility. We present SWXAI, an open-source library that unifies explainable AI (XAI) workflows for image, time-series, and tabular data in space weather forecasting and heliophysics. SWXAI provides a common, extensible interface across commonly used vision, time-series, and tabular learning models, with validation, adaptation, and persistent explanation objects. It also includes domain-grounded examples, reproducible notebooks, tests, and documentation, enabling users to inspect outputs, swap models or explainers, and extend workflows to new heliophysics datasets. SWXAI reduces modality-specific engineering overhead and supports comparable, reusable explanations across heterogeneous scientific machine learning pipelines. A benchmark against direct backend implementations shows that SWXAI substantially reduces the code users write to produce an explanation, with no practical runtime cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWXAI，一个面向空间天气预报与日球物理的开源可解释AI（XAI）库，统一了图像、时间序列和表格数据的解释工作流，并与直接调用后端实现的方案进行了基准对比。
AI.motivation: 空间天气与日球物理的机器学习模型需处理多视角多波段太阳图像、栅格、多变量时间序列、空间标注和事件级表格等异构输入；但现有XAI工作流分散于不同库、模型接口和输出格式之间，导致解释结果难以复用与复现，且需承担大量模态相关的工程开销。
AI.method: SWXAI提供跨常用视觉、时间序列和表格学习模型的统一且可扩展接口，集成输入/解释结果验证、模型适配以及可持久化的解释对象；同时提供领域相关的示例、可复现notebook、测试与文档，支持用户检查输出、替换模型或解释器，并将工作流扩展到新的日球物理数据集。作者设计了与直接后端实现的基准对比实验，以代码量与运行时开销为指标进行评估。
AI.result: 基准测试表明，SWXAI显著减少了用户为生成解释所需编写的代码量，且没有带来实际的运行时开销（no practical runtime cost）。
AI.conclusion: SWXAI降低了模态特定工程的负担，支持在异构科学机器学习流水线中获得可比、可复用的解释，为空间天气与日球物理领域的可解释性研究提供了统一、可扩展的开源基础设施。

title: When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted by the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
summary: We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two <=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

AI.tldr: 在小模型、紧算力预算下，固定样本预算的自一致（SC）常被过度调用；本文用「oracle 门控」给出上界（用23-30%算力达109-174%精度），并提出可部署的贪心通过信号门控，跳过45-99%的SC调用、削减36-79%算力，精度保持点估计98.1-98.8%（CI较宽）。
AI.motivation: 在小模型上，per-query 算力预算紧张，但 SC 通常沿用大模型的固定采样预算（N=5），不区分实例难度，导致算力浪费；同时 SC 也可能把贪心正确的结果翻错。作者希望量化「自适应调用 SC」的收益上界与实际可部署近似。
AI.method: 在 Qwen-2.5-0.5B、Gemma-3-1B 两个模型家族上，FP16 与 MLX-Q4 两种精度，GSM8K 与 MATH-500 两个数学基准，n=200-400，开展 8 个单任务与 4 个任务池化实验，使用 1,000 次配对 bootstrap 置信区间。方案（1）oracle gate：逐 prompt 决定是否调用 SC 的上界；（2）可部署门控：基于 greedy-pass 信号决定是否调用 SC。
AI.result: oracle 门控在全部 12/12 组达到 always-SC 精度的 109-174%，仅用其 23-30% 算力，说明 N=5 时 always-SC 在网格上被全面支配；该差距即 SC 将正确贪心翻错的比率（3-10.5% prompts），在 Qwen-Q4 × MATH-500 上超过错→对率，使 always-SC 比 always-greedy 低 3 个百分点。可部署门控跳过 45-99% 的 SC 调用，bootstrap CI 半宽 <5 pt，削减 36-79% 算力；对应工作点精度保持点估计 98.1-98.8%（CI 下界 76-86%，因 SC 精度仅 15-36% 而偏宽）。
AI.conclusion: 在 ≤1B 模型、两个数学基准、N=5 的范围内，固定预算 always-SC 被自适应门控支配；基于贪心通过信号的轻量门控可在保持精度的同时显著降低算力，具备部署价值。

title: Stochastic Port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Processes for Learning from Noisy Dynamics on Lie Groups
summary: Learning predictive models for dynamics is difficult because observations are often sparse and noisy, while the underlying dynamics evolve on nonlinear configuration manifolds and are affected by environmental dissipation and stochastic disturbances. Standard neural dynamics models can fit short-term trajectories but often violate physical structure, accumulate error over long horizons, or rely on parameterizations that introduce singularities such as gimbal lock. We introduce LieSPHGP, a stochastic Gaussian-process framework for learning rigid body dynamics with port-Hamiltonian structure and stability-aware robustness. LieSPHGP represents motion on Lie groups and Lie algebras, enabling coordinate-consistent optimization without singular parameterizations. Learned mass, potential energy, dissipation, and control components retain physical roles and a separate diffusion term represents stochastic forcing. Each component is modeled by Matérn kernel Gaussian processes which capture uncertainty induced by noisy observations. To improve physical validity, Lie group exponential map updates preserve rotational constraints, while positive-definite damping ensures nonnegative deterministic energy dissipation. The implicit-explicit integrator additionally provides unconditional stability for the frozen linear damping subsystem. The resulting model learns predictive dynamics that are robust to noise, respect rigid body geometry, and capture both intrinsic motion and environmental dissipation. Experiments on various noisy rigid body benchmarks show improved prediction accuracy, stronger long-horizon stability, and better satisfaction of manifold constraints compared with neural dynamics baselines. Code, data and interactive results are available on the project website: https://thribhuvanrapolu.github.io/liesphgp/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LieSPHGP：一个在李群/李代数上、具有 port-Hamiltonian 结构的随机高斯过程框架，用于从稀疏含噪观测中学习刚体动力学，兼顾物理一致性与长时稳定性。
AI.motivation: 观测稀疏且含噪，而真实动力学在非线性构型流形上演化，并受环境耗散与随机扰动影响。标准神经动力学模型短期拟合尚可，但常违反物理结构、长时误差累积，且某些参数化（如万向节锁）引入奇异性。
AI.method: 以李群与李代数表示运动，实现坐标一致的优化并规避奇异参数化；将质量、势能、耗散与控制分量分别建模，保留明确物理角色，另用独立扩散项表示随机激励；各分量由 Matérn 核高斯过程建模以刻画噪声观测带来的不确定性；采用李群指数映射更新以保持旋转约束，正定阻尼保证确定性耗散非负；隐式-显式积分器对冻结线性阻尼子系统提供无条件稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个含噪刚体基准上，相比神经动力学基线，预测精度更高、长时稳定性更强、流形约束满足度更好。
AI.conclusion: LieSPHGP 学习到的预测动力学对噪声鲁棒、尊重刚体几何、能同时刻画本征运动与环境耗散；结果提示将结构化 port-Hamiltonian 先验、李群表示与随机 GP 建模及稳定积分相结合是学习物理一致动力学的有效路径。

title: LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting
summary: Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

AI.tldr: 提出 LoMASA，一个完全在单台桌面电脑上运行的免训练多智能体销售助理：35B MoE 模型（System-1）单次前向完成决策并从选项概率读取置信度，27B 稠密模型（System-2）负责撰写客户回复与升级简报并在不确定时被调用，代码负责全部定价与毛利计算、硬性定价规则不可覆盖。在 500 个模拟回合、1512 个决策上的测试中，仅 19.5% 决策需人工判断：38.0% 自动成交（中位延迟 2.67 秒），42.5% 被硬规则升级给经理；自动成交决策准确率与规则基线持平（0.894 对 0.894），但事后毛利跌破底线的承诺更少（2.61% 对 4.53%），代价是更多人工升级。选项概率在零训练下即校准良好，而同一模型用文字表达的置信度则不然；System-2 很少改变决策。
AI.motivation: 一线销售每天大量时间用于在客户变更数量、索要折扣或新付款条件、或成本波动后重新协调报价，重复性协调负担重，且价格与毛利计算容易出错、定价规则需合规可控。作者希望在不做模型微调、不依赖云端的前提下，用本地可部署的模型系统分担这部分工作。
AI.method: 构建双系统多智能体架构：System-1 为 35B 混合专家模型，以单次前向在候选项中做出决策，并直接从各答案选项的概率读出置信度；System-2 为 27B 稠密模型，负责生成客户回复和升级简报，仅在 System-1 不确定时介入。所有价格、毛利与选项由确定性代码计算，硬性定价规则为不可覆盖的约束，触及时直接升级给经理。系统免训练，全部运行在单台桌面电脑上。评测使用基于公开供应链数据构建的 500 个模拟回合、共 1512 个决策的测试集。
AI.result: 销售员仅需处理 19.5% 的决策；38.0% 自动成交，中位延迟 2.67 秒；42.5% 由硬规则升级给经理。自动成交决策上准确率与规则基线相当（0.894 vs 0.894），但事后毛利跌破底线的承诺比例更低（2.61% vs 4.53%），代价是更多升级。无训练条件下选项概率校准良好，优于同一模型用自然语言表达的置信度。
AI.conclusion: LoMASA 表明，在单机、免训练、规则硬约束的设计下，多智能体系统可把大部分报价重协调决策自动化，并在准确率不降的前提下降低毛利风险，逻辑到概率的置信度读取可靠。局限同样明确：System-2 几乎不改变决策，其附加价值有限；且毛利改善以更多人工升级为代价。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
summary: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points. To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.

AI.tldr: 提出 Deletion Tuning：仅将 Transformer 门控投影中不到 0.05% 的权重置零（学习二值掩码），即可在 RLVR、SFT 与 on-policy 蒸馏三种后训练范式中匹配全参数微调（FFT），同时大幅降低存储成本与灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练 LLM 获得新能力所需的最小改动量，并解决持续学习中的遗忘问题与全参数微调 checkpoint 过大的实际负担。
AI.method: 在 Transformer block 的 gate projection 上学习二值掩码，将掩码选中（<0.05%）的权重置零，不做其他修改；随后用 stable rank、spectrum drift、principal-weight overlap 三种几何指标分析 RL 下权重变化的谱结构。
AI.result: 在 RLVR、SFT、on-policy 蒸馏三种 regime 下均与 FFT 性能相当；掩码比 FFT checkpoint 小数百至数千倍；RL 下先前任务准确率接近基座水平，而 FFT、LoRA、随机稀疏微调最多下降 5.4 个点；三种几何指标上最接近 FFT。
AI.conclusion: 极稀疏的"删除式"参数修改已足以承载新能力，说明后训练的有效更新高度集中且低秩；Deletion Tuning 在性能、存储效率与抗遗忘间取得更优折衷。

title: Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference
summary: Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

AI.tldr: VerKV：混合式KV cache方案，在GPU上保留查询无关的枢纽token与全缓存sketch，配合CPU端完整缓存，通过PoissonComp采样与KVFetch误差估计实现带(ε,δ)保证的自适应检索。
AI.motivation: 长上下文、长期运行agent及多agent系统使KV cache超出GPU HBM容量，需卸载至主机内存，而CPU-to-GPU传输成为推理延迟瓶颈。查询无关的压缩难以保证任意查询的注意力精度，故需兼顾有界误差与最小化传输。
AI.method: 提出VerKV混合框架：GPU上维护紧凑的查询无关枢纽token集合与token级全缓存sketch，CPU保存完整cache。采用新提出的随机采样过程PoissonComp选取枢纽token；推理时用KVFetch基于枢纽token与sketch估计注意力计算的相对误差，若满足用户指定的(ε,δ)容差则无需访问主机内存，否则执行查询感知检索从CPU取回额外token以精化注意力。
AI.result: PoissonComp优于现有KV cache压缩方法；结合KVFetch在32K上下文上（RULER与LOFT平均）达到近稠密性能（稠密质量的90-100%），使用Qwen3-4B、Qwen3.5-9B与Ministral-3-8B，GPU显存占用降低8-32x，每生成token的CPU-to-GPU取回量仅占缓存2-23%。
AI.conclusion: VerKV通过查询无关压缩与查询感知检索的结合，在提供注意力近似误差有界保证的同时显著降低显存占用与主机内存传输开销，实现近稠密推理质量。

title: Online Imitation Learning for Stabilizing Vlasov--Poisson Plasmas
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 43 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables
summary: We study the problem of controlling instability in the Vlasov--Poisson plasma systems, a fundamental challenge for nuclear fusion control. Motivated by the partial observability of plasma states in practice, we investigate imitation learning algorithms that learn from a fully-observable expert controller, but operate under macroscopic measurements. We theoretically establish a separation between online and offline imitation learning --- even a small behavior cloning error leads to error compounding that exponentially amplifies instability over time. By way of contrast, the online imitation learning loss can polynomially control the stability of rollout trajectories. We then propose a DAgger-style algorithm that learns the stabilizing controller under partial observability. Simulation results on a 1D Vlasov--Poisson system demonstrate that our algorithm can effectively stabilize plasma instabilities over longer time horizons than behavior cloning.

AI.tldr: 研究部分可观测下Vlasov–Poisson等离子体系统的稳定性控制，理论区分在线与离线模仿学习，并提出DAgger式在线模仿学习算法。
AI.motivation: 核聚变控制中等离子体不稳定性抑制是核心难题，而实际中只能获得宏观测量、无法完全观测等离子体状态，因此需要从全观测专家控制器学习、但仅依赖宏观观测运行的模仿学习算法。
AI.method: 建立模仿学习的理论分析：对比在线与离线模仿学习的误差传播；推导行为克隆误差随时间指数放大导致不稳定性累积，而在线的模仿学习损失可多项式地控制回滚轨迹的稳定性；据此提出在部分可观测下学习镇定控制器的DAgger式算法。
AI.result: 理论证明了在线与离线模仿学习之间存在分离：即使很小的行为克隆误差也会引发指数级误差复合与不稳定性放大，而在线损失对稳定性的控制为多项式级。在一维Vlasov–Poisson系统仿真中，该算法相比行为克隆能在更长时间范围内有效镇定等离子体不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 在线（DAgger式）模仿学习在部分可观测的等离子体稳定性控制中优于离线行为克隆，误差复合由指数级降为多项式级，为聚变控制中的实际部署提供了理论与算法支撑。

title: Separation of Skilling Context for Standard Operating Procedure-based Agents
summary: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are kept concise for human readability, so LLM agents that generate executable skills from them lack the tacit knowledge and implementation details needed for automation. Human intervention fills these gaps, but must be repeated as SOPs evolve---a problem we call \textit{SOP-skill drift}. We propose managing SOPs and Contextual Knowledge (CK) separately, together with a \textit{contract-aware} evaluation that distinguishes genuine violations from CK-resolved differences. On eight Indeed-derived workflows (single LLM), it raises the functional-equivalence rate from 12\% to 58\%. Under three SOP-revision perturbations, previously extracted CK already covers 79.5\% of newly introduced automation gaps.

AI.tldr: 论文针对 SOP 简洁性与 LLM 智能体生成可执行技能所需隐含知识之间的缺口，提出将 SOP 与上下文知识（CK）分离管理，并引入契约感知评估，从而缓解"SOP-skill drift"问题。
AI.motivation: SOP 为便于人阅读而被压缩，LLM 智能体据此生成可执行技能时缺乏隐性知识与实现细节，导致自动化需要人工反复介入；SOP 演化时人工修补须重复进行，形成 SOP-skill drift。
AI.method: 将 SOP 与 Contextual Knowledge (CK) 分开管理；提出契约感知（contract-aware）评估，用以区分真正的违规与可由 CK 解释的差异；在八个源自 Indeed 的工作流上进行单 LLM 实验，并施加三种 SOP 修订扰动。
AI.result: 功能等价率从 12% 提升至 58%；在三种 SOP 修订扰动下，已提取的 CK 覆盖了 79.5% 的新增自动化缺口。
AI.conclusion: 分离管理 SOP 与上下文知识并配合契约感知评估，可显著提升生成技能的功能等价性，且已积累的 CK 对 SOP 演化具有良好复用性与前瞻覆盖能力。

title: BRAT: Bounded Residual-Aligned Training for Stable Multi-Pass LLM Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement learning for large language model post-training often reuses each batch of sampled rollouts for several gradient passes to amortize the cost of generation. Under such multi-pass reuse, existing objectives fail in different ways: unclipped updates collapse as the policy drifts away from the sampling policy, adding a negative baseline avoids collapse but reinforces every sampled response, and PPO-style ratio clipping cuts off gradients abruptly. We first ask why reuse is fragile. Measuring how well an update estimated from a small rollout group aligns with the KL-regularized target on held-out rollouts of the same prompts, we find that this alignment drops by nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, suggesting that repeated passes largely overfit the sampled group. Motivated by this finding, we propose Bounded Residual-Aligned Training (BRAT), motivated by a proximal update toward a bounded reweighting of the sampling policy. BRAT assigns each token a gradient weight that decreases linearly with its probability ratio and vanishes at a trust-region boundary, and normalizes group-centered rewards by their maximum magnitude, keeping advantages zero-mean and bounded without extra hyperparameters. With four reuse passes, BRAT avoids training collapse, limits policy drift, and achieves higher average accuracy with lower seed variance on most benchmarks.
