AI.result: 在相当的真实环境交互步数下，ALFWorld 成功率由 PPO 的 63.5% 提升至 87.5%，ScienceWorld 由 39.3% 提升至 52.9%。在 ALFWorld 上达到所测最强 PPO 改进方法的水平，在 ScienceWorld 上超出最佳方法 6.5 个百分点。训练所得策略更常在放置物体或给出答案前完成前置步骤。
AI.conclusion: 用世界模型对"假设动作"做前向预测并交由 critic 估值，可将稀疏终局奖励下的隐式动力学信息转化为密集的辅助优势与辅助价值目标，且无需额外监督或特权信息；共享门控的自适应加权保障了辅助信号的可信度，最终显著提升长程稀疏奖励任务的成功率与行为合理性。

title: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
summary: High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly. We formulate this setting as Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling (PSWD), a task that jointly refines spatial and temporal resolution while predicting future high-resolution trajectories. To this end, we propose a framework that decomposes prediction into spatial and temporal stages using a shared pretrained backbone, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight residual heads. For backbone adaptation, we introduce PROLA (PRincipal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation), which allocates a fixed low-rank budget between pretrained weights' principal directions and their orthogonal complement. PROLA further rescales rank-1 optimizer updates using gradient signals, improving adaptation without increasing trainable rank. Experiments in the PSWD setting show that PROLA outperforms representative low-rank adaptation baselines. Further experiments across diverse datasets and tasks support the broader applicability of PROLA, showing that its benefits extend beyond the primary weather downscaling setting.

AI.tldr: 提出PSWD任务与PROLA低秩适配方法，用于将预训练天气骨干网络适配到高分辨率未来天气预报。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率天气预测能刻画粗分辨率全球预报遗漏的局地大气结构，但将预训练天气骨干网络用于"由近期粗状态预测未来高分辨率场"代价高且困难。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为预测式时空天气降尺度（PSWD），把预测拆分为空间与时间两个阶段，共享同一预训练骨干、固定数值脚手架与轻量残差头；并提出PROLA，在预训练权重的主方向与其正交补之间分配固定低秩预算，并利用梯度信号对秩1优化器更新进行重缩放，且不增加可训练秩。
AI.result: 在PSWD设置下，PROLA优于代表性低秩适配基线；在多种数据集与任务上的额外实验表明其收益可推广至天气降尺度之外。
AI.conclusion: PROLA是一种有效且通用的低秩适配策略，可支撑预训练天气骨干网络向高分辨率时空预测的高效迁移。

title: PARIS: A multi-agent LLM framework for end-to-end, PRISMA-guided systematic literature reviews with pre-synthesis corpus quality assessment
summary: Systematic literature reviews (SRs) remain slow and labor-intensive, and most automation tools address single stages of the workflow. We present PARIS (PRISMA Agentic Research Intelligence System), an open-source framework in which a conductor agent running in Claude Code orchestrates 15 specialized large language model (LLM) agents, from scoping a research question to exporting a manuscript draft. Agents are specified declaratively, coordinate exclusively through persisted artifacts that the conductor validates before every transition, and delegate retrieval, bibliometric analysis and scoring to deterministic Python utilities. Three human checkpoints gate study inclusion, corpus adequacy and the synthesis outline. We also introduce QualityScore, a pre-synthesis index that aggregates normalized network, bibliometric, semantic and process sub-scores into a 0-100 grade. Two case studies illustrate both: AI chatbots and university students' learning (388 records, 100 included) and AI-assisted SR methods (131 records, 123 included, QualityScore 69.1 recomputed with a proxy network sub-score). They show end-to-end feasibility across domains and the diagnostic use of QualityScore: in the first run, corpus improvements chosen at the corpus-adequacy checkpoint raised the score from 74.6 to 81.9 and the number of pre-2023 studies from 1 to 19. Audits of both runs exposed failure modes: incomplete retrieval, counts that drifted between agents, unrecorded or delegated checkpoint decisions and a grade that depends on how citation data are handled. PARIS fully supports 8 of the 27 PRISMA 2020 items and partially supports 11. Output quality has so far been judged only by an internal reviewer agent; independent validation against human reviews is the next step.

AI.tldr: PARIS 是一个开源的多智能体框架，由运行于 Claude Code 的指挥智能体编排 15 个专用 LLM 智能体，覆盖系统综述从选题到稿件导出的全流程，并引入 QualityScore 进行合成前质量评估。
AI.motivation: 系统综述（SR）过程缓慢且劳动密集，现有自动化工具大多只覆盖工作流的单一环节，缺乏端到端的编排与质量控制。
AI.method: 构建 PARIS 框架：智能体以声明式规范定义，仅通过持久化产物协作，指挥智能体在每次状态转移前校验；检索、文献计量分析与打分交由确定性 Python 工具完成；设置研究纳入、语料充分性、综述大纲三个人工检查点。同时提出 QualityScore，将归一化的网络、文献计量、语义与过程子分数聚合为 0–100 分。通过两个案例研究（AI 聊天机器人与大学生学习：388 条记录/纳入 100 条；AI 辅助 SR 方法：131 条记录/纳入 123 条）进行验证。
AI.result: 两案例展示跨领域端到端可行性及 QualityScore 的诊断价值：第一例中，语料充分性检查点所选的语料改进将分数从 74.6 提升至 81.9，2023 年前研究数由 1 增至 19。审计揭示若干失效模式：检索不完整、智能体间计数漂移、检查点决策未记录或被代行、评分依赖引文数据处理方式。PARIS 完整支持 27 项 PRISMA 2020 条目中的 8 项，部分支持 11 项。
AI.conclusion: PARIS 证明多智能体编排可端到端支撑系统综述流程，但输出质量目前仅由内部评审智能体判定，下一步需与人工综述开展独立对照验证。

title: When Sensors Fail: Coverage Auditing with Incomplete Sensor Records
comment: Concise author preprint; 3 pages, 1 table; no supplementary material
summary: Sensor outages can conceal prediction-interval coverage deficits behind acceptable marginal performance, while unavailable future readings leave some issued forecasts unscorable. We present a measurement-record audit that links issue-time outage duration, original target availability, and time-uniform statistical evidence. The audit retains complete forecast keys, batches all sensors and overlapping horizons at each measurement tick, and projects simultaneous covered-count and scored-count bounds onto a cumulative conditional expected coverage ratio. This target is distinguished from empirical coverage and outage-conditional population coverage. Selected traffic and air-quality results illustrate the gap between pooled and long-outage coverage; in METR-LA, only 7.6% of issued long-gap forecasts have originally observed targets. Of 30 primary sequential outage-state audits, 26 are inconclusive and four lack scored support. This concise presentation gives the core construction and selected aggregate evidence without the full experimental supplement.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"测量记录审计"框架，将传感网断连时长、原始目标可获得性与时间一致的统计证据联系起来，检验预测区间覆盖是否因断连被掩盖。
AI.motivation: 传感器断连会使预测区间覆盖缺陷被"看起来可接受的边际性能"掩盖；而未来读数缺失又使部分已发布预测无法评分，因此需要同时考虑断连时长与目标缺失的覆盖审计方法。
AI.method: 保留完整预测键；在每个测量时刻批次聚合所有传感器与重叠预测步长；将同时刻覆盖计数与可评分计数的界投影到累积条件期望覆盖比上，并给出时间一致（anytime-valid）的统计证据；明确区分该目标与经验覆盖、断连条件总体覆盖。
AI.result: 交通与空气质量数据表明汇总覆盖与长断连覆盖存在明显差距；METR-LA中仅7.6%的长间断期已发布预测具有原始观测目标；30项主要序贯断连状态审计中26项不确定、4项缺乏可评分支持。
AI.conclusion: 边际覆盖指标不足以揭示断连条件下的覆盖缺陷，审计结论多为不确定，需要按断连状态分层并进行时间一致的序贯检验。

title: ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents
summary: On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.

AI.tldr: 提出环境校准的在线自蒸馏（environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation），用环境结果而非上下文引起的似然偏移来决定教师指导的权重，解决自写技能错误传播问题。
AI.motivation: 在线自蒸馏让语言智能体以自身轨迹写出的技能等特权上下文充当教师，但其指导权重取决于上下文对token似然的影响幅度，而非是否真正改善行为，导致自写技能中的错误经由后续更新被放大和回传。
AI.method: 以环境结果为校准信号，按"命令级优势"（比较在相似观测下执行的命令来估计）对教师的每个偏好进行缩放，并奖励那些诱导偏好指向更高优势命令的反思与技能；消融中将监督范围限定为可执行命令而非Actor的完整回复。
AI.result: 推理时不使用技能，3B与7B智能体在已见ALFWorld任务上宏平均成功率分别为90.5%和93.3%，WebShop成功率分别为75.5%和80.5%；在未见ALFWorld任务上，相同协议下分别较GRPO提升11.0和7.6个百分点。消融显示仅监督可执行命令使3B在WebShop上从52.3%提升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 用环境结果校准教师指导的可信度、并对技能进行优势加权的选择性强化，能有效抑制自写技能错误传播，在多个任务上取得显著性能提升，且技能无需在推理时保留。

title: When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains language models through multi-turn tool interactions, yet their reasoning performance and tool-calling ability can decline during training. We trace this degradation to three coupled mechanisms: (1) tool-token imbalance produces negative overall tool credit when incorrect trajectories contain more tool tokens per turn than correct ones; (2) aggregation amplification can further strengthen this negative signal as token-mean aggregation gives longer incorrect trajectories greater weight in policy updates; and (3) failure-driven retries prolong trajectories as models tend to call tools again after execution errors, extending potential negative credit to recovery attempts. To counter this suppression, we propose Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which targets the transition from reasoning to tool use through supervision of both call initiation and generation. Specifically, TACA uses Advantage Projection to enforce a nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens within each prompt group through a minimal uniform shift. Additionally, TACA guides tool-use decisions with Decision Contrast, comparing rewards for tool-assisted and direct answers to the same prompt. Through Supervised Replay, it reinforces tool-call generation using calls from previously sampled correct trajectories. Across models and tasks, TACA improves performance and sustains more reliable tool interaction during training, raising mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA.

AI.tldr: 提出TACA方法，通过监督"推理→工具调用"的过渡环节（优势投影、决策对比、监督回放）缓解智能体强化学习训练中推理与工具调用能力的退化，在六个推理基准上优于MT-GRPO。
AI.motivation: 带可验证奖励的智能体强化学习（多轮工具交互）中，模型的推理性能与工具调用能力会在训练过程中下降。作者将其归因于三种耦合机制：工具token失衡导致整体工具token信用为负；token均值聚合使更长的错误轨迹权重更大，进一步放大负信号；失败驱动的重试延长轨迹，将负信用扩散到恢复尝试。
AI.method: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA)，聚焦推理到工具使用的过渡，同时监督调用发起与生成：1) Advantage Projection——在每个prompt组内对工具调用token施加最小均匀偏移，强制其平均优势非负；2) Decision Contrast——对比同一prompt下工具辅助与直接作答的奖励，引导工具使用决策；3) Supervised Replay——利用此前采样到的正确轨迹中的调用进行监督回放，强化工具调用生成。
AI.result: 在多个模型与任务上，TACA提升性能并在训练中维持更可靠的工具交互；相较MT-GRPO，在六个推理基准上平均准确率提升：Qwen2.5-1.5B为4.61个百分点，Qwen2.5-3B为3.61个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用能力的退化源于工具token层面的信用分配失衡与聚合放大效应；通过针对过渡环节的信用重分配（非负优势约束、决策对比与正确轨迹回放），可有效抑制该退化，实现更稳定、更优的智能体强化学习训练。

title: Representational Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain in Speech Processing under Audiovisual Noise
comment: Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain
summary: Speech comprehension in the human brain is an incremental process that begins with acoustic processing and advances to linguistic processing. While recent studies have revealed that the hierarchy of deep neural networks (DNNs) correlates with the ascending auditory pathway, the exact nature of this DNN-brain alignment remains underexplored. In this study, we investigate how DNN representations align with the brain's acoustic-to-linguistic processing. Specifically, we employed neural encoding models to simulate neural responses to acoustic (i.e., speech and noise envelope) and linguistic features (i.e., word onset and surprisal). By applying representational similarity analysis (RSA), we quantified the similarity between these neural responses and the DNN embeddings generated by a pre-trained automatic speech recognition (ASR) model, both before and after fine-tuning on audiovisual noisy data. Our results demonstrate significant DNN-brain alignment: embeddings from shallow layers exhibit higher similarity to neural responses associated with acoustic features, while those from deeper layers align more closely with neural responses related to linguistic features. Importantly, the fine-tuning process enhances this alignment by improving noise processing in shallower layers and refining linguistic representations in deeper layers. These results suggest that fine-tuned DNN models can naturally develop human-like processing patterns in noisy environments, highlighting a functional alignment between the human brain and DNNs in speech representation.

AI.tldr: 该研究用神经编码模型模拟脑对声学（语音/噪声包络）与语言特征（词起始、surprisal）的响应，并通过RSA量化其与预训练ASR模型（音频-视觉噪声数据微调前后）DNN嵌入的相似性。发现浅层对齐声学响应、深层对齐语言响应，微调进一步增强这种"声学→语言"层级对齐。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明DNN层级与听觉上行通路存在相关性，但DNN与大脑对齐的确切性质（尤其是声学到语言加工的层级映射，以及噪声环境下微调的影响）仍缺乏深入探究。
AI.method: 以神经编码模型分别模拟对声学特征（语音包络、噪声包络）和语言特征（词起始word onset、surprisal）的神经响应；用表征相似性分析（RSA）比较这些模拟响应与预训练ASR模型DNN嵌入（微调前/后，基于音频-视觉噪声数据）之间的相似度。
AI.result: 存在显著的DNN-大脑对齐：浅层嵌入与声学特征相关响应更相似，深层嵌入与语言特征相关响应更接近；微调通过改善浅层的噪声处理、精炼深层的语言表征而增强该对齐。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的DNN模型能在噪声环境中自发形成类人的加工模式，表明人脑与DNN在语音表征上存在功能性对齐。

title: Where Should a Gate Look? Input vs. State Gating in Diagonal State Space Models
summary: Modern state-space models owe much of their computational efficiency to their linear, often diagonal, dynamics. Classical recurrent neural networks instead allow nonlinear state-to-state interactions, which can be beneficial when memory updates need to depend on the past context. In this paper, we ask whether state feedback through a simple gate regulating memory updates can enhance the expressivity of diagonal state-space models. To investigate this question, we compare gates that depend on the current input, the recurrent state, or both. We establish a strict expressivity separation: for scalar models, state gating solves induction-head tasks for arbitrary vocabulary size and sequence length, whereas input gating fails on a finite instance under standard stability assumptions on the state transition matrix. Experiments show that state gating retains its advantage on induction-head tasks in higher-dimensional models, whereas input gating performs better on selective copying tasks. Together, our results show that even a simple, diagonal form of state-feedback gating can unlock capabilities unavailable to input-controlled models, while input and state gating offer complementary strengths and achieve the strongest overall performance when combined.

AI.tldr: 通过对比输入门控与状态门控，证明含状态反馈门控的对角状态空间模型在表达能力上严格强于输入门控模型，且两者互补、组合后性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 现代状态空间模型因线性（常为对角）动力学而高效，但牺牲了经典RNN中非线性的状态间交互，这种交互在记忆更新依赖历史上下文时有益。作者因此探究：用一个简单门控调节记忆更新所引入的状态反馈，能否提升对角SSM的表达能力。
AI.method: 比较三类门控机制（依赖当前输入、依赖循环状态、两者兼有）；在标量模型上进行理论分析，在状态转移矩阵的标准稳定性假设下建立严格的表达能力分离；并在高维模型的 induction-head 与 selective copying 任务上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上，标量模型中状态门控可解决任意词表规模与序列长度的 induction-head 任务，而输入门控在有限实例上失败；实验中，状态门控在高维模型的 induction-head 任务上保持优势，输入门控在 selective copying 任务上表现更好，组合门控取得最强整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 即便简单、对角形式的状态反馈门控也能解锁输入控制模型不具备的能力；输入门控与状态门控各具互补优势，二者结合可获得最佳性能。

title: Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models
summary: Recurrent latent reasoning in large lanugage models (LLMs) scales test-time computation by increasing recurrent depth, naturally framing inference as a problem of deciding when to stop. We identify a previously overlooked limitation of this single-depth view through systematic preliminary analysis: deeper recurrence can lose correct solutions found at shallower depths, while depth-specific success sets remain broadly non-nested even after controlling for marginal accuracy. This suggests that depth determines not only computation cost, but also access to distinct candidate solutions. Motivated by this finding, we propose Depth Portfolio Allocation (DPA), which reformulates recurrent test-time scaling as budgeted allocation across depth-specific candidate sources. DPA supports both fixed portfolios and feedback-guided sequential allocation under a shared inference budget. Experiments on GSM8K, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MBPP show that mixed-depth portfolios expand oracle coverage under matched candidate counts and nominal costs, while feedback-guided allocation generally matches or improves uniform allocation and can reduce computation in high-budget settings. Code and data are avaible at : https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LLM-latent-B7BC/.

AI.tldr: 将循环潜空间推理的测试时扩展重构为"深度组合分配"问题，用跨深度的候选组合替代单一深度停止决策。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将循环深度的测试时计算视为"何时停止"的单一深度决策问题。作者通过系统预实验发现该视角存在被忽视的局限：更深循环可能丢失浅层已找到的正确解，且控制边际准确率后各深度的成功解集合仍广泛非嵌套，说明深度不仅决定计算成本，也决定可访问的候选解集合。
AI.method: 提出Depth Portfolio Allocation (DPA)，把循环测试时扩展重新表述为在共享推理预算下、对多个深度特定候选源进行预算化分配。支持两种形式：固定组合（fixed portfolios）与反馈引导的顺序分配（feedback-guided sequential allocation）。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、SVAMP、MultiArith、MBPP上，等候选数与等名义成本条件下，混合深度组合扩大了oracle覆盖率；反馈引导分配总体匹配或优于均匀分配，并在高预算设置下减少计算量。
AI.conclusion: 深度是候选解多样性的来源而非单纯成本维度，跨深度组合分配为循环潜推理的测试时计算提供更有效的预算使用范式；代码与数据已匿名开放。

title: OPSRL-SSP: Optimistic Posterior Sampling for Stochastic Shortest Path with Minimax-Optimal Regret
summary: We study online reinforcement learning for the stochastic shortest path (SSP) problem with unknown transition dynamics. Although existing posterior-sampling methods perform well empirically on SSPs, their regret guarantees do not achieve the minimax-optimal order. We address this limitation by proposing OPSRL-SSP, an optimistic posterior-sampling algorithm for the SSP setting. The algorithm operates in epochs and uses a logarithmic, time-dependent schedule for the number of posterior samples. To induce optimism, we augment the transition model with a pseudo-state assigned an optimistic boundary value. We establish a high-probability regret bound of $\tilde{O}(B_\star \sqrt{SAK} + B_\star S^2 A)$, where $B_\star$ is an upper bound on the expected cost of the optimal policy, $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively, and $K$ is the number of episodes. In addition, we extend the analysis to general zero-cost SSPs using a universal cost-perturbation argument. The leading term matches the minimax lower bound $Ω(B_\star \sqrt{SAK})$, thereby addressing the open problem raised by Jafarnia-Jahromi et al. [19] for posterior sampling in the SSP setting.

AI.tldr: 提出乐观后验采样算法 OPSRL-SSP，为未知转移的随机最短路（SSP）问题取得 $\tilde{O}(B_\star\sqrt{SAK}+B_\star S^2A)$ 的高概率遗憾界，主项达到 minimax 最优。
AI.motivation: 已有后验采样方法在 SSP 上经验表现良好，但遗憾保证未达 minimax 最优阶；Jafarnia-Jahromi 等[19] 提出的后验采样公开问题尚未解决。
AI.method: OPSRL-SSP：按 epoch 运行的乐观后验采样；采用对数形式的、随时间变化的后验采样条数调度；为诱导乐观性，在转移模型中引入一个赋予乐观边界值的伪状态；并通过通用的代价扰动论证把分析推广到一般零代价 SSP。
AI.result: 建立高概率遗憾界 $\tilde{O}(B_\star\sqrt{SAK}+B_\star S^2A)$，其中 $B_\star$ 为最优策略期望代价上界，$S$、$A$ 为状态与动作数，$K$ 为回合数；主导项与 minimax 下界 $\Omega(B_\star\sqrt{SAK})$ 匹配。
AI.conclusion: 主项达到 minimax 下界，解决了 SSP 后验采样遗憾最优性的公开问题；伪状态乐观机制与自适应采样调度是关键技术。

title: Reconfigurable Action Theories: A Formal Foundation for Dynamically Composable Agent Harnesses
summary: Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.

AI.tldr: 提出可重构行动理论 RAT，允许行动改变行动理论本身（词汇、因果律、初始化器），并给出语义充分条件、复杂度与到因果理论及 ASP 的编译，实验与三种智能体脚手架实现对照。
AI.motivation: 传统行动理论假定词汇与因果律固定不变，而智能体脚手架在执行中会改变工具、提供者与策略；需要形式化基础来分析组件变动如何影响可用行动、行为与可达目标。
AI.method: 将理论划分为模块（词汇、因果律、初始化器）；RAT 配置记录活跃模块集与世界状态；模块加载/卸载由受普通因果律支配的行动表示；在活跃模块集固定时保持原有因果行动语义；给出至多一个后继配置、模块添加时保持既有行为、任意加载顺序结果一致的充分条件；分析推理任务的复杂度；将有限 RAT 系统翻译为非单调因果理论与 ASP，并保持有界执行。
AI.result: 确立了推理任务的计算复杂度，实现到因果理论与 ASP 的保持有界执行的翻译，并将有限 RAT 模型与 DeepSeek Harness、Pi、OpenHands 官方实现的实际执行进行实验对比。
AI.conclusion: RAT 为检验组件变动对脚手架可用行动、行为与可达目标的影响提供了形式化基础。

title: Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code and data: https://github.com/hopit-ai/harness-mistakes-artifacts
summary: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.

AI.tldr: 论文考察模型外部的"笔记/外围框架"(harness)能否从AI agent的失败轨迹中学习，而非仅靠从未见过失败样本的匹配搜索。结论是能，但幅度小于表面数字：在客服决策任务上，基于错误的笔记比扣除错误的同流程笔记提升4.0个百分点，而搜索过程本身已贡献约60%的总提升；在完整客服对话与工具使用任务上未显示出可验证增益。
AI.motivation: 现有做法多是通过搜索（试错并保留更优笔记）来优化agent的模型外围说明，但这类搜索并不真正利用agent的失败轨迹。作者怀疑"从失败中学习"的增益可能被搜索本身的收益夸大，因此需要设置严格对照，量化失败轨迹带来的真实增量，并检验其可泛化性。
AI.method: 1) 使用固定权重的开放9B参数模型，由更大的教师模型撰写笔记；2) 生成式客服决策任务，两组笔记撰写者均被告知目标规则，一组基于agent错误、另一组在同一流程下扣留错误，进行对照；3) 分解贡献：单独搜索（试错并保留得分更高的笔记）达到约60%的总提升；4) 在完整客服对话上复测；5) 对单条经验(lesson)做严格筛选，并在新数据/新工具使用任务上检验；6) 设置无流程的中性笔记作探索性对照；7) 采用盲审对工具使用测试集进行质量审计。
AI.result: 客服决策任务：基于错误的笔记较扣留错误的同流程笔记提升4.0个百分点，搜索单独解释约60%的总提升。完整客服对话：无增益证据。严格筛选后仅接纳2条客服经验（尚待新数据检验）与1条工具使用经验（撰写时未见错误），均在新任务上无可见增益。探索性结果显示无流程的中性笔记得分高于学到的经验。盲审判定240条工具使用测试项中有146条存在缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 失败轨迹可转化为笔记层面的改进，但真实收益有限，且大部分由搜索而非"从错误学习"贡献；增益难以迁移到完整对话与工具使用场景。中性笔记反超学到的经验、以及高达61%（146/240）的测试项被盲审判为缺陷，提示部分对比可能受噪声与数据质量污染，需以更严格的数据与评测设计重新验证。

title: PACE-ECG: Patient-Aware Contrastive ECG Pretraining; Leveraging Longitudinal Structure for Transferable Representations
summary: Foundation models for physiological signals are commonly evaluated on in-domain interpretation tasks, but their ability to transfer to longitudinal clinical prognosis across healthcare systems remains uncertain. We developed PACE-ECG, an ECG pretraining framework that combines contrastive learning across temporally neighbouring recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision. We evaluated frozen ECG representations for post-myocardial-infarction all-cause mortality and incident heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and two external HEEDB cohorts, comparing the proposed representation with DeepECG-SSL, a state-of-the-art model, and two control baselines. Across both downstream tasks, the proposed model outperformed DeepECG-SSL in-domain (AUROC +1.9% for mortality and +4.0% for heart failure) and on external populations in HEEDB-Boston (+5.6% for mortality +10.3% for heart failure) and HEEDB-Atlanta (+6.9% for mortality +11.0% for heart failure) while using an encoder 41 times smaller and a fraction of the pretraining data. A matched ablation showed that patient-temporal pairing improved external mortality and heart failure AUROC over generic self-supervision by 7.0% and 9.4% on HEEDB-Boston and 8.9% and 9.3% on HEEDB-Atlanta. These findings indicate that pretraining-objective design greatly influences downstream transfer alongside model and data scale, and that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to establish the clinical generalisability of ECG foundation representations.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE-ECG心电自监督预训练框架，结合患者时间邻域对比学习与临床引导多任务监督，在跨机构心梗后死亡与心衰预测上显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生理信号基础模型多在同域解读任务上评估，其跨医疗系统进行纵向临床预后迁移的能力尚不明确，同域性能不足以证明临床泛化性。
AI.method: PACE-ECG将同一患者时间相邻记录的对比学习与临床引导的多任务监督相结合；冻结表征后在MIMIC-IV与两个外部HEEDB队列上评估心梗后全因死亡与心衰发生预测，对比DeepECG-SSL及两个对照基线，并做匹配消融。
AI.result: 同域AUROC提升1.9%（死亡）与4.0%（心衰）；HEEDB-Boston提升5.6%/10.3%，HEEDB-Atlanta提升6.9%/11.0%；编码器小41倍且预训练数据更少。消融显示患者-时间配对相较通用自监督在外部集提升7.0%/9.4%（Boston）与8.9%/9.3%（Atlanta）。
AI.conclusion: 预训练目标设计与模型和数据规模同样关键，显著影响下游迁移；仅凭同域性能不足以建立心电基础表征的临床泛化性。

title: Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines
summary: Spatial reasoning requires understanding how objects and observers are arranged in a scene and how their relations change with viewpoint or movement. Vision-language models (VLMs) typically perform both steps through model-internal reasoning, forming an implicit scene interpretation from partial views and imagining the consequences of spatial transformations. A misread scene can lead to a wrong answer, while even a correct interpretation does not ensure that imagined transformations satisfy spatial constraints. We introduce Spatial Harness, which represents scenes as explicit and executable world states to ground spatial reasoning in physics-engine feedback. A Perceiver integrates scene constraints extracted from the question with specialized visual estimates to place objects and cameras in a shared coordinate frame. The resulting state is instantiated in a physics engine, where a Reasoner executes viewpoint changes and uses computed measurements and rendered views to guide reasoning. We evaluate on MindCube, SAT, MMSI-Bench, and SpatialRGPT-Bench with open- and closed-weight VLMs. On MindCube, Spatial Harness improves Qwen3.5-27B from 52.70% to 71.14%, surpassing pySpatial by 7.52 percentage points. Given identical annotated object and camera poses, it reaches 98.25% versus 71.81% for model-internal reasoning. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tmlr-group/Spatial-Harness

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Harness，将场景表示为显式可执行的世界状态，用物理引擎反馈把 VLM 的空间推理外化为「感知—建场—推演」三阶段流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 把"场景理解"与"视角变换推演"都放在模型内部隐式完成：场景读错会直接导致错答，即便理解正确，想象中的变换也未必满足空间约束，缺乏可验证的中间状态。
AI.method: Perceiver 模块结合从问题中抽取的场景约束与专用视觉估计（物体位姿、相机位姿），在统一坐标系中放置物体与相机；所得世界状态在物理引擎中实例化，由 Reasoner 执行视角变化，并利用引擎计算出的测量量与渲染视图引导推理。
AI.result: 在 MindCube、SAT、MMSI-Bench、SpatialRGPT-Bench 上评测开源与闭源 VLM。MindCube 上 Qwen3.5-27B 从 52.70% 提升至 71.14%，比 pySpatial 高 7.52 个百分点；在给定相同的标注物体与相机位姿条件下达 98.25%，而模型内部推理为 71.81%。
AI.conclusion: 显式世界状态 + 物理引擎反馈是提升空间推理的有效范式，且位姿估计精度是当前主要瓶颈（标注位姿下性能大幅跃升），代码已开源。

title: AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation
summary: For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\% validity (vs. 32.5\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

AI.tldr: AMSchem 是一个免训练、验证器引导的智能体框架，可将 AMS 网表自动转换为人类可读的原理图，并在 AMSchem-Bench 上达到 85.0% 有效性，还能作为视觉反馈模块提升 LLM 模拟电路设计的成功率。
AI.motivation: 网表只编码连接关系而不包含视觉呈现信息，人工转换为可读原理图耗时且依赖专家惯例；同时 LLM 设计工具缺乏结构化视觉反馈，只能在"看不见"的电路上迭代。这一 netlist-to-schematic 鸿沟长期存在。
AI.method: 提出免训练、验证器引导的智能体框架：将电路感知的视觉规划（DrawingIntent）与可执行的原理图几何表示（SchematicIR）解耦；采用局部视觉反馈与有界、可重验证的修复补丁；并由确定性验证器全程约束器件保留、引脚-网络一致性及几何正确性。
AI.result: 构建 AMSchem-Bench（12 类共 64 个电路）。在 40 个原理图子集上，配合 gpt-5.5 达到 85.0% 有效性，而直接生成仅 32.5%。作为 LLM 模拟设计中的视觉反馈模块，在五个模型上解决了 AnalogCoder 基准中全部 13 个此前失败的案例，显著提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: AMSchem 以"规划-几何分离 + 确定性验证 + 局部修复"的方式有效弥合网表到原理图的鸿沟，并可作为通用视觉反馈模块增强 LLM 基模拟设计流程。

title: MG-Cache: Multi-Granularity Caching for Accelerating Diffusion Transformer Inference
summary: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models, while having become a powerful backbone for generative synthesis, suffer from high inference cost on generating high-resolution images. Diffusion caching has emerged as a promising acceleration technique to reduce inference cost. However, existing caching strategies fail to accurately identify the varying importance of different computational modules and rarely coordinate cache reusing across the timestep and layer granularities, making it difficult to control error accumulation. To address these limitations, we propose multi-granularity caching (MG-Cache) for DiTs, a novel and fully training-free approach to exploit computational redundancy both on timesteps and Transformer layers. Our core innovation contains a two-stage caching strategy: an offline timestep profiling analysis that identifies redundant timesteps for cache reuse, followed by an adaptive layer-wise caching strategy that combines input stability with importance of each Transformer layer to selectively cache stable Attention and MLP submodules. Extensive experiments on mainstream open-source DiT models validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving significant acceleration while maintaining high fidelity to the uncached output, with up to a 4.18x acceleration on HunyuanVideo.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的MG-Cache，从时间步与Transformer层两个粒度协同复用计算冗余，实现DiT高效推理加速。
AI.motivation: DiT在高分辨率图像生成上推理成本高；现有扩散缓存策略难以准确识别不同计算模块的重要性差异，且缺乏时间步与层粒度间的缓存复用协调，导致误差累积难以控制。
AI.method: 完全免训练的两阶段缓存策略：先离线进行时间步profiling分析，识别可复用缓存的冗余时间步；再在层粒度上采用自适应缓存，结合输入稳定性与各Transformer层的重要性，选择性缓存稳定的Attention与MLP子模块。
AI.result: 在主流开源DiT模型上验证有效，在保持与未缓存输出高度一致的前提下显著加速，HunyuanVideo上最高达4.18倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度缓存可有效利用时间步与层维度的计算冗余，在不训练的情况下实现DiT推理的高加速与高保真平衡。

title: Rethinking Radar 3D Perception: Representation Learning from Raw Spectra
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Miao Zhang and Mohamed Abdelsamad contributed equally
summary: Raw radar spectra are widely viewed as too cluttered and noisy for direct representation learning, motivating handcrafted reductions, sparse point clouds, or compact Doppler descriptors in radar perception. We challenge this assumption and argue that the main limitation lies not in the raw representation itself, but in the absence of a learning objective that separates structured signal from noise. Handcrafted reductions partially address this problem but impose rigid assumptions about what constitutes signal, discarding weak yet informative structure while retaining artifacts that fit the reduction model. Once removed, such information cannot be recovered by supervised learning. We propose an alternative: structure is the component of a radar spectrum that remains reconstructable under localized corruption, while noise is the component that does not. This perspective motivates self-supervised masked modeling for dense radar spectra without predefined signal-noise separation. We instantiate it with Leakage-aware Spectral MAE, a masked autoencoder for raw radar cubes using a corruption strategy inspired by cross-bin energy spreading caused by spectral leakage. We also demonstrate the importance of Doppler organization: treating Doppler as a primary spatial dimension in an x-y-D representation, with height encoded as features, substantially outperforms naive channel stacking and enables effective learning from dense 4D spectra. Without handcrafted reductions, our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art radar-based detectors and point-cloud-based self-supervised learning (SSL) counterparts. These results establish raw radar spectra as an effective representation for 3D perception when paired with an appropriate pretraining objective.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑"原始雷达谱噪声过大不宜直接做表征学习"的假设，提出信号-噪声分离的缺失在于学习目标而非表征本身，采用泄漏感知的谱MAE自监督掩码建模直接在原始雷达立方体上预训练，并将多普勒作为x-y-D表征的主空间维度，性能超越现有雷达检测器与点云SSL方法。
AI.motivation: 原始雷达谱通常被视为杂乱噪声大，因此现有雷达感知依赖手工降维、稀疏点云或紧凑多普勒描述子。但手工降维引入刚性信号假设：既丢弃弱而有用的结构，又保留符合降维模型的伪影，且一旦移除便无法通过监督学习恢复。作者认为瓶颈在于缺少能将结构化信号与噪声分离的学习目标。
AI.method: 提出"结构=在局部破坏下仍可重建的成分，噪声=不可重建的成分"这一准则，据此对稠密雷达谱做无需预定义信噪划分的自监督掩码建模。实例化为Leakage-aware Spectral MAE：面向原始雷达立方体的掩码自编码器，其破坏策略受谱泄漏引起的跨bin能量扩散启发。同时强调多普勒组织方式：将多普勒作为x-y-D表征中的主空间维度、高度编码为特征，优于朴素通道堆叠，从而支持稠密4D谱的有效学习。
AI.result: 在无手工降维的条件下，该方法稳定优于当前最优的基于雷达的检测器，以及基于点云的自监督学习对照方法；多普勒作为空间维度的表征显著优于通道堆叠，并能从稠密4D谱中有效学习。
AI.conclusion: 原始雷达谱在配备合适预训练目标时，可作为3D感知的有效表征；关键不在于降维，而在于设计能区分可重建结构与噪声的自监督目标，以及合理的多普勒空间组织。

title: D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification
summary: Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round. The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

AI.tldr: 提出 D3Tree，用一个仅 2H+2 参数的树规模预测头学习块扩散草稿树中哪些节点值得验证，从而得到祖先闭合的、随请求与解码轮自适应大小的验证子树。
AI.motivation: 块扩散草稿器一次前向生成整块 token，其位置边缘分布构建的草稿树可提升推测解码的期望接受长度。但目标验证中每个树节点占用一行 query，并发服务时低收益分支会挤占其他请求的验证算力；现有树方法按草稿概率在固定或按代价选择的每请求预算下选点，只能保留草稿器排序的前缀，无法甄别真正值得验证的节点。
AI.method: 设计树规模预测头（2H+2 参数），由草稿状态、候选嵌入及草稿对数概率预测每个候选的条件存活概率；沿父链对分数连乘后阈值化，得到祖先闭合的自适应子树。该头在冻结草稿器上用完整候选树的条件下标签训练，可选联合模式将草稿器导向被保留的参考路径。服务时轻载验证整棵树，重载则按预测存活率分配批级统一节点预算并与目标矩阵乘 tile 对齐；保留树共享一次祖先掩码的目标前向，构建、剪枝与调度在 GPU 上执行并与主机端重叠。
AI.result: 在 6 个视觉语言验证器、17 个文本与多模态基准上，72 种负载设置中 70 种最快；单请求相对自回归解码加速 3.2–4.0 倍，64 并发请求下为 1.3–1.8 倍，而固定预算树此时已低于自回归速度；在时变到达轨迹下，每个到达阶段的平均端到端延迟最低。
AI.conclusion: 将"验证哪些节点"视为可学习的预测问题而非固定排序截断，能在并发约束下显著提升推测解码的吞吐与延迟表现，且额外开销极小。

title: DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by letting a lightweight drafter propose several future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash draft a whole block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds a draft tree from their per-position distributions. Each of these distributions assumes that the drafter's own most likely continuation is correct. A tree, however, gains over a chain only on branches that leave this continuation, where the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its candidate lists miss the right token far more often. When re-run from the fork token, the same drafter is usually correct, so the errors come from the prefix that the distributions condition on rather than from what the drafter knows. We introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. DForkTree adds n-gram statistics from the target model's own outputs to the drafter's scores as pointwise mutual information, weights them more after the fork, and builds the optimal tree under these scores exactly on the GPU. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, with all tree methods sharing one drafter, tree pipeline and verifier, DForkTree is the fastest tree method on every benchmark. It is up to 41.5% faster than DFlash and 15.1% faster than DDTree in the same setting, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: DForkTree 是一种免训练方法，通过在分叉点后以目标模型输出统计的 PMI 重新锚定各分支，提升块扩散草稿器在投机解码中的草稿树质量与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 块扩散草稿器（如 DFlash）一次前向生成整块，DDTree 由此构建草稿树；但各位置分布均以草稿器自身最可能的续写为条件。树相对链的收益恰恰来自偏离该续写的分支，此时草稿器 top-1 准确率从 89% 骤降至 18%，候选列表漏词显著增加。从分叉令牌重新运行时草稿器通常正确，说明误差源于条件所依赖的前缀而非草稿器知识本身。
AI.method: 提出 DForkTree：免训练，为每个分支以其自身令牌重新锚定条件；将目标模型自身输出上的 n-gram 统计以逐点互信息（PMI）形式加入草稿器打分，并在分叉后加大其权重；在 GPU 上依据这些分数精确构建最优树。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B 上，所有树方法共享同一草稿器、树流水线与验证器，DForkTree 在每个基准上均为最快的树方法：较 DFlash 快至多 41.5%，较 DDTree 快 15.1%，相对自回归解码平均加速最高达 4.75x。
AI.conclusion: 草稿树的瓶颈在于分叉后条件前缀的失准而非草稿器能力；以目标模型 n-gram PMI 重锚定分支并精确求解最优树，可在不额外训练的前提下显著提升投机解码效率。

title: LLM-based Multi-Criteria Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Efficient 5G UPF Selection
summary: User plane function (UPF) selection in 5G networks is an active area of research, with various limited approaches proposed to enhance network efficiency and manage resources effectively. In this paper, we address this gap in the related literature by proposing a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) UPF selection method that utilizes a dynamic, multi-objective reward function and validating it on a real-world 5G emulation platform. The proposed method is based on the large language models' (LLMs) translation of network operator intents and the network data analytics function (NWDAF) abnormality alerts. The experimental results validated in the real-world experimental setup demonstrate that our dynamic DRL solution achieves an effective balance between latency, power consumption, and traffic distribution, outperforming the heuristic baselines and fixed DRL by 16.89%. These findings highlight the real-world applicability of our approach for dynamic, intent-driven UPF selection.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM意图翻译与NWDAF告警的DRL UPF选择方法，采用动态多目标奖励函数并在真实5G仿真平台验证。
AI.motivation: 现有5G UPF选择研究多采用受限方法，难以在网络效率与资源管理间取得有效平衡，且缺乏真实环境验证，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建基于深度强化学习（DRL）的UPF选择方法，核心为动态多目标奖励函数；通过大语言模型（LLM）将网络运营商意图翻译为可执行信号，并结合NWDAF异常告警作为输入驱动决策；在真实5G仿真平台上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在真实实验环境中，动态DRL方案在时延、功耗与流量分布之间实现有效平衡，相较启发式基线和固定奖励DRL提升16.89%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明该意图驱动、动态多目标的UPF选择方法具备真实场景适用性。

title: TANSAR: Editable and Attributable Correlation Matrix Memories under Correlated Keys, with Rule-Constrained Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing
summary: Correlation Matrix Memories (CMMs) store associations as sums of rank-one outer products, providing closed-form addressability, exact deletion, and linear attribution. While classical analyses assume random, orthogonal keys, semantic encoders produce correlated representations. We analyse CMMs under correlated keys using frame-theoretic coherence: (i) capacity bounds yielding an encoder-independent limit $n \le d(1+\varepsilon^2)$ for mean squared crosstalk $\varepsilon^2$; (ii) an exact characterisation of the collateral effect of deleting an association, guaranteeing that deletion never invalidates certified associations; and (iii) a geometric transparency bound demonstrating why attribution requires candidate sets of centred keys. On this basis, we introduce Topology-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Associative Retrieval (TANSAR). TANSAR traverses a directed acyclic association graph, prunes invalid paths via sound ground Horn constraints, and injects a representation derived strictly from the verified path into the residual stream of a frozen language model, guarded by a Clopper--Pearson selective-risk gate. Controlled experiments confirm all theoretical bounds. In multi-hop knowledge editing, Horn pruning reduces answer contradictions from 25.1% to 0.5%, whereas Hopfield retrieval incurs 24% contradictions when stale associations remain stored (and 0% if stale associations are removed). An end-to-end edit transaction requires 13.6 ms on a standard CPU and 2.37 ms on GPU. The symbolic component matches gold labels across all 600 ProofWriter theories and achieves 94.0% agreement on FOLIO, demonstrating sound and efficient multi-hop associative retrieval with exact unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文从帧理论相干性角度分析相关键下的相关矩阵记忆（CMM），给出容量上界、删除副作用精确刻画与归因的几何透明度界，并据此提出拓扑感知神经符号联想检索框架 TANSAR，实现带精确遗忘的可验证多跳联想检索。
AI.motivation: 经典 CMM 分析假设键向量随机且正交，但语义编码器实际产生相关表示，导致既有容量与删除/归因结论失效；同时多跳知识编辑中陈旧关联会引发答案矛盾，缺乏可验证、可精确删除的检索机制。
AI.method: 以帧理论相干性为工具，在相关键下推导：(i) 与编码器无关的容量界 n ≤ d(1+ε²)；(ii) 删除关联时附带效应的精确刻画；(iii) 说明归因需以中心化键构成候选集的几何透明度界。在此基础上构建 TANSAR：在关联有向无环图上遍历，用可靠的 ground Horn 约束剪除无效路径，将严格源自已验证路径的表示注入冻结语言模型的残差流，并由 Clopper–Pearson 选择性风险门控把关。
AI.result: 受控实验验证全部理论界成立。多跳知识编辑中，Horn 剪枝将答案矛盾率由 25.1% 降至 0.5%；陈旧关联存留时 Hopfield 检索矛盾率达 24%（移除陈旧关联则为 0%）。端到端编辑事务在标准 CPU 上耗时 13.6 ms、GPU 上 2.37 ms。符号组件在全部 600 个 ProofWriter 理论上与金标签一致，在 FOLIO 上达 94.0% 一致率。
AI.conclusion: 相关键下的 CMM 可通过相干性理论获得可认证的容量、删除与归因保证；TANSAR 将可靠的符号剪枝与残差流注入结合，实现了高效、可靠且支持精确遗忘的多跳联想检索。

title: Self-Supervised Collapse Prevention with Score-Based Entropy Maximization
summary: Diffusion models have demonstrated the effectiveness of score-based objectives for generative modeling, yet their potential for self-supervised representation learning remains underexplored. We introduce Entropy-Based Regularization (EBReg), a framework that uses latent score estimation to regularize the latent distribution during self-supervised training. EBReg jointly learns an encoder and a latent score model, and utilizes the learned score to provide a diversity-preserving signal that prevents representational collapse. Motivated by a mutual-information lower bound, we formulate the objective as view alignment with smoothed marginal entropy maximization and optimize the marginal entropy without explicit density evaluation. The same score model can additionally be used at test time to refine corrupted representations toward the training latent distribution. Empirically, EBReg learns competitive representations on ImageNet-1K, achieving 75.57% linear-probe accuracy with ViT-L. Across diverse architectures, score-guided test-time adaptation further improves robustness on ImageNet-C, yielding an average relative accuracy gain of approximately 5%.

AI.tldr: 提出熵正则化框架 EBReg，用潜在得分估计正则化自监督训练中的潜在分布，防止表征坍缩，并在测试时利用同一得分模型提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型已验证得分目标在生成建模中的有效性，但其在自监督表征学习中的潜力尚未充分挖掘；自监督学习中的核心难题是表征坍缩，需要保持表征多样性的机制。
AI.method: EBReg 联合学习编码器与潜在得分模型；基于互信息下界，将目标形式化为"视图对齐 + 平滑边缘熵最大化"，借助学到的得分信号在无需显式密度估计的情况下优化边缘熵；同一得分模型在测试时可将受扰动的表征精炼回训练潜在分布。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，ViT-L 达到 75.57% 线性探测精度，具竞争力；在多种架构下，得分引导的测试时自适应在 ImageNet-C 上平均相对精度提升约 5%。
AI.conclusion: 潜在得分估计可作为有效的多样性保持正则项用于自监督表征学习，且得分模型可复用于测试时适应，兼具表征学习与鲁棒性增强的双重价值。

title: Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation
comment: 55 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code, catalog and evaluation bench: https://github.com/jeremy1392/IntuneAgentDetector
summary: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.

AI.tldr: 自主AI代理会因构建工具近乎零成本、继承用户权限、留下未授权脚本与MCP服务器而加速Shadow IT的指数级增长；本文提出用"锚定远程服务身份+关联配置/安装/执行历史"的端点检测方法（Agent Detector），在12个合成代理的受控测试床上实现零误报、多数运行下全检出，并指出检测存在时间性局限。
AI.motivation: Shadow IT（未经IT组织批准的技术使用）是长期存在的治理难题。作者认为自主AI代理会使其急剧恶化：代理让搭建工具几乎免费、以用户权限行事、并留下脚本、自动化与MCP服务器等本身即未受批准的产物。由此形成治理闭环的起点——要淘汰这些产物，首先必须能检测到它们。
AI.method: 1) 建立简单的复利（compounding）模型，刻画代理产物在"复制速度快于组织退役速度"时的指数增长；2) 提出九类代理与六层端点足迹的分类体系；3) 论证仅凭进程与连接结构的规则无法区分代理与其"行为孪生体"（同一程序与非AI服务通信）；4) 实现开源Windows检测器Agent Detector：将行为锚定到远程服务身份，并与配置、安装、执行历史关联，使用含39个工具、184条LLM端点条目的目录；采用需用户确认的提示而非阻断。
AI.result: 在由12个合成代理、3个AI组件和9个良性工作负载组成的受控测试床上（单机重复5次）：两条纯行为规则把每个行为孪生体都误报，Agent Detector零误报且在多数运行中检出全部代理。局限为时间性：对处于共享CDN之后的提供商的连接仅在DNS缓存保留其名称期间可归因（约1–5分钟），间歇性代理约每3次扫描才被看到1次；单次扫描约154 ms。测试床规模过小，不足以对检测器排序。
AI.conclusion: 测试床的价值在于厘清各类证据的可见边界：未授权代理可被部分检测，且不能仅靠行为检测；检测需结合服务身份与系统历史等多元证据，治理应从"检测—退役"入手，而非单纯依赖行为规则或阻断手段。

title: The comparison of density estimation for transfer learning in Banach, Hilbert, Euclidean spaces
summary:
Domain adaptation or DA methods are indispensable when target labels or computational resources are scarce, yet the domain kernel density and subspace alignment approaches completely assume a Hilbertian geometry.
  They measure distributional discrepancy with symmetric L2 divergences over Euclidean feature spaces or reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS). This preprint summarizes the manuscript Non-Hilbertian Domain Adaptation. Total Variation Alignment via L1 Density Regularization on Feature Manifolds, which proposes Banach Manifold Transfer Learning or BMTL. BMTL makes two coupled design decisions. The first one is that features are embedded on a geodesic manifold rather than treated as points of a flat Euclidean space, and the second one is that the density matching regularizer is formulated in an L1 Banach norm, whose minimization is equivalent, by Scheffe's theorem, to contracting the Total Variation or TV distance between domain densities, a bounded metric that weights all regions of the sample space uniformly. The L2 formulation, by contrast, squares deviations and therefore amplifies errors in the tails, over emphasizing density outliers that do not reflect meaningful distributional shift. Experiments on MNIST-USPS, COIL20, and Office+Caltech10 show consistent gains; the L1 variant beats an otherwise identical L2 ablation on every task, for example 92.44% vs. 89.80% on USPS->MNIST and surpasses the strongest baseline DMDA by +3.68% on average over twelve Office+Caltech transfers. This document situates the contribution with an explicit comparison of Euclidean, Hilbert, and Banach geometries.

AI.tldr: 该预印本提出Banach流形迁移学习（BMTL）：将特征嵌入测地流形，并用L1 Banach范数正则化密度匹配，依Scheffé定理等价于压缩域间Total Variation距离，从而在MNIST-USPS、COIL20、Office+Caltech10上一致优于L2消融与DMDA等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有域自适应方法（域核密度、子空间对齐）均假定Hilbert几何，用欧氏特征空间或RKHS上的对称L2散度度量分布差异。L2对偏差取平方，会放大尾部误差、过度强调不反映真实分布漂移的密度离群点，因而在目标标签或算力稀缺场景下几何假设与度量选择均不理想。
AI.method: BMTL包含两项耦合设计：(1) 特征嵌入测地流形而非平坦欧氏空间的点；(2) 密度匹配正则项采用L1 Banach范数，据Scheffé定理其最小化等价于收缩域密度的Total Variation距离——该有界度量对样本空间所有区域均匀加权。文中并给出欧氏、Hilbert与Banach几何的显式对比。
AI.result: MNIST-USPS、COIL20、Office+Caltech10上获得一致增益；L1变体在每个任务上均胜过其余条件相同的L2消融，如USPS->MNIST为92.44%对89.80%；在十二个Office+Caltech迁移任务上平均超过最强基线DMDA +3.68%。
AI.conclusion: 以Banach几何替代Hilbert几何是有益的域自适应设计选择：TV/L1密度正则对尾部误差不敏感、加权均匀，实证上稳定优于L2方案与主流基线，表明非Hilbert度量在分布对齐中具有实用价值。

title: Reconstructing hourly traffic on every street of a capital from a sparse counting network: a graph neural network applied to Paris
summary: Micro-scale air quality models require hourly traffic data on every road segment, whereas permanent counters cover only a small part of the network. A graph neural network (GNN) was developed to reconstruct hourly traffic flows on the 32,163 road segments of Paris intra-muros from the 1,573 segments equipped with a counter (4.9%). The model adapts the Graph Neural Network for Urban Interpolation (GNNUI) to a real, sparse counting network. Flows are decoded on the edges of the junction graph (one edge per segment, both directions summed), a traffic climatology serves as an offset in a zero-inflated negative-binomial likelihood, and training proceeds by masking counters. Eight-fold spatial cross-validation, with counters sharing a published series merged before splitting, distinguishes interpolation at a withheld counter in an instrumented district (R${}^2$ = 0.89, error of a quarter of the mean flow) from extrapolation to a district without counters (R${}^2$ = 0.74, a third of the mean flow). These scores hold on main axes where counters are located, while relative errors are about 50% on the few counted local streets. Ablations show that the climatology offset tends to help extrapolation. Road attributes, time cycles and the live state of the counting network matter most, while weather inputs have no significant effect. The masking rate is the only inherited hyperparameter with a clear effect. When evaluated on January--August 2026 (outside the training period), the frozen model stayed around the error band of previous years.

AI.tldr: 将GNNUI适配到真实稀疏计数网络，用交通气候学作偏移、掩码计数器训练，在巴黎32,163条路段上重建逐时交通流，插值R²=0.89、外推R²=0.74。
AI.motivation: 微观空气质量模型需要每条路段的逐时交通流数据，而固定计数器仅覆盖路网的4.9%（巴黎1,573/32,163），亟需从稀疏观测重建全网流量。
AI.method: 将Graph Neural Network for Urban Interpolation（GNNUI）适配真实稀疏计数网络；在交叉口图的边上解码流量（每条路段一条边、双向求和）；以交通气候学作为零膨胀负二项似然中的偏移项；通过掩码计数器进行训练；采用八折空间交叉验证，并在划分前合并共享同一公开序列的计数器。
AI.result: 有计数器街区的留出计数器插值R²=0.89（误差约为均值流量的四分之一），无计数器街区外推R²=0.74（约三分之一均值流量）；在计数器所在的主干轴上保持该表现，少数有计数的局部街道相对误差约50%。消融显示气候学偏移有助于外推；道路属性、时间周期与计数网络实时状态最重要，天气输入无显著影响；继承的超参数中仅掩码率有明显作用。在训练期外（2026年1–8月）评估时，冻结模型误差仍处于往年区间。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在仅覆盖约5%路段的真实计数网络上实现高精度逐时流量重建，插值优于外推且可靠性主要依赖主干道，模型跨期保持稳定，可支撑微观空气质量建模。

title: Orthogonal Updates for the Win: Towards Accelerated Adaptive Minimax Optimization
summary: Single-loop minimax methods are appealing for modern machine learning, but standard stochastic gradient updates can be unstable and oscillatory under tightly coupled primal-dual dynamics, making performance notoriously sensitive to stepsizes. To fundamentally improve stability, we develop an orthogonal update framework tailored to minimax optimization, which applies updates along orthogonalized directions to reduce update anisotropy. However, orthogonalization reshapes the optimization geometry and makes coordinating primal-dual stepsizes even more delicate. To overcome this challenge, we develop AdaSGDA, which equips orthogonal updates with an adaptive stepsize rule driven by accumulated gradient norms. This mechanism automatically balances coupled primal-dual progress under orthogonalization, yielding an effectively parameter-free method for nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization. We prove that AdaSGDA avoids problem-dependent tuning while attaining the state-of-the-art $\mathcal{O}\left(T^{-1/4}\right)$ convergence rate. We further propose AdaSGDA-VR, which incorporates a carefully designed variance reduction scheme and achieves the faster $\mathcal{O}\left(T^{-1/3}\right)$ rate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our methods deliver competitive performance compared to existing minimax optimization methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对minimax优化中单循环随机梯度更新的不稳定与振荡问题，提出正交更新框架，并结合自适应步长得到免调参的AdaSGDA及其方差缩减版本AdaSGDA-VR。
AI.motivation: 单循环minimax方法在机器学习中很有吸引力，但在原始-对偶强耦合动力学下，标准随机梯度更新易产生不稳定和振荡，性能对步长极其敏感。作者希望从根本上提升稳定性，同时避免繁琐的步长调参。
AI.method: 1) 构建面向minimax优化的正交更新框架，沿正交化方向更新以降低更新各向异性；2) 由于正交化改变了优化几何，使原始-对偶步长的协调更微妙，因此提出AdaSGDA，用累积梯度范数驱动的自适应步长规则自动平衡正交化下的耦合原始-对偶进展；3) 进一步设计方差缩减方案得到AdaSGDA-VR。
AI.result: 在非凸-强凹minimax设定下，理论上证明AdaSGDA无需问题相关调参即可达到当前最优的O(T^{-1/4})收敛率，AdaSGDA-VR达到更快的O(T^{-1/3})速率；大量实验表明其性能与现有minimax优化方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 正交化更新结合梯度范数自适应步长可有效缓解minimax优化的不稳定与振荡，实现"有效免参"的单循环算法，并通过方差缩减进一步加速，为minimax优化提供稳定且实用的新范式。

title: AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace
summary: As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AutoBuddy-Bench 模拟器，用于评估 LLM 智能体在知识工作场景中的"主动任务发现与执行"能力，并发现不同能力模型的失败环节存在系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常直接把任务交给智能体，但真实知识工作中请求隐含在用户的工作区里，智能体需先自主识别义务所在。因此需要研究主动任务发现与执行，并解决两个挑战：任务淹没在海量邮件、聊天、文档与记录中；评测需要一个内部自洽的模拟组织以生成真实任务并确定正确结果。
AI.method: 构建 AutoBuddy-Bench 模拟器：将组织的员工、项目、业务系统与事件历史建模为时序图，渲染为真实的工作区素材，从产生义务的事件中推导出 ground-truth 任务，并依据世界状态计算任务结果；执行效果通过智能体对工作区的改动来评判。同时构建参考智能体 AutoBuddy，可从工作区识别任务、将每个任务溯源至其源记录，并在具备写权限的独立会话中执行；仅替换其骨干 LLM 进行对照实验。
AI.result: 仅改变骨干模型时，任务丢失环节出现系统性迁移：弱模型主要在发现阶段失败；中等模型能识别任务但常止步于执行前；最强模型主要在执行业务系统操作时失败。任务发现精确率与执行质量仅弱相关，表明二者是相互独立的能力。
AI.conclusion: 主动式知识工作智能体的评测应区分"发现"与"执行"两类能力，AutoBuddy-Bench 提供了此类评测的可行范式，并揭示了当前 LLM 的瓶颈随能力提升从发现向执行转移。

title: Decomposing Earth Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将地球观测基础模型的稠密嵌入分解为稀疏、近似单义的过完备字典特征，并设计适配空间自相关的评估协议；结果显示SAE在匹配稀疏度下重建优于所有基线，特征与参考概念的对齐度远低于原始维度，且方差更集中于细空间尺度，但两项下游应用尚不足以实用。
AI.motivation: 地球观测基础模型（如AlphaEarth、Tessera）输出全球米级分辨率的稠密嵌入，但各维度纠缠无关物理概念，导致可解释性差、鲁棒性难以评估；同时，LLM对解释的评判不适用于卫星像元，且空间自相关不可忽略，缺少合适的评估方法。
AI.method: 将SAE用于地球嵌入的可解释分解（BatchTopK、Matryoshka等变体）；提出定制评估协议，从三方面评分：匹配稀疏度下的重建质量、与参考概念的对齐度、空间尺度分布，并与多个基线对比，其中包括解码器为冻结随机字典的SAE。
AI.result: SAE在匹配稀疏度下对AlphaEarth与Tessera的重建优于所有基线；特征对齐的参考概念远少于原始维度（AlphaEarth上88%的特征至多对齐20个概念组中的1个，多数无对齐，而原始维度中位数为12）；更多方差集中于细空间尺度（BatchTopK与Matryoshka在640 m斑块内为23–32%，对比基线9%）；冻结随机解码器的SAE同样具备上述两性质，说明其源于稀疏性，而只有学习得到的字典才能准确重建（训练SAE的未解释方差少8倍）。应用上探索了地物子概念发现与基于适用域估计的分布外像元检测，但均尚不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏性与学习字典各自贡献不同属性，SAE为可解释的地球观测特征提供了可行路径；所提评估协议可推广至任意SAE，但下游应用仍需进一步改进才能实用。

title: AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions
summary: Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.

AI.tldr: AuDiR 通过四种条件化输入干预（原始、给规则、给规则+声学观察文本、去音频）区分音频问答中"声学感知失败、规则知识缺失、规则应用失败"三类失败来源，但作者明确其只能给出操作性标签而非唯一内部归因。
AI.motivation: 仅凭答案正确率无法区分失败究竟源于声学感知、规则知识还是规则应用，需要一个能对输入信息进行受控干预、从而分离这些环节的诊断型基准。
AI.method: 构建 AuDiR 基准：每题含音频片段、多项选择题、任务通用规则、以及回答所需的声学观察文本描述。设置三个递进条件逐步提供规则与观察，第四个条件移除音频但保留问题与规则；以首个答对的条件作为操作性响应标签，而非唯一内部病因。数据为 201 题、18 个家族、9 个来源，答案标注与感知抽取分离记录；并用 Gemini-3.8-flash 做初步评测，辅以家族级知识探测。
AI.result: 无信息时准确率 29.3%，提供规则后 31.3%，再提供声学观察文本后达 98.5%；无音频条件 23.9%，置信区间覆盖 25.0% 随机水平。家族级知识探测发现规则回忆不完整与从规则提供中获益更大相关。存在非单调响应。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明以文本形式提供声学观察带来显著增益；但验证不充分、可能存在识别捷径及非单调响应，限制了更强的失败归因结论。

title: Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability
summary: We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most $B$. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in $\log(2+B)$. The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale $B^{-2}$. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on $B$. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent $2$ is necessary.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究有限时域MDP中的离线策略优化：每个确定性Markov策略的动作价值函数在已知特征下线性、系数范数不超过B。在单条未知Markov行为策略的独立完整轨迹与全策略占用覆盖下，给出样本复杂度为Õ(ε⁻²)、计算复杂度对log(2+B)多项式的算法，且每层仅做一次凸回归。
AI.motivation: 已有离线策略优化/离线强化学习理论大多需要大量策略被覆盖检查、较强的可实现性假设，或计算复杂度对B（系数范数上界）呈不利依赖。作者希望在这些维度同时改进：只对确定性策略要求可实现性与覆盖、允许任意初始状态分布、并让计算量仅依赖log(2+B)而对B的规模不敏感；同时厘清精度指数2的必要性。
AI.method: 1) 数据：来自同一未知Markov行为策略的独立完整轨迹；假设全策略占用测度覆盖。2) 每层只求解一次凸（一种快速裁剪回归/clipped regression）问题。3) 回归目标为“停时回报”(stopped-return)，其值由单一一致的Markov见证策略(witness policy)给出，从而保证层间一致性。4) 用共享的参考设计与有界预测约束，把快速裁剪回归误差转为对原始线性预测的逐点置信界。5) 用截断杠杆(truncated leverage)控制性能损失，避免在B⁻²尺度上做经验协方差近似。6) 将置信半径向上取整以保留精确的见证策略，从而在有理数输入下得到多项式时间比特实现。7) 另给出协方差覆盖下的变体：统一近似可实现性、对B多项式依赖。8) 证明两动作情形下的下界：精度指数2是必要的。
AI.result: 得到了样本复杂度Õ(ε⁻²)、计算复杂度对log(2+B)多项式的离线策略优化算法，每层仅一次凸回归；支持任意固定初始状态分布；可实现性与覆盖只需对确定性策略成立。给出协方差覆盖变体，具有统一近似可实现性和对B的多项式依赖。两动作下界表明ε的指数2是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了计算高效、样本近最优的线性MDP离线策略优化算法，显著放宽可实现性/覆盖假设（仅需确定性策略、任意初始分布），并通过对B的对数级依赖与有理输入的精确比特实现提升了实用性；下界刻画了ε⁻²的统计必要性。

title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
summary: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SciMARS框架，对闭环科学发现中的多智能体执行架构进行递归式任务局部自适应，通过独立组件编辑器改写角色与协作，并可选加入记忆编辑器，在多个基准上显著提升任务解决率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在科学发现中协同分析、实验设计与验证，但存在两大瓶颈：缺乏共享记忆导致观测丢失与重复劳动；固定的角色流程、交接与记忆策略使错误被持续继承，即便证据已被保留也无法纠正。
AI.method: 构建共享证据图（shared evidence graph），并设置相互独立的组件编辑器。SciMARS 自适应地调整角色与协调方式；SciMARS + Memory 额外增加第三个编辑器，用于控制智能体记录、检索与接收证据的方式。候选探针（candidate probes）用于指导下一轮执行架构的组合与选择，形成递归式任务局部适配。
AI.result: 在 Autonomous Science Bench 上，SciMARS + Memory 于 GPT-6-Astra 上解决 12/18、GLM-5.3 上解决 2/18，基线多智能体团队分别为 8/18 与 1/18；在 ScienceAgentBench 与 AppWorld 上分别解决 14/38 与 11/20，基线为 11/38 与 5/20。
AI.conclusion: 将共享记忆与执行架构自适应相结合，可同时提升科学发现类与交互类任务的表现，说明记忆机制与组件级流程编辑具有互补价值。

title: CHANNELS4WORLD: An Environment-Scale Dataset for Wireless Foundation Models
summary: Wireless foundation models learn reusable representations across tasks, configurations, and deployment environments. Their pretraining requires environmental breadth, yet wireless datasets often sample few sites densely. We introduce Channels4World, a scene-centered dataset of 100,000 distinct outdoor RF scenes and a procedural method for generating them. Each scene links a generated environment and RF material assignments to 32 base-station (BS) positions, 16,384 UE positions, and aligned variable-length multipath and ordered interaction records at 3.5 and 7~GHz. The corpus comprises 52.43 billion physical BS-UE pairs, 104.86 billion frequency-specific evaluations, and a 29.14-TB packaged payload. Scene identity aligns geometry, placements, channels, and interactions across frequencies, allowing environmental breadth and within-scene observation density to vary independently. The public release offers predefined subsets at multiple scales and separate access to corpus components. A deterministic 90K/10K scene-level train-test split keeps both frequencies and all scene components together. We characterize morphology, RF materials, and transceiver placement across three generation profiles. Controlled propagation and path-retention analyses show that diffraction materially affects retained-link availability and multipath structure, while the retention policy reduces storage substantially with little loss in represented aggregate power. Under matched training exposure, models trained on broader scene collections perform better on held-out scenes, although an equal-episode control shows that scene count alone cannot explain the gain. By making environmental breadth explicit and controllable, Channels4World supports the development and evaluation of wireless foundation models for generalization across deployment environments.

AI.tldr: Channels4World 是一个以场景为中心的大规模户外无线信道数据集，含 10 万个独立 RF 场景及可程序化生成方法，用于训练和评测无线基础模型的跨环境泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 无线基础模型需要跨任务、配置与部署环境的可复用表示，其预训练依赖环境多样性；但现有无线数据集往往只采样少量站点并做密集测量，环境广度不足且难以独立调控。
AI.method: 提出 Channels4World 数据集与程序化生成流程：每个场景将生成的环境几何与 RF 材料赋值，关联 32 个基站位置、16,384 个 UE 位置，以及 3.5 GHz 与 7 GHz 下对齐的变长多径和有序交互记录；提供多尺度预定义子集与组件化访问，并采用确定性 9 万/1 万场景级训练-测试划分（频率与场景组件同步划分）。实验上刻画三种生成剖面下的形态学、RF 材料与收发端布局，并进行受控传播与路径保留分析及匹配训练曝光下的对比实验。
AI.result: 语料规模达 524.3 亿 BS-UE 对、1048.6 亿次频率特定评估、29.14 TB 封装数据。分析表明衍射显著影响保留链路的可用性与多径结构；路径保留策略在大幅压缩存储的同时，对聚合功率表示的损失很小。在匹配训练曝光下，基于更广场景集合训练的模型在留出场景上表现更优，但等片段控制实验显示仅场景数量本身并不能解释该增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式且可控地引入环境广度，Channels4World 为无线基础模型在跨部署环境泛化方面的开发与评测提供了支撑。

title: Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather
summary: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出Multi-STG框架，将LLM语义先验与图时空学习结合，用于恶劣天气下的城市交通流预测。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动模型在罕见气象事件下因数据稀疏、非线性突变而失效，且仅将环境上下文当作浅层数值特征，缺乏对"特定恶劣条件如何改变不同功能区出行行为"的语义推理能力。
AI.method: 三部分：(1) LLM赋能的语义增强模块，将天气、POI、节假日等上下文描述转为高层语义嵌入，作为知识驱动的数据补充；(2) 多模态注意力融合机制，动态加权异构输入；(3) 语义增强预测头，配门控残差校准，依据语义引导稳健调整预测。
AI.result: 在真实多城市私家车数据集上优于SOTA基线，三城市平均MAE相对最强基线降低11.82%，且在稀疏与非平稳条件下保持稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入LLM语义先验可有效弥补数据稀缺并刻画气象-功能区的语义耦合，验证了语义增强与图时空学习融合在恶劣天气交通预测中的有效性。

title: Learning to Rank Propagators in Constraint Programming
summary: The order in which propagators are executed can substantially affect the performance of constraint programming solvers, yet propagator priorities are typically determined by fixed, manually designed heuristics. In this work, we explore learning instance-dependent propagator priorities from static problem features. We formulate the task as a learning-to-rank problem, addressing the challenge that the quality of a priority assignment can be measured through solver runtime, while the desired priorities of individual propagators are not directly observable. A self-attention-based model jointly scores the propagators present in an instance and is trained using pairwise preferences derived from solver runtimes measured under randomized propagator priority assignments, with a Plackett-Luce-based ranking objective. Predicted rankings are mapped to the discrete priority levels of the Choco solver before search begins, without modifying its propagation or search procedures. We evaluate the approach on XCSP3 instances and demonstrate that propagator ordering can have a substantial impact on solving time. On a test set of 698 instances, picked out as most difficult by problem class, the learned priorities increase the number of solved instances from 634 to 654, reduce median solver runtime by 27.93%, and reduce aggregate penalized runtime (PAR1) by 12.65% compared with Choco's default priorities. We further observe that improvements vary across problem classes and show that a simple policy selecting between learned and default priorities further increases the number of solved instances. These results demonstrate the potential of learning instance-dependent propagator priorities to improve constraint programming performance, particularly on difficult instances.

AI.tldr: 该论文从静态问题特征学习实例相关的传播器优先级，将任务建模为排序学习问题，用自注意力模型联合打分传播器，以求解器运行时间导出的成对偏好和Plackett-Luce目标训练，并将预测排序映射为Choco的离散优先级。
AI.motivation: 传播器执行顺序显著影响约束规划求解器性能，但现有优先级多由固定的人工设计启发式决定，缺乏对实例特性的适应性。
AI.method: 形式化为learning-to-rank问题：以随机优先级下测得的求解器运行时间构造传播器成对偏好；采用自注意力模型对实例中所有传播器联合打分；以Plackett-Luce排序目标训练；搜索前将预测排序映射为Choco的离散优先级等级，不修改其传播与搜索流程。在XCSP3实例上评估。
AI.result: 在按问题类别筛选出的698个最难测试实例上，学习优先级使求解实例数从634提升至654，中位运行时间降低27.93%，PAR1降低12.65%；改进随问题类别而异，且一个在学习优先级与默认优先级间选择的简单策略可进一步增加求解数量。
AI.conclusion: 学习实例相关的传播器优先级可有效提升约束规划性能，尤其在困难实例上。

title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Presented as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS). Code and data: https://github.com/hanktang-research/TrialDesignBench
summary: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrialDesignBench——包含617项I期/I-II期肿瘤剂量探索试验的基准，每项配有符合最新FDA监管要求的专家验证参考设计，用于评估LLM辅助的临床试验统计设计能力。
AI.motivation: 临床试验统计设计是决定药物剂量如何在人体测试与评估的关键环节，但AI在此几乎无进展。LLM在生物医学知识与统计推理上有优势，却缺乏合适的评估手段；同时FDA Project Optimus等监管与方法学变革重定义了"合理设计"，使大量旧设计失效。
AI.method: 构建617项I期/I-II期肿瘤剂量探索试验的基准，通过与专家设计流程形式化一致的方法生成专家验证的参考设计；评估五个前沿LLM，并进行消融实验以定位性能差距来源。
AI.result: 五个前沿LLM均未达到参考标准；性能差距主要源于两点：一是从试验资料中推断未记录的潜在设计决定因素（提供这些因素可使类别平衡准确率提升0.22），二是结构化决策树推理（提升0.24）。
AI.conclusion: TrialDesignBench为评估与提升AI辅助试验设计提供了可复现、符合当代监管标准的客观基准，并为后续AI方法改进指明方向。

title: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了on-policy distillation（OPD）对训练-推理不一致（mismatch）的容忍度，发现OPD存在经验性的"mismatch预算"，并据此提出轻量准入检查与FP8配方，实现1.93× KV-cache容量与1.62×训练加速。
AI.motivation: OPD需在学生的自生成响应上训练，而量化推理与异步rollout虽降低成本却引入rollout引擎与训练模型间的不一致。该不一致会破坏RL稳定性，但其对OPD的影响尚不明确，体系需量化其容忍度并加以利用。
AI.method: 将所有不一致来源统一到同一尺度度量：在三组学生-教师对上考察量化影响，并在其中一对上测试权重陈旧（weight staleness）与注入噪声；与RL方法做受控对比；分析逐层敏感性与前缀漂移；提出基于校准预算的轻量准入检查，并给出模型特定的FP8配方。
AI.result: OPD可容忍显著不一致而训练质量无明显损失，超过阈值后性能下降，呈经验mismatch预算；质量代价与量化引入的不一致均依赖模型，部分层对低精度尤为敏感；在会破坏RL的rollout配置下OPD仍稳定；权重噪声还会使生成前缀发生偏移，逐token校正无法修复。FP8配方保持质量并提供≥1.93× BF16的KV-cache容量；FP8+异步rollout比同步BF16快1.62×达到同等质量。
AI.conclusion: OPD对训练-推理不一致具有可量化的容忍区间，可将该容忍度转化为系统效率：通过准入检查筛选配置、结合模型特定FP8与异步rollout，在保持训练质量的同时显著提升吞吐与KV-cache容量。

title: Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific
summary: Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.

AI.tldr: 通过仅用无标注提示拟合的残差流映射，可将拒答方向、正确性方向与情感探针跨模型迁移；迁移效果取决于映射拟合所用的数据覆盖范围，加入工具作用区域的无标注提示后恢复率可达102%（拒答）与88%–98%（正确性），而对照方向至多1%。
