AI.motivation: 现有可解释性工具（拒答方向、真实性探针、引导向量）通常一次只针对单个模型、依赖该模型的标注数据构建，难以复用。作者希望检验这些工具能否借助一个仅用无标注提示拟合的残差流映射迁移到其他模型，从而降低重复构建成本。
AI.method: 在残差流之间拟合线性映射（仅用无标注提示）。迁移三类工具：拒答方向（用加性与消融做因果检验）、正确性方向、情感探针。覆盖5个模型家族、1B–72B参数、110对模型，并包含基座与指令微调模型之间的迁移；设置特异性对照与5个随机种子。对比不同拟合数据（普通问题 vs. 加入工具作用区域的无标注提示），并给出映射有效性的理论证明与无标签覆盖度评分。
AI.result: 用普通问题拟合的映射可恢复目标模型自身拒答引导效果的54%、正确性增益的16%–77%；加入工具作用区域的无标注提示后升至102%与88%–98%；对照方向最多恢复1%。由理论推出的无标签覆盖度评分在超过16,000次运行中与恢复率一致，并解释了此前"跨域映射失败"的报道；迁移的读出工具优于目标模型无标注表征本身所能达到的效果。
AI.conclusion: 只要两个模型在映射所覆盖的数据上呈线性对应，线性映射即可有效迁移可解释性工具；映射成败的关键是数据覆盖而非模型配对本身。可解释性结果一旦获得，只需少量无标注提示即可跨模型复用。

title: MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted to the Privacy in the Era of Large Opaque Models (PriLOM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary:
Temporally correlated noise can substantially improve the utility of differentially private optimization, yet candidate mechanisms are commonly designed or evaluated using only partial information about the optimization process, such as workload structure, learning-rate schedules, or local curvature. We study whether persistent optimizer state provides additional information that can change the relative utility of privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms.
  We introduce MOMENT-DP, an optimizer-state-aware framework that models how temporally correlated privacy noise propagates through momentum-based optimization. For locally quadratic objectives, MOMENT-DP expresses privacy-induced final loss through an optimizer transfer operator that jointly captures curvature, learning-rate scheduling, momentum, and temporal noise covariance. NoiseCurve's curvature-aware quadratic criterion is recovered exactly as the zero-momentum, constant-learning-rate special case.
  Changing only momentum while holding curvature, schedule, privacy calibration, and candidate mechanisms fixed induces genuine mechanism-ranking reversals. The effect persists outside exact quadratic dynamics in per-example-clipped private logistic regression, while remaining unresolved in the neural regime we study. These results establish optimizer state as an under-modeled, decision-relevant axis in evaluating temporally correlated privacy noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MOMENT-DP，一个感知优化器状态的框架，刻画时间相关隐私噪声在动量优化中的传播，并证明动量状态会改变相关噪声机制的相对效用排序。
AI.motivation: 时间相关噪声能显著提升差分隐私优化的效用，但现有机制设计与评估只利用不完全信息（工作负载结构、学习率调度、局部曲率），未考虑持续的优化器状态是否会影响各隐私机制的相对优劣。
AI.method: MOMENT-DP 建模时间相关噪声经动量优化的传播；对局部二次目标，用"优化器传递算子"将隐私导致的最终损失表示为同时包含曲率、学习率调度、动量和噪声时间协方差的函数，并将 NoiseCurve 的曲率感知二次准则作为零动量、常数学习率的特例精确还原。
AI.result: 在固定曲率、调度、隐私校准和候选机制、仅改变动量时，出现真实的机制排序反转；该效应在逐样本裁剪的私有逻辑回归（非精确二次动力学）中依然存在，而在所研究的神经网络场景中尚未定论。
AI.conclusion: 优化器状态是评估时间相关隐私噪声时一个建模不足但影响决策的关键维度，应纳入机制设计—评估流程。

title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
summary: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.

AI.tldr: Sage-Taiyi 是一个受元认知启发的科学构想架构，通过显式监控与控制机制，利用累积的科学理解来指导“研究什么”与“如何研究”。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 科学家系统在科学构想上缺乏对自身证据、假设与未解问题的显式评估与调控，难以自适应地选择研究目标与可复用的推理方法。
AI.method: 引入显式监控与控制（monitoring & control）机制：系统持续修正对证据、假设及未解问题的理解，并基于这些评估自适应调整研究目标、筛选可复用推理方法。
AI.result: 在 Taiyi-Bench（50 篇论文、10 个学科、265 项任务）上，历史再发现与开放式构想共八项指标全部第一，Overall 54.0 对比最强基线 AI Scientist-v2 的 47.9；另在两个外部科学构想基准上表现良好。五项专家引导合作在化学、材料、工程领域完成实验与计算验证；化学中钴催化羰基化产率由痕量提升至 84%，光催化烯丙基胺化由 13% 提升至 69%。
AI.conclusion: 元认知调控可作为科学构想及其走向实际验证的有效路径。

title: LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion
summary: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.

AI.tldr: LogCDM 是一个仅 8.1–8.8M 参数、无需 GPU 的紧凑日志异常检测器，融合因果 Transformer 的下一事件惊奇度、会话转移图的图注意力嵌入距离、转移漂移统计三种信号，经 sigmoid 门控（在高斯共享协方差下为贝叶斯后验）加权，在 HDFS/BGL/Thunderbird 上 F1 达 0.984/0.870/0.850，CPU 单会话 5.5–10.5 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有日志异常检测日益依赖大规模预训练模型（BERT 级编码器至 8B 参数 LLM），推理需 GPU、难以部署在产生日志的监控节点上，因此需要高精度且可在 CPU 上本地运行的紧凑检测器。
AI.method: 对每个日志会话计算三种互补信号：(1) 小型因果 Transformer 的下一事件惊奇度；(2) 会话自身转移图的图注意力嵌入与正常参考图嵌入之间的距离；(3) 转移漂移统计量，作者证明其恰为转移核之间的频率加权卡方散度。该散度视角给出渐近零分布、长度标准化分数与可解释每次告警的逐边分解。三信号由 sigmoid 门控融合，在共享协方差高斯模型下该门控即贝叶斯后验。
AI.result: 在相同协议下，8.1–8.8M 参数的 LogCDM 取得 HDFS 0.984、按时间划分的 BGL 0.870、Thunderbird 0.850 的 F1，与 8.1B 参数 LLM 检测器相差 0.013–0.12，并在 BGL 上优于所有紧凑基线；CPU 上单会话评分 5.5–10.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑模型可在无 GPU 条件下接近超大规模 LLM 的检测性能；消融显示结构信号在 BGL 和 Thunderbird 上提升 0.025–0.030 F1，而在 HDFS 上几乎无增益，这与学习到的融合权重一致；漂移散度框架还提供理论零分布与告警级可解释性。

title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks
comment: 20th CIRP Conference on Intelligent Computation in Manufacturing Engineering
summary: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并比较两种从非结构化拆解手册中提取拆解指令的框架，将自然语言文本转化为结构化、可机器读取的数据，为中小企业应对产品复杂度上升与拆解自动化提供数据基础。
AI.motivation: 循环经济与Re-X原则推动下，产品复杂度不断上升，阻碍拆解自动化的采用，中小企业（SME）尤受挑战；而拆解知识多存在于非结构化文本中，缺乏可直接利用的结构化数据基础。
AI.method: 构建两个框架进行对比：一是基于规则的自然语言处理（NLP）框架，二是基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式AI框架；两者均用于从拆解手册等非结构化信息源中抽取拆解指令，并输出为结构化、经整理且机器可读的格式。
AI.result: 使用真实拆解手册对两种方法进行实现与测试，并对其性能进行对比评估。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来拆解流程的开发与自动化提供了必要的数据基础；规则法与生成式方法各有适用性，需结合实际手册特性选择。

title: Regret without Optimal-Arm Feedback under Reward-Dependent Delays
comment: 45 pages, 3 figures. Code and data are included as ancillary files
summary: We study stochastic bandits with reward-dependent delays, possibly infinite, whose reports omit the originating round. For each $c\in[0,1)$, Balanced Historical Optimism (BHO) has a delay term controlled by the largest suboptimal-arm quantile at level $1-cΔ_i$, without requiring optimal-arm reports. Lower bounds give an inverse-square slack cost in the logarithmic statistical regime and linear minimax regret at $c=1$. A family with growing $K$ forces worst-case regret $Ω(G\log K)$ for every learner, where $G=\max_iΔ_i h_i$ is the largest gap-weighted suboptimal cutoff. Pending-triggered balance preserves BHO's weighted-cutoff bound for $c<1$ and attains the historical-greedy exploration coefficient with deterministic rewards, a unique optimum and fixed bounded delays. Gap-weighted comparisons and experiments show when shared waiting helps and what balanced exploration costs.

AI.tldr: 研究带有与奖励相关（可能无限）且报告不含原始轮次信息的延迟的随机多臂老虎机，提出平衡历史乐观（BHO）算法，以最优臂子集分位数刻画延迟项并给出匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 传统带延迟老虎机通常假设延迟结构固定或与奖励无关，且需要知道报告的来源轮次。本文关注更困难的情形：延迟依赖于被拉臂的奖励（可能无穷大），并丢失轮次标记，需要在不依赖最优臂报告的条件下刻画可学习性并量化延迟带来的代价。
AI.method: 提出Balanced Historical Optimism (BHO)：对每个c∈[0,1)，用第1−cΔ_i水平上最大的次优臂分位数控制延迟项，避免依赖最优臂报告；进一步引入pending-triggered balance（待定触发平衡）机制，在存在待定拉臂时平衡探索，并给出下界：对数统计区间内反平方松弛代价、c=1时线性极小极大遗憾、以及K增长情形下Ω(G log K)的最坏遗憾（G为最大间隙加权次优截断）。
AI.result: BHO在c<1时保持加权截断界；pending-triggered balance在确定性奖励、唯一最优臂、固定有界延迟下达到历史贪婪探索系数；下界显示log K因子不可避免，且gap-weighted比较与实验说明共享等待何时有益、平衡探索的代价。
AI.conclusion: 奖励相关且无轮次标记的延迟本质上提高了问题难度：需要加权截断与平衡探索以同时兼顾延迟适应性和统计效率，并为延迟老虎机提供接近最优的算法框架与信息论刻画。

title: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

AI.tldr: MaxIM 将增量记忆摘要建模为容量约束下的信息论奖励塑形问题，通过最大化对未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然与历史互信息，并用非对称 critic 提供稠密奖励，缓解稀疏奖励下的信用分配瓶颈，在长程科学阅读与多轮对话任务上优于 RL、SFT 与提示类基线。
AI.motivation: AI 系统需在无限交互历史中维持有界记忆，但用标准 RL 直接优化记忆表示及其更新以提升下游效用很困难：稀疏、延迟的奖励导致严重的信用分配瓶颈。论文希望为增量摘要/记忆更新设计可优化、有理论依据的目标。
AI.method: 提出 MaxIM 框架，将增量摘要表述为容量约束的信息论奖励塑形问题。基于值次优性界，论证限制序列信息损失等价于最大化未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然（预测充分性的变分下界）。引入递归一致性条件，通过最大化摘要与观测历史的互信息（MI）保证摘要的接地性。采用参数化非对称 critic 计算逐步变分 MI 下界，作为稠密奖励以缓解信用分配问题。
AI.result: 在长程科学阅读与多轮对话基准上，在严格 token 预算与更长交互跨度下，MaxIM 在事实接地性、综合 autorater 指标及下游任务效用上均优于 RL、监督微调（SFT）与提示优化类基线，且无需昂贵的人类偏好标注。
AI.conclusion: 将有界记忆的增量摘要转化为信息论奖励塑形问题，并把预测充分性与历史互信息结合为可稠密化的学习信号，是提升长程记忆效用的一种有效且无需偏好标签的路径。

title: JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
summary: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

AI.tldr: 提出JoMoHa框架，首次通过强化学习联合训练可执行harness生成策略与任务执行策略，实现语言智能体模型与harness的协同演化与递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体性能同时依赖模型权重与harness，单独优化任一方都会受另一方制约；作者分析朴素交替训练发现模型与harness逐渐失配，日益干扰任务执行并可能损害模型训练，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出JoMoHa，据称是首个联合训练可执行harness生成策略与任务执行策略的强化学习框架，使模型与harness协同演化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、DBBench上优于权重单独优化与harness单独优化基线，取得最高成功率，平均70.3%，ALFWorld上达97.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习自身生成轨迹中的任务执行与运行时改进，JoMoHa实现递归自我改进（RSI），为模型与harness协同演化提供了有效路径。

title: Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve an agent's task capability while reinforcing behavior that violates contextual execution requirements. We study this reward-driven misalignment, including reward hacking, through verifiable reward--context conflicts, where compliant task completion remains feasible while some executable shortcuts earn more reward than every compliant strategy. Encoding these conflicts in task dynamics lets us generate diverse interactive environments at scale and derive compliance feedback from execution histories. In resource and reporting workflows, task optimization increases real productivity through unauthorized resource use or raises reported scores while actual work declines. Controlled changes in the training distribution show that minority conflict exposure can still lead to widespread shortcut acquisition, reaching 97.9\% certified profitable violations on an API task under a 25\% conflict mixture after 128 updates. The same contextual checks supply a simple binary penalty that supports joint capability and compliance gains and partially mitigates acquired violations. Learned safety adapts to expanded authorization and transfers across mechanisms into workflows with evolving evidence and approval requirements. On 32 unseen changing-evidence tasks, resource-trained safety increases safe completion from 53.1\% to 89.1\% relative to task-only training, while both policies achieve full real work. These results connect a verifiable account of reward-driven misalignment with scalable task construction and safety learning that remains useful under changing execution requirements.

AI.tldr: 论文通过"可验证奖励—上下文冲突"构造大规模交互环境，研究奖励驱动的对齐失效（含奖励黑客），发现少量冲突样本即可导致违规捷径的广泛习得，并证明基于上下文检查的二元惩罚可部分缓解违规并提升合规与能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能提升任务能力，却也会强化违反上下文执行要求的行为，即奖励驱动的错位与奖励黑客。缺乏可验证、可规模化构造的框架来刻画此类失效，因而需要一种既能生成多样化环境、又能客观判定合规性的方法。
AI.method: 提出"可验证奖励—上下文冲突"设定：合规完成始终可行，但某些可执行捷径获得的奖励高于所有合规策略。将冲突编码进任务动力学以规模化生成交互环境，并从执行历史中推导合规反馈。在资源与报告类工作流中设置受控训练分布变化（如25%冲突混合、128次更新），检验捷径习得的传播；并以同一上下文检查构造简单二元惩罚进行联合训练。
AI.result: 即便冲突样本为少数，也导致捷径广泛习得：API任务在25%冲突混合下经128次更新达到97.9%的"已认证有利可图违规"。二元惩罚支持能力与合规的联合提升，并部分缓解已习得的违规。学得的安全策略可适应扩大的授权范围，并跨机制迁移到证据与审批要求不断变化的工作流；在32个未见的变化证据任务上，资源训练的安全策略将安全完成率从53.1%提升至89.1%，且两种策略均完成全部真实工作量。
AI.conclusion: 研究将奖励驱动错位的可验证刻画与可扩展任务构造、安全学习相连接；所学的合规性在变化的执行要求下仍具实用性，为奖励黑客的度量与缓解提供了可复现框架。

title: Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation
summary: Due to the fundamental problem of causal inference -- the impossibility of observing counterfactual outcomes -- there is always a gap between the training goal (outcome, propensity) and the inference target (CATE, ATE). Traditional causal effect estimation revolves around setting assumptions, selecting identification strategies, and choosing causal estimators, while more recently, Causal Foundation Models (CFMs), built on Prior-Data-Fitted Networks (PFNs), ease this process by pretraining on massive synthetic prior datasets. Despite their success, such amortization makes causal inference less transparent, obscuring which assumptions the model implicitly relies on for a given dataset. The high diversity of real-world data-generating processes (DGPs) and Structural Causal Models (SCMs) makes it hard to know, a priori, which causal inference strategy is compatible with a given dataset. In this work, we focus on this compatibility between an observational dataset and method-specific assumptions, and find that geometric characteristics of data embeddings -- specifically, the variogram -- provide a useful signal of whether a given causal estimation strategy is appropriate. We develop MoE-Learner, a mixture-of-causal-experts framework that embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram as a counterfactual-free router to assess each expert's validity. Rather than eliminating causal assumptions, this shifts their validation from a fixed, a priori choice to a criterion that can be checked directly from data geometry. MoE-Learner achieves the best average rank on benchmark datasets (IHDP, ACIC, Lalonde). Being orthogonal to (causal) foundation models, our method builds a bridge from data characteristics to causal estimation strategy rather than proposing another CFM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoE-Learner，利用数据嵌入的几何特征（变差函数/variogram）作为无反事实路由信号，在多种假设视角下自适应选择因果估计专家。
AI.motivation: 因果推断中反事实不可观测，导致训练目标（outcome、propensity）与推断目标（CATE、ATE）之间存在根本缺口。传统方法依赖先验假设选择识别策略与估计器；因果基础模型（CFMs/PFNs）虽通过大规模合成先验数据预训练简化流程，但其摊销特性降低了透明性，难以判断模型隐式依赖哪些假设。真实世界 DGP 与 SCM 高度多样，难以先验判断哪种因果推断策略与给定数据集兼容。
AI.method: 聚焦观测数据与方法特定假设之间的兼容性，发现嵌入数据的几何特征——特别是变差函数（variogram）——可作为判断某因果估计策略是否适用的有效信号。据此构建 MoE-Learner：将数据集在多假设视角下嵌入，并以 variogram 作为无需反事实的路由器，评估各因果专家的有效性，形成混合专家框架。
AI.result: 在 IHDP、ACIC、Lalonde 等基准数据集上取得最佳平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 并非消除因果假设，而是将其验证从固定的先验选择转变为可直接从数据几何检验的准则。该方法与（因果）基础模型正交，建立了从数据特征到因果估计策略的桥梁，而非再提出一个 CFM。

title: ConvLUT: Rethinking Convolutional Architectures for Ultra-Low-Latency LUT-Based Inference
summary: Lookup-table (LUT)-based neural networks (NNs) offer a compelling path to ultra-low-latency inference on FPGAs. However, existing LUT-based neural networks have largely been restricted to MLP-style topologies, leaving structured vision and audio tasks underexplored. We present ConvLUT, a family of fully unrolled LUT-mappable convolutional architectures targeting the MLPerf Tiny benchmarks. It is comprised of a standard convolutional model built around a hierarchical tree of LUTs and a depthwise separable model following the MobileNet design philosophy. These architectures are enabled by four key contributions: a unified LUT-based convolutional framework supporting standard, depthwise, and pointwise convolutions under explicit fan-in constraints; a LUT-tree that addresses the $k^2c$ receptive field dimensionality bottleneck; a channel-partitioned LUT pooling layer that replaces conventional spatial pooling; and a hardware-aware iterative pruning strategy for stable convergence at scale. Evaluated on CIFAR-10, Visual Wake Words, and Keyword Spotting, ConvLUT achieves competitive accuracy with fully unrolled inference latencies below $\sim 50$ ns. On CIFAR-10 it reaches at least a $8844\times$ latency reduction over non-logic-based prior implementations, and outperforms existing MLP-style LUT-based models on the same task by at least $20$ pp in test accuracy.

AI.tldr: ConvLUT 提出一族可完全展开并映射为查找表（LUT）的卷积架构，面向 MLPerf Tiny 基准，在 CIFAR-10、VWW、KWS 上以 <~50 ns 的全展开推理延迟取得有竞争力的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LUT 的神经网络多局限于 MLP 类拓扑，结构化视觉与音频任务探索不足；同时卷积的感受野维度 k²c 带来固有瓶颈，阻碍 LUT 方法向卷积网络扩展。
AI.method: 包含两种模型：以分层 LUT 树构建的标准卷积模型，以及遵循 MobileNet 思想的深度可分离模型。四项关键贡献：(1) 统一 LUT 卷积框架，在显式扇入约束下支持标准、深度可分离与逐点卷积；(2) 缓解 k²c 感受野维度瓶颈的 LUT 树；(3) 以通道分区的 LUT 池化层替代传统空间池化；(4) 面向硬件的迭代剪枝策略，保证大规模下稳定收敛。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 上相较非逻辑型已有实现实现至少 8844× 的延迟降低；在同任务上比现有 MLP 式 LUT 模型精度高出至少 20 个百分点；全展开推理延迟低于约 50 ns。
AI.conclusion: LUT 映射的卷积架构可在极低延迟下保持竞争性精度，将 LUT-NN 从 MLP 拓展到结构化视觉与音频任务，为 FPGA 上的超低延迟推理提供可行路径。

title: Detecting Common Golfing Faults Using AI and Video-Derived Biomechanical Features
summary: Understanding how an athlete moves can improve both technique and safety, yet outside the laboratory technique is still assessed by eye. We present a pipeline that detects named golf swing faults from ordinary video, without markers or calibration. Instead of learning end to end, it tracks body pose and the clubhead in a body-centered frame, and classifies the biomechanical quantities a coach would measure, such as the height of the clubhead above the swing plane, with shallow boosted trees. We demonstrate the approach on two common faults, coming over-the-top (OTT) and early-extension (EE). On 160 swings and 143 swings from public sources it detects OTT and EE with a cross-validated ROC-AUC of 0.975 and 0.911 respectively. Because every feature is a biomechanical quantity a coach already uses, measured at a known phase of the downswing, each decision can be traced to the signals and the moments of the swing that drove it. The signals the model relies on most are the same ones a coach checks when diagnosing these faults. The pipeline processes phone video on a consumer laptop in seconds, so it could feasibly be developed into an app for golfers of all abilities and extended to other sports in which technique is judged against a biomechanical reference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从普通手机视频中检测命名高尔夫挥杆动作缺陷的流水线，无需标记、标定或端到端学习：在人体中心坐标系下跟踪人体姿态与杆头，用浅层提升树对教练会测量的生物力学量进行分类，实现可解释的挥杆诊断。
AI.motivation: 目前运动员动作技术在实验室之外仍主要靠肉眼评估，缺乏客观、可及的分析手段。端到端深度学习方法虽可行，但缺乏可解释性，难以让教练信任并追溯到具体动作时刻。
AI.method: 构建分阶段流水线：1）从普通视频中跟踪人体姿态与杆头，建立人体中心坐标系（无需标记与相机标定）；2）在下挥杆已知阶段提取教练惯用的生物力学特征（如杆头相对挥杆平面的高度）；3）用浅层提升树（boosted trees）进行分类，而非端到端训练。
AI.result: 在公开来源的160个挥杆样本上检测"下杆过顶（OTT）"，143个样本上检测"提前伸展（EE）"，交叉验证ROC-AUC分别达0.975与0.911。模型最依赖的信号与教练诊断这些缺陷时检查的信号一致。消费级笔记本上数秒内即可处理手机视频。
AI.conclusion: 该方法兼顾可解释性与实用性：每个决策均可追溯到具体信号及下挥杆时刻，具备开发成面向各水平球手应用软件的可行性，并可推广到其他以生物力学为参考标准评判技术的运动项目。

title: Hydra: Towards Transferable Multi-Task Learning on Temporal Graphs
summary: Real-world evolving networks are naturally modeled as temporal graphs (TGs), where capturing temporal dynamics is essential for predicting future graph properties that support downstream decision-making. Existing temporal graph methods have been developed primarily for single-task prediction, and little is known about their generalization across tasks or transfer to unseen networks. This leaves the challenge of multi-task graph property prediction in TGs largely open. We address this challenge by introducing Hydra, a novel architecture that integrates local connectivity features from temporal GNNs with a spectral learning module that captures global connectivity patterns. This design enables joint learning of local and global information under a multi-task objective. In multi-task classification, Hydra achieves an 8.9% relative gain in AUC over the strongest competitor. In multi-task regression, Hydra achieves competitive results in all three tasks, while obtaining the best results in two tasks with a 8.2% relative gain in MAE compared to the strongest baseline. Moreover, Hydra delivers these gains with a 22% reduction in training time compared to temporal transfer models. These results provide the first systematic evidence that multi-task transferable learning on temporal graphs is effective. By delivering consistent top-ranked performance, Hydra highlights multi-task training on temporal graphs as a promising direction toward adaptable foundation models for temporal graphs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Hydra架构，将时序GNN的局部连接特征与谱学习模块的全局连接模式相结合，实现时序图上的多任务图属性预测，并在分类与回归任务上取得最优性能且训练更快。
AI.motivation: 现实演化网络天然可建模为时序图（TG），预测其未来属性对下游决策至关重要。但现有时序图方法主要面向单任务预测，跨任务泛化能力与向未见网络的迁移能力尚不清楚，时序图上的多任务图属性预测仍是开放难题。
AI.method: 提出Hydra架构：集成时序GNN输出的局部连接特征与一个谱学习模块所捕获的全局连接模式，在多任务目标下联合学习局部与全局信息。
AI.result: 多任务分类中AUC相对提升8.9%；多任务回归中三项任务均具竞争力，其中两项最优，MAE相对提升8.2%；相比时序迁移模型训练时间减少22%。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统性证明时序图上的多任务可迁移学习有效。Hydra在各任务上稳定排名领先，表明时序图多任务训练是通向可适应时序图基础模型的有前景方向。

title: Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations
summary: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"有效边界复杂度"(effective boundary complexity)这一标签预算诊断指标，用于评估冻结表征与线性探针在少标签迁移下还需多少标签才能学出下游决策边界。
AI.motivation: 现有可迁移性与探针质量评分只刻画全局对齐、似然、间隔与校准，无法反映标签最昂贵的"边界附近"歧义区域的规模，因此需要一个针对标签预算的边界诊断量。
AI.method: 度量学得边界周围薄带内的样本质量，并按类别平衡归一化，从而同时计入稠密歧义区与预测类别不平衡；理论证明在光滑表征映射下，密度变化与切向曲面变化在一阶相互抵消，边界法向的拉伸/压缩成为主导因素；据此给出缓存特征估计器：在一份划分上拟合探针，统计独立留出特征中靠近边界的比例。
AI.result: 在74个映射的受控变换中与预测规律吻合，中位相对误差0.38%；真实冻结特征上，法向变化同时改变边界质量与标签需求，而切向对照保持一阶系数；可微代理在匹配top-1效用下将测得复杂度降低16–36%；CIFAR-100与Tiny-ImageNet支持边界质量作为近并列表征的二阶诊断；五分类实验OvR接口主干排序一致性强(Spearman 0.872)，采集实验中初始边界质量与三种采样策略下实际标签预算相关性为0.779–0.830。
AI.conclusion: 边界附近目标质量可作为廉价、可缓存的下游标签预算诊断，在近并列表征间提供区分度，并预测实际标注需求；代码已开源。

title: A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence
summary: AdamW is ubiquitous in deep learning, yet its behavior remains poorly understood. We analyze its dynamics through the lens of dynamical systems and show that AdamW admits an implicit fixed-point objective: its fixed points coincide with the stationary points of a constrained and regularized optimization problem. However, not all of these fixed points are stable under AdamW's dynamics, and stability depends sensitively on curvature, weight decay, and momentum parameters. Even in one-dimensional settings, equilibria may be unstable, and trajectories can exhibit persistent oscillations rather than convergence to them. We further extend the analysis to higher dimensions, deriving sufficient conditions for local stability of the continuous-time dynamics, and propose a convergent modification that preserves AdamW's fixed points. These results clarify what optimization problem AdamW is associated with, when its convergence can be expected, and how its dynamics could inspire more reliable optimizers.

AI.tldr: 从动力系统视角分析AdamW：其不动点等价于某约束+正则优化问题的驻点，但并非都稳定；稳定性敏感依赖曲率、权重衰减与动量，即使一维也可能出现持续振荡；给出高维连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件，并提出保持不动点的收敛性修正。
AI.motivation: AdamW在深度学习中无处不在，但其行为机理理解不足；作者希望明确AdamW究竟对应什么优化问题、何时可期望收敛，以及其动力学如何指导更可靠的优化器设计。
AI.method: 用动力系统理论分析AdamW：识别其隐式不动点目标（不动点集合与带约束和正则项的优化问题驻点一致）；分析不动点在AdamW动力学下的稳定性，考察曲率、权重衰减与动量参数的影响；从一维推广到高维，推导连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件；在此基础上提出一种保留原不动点的收敛性修正算法。
AI.result: AdamW的不动点虽对应某优化问题的驻点，但其中部分在动力学下不稳定，且稳定性对曲率、权重衰减和动量高度敏感；即使在一维情形平衡点也可能不稳定，轨迹出现持续振荡而非收敛；高维情形下给出了连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: AdamW可被解释为求解一个约束且正则化的隐式目标，但其不动点稳定性无保证，收敛并非必然；所提出的保留不动点的修正可提升收敛可靠性，并为设计更稳健的优化器提供理论依据。

title: Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: There is a well-established body of work demonstrating that individual machine learning (ML) algorithms can be manipulated or deceived. However, in many real-world systems, multiple ML algorithms are composed to enable automated decision-making, particularly in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Often such systems use a composition of vision, planning, and other ML models to affect their internal state and ultimate take actions in the physical world. While there is a huge literature on the (in)security of ML algorithms, it is not immediately clear how an attacker might leverage their ability to trick individual learners when attacking the composition as a whole. We develop methods for creating an attack policy (a mapping from state to attack) for a data-manipulating attacker affecting a CPS or other state-machine-based AI compositions. We describe our framework, a basic threat model and corresponding methods for computing an optimal attack policy, as well as planned extensions. The goal of this work-in-progress paper is to stimulate conversation and forge new collaborations regarding the security of compositional learning.

AI.tldr: 针对由多个ML模型组合而成的CPS/状态机式AI系统，提出构造"攻击策略"（状态到攻击的映射）的框架，并给出基本威胁模型及最优攻击策略计算方法。
AI.motivation: 已有大量工作证明单个ML算法可被操纵或欺骗，但真实系统（尤其是CPS）往往由视觉、规划等多个ML模型组合而成，攻击者如何将"欺骗单个学习器"的能力提升为对整个组合系统的攻击尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建面向数据操纵型攻击者的框架：定义基本威胁模型，将攻击形式化为从系统状态到攻击动作的策略映射，并提出相应方法计算最优攻击策略；文中还概述了计划中的扩展方向。
AI.result: 给出了攻击策略框架、威胁模型及最优攻击策略的求解方法（属于work-in-progress阶段性成果，未报告定量实验结果）。
AI.conclusion: 旨在引发关于"组合式学习安全性"的讨论并促成新的合作，为组合ML系统的整体安全分析提供初步形式化基础。

title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
summary: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅沿深度研究transformer表征忽略了模块维度，通过超过144,000次线性探测实验证明层与模块应联合选择，并提出简单固定的探测策略(视觉Act@100、语言LN2@60)，在多数评测中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有工作发现探测最后一层往往次优、中间层特征更好，但仍主要沿深度维度研究，将每个transformer block视为不可分割的原子单元，忽视了block内部各模块（如FFN激活、归一化层）的表征差异，因此有用表征无法仅用深度刻画。
AI.method: 对视觉基础模型(VFMs)与大语言模型(LLMs)进行逐层、逐模块的分析，共执行超过144,000次线性探测评估；联合考察"层-模块"配对，并与固定残差流的逐层探测对比，同时评估简单固定探测策略：视觉用末层前馈激活(Act@100)，语言用60%深度处的第二归一化层(LN2@60)。
AI.result: 最优层-模块配对相对末层残差流的提升远大于固定残差流下最优层的提升；模块性能随层变化显著。固定策略在多数评测中优于探测基线，分别平均恢复视觉42%、语言86%的最优层-模块配对增益；对VFM，该增益随预训练与下游数据的迁移难度增大而提高。
AI.conclusion: 探测表征时应联合考虑层与模块，而非仅按深度；简单的固定探测位置可作为强基线并捕捉大部分可得增益，且对视觉模型的收益在迁移难度高时更明显。

title: UTOPI: Efficient Egocentric Long-Video Understanding in AR via User-Guided Token Pre-Compression
summary: As long-video understanding gains increasing attention, augmented reality (AR) devices are emerging as a compelling deployment platform. However, egocentric videos exhibit significant temporal redundancy, imposing substantial memory and computational burdens on resource-constrained AR hardware. To address this challenge, we introduce UTOPI, a plug-and-play pre-compression module designed specifically for egocentric long videos on AR platforms. First, we leverage user motion signals to estimate inter-frame overlap and propose a viewpoint-shift-invariant pruning algorithm. Second, we exploit eye-tracking sensors to identify user fixations, enabling the separation of attended foreground content from background and its preferential retention via a fine-tuned neural network-based adjustment mechanism. Across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, UTOPI achieves up to 95% compression while preserving performance. Code and project page are available at https://sai-lab-nyu.github.io/utopi/.

AI.tldr: 提出 UTOPI，一种面向 AR 设备自我中心长视频的即插即用预压缩模块，利用运动信号做视角不变剪枝、利用眼动追踪分离注视前景与背景并优先保留，在多个基准与骨干上实现最高 95% 压缩且保持性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解受到关注，AR 设备成为重要部署平台；但自我中心视频存在大量时间冗余，给资源受限的 AR 硬件带来显著内存与计算负担，需要在使用前进行高效压缩。
AI.method: UTOPI 为预压缩模块：(1) 利用用户运动信号估计帧间重叠，提出视角偏移不变的剪枝算法；(2) 利用眼动追踪传感器识别注视点，将受关注的前景与背景分离，并通过微调的神经网络调整机制优先保留前景内容。模块为即插即用设计。
AI.result: 在多个基准和模型骨干上，压缩率最高可达 95%，同时保持下游任务性能；代码与项目主页已公开。
AI.conclusion: 面向 AR 自我中心长视频的预压缩具有可行性：结合运动与眼动等设备侧信号可有效去除时间冗余并保留任务相关信息，为资源受限 AR 平台上的长视频理解提供轻量化前处理方案。

title: Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents can use feedback from repeated attempts to improve their decisions without updating model parameters. However, positive action credits can continue to favor actions that repeatedly achieve the same score, even when higher scores are achievable. Under a fixed interaction budget, trying new actions in the final attempts can also lower performance. We introduce EARN, a method that uses past experience to guide further progress and retain earlier performance through conditional reuse of effective action sequences. EARN reduces action credits for reaching scores repeatedly attained in earlier episodes and assigns larger credits to action segments that reach higher scores. These credits adjust the probabilities of LLM-proposed actions. During the final episodes, EARN directly replays stored actions when the current context matches the recorded context and the actions remain available, bypassing LLM candidate generation. We evaluate performance at the end of the interaction budget using the average score over the final four episodes. Across Jericho, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, EARN achieves the best score on this metric in 31 of 33 task--budget settings among the evaluated methods, including ties. Across the evaluated Jericho budgets, replay bypasses 78.9--86.3\% of candidate-generation calls in the final four episodes, averaged across games.

AI.tldr: EARN：通过条件复用有效动作序列，结合分数加权的动作信用调整与末期直接回放，在固定交互预算下提升 LLM 智能体的最终性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体可借助多次尝试的反馈改进决策而无需更新参数，但存在两个问题：正动作信用会持续偏向"重复获得相同分数"的动作，即使存在更高分可达；在固定交互预算下，末期探索新动作也会拉低性能。因此需要一种既能利用历史经验推动进步、又能保住已有表现的机制。
AI.method: 提出 EARN 方法，包含两部分：（1）信用重标定：降低仅达到历史已多次取得分数的动作信用，对能到达更高分数的动作片段赋予更大信用，并用该信用调整 LLM 候选动作的概率；（2）条件回放：在最后若干回合中，若当前上下文与记录上下文匹配且动作仍可用，则直接回放已存动作序列，跳过 LLM 候选生成。
AI.result: 以交互预算末端最后四个回合的平均分数为评价指标，在 Jericho、ScienceWorld、Crafter 三个环境中，EARN 在 33 个任务—预算设置中的 31 个（含并列）取得最佳成绩；在 Jericho 各预算下，最后四回合平均有 78.9%–86.3% 的候选生成调用被回放机制绕过（跨游戏平均）。
AI.conclusion: EARN 通过区分"重复分数"与"更高分数"的信用分配，并在预算末端可靠复用有效动作序列，兼顾探索收益与性能保持，显著提升固定交互预算下的最终表现，同时大幅降低末期推理开销。

title: Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery
summary: Autonomous microscopy can turn fast acquisition into scientific progress when it decides not only where to measure, but also what information to acquire, at what scan rate, and when to recalibrate the instrument. We develop a budget constrained framework for such multistep structure-property workflows. It combines explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models, transfer of pre experiment knowledge into the online campaign, and evaluation kept independent of the controller. The transferred knowledge includes predictor accuracy and computational cost, empirical learner maturity functions that weight model-derived rewards, and drift characteristics established before controller training. Using a real electron energy-loss spectroscopy dataset, we run two complementary campaigns. In the first, the controller chooses between imaging and spectroscopy, image size, and scan speed. In the second, the instrument drifts and the controller also decides when to recalibrate. The campaigns show that response discovery and structure-property learning favor different surrogate models and acquisition strategies. They also show that simple acquisition rules form strong, practical baselines. Independent error analysis reveals where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal. In the drift campaign, explicit registration greatly improves positional accuracy, and the framework measures what this costs in spectroscopy throughput. Together, these results provide a reproducible way to design, compare, and audit autonomous experiments, and they define what microscopes must provide for deployment: independently executable actions, characterized scan and detector responses, timestamped registration telemetry, and complete action records.

AI.tldr: 提出一个预算受限的多步"结构-性质"自主显微框架，整合显式科学奖励、动作成本、仪器观测模型、实验前知识迁移与独立评估，在真实EELS数据上验证控制器在成像/谱学、图像尺寸、扫描速率和重校准时机上的决策能力。
AI.motivation: 自主显微若仅决定"在哪测量"而不决定"获取何种信息、以何扫描速率、何时重校准"，则难以将快速采集转化为科学进展；同时缺乏可复现、与控制器解耦的评估方式。
AI.method: 构建预算约束的多步结构-性质工作流框架：将显式科学奖励与动作成本、仪器观测模型耦合；迁移实验前知识（预测器精度与计算成本、经验学习者成熟度函数用于加权模型驱动奖励、控制器训练前建立的漂移特性）；评估独立于控制器。基于真实电子能量损失谱（EELS）数据集开展两组互补实验：其一控制器在成像与谱学之间选择并决定图像尺寸与扫描速度；其二引入仪器漂移并让控制器决定重校准时机。
AI.result: 响应发现与结构-性质学习偏好不同的代理模型与采集策略；简单采集规则构成强实用基线；独立误差分析揭示模型不确定性在何处是/不是可靠的学习信号；漂移实验中显式配准显著提升定位精度，并量化其对谱学通量的代价。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一套可复现地设计、比较与审计自主实验的方法；并明确部署所需显微镜能力：可独立执行的动作、经表征的扫描与探测器响应、带时间戳的配准遥测、完整的动作记录。

title: Daily Emergency Call Volume Forecasting using Univariate and Multivariate TimeGPT
comment: Keywords: Emergency calls; Prehospital emergency services; Time-series forecasting; Foundation models; TimeGPT; Univariate forecast; Multivariate forecast
summary: This study investigates the potential of TimeGPT, a pretrained foundation model for timeseries, for forecasting daily emergency call volumes. Real-world emergency call data, comprising 2,101 daily observations, are used to evaluate both univariate and multivariate forecasting settings under one-step-ahead and seven-day multi-step-ahead scenarios. The multivariate forecasting incorporates temporal, meteorological, demographic, and socioeconomic variables. A chronological training, validation, and test split is adopted to prevent information leakage, while hyperparameters are selected using the validation set through grid search and early stopping when applicable. Forecasting performance is evaluated using multiple error metrics. Its forecasting performance is compared with several established forecasting approaches, including Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Poisson regression (PR), Negative Binomial regression (NBR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The results show that SARIMAX achieves the best overall performance in the univariate setting. In the multivariate setting, NBR and PR provide best performance. These findings indicate that the large-scale pretraining of TimeGPT do not necessarily translate into superior forecasting accuracy for emergency call volumes. Frugal methods trained solely on the available data remain better for this application.

AI.tldr: 研究评估预训练时间序列基础模型TimeGPT在每日紧急呼叫量预测中的表现，结果显示其大规模预训练优势并未转化为更优精度：单变量下SARIMAX最佳，多变量下负二项与泊松回归最佳，仅依赖本地数据训练的"经济型"方法仍更适合该应用。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型（如TimeGPT）在其他领域展现潜力，但其在紧急呼叫量这一具有强季节性、计数型、受气象与社会经济因素影响的场景中的有效性尚不明确；同时需要检验大规模预训练是否能超越传统轻量方法。
AI.method: 采用2,101条真实每日紧急呼叫观测数据，构建单变量与多变量（纳入时间、气象、人口与社会经济变量）两种设定，覆盖一步预测与七天多步预测场景；按时间顺序划分训练/验证/测试集以避免信息泄露，通过网格搜索与早停选择超参数；以多指标评估TimeGPT并与SARIMAX、泊松回归、负二项回归、XGBoost、MLP、LSTM对比。
AI.result: 单变量设定下SARIMAX整体表现最佳；多变量设定下负二项回归与泊松回归表现最佳；TimeGPT未能在任一设定中取得最优精度。
AI.conclusion: TimeGPT的大规模预训练并不必然带来紧急呼叫量预测精度的提升；针对该任务，仅用可得数据训练的简约/经济型统计模型仍优于基础模型，提示基础模型的领域适配性与成本效益需谨慎评估。

title: GenISys: Integrated Ship Systems Design Using Subsystem-Conditional Tabular Diffussion
summary: Ship design requires coordinating coupled subsystems to satisfy engineering constraints and balance competing performance and cost objectives. Generative artificial intelligence has supported component design, but integrated ship generation must also account for interactions among hull geometry, structure, propulsion, and operation. This paper presents GenISys, a framework for generating integrated systems, demonstrated through early-stage bulk-carrier design. Its dataset contains 217,999 proposed designs, including 16,247 that satisfy the formulated engineering constraints. The proposed simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) generates subsystems together, allowing each subsystem model to respond to changes elsewhere during generation. Experiments compare this approach with monolithic whole-ship generation and sequential subsystem generation across five independent training runs per architecture. In a study targeting lower cost per tonne of cargo transported, designs were generated for a required voyage range of 5,000 nautical miles. SCDDPM produced designs satisfying the formulated engineering constraints and meeting a common low-cost target in 55.70% of generation requests, compared with 51.10% for the monolithic model and 47.54% for the sequential model. These correspond to 9.0% and 17.2% more qualifying designs, respectively, while maintaining similar estimated transport costs. These results show how generative artificial intelligence can coordinate subsystems to generate feasible, high-performing integrated systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GenISys框架及SCDDPM模型，用于生成耦合子系统构成的集成船舶设计，在散货船早期设计中以更低运输成本目标生成满足工程约束的设计比例达55.70%，优于整体式与顺序式生成方法。
AI.motivation: 船舶设计需协调船体几何、结构、推进与运营等耦合子系统，在满足工程约束的同时平衡性能与成本等多目标。现有生成式AI多用于零部件设计，缺乏对子系统间交互的集成生成能力。
AI.method: 构建GenISys集成系统生成框架；建立含217,999个候选设计（其中16,247个满足约束）的数据集；提出同时条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM），在生成过程中使各子系统模型相互响应；与整体式整船生成、顺序式子系统生成在每种架构5次独立训练下对比，目标为5,000海里航程下更低单位货物运输成本。
AI.result: SCDDPM在55.70%的生成请求中同时满足工程约束与低成本目标，整体式模型为51.10%，顺序式为47.54%，分别提升9.0%与17.2%，且估计运输成本相近。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI可通过同时条件建模协调子系统交互，生成可行且高性能的集成系统，为船舶及其他多子系统耦合工程设计提供新范式。

title: A Trust Region Approach for Learning Schrödinger Bridges
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026; Takeshi Koshizuka and Lorenz Richter contributed equally
summary: We study the numerical approximation of Schrödinger Bridges in the setting where samples from the target distribution are unavailable and only an unnormalized target density is given. In this regime, the widely used iterative proportional fitting (IPF) procedure (and its variants) often exhibits severe numerical instabilities, stemming from ill-conditioned underlying control problems and from the fact that the optimal solution may lie far from the initialization. To address these issues, we propose a trust region variant of IPF that constrains successive updates to remain at a fixed Kullback-Leibler divergence from the current iterate. This restriction significantly improves numerical stability. Moreover, we show that the resulting method admits an interpretation as a mirror descent scheme with an adaptively chosen step size. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on several challenging sampling tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对仅已知未归一化目标密度、无法获取目标样本的设定，本文提出信任域版本的 IPF（约束相邻迭代间的 KL 散度固定），以提高 Schrödinger Bridge 数值近似的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在仅有未归一化目标密度、无目标样本的场景下，常用的迭代比例拟合（IPF）及其变体因底层控制问题病态、且最优解可能远离初始化而出现严重数值不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 IPF 的信任域变体：将每次更新约束在当前迭代点的固定 KL 散度邻域内；并给出其作为自适应步长镜像下降（mirror descent）的等价解释。
AI.result: 该约束显著提升了数值稳定性，并在多个具有挑战性的采样任务上验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 信任域式 KL 约束结合自适应步长的 mirror descent 视角，为无目标样本条件下的 Schrödinger Bridge 计算提供了稳定可行的数值方案。

title: Means vs. Foundation Models for Emergency Call Forecasting
comment: Keywords: Prehospital emergency calls; Foundation models; TimeGPT; Hölder means; Lehmer means
summary: This study investigates whether generalized means can achieve forecasting performance comparable to that of TimeGPT for daily emergency call volume prediction. Specifically, two families of generalized means, the Hölder means (HM) and the Lehmer means (LM), are evaluated against fine-tuned TimeGPT across forecasting horizons ranging from one to seven days. Forecasting performance is assessed on a real-world emergency call dataset using multiple error metrics, and Diebold-Mariano test. Experimental results show that HM and LM achieve nearly identical predictive performance across all forecasting horizons. For short-term forecasting, both generalized means outperform TimeGPT, with reductions of mean absolute error (MAE) approximately 1.24\% and 2.48\% at horizons of one and three days, respectively. Conversely, TimeGPT achieves a lower error at the seven-day horizon, with an descresing of MAE by 1.98\%. However, Diebold-Mariano tests reveal no statistically significant differences between the methods at the evaluated horizons. These findings suggest that generalized means can provide competitive forecasting performance compared with a energyvore foundation model.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较广义均值（Hölder均值HM与Lehmer均值LM）与微调TimeGPT在1–7天急诊呼叫量预测上的表现，发现二者整体竞争力相当，且差异在统计上不显著。
AI.motivation: 检验简单、高效的广义均值方法能否在大模型（TimeGPT）面前达到可比的预测精度，从而为资源受限场景提供轻量替代方案。
AI.method: 在真实急诊呼叫数据集上，对HM、LM两族广义均值与微调TimeGPT进行1–7天多步预测对比，采用多种误差指标评价，并使用Diebold-Mariano检验判断差异显著性。
AI.result: HM与LM表现几乎一致；短期（1天、3天）两者MAE分别较TimeGPT降低约1.24%与2.48%，而7天horizon上TimeGPT的MAE低约1.98%；但DM检验显示各horizon差异均不显著。
AI.conclusion: 广义均值可与能耗型基础模型（TimeGPT）提供相当的预测性能，是低成本、易实现的可行替代，但需注意差异缺乏统计显著性、结论受单一数据集限制。

title: A Theoretical Reduction From Membership Inference to Reconstruction Attacks Against Learners
summary: We study reconstruction attacks, which recover training data from a learned model. In our adversarial model, the adversary designs a hard instance, drawn from a parameterized family of data distributions, and is given the parameter used to generate it. Our main contribution is a general reduction showing that, in this model, membership inference (determining whether a given datapoint was used for training) implies reconstruction: for a training set of size $n$, a membership test with recall at least $q(n)$ and false-positive rate $O(δ^2/n^2)$ yields a reconstruction algorithm that, with probability $1 - O(δ)$, outputs only training points, and recovers $Ω(n \cdot q(n))$ of them in expectation. This reduction applies to any learning algorithm. For stochastic convex optimization (SCO), we make the reduction computationally efficient over exponentially large domains via structured distributions whose support is partitioned into polynomially many categories of exponentially many elements each, so that reconstruction iterates over categories rather than the full support. Combining this with an existing membership inference result for SCO, we prove that any learning algorithm achieving low excess risk over all distributions admits a polynomial-time reconstruction attack recovering $Ω(n)$ training points, even when the underlying distribution has exponentially large support.

AI.tldr: 该论文在参数化硬实例+已知参数的对抗模型下，证明成员推断可归约为重构：高召回、极低假阳性的成员检验可推出一个仅输出训练点并以 1-O(δ) 概率恢复 Ω(n·q(n)) 个训练点的重构算法，且适用于任意学习算法；对 SCO 通过结构化分布实现多项式时间高效重构。
AI.motivation: 重构攻击（从模型中恢复训练数据）虽已在下界和实证中被研究，但其可行性来源不清、且常依赖指数级枚举。作者希望建立成员推断与重构之间的通用联系，并说明在何种计算约束下重构仍可行。
AI.method: 提出通用归约：对抗者设计来自参数族的硬实例并已知生成参数；在训练集规模 n 下，若存在召回率≥q(n)、假阳性率 O(δ²/n²) 的成员检验，则构造重构算法，以概率 1-O(δ) 只输出训练点，期望恢复 Ω(n·q(n)) 个。对 SCO，将归约计算高效化：采用支撑集被划分为多项式多个类别、每类含指数多元素的结构化分布，使重构按类别迭代而非遍历整个支撑集；再结合已有的 SCO 成员推断结果。
AI.result: 归约对任意学习算法成立。对 SCO，结合现有成员推断结果证明：任何在所有分布上达到低超额风险的学习算法，都存在多项式时间重构攻击，能恢复 Ω(n) 个训练点，即使底层分布支撑集指数级大。
AI.conclusion: 成员推断在本文对抗模型下蕴含重构，二者存在定量联系；SCO 中低超额风险并不保证隐私，存在高效重构攻击，说明隐私与效用间需显式权衡。

title: Resolvent Ellipsoid for Minty Set Inclusions
comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
summary: We study Minty set inclusion on a compact convex set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ with a set-valued operator $A : \mathcal{X} \rightrightarrows \mathbb{R}^d$. Under the Minty promise, the goal is to compute $x \in \mathcal{X}$ and $u \in A(x)$ such that $\sup_{y \in \mathcal{X}} \langle u, x - y \rangle \le \varepsilon$. Our approach is geometric and we work in the fixed-scale constrained-resolvent oracle model, where a query at anchor $a$ is assumed to return a resolvent point $x^+$ together with the Yosida vector $g_η(a) = (a - x^+)/η$. We prove that each oracle response yields a sharp dichotomy: either the returned point provides an $\varepsilon$-SVI certificate, or the Yosida vector defines a strict separating normal for the Minty set. Thus, a single black-box resolvent query supplies either a certified candidate solution or a valid geometric cut. Combining this separation principle with the ellipsoid method, we obtain RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID, an algorithm that computes an $\varepsilon$-SVI in $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\operatorname{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box oracle calls to the fixed-scale constrained resolvent. For monotone inclusions, our algorithm gives, to our knowledge, the first $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\mathrm{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box guarantee in the fixed-scale resolvent model.

AI.tldr: 研究紧凸集上集合值算子的 Minty 集包含问题，在固定尺度约束预解（resolvent）预言机模型下，利用几何分离原理结合椭球法，给出首个 poly(d, log(1/ε)) 黑盒复杂度的 ε-SVI 算法。
AI.motivation: Minty 集包含/单调包含问题是变分不等式与算子理论的核心问题，但现有黑盒复杂度结果多依赖较弱的预言机模型或对 ε 的依赖较差；作者希望在固定尺度约束预解预言机这一更贴近实际（每次查询返回预解点与 Yosida 向量）的模型下获得与维数多项式、对精度对数依赖的复杂度保证。
AI.method: 采用几何视角，在锚点 a 处查询固定尺度约束预解，得到预解点 x⁺ 与 Yosida 向量 g_η(a)=(a−x⁺)/η。证明每次预言机响应满足尖锐二分性：要么返回点构成 ε-SVI 证书，要么 Yosida 向量给出 Minty 集的严格分离法向量（有效几何切割）。将该分离原理与椭球法结合，设计 RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID 算法：每次查询要么终止于认证解，要么产生一个切割以收缩椭球。
AI.result: 证明单次黑盒预解查询即可提供认证候选解或合法几何切割，并据此得到 RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID 算法，其在 O(poly(d, log(1/ε))) 次固定尺度约束预解黑盒调用内计算出 ε-SVI。对单调包含问题，这是据作者所知固定尺度预解模型下首个 poly(d, log(1/ε)) 黑盒复杂度保证。
AI.conclusion: 预解响应天然具备"解或切割"的二分行性，可作为椭球法的分离预言机，从而在固定尺度预解模型下实现与维度多项式、对精度对数依赖的黑盒复杂度；该结果将 Minty 集包含的几何结构与经典凸优化算法有效衔接。

title: Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models
summary: Energy claims for efficient neural networks are often inferred from operation counts. We report direct GPU energy measurements on two workloads that batch very differently, recurrent policies in GPU-vectorised multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, and ask one question of both: can the rows of a batch be made to share computation, across the batch and over time, at a measured saving? On recurrent policies the answer so far is no. Shared activity patterns exist but rarely last one step, masking a frozen policy fails, and trained-in masks succeed only because a fixed mask is equivalent to a narrow GRU, at 11x the energy of a small dense policy in our implementation. Test-time steering adds nothing beyond re-picking on either workload. On MoE models the answer is yes, and granularity decides how much: on Qwen3-30B-A3B, batch-aware routing reads 25-31% fewer expert weights within KL 0.05, with benchmark changes within noise at 500 items, and uses 12-18% less energy per token on a fused forward. We also introduce persistence-aware OEA, a one-parameter rule that keeps the batch-aware cut with about 40% fewer new experts per step than native routing at batch 32-64, though its energy has not yet been measured. These are pilot measurements on one GPU type, and we state their limits.

AI.tldr: 论文基于GPU直接能耗测量，检验"批内行能否跨批与跨时间共享计算"这一问题：循环策略（GPU向量化MARL）尚无收益，MoE语言模型则有收益，且收益取决于粒度。
AI.motivation: 高效神经网络常以运算次数（FLOPs）推断能耗，但运算计数未必反映真实能耗；作者希望用直接测量的GPU能耗来检验：批内各行能否通过共享计算获得可测量的节能。
AI.method: 在两类批处理特性差异很大的负载上做直接GPU能耗测量：(1) GPU向量化多智能体强化学习中的循环策略；(2) 混合专家（MoE）语言模型。对两者提出同一问题——批内行能否跨批、跨时间共享计算。手段包括共享活动模式分析、冻结策略掩码、训练得到的掩码、测试时引导（test-time steering），以及batch-aware routing与新增的persistence-aware OEA（一参数规则，保留batch-aware裁剪并减少每步新增专家数）。
AI.result: 循环策略：答案为否。共享激活模式存在但极少持续一步；冻结策略掩码失败；训练得到的掩码之所以有效，仅因固定掩码等价于窄GRU，其实现在小密集策略11倍能耗。测试时引导在两类负载上均无额外收益。MoE：答案为是，粒度决定幅度。Qwen3-30B-A3B上，batch-aware routing在KL 0.05内少读25–31%专家权重，500样本下基准变化在噪声范围内，融合前向中每token能耗降低12–18%。persistence-aware OEA在batch 32–64时比原生路由每步约少40%新专家（能耗尚未测量）。
AI.conclusion: 批内共享计算的节能潜力高度依赖负载与粒度：循环策略不适合此路径，MoE则可行且收益随粒度变化。结果为单一GPU型号上的初步（pilot）测量，作者明确说明了其局限。

title: Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning
summary: Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将时间序列反事实解释建模为单步上下文赌博机策略学习的框架，在预训练自编码器潜空间中训练actor-critic智能体，实现单次前向传播直接生成有效且合理的反事实，避免逐实例迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 时间序列反事实解释受困于复杂时序依赖以及传统实例特定优化（per-instance optimization）的计算低效；现有方法需对每个新输入进行迭代优化，推理成本高、难以扩展。
AI.method: 将反事实生成形式化为one-step contextual-bandit策略学习问题；在预训练自编码器的潜空间中训练actor-critic智能体，学习可迁移的全局策略，捕捉数据的全局结构规律；推理阶段以单次前向传播直接生成反事实，无需逐实例优化。
AI.result: 在13个UCR基准数据集上，该框架在多个异常检测指标下均取得高有效性（validity）与强合理性（plausibility）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将反事实生成与逐实例优化解耦，该方法为时间序列反事实解释提供了一种高效、可扩展的替代方案。

title: Variational Approach to Optimal IPS Estimator for Multi-logger Off-Policy Evaluation
summary: We study off-policy evaluation (OPE) in contextual bandits with data collected from multiple logging policies. Inverse propensity scoring (IPS) is a standard approach to OPE and extends naturally to the multi-logger setting. However, as highlighted by Agarwal et al. [2017], neither balanced nor weighted IPS consistently outperforms the other in this setting. We resolve this dilemma by deriving an optimal IPS estimator with sample-dependent weights that minimize variance subject to unbiasedness. Using a variational calculus approach, we obtain closed-form optimal weights, yielding an estimator that is unbiased and achieves asymptotically optimal variance within a generalized weighted-IPS estimator class. Instead of a reward model, the estimator needs only a $K\times K$ matrix and a $K$-vector of moments, where $K$ is the number of logging policies, and we quantify how much efficiency this costs relative to the semiparametric oracle. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our estimator generally improves on existing multi-logger IPS methods. We also extend our estimator to a doubly robust form by incorporating a conditional reward estimator. We compare the resulting DR extension with the semiparametrically efficient DR estimator of Kallus et al. [2021], both theoretically and empirically. We show that the two estimators achieve the same asymptotic variance when the conditional reward estimator is consistent, while our estimator can retain semiparametric efficiency under certain forms of reward misspecification. Empirically, the proposed DR estimator often achieves lower estimation error than the existing DR baseline.

AI.tldr: 该文在多日志策略的上下文赌博机中进行离策略评估，通过变分法推导出样本相关权重的最优IPS估计量（闭式解），实现无偏且渐近最优方差，并扩展为在特定奖励误设下仍保持半参数有效性的DR估计量。
AI.motivation: 多日志策略下的OPE中，平衡IPS与加权IPS谁更优无定论（Agarwal et al. 2017），需要一种能在无偏约束下最小化方差的最优IPS估计量，以解决该两难问题。
AI.method: 在广义加权IPS类中，以无偏性为约束、方差最小化为目标，用变分法推导样本相关权重的闭式最优解；该估计量仅需 K×K 矩阵与 K 维矩向量（K为日志策略数），无需奖励模型；进一步引入条件奖励估计器构造DR形式。
AI.result: 得到无偏且类内渐近方差最优的IPS估计量，并量化其相对半参数oracle的效率损失；基准数据集实验中总体优于现有多日志IPS方法。DR扩展在条件奖励估计一致时与Kallus et al. [2021]的半参数有效DR估计量具有相同渐近方差，且在特定奖励误设下仍保持半参数有效性，经验上误差常低于现有DR基线。
AI.conclusion: 样本相关最优权重可调和平衡IPS与加权IPS之争，在不建模奖励的前提下达到类内渐近最优，并通过DR扩展在实用性与理论效率间取得良好折中。

title: Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies
summary: Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start loss among matched-architecture comparators. The learned mask-overlap geometry tracks the known concept-sharing structure where available. We show experimentally that under correlated concept shift, support-set mask reconfiguration is necessary even for retention. Under domain shift, the distributed bank with replay is sufficient to handle retention without the configurer. Forward transfer, or head-start, and backward transfer, are also contributed by support-set mask configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出Functional Task Networks（FTN），一种受哺乳动物新皮层特性启发的持续学习与知识迁移方法，将网络建模为分布式随机专家混合体，用稀疏二值路由掩码在推理时按小样本支持集动态配置，从而缓解灾难性遗忘并支持知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 人工神经网络在概念漂移/域漂移下再训练会出现灾难性遗忘，且通常要求每个数据批次大致代表完整分布，代价高且不实用；受大脑新皮层特性启发，寻求可持续学习与知识迁移的机制。
AI.method: FTN：分布式、随机专家混合结构；推理时利用少量输入-输出支持样本计算稀疏二值路由掩码；训练中按批次重配置路由器（configurer），并结合掩码重叠过滤的回放（mask-overlap-filtered replay），形成一组重叠、部分训练的子网络基。无关任务路由到基本独立的子网络，相关任务在共享组件上重叠。
AI.result: 在分块顺序训练的持续学习与知识迁移任务上，FTN的保持性能接近不相交掩码隔离；在匹配架构的比较方法中取得最低的更新前head-start损失（正向迁移最强）；学到的掩码重叠几何在可获取时能反映已知的概念共享结构。实验显示：相关概念漂移下，支持集掩码重配置对保持是必要的；域漂移下，分布式专家库加回放即可实现保持，无需configurer；正向迁移（head-start）与反向迁移均由支持集掩码配置贡献。
AI.conclusion: 支持集掩码重配置与重叠子网络结构分别在不同漂移类型下发挥关键作用，FTN为持续学习中的灾难性遗忘、正向与反向迁移提供了统一的、类脑的解决框架。

title: The Dark Matter of Clinical Data: An Identification Limit on Disentangling Physiology from Care Process in electronic health records
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary Information and code are provided as ancillary files. Interactive companion with narrated explainers: https://criticaldata.github.io/Dark_Matter/
summary: Representations learned from electronic health record (EHR) data encode patient physiology together with the clinical process that decides what is measured, when, and for whom. We formalize the data-generating process with latent physiology, ordering intent, laboratory values that exist only when measured, a learned representation, and clinical environments, and analyze two strategies for undoing this entanglement. First, no division of the information carried by laboratory "value" and "ordering" channels is identified from a single dataset: when ordering depends on the analyte, its distribution among untested patients is not recoverable, and a sentinel code for the undefined recorded value makes it carry all the entropy of the ordering indicator, fixing partial information decomposition (PID) for every redundancy measure satisfying the Williams-Beer axioms and invariant under injective re-encoding. Second, cross-site invariance of representation-conditional outcomes is a falsifiable implication of biological invariance taken jointly with exclusion and representation-sufficiency conditions, but not an identification strategy: we construct observationally equivalent models that disagree about biological invariance, whether the invariance test fails or passes. For binary physiology this happens exactly when case mix differs, the representation is lossy, and physiology affects the outcome. A worked example yields a 9.6-percentage-point cross-site gap under an unchanged biological mechanism. Tests performed for every patient remove the ordering gate, and measured tests can restore identification: biological invariance is identified when a test exactly summarizes outcome-relevant physiology, or, for binary physiology, when two tests with independent errors are available at sites with different case mix. Cross-site analyses should be reported as tests of a stated joint hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化EHR数据的生成过程（潜生理、开单意图、仅被测时存在的检验值、学习到的表示、临床环境），论证两种"解耦"策略均不可行：单一数据集无法辨识"检验值"与"开单"两通道的信息划分；跨站点不变性只是可证伪的推论而非辨识策略。并指出"对所有患者做检测"可移除开单门控，从而在特定条件下恢复生物不变性的辨识。
AI.motivation: EHR表示同时编码患者生理与决定"测谁、何时测、测什么"的临床过程，二者纠缠使得基于表示的模型可能学到的是测量/开单行为而非生物学规律，因此在多站点间泛化或做因果解释时产生偏差。作者希望厘清哪些量在何种条件下可从数据中辨识，避免把不可辨识的量当作可估计对象。
AI.method: 建立含潜生理、开单意图、仅在测量时存在的实验室值、学习表示与临床环境的生成模型；用部分信息分解（PID）与Williams-Beer公理及单射重编码不变性分析"值/开单"通道；用观察等价模型构造论证跨站点不变性检验的不可辨识性（二元生理情形给出失效的精确条件：病例组合不同、表示有损、生理影响结局）；并分析"全患者检测"与"恰好汇总结局相关生理的检验"或"两个独立误差检验"下的可辨识性。
AI.result: 单一数据集下"值"与"开单"的信息划分不可辨识：开单依赖分析物时，未检测者的分布不可恢复，哨兵编码使记录值携带开单指示的全部熵，从而对所有满足公理的冗余度量固定PID。跨站点不变性不构成辨识策略：构造出在不变性检验通过或失败时均对生物不变性持相反意见的观察等价模型；二元生理下，当病例组合不同、表示有损且生理影响结局时恰可发生。示例在生物机制不变情况下得到9.6个百分点的跨站点差距。全患者检测消除开单门控；当检验恰好汇总结局相关生理，或二元生理下在两病例组合不同的站点具备两个独立误差的检验时，生物不变性可辨识。
AI.conclusion: EHR表示中生理与临床过程的纠缠在单一数据集内不可分离，跨站点不变性检验只是对"生物不变性+排除性+表示充分性"联合假设的检验，不能作为辨识策略；跨站点分析应明确报告所检验的联合假设，并通过全患者检测或满足特定误差结构与病例组合条件的多检验设计来恢复辨识。

title: Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). Details: https://openreview.net/forum?id=UGIcayxHMI
summary: Language-model post-training modifies weights through cumulative updates and successive displacements, yet existing studies report seemingly conflicting spectral properties: nearly full-rank updates and low stable-rank changes. We show these observations are compatible and characterize update directions during training. For singular values following $σ_i \propto i^{-α}$ with $0 < α\leq 1/2$, we prove that stable rank becomes negligible relative to fixed-energy rank as dimension increases. Full singular value decompositions of selected OLMo-2-7B updates confirm this separation: three proximal policy optimization (PPO) attention updates have stable ranks of 9.6-18.3 but require 532-1,222 singular components to capture 80% of their energy. We next compute consecutive checkpoint-displacement cosines from full-model inner products. Across nine publicly released reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) stages, all 131 adjacent pairs have negative cosines on their native checkpoint grids, including PPO and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning comparisons across four model families show configuration-dependent alignment, including negative late-training cosines for Mistral and FP32 Llama. Finally, a controlled OLMo-2-1B study with three paired seeds and a 2,048-token response cap compares group-relative advantages against a learned critic with generalized advantage estimation (GAE). At matched 60-rollout windows, late-training mean cosines are +0.259 and +0.012, respectively; the paired critic-minus-group difference is -0.247 (seed-level 95% interval [-0.358, -0.137]). These findings distinguish spectral concentration, energy coverage, and trajectory direction, and demonstrate that the advantage system influences directional alignment under matched training conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文调和了“近满秩更新”与“低稳定秩变化”的表面矛盾：对 σ_i ∝ i^{-α}(0<α≤1/2) 的情形证明随维度增大稳定秩相对固定能量秩可忽略，并用OLMo-2-7B全SVD实证分离稳定秩与能量覆盖率；同时通过全模型内积计算连续检查点位移余弦，发现RLVR各阶段相邻位移几乎全部负相关，并在受控OLMo-2-1B实验中表明优势估计方式（组相对优势 vs. GAE评论家）显著影响方向对齐。
AI.motivation: 语言模型后训练通过累积更新与逐次位移改变权重，但已有研究报告的谱性质看似冲突：更新近似满秩，而稳定秩变化很小。作者希望说明这两种观察可以共存，并进一步刻画训练过程中的更新方向（轨迹方向），区分谱集中度、能量覆盖率与轨迹方向三个概念。
AI.method: 1) 理论：对奇异值满足 σ_i ∝ i^{-α}(0<α≤1/2) 的谱分布，证明维度增大时稳定秩相对固定能量秩趋于可忽略。2) 实证谱分析：对选定的OLMo-2-7B更新做完整SVD，比较稳定秩与捕捉80%能量所需的奇异分量数。3) 对九个公开RLVR阶段的全模型内积计算相邻检查点位移余弦（131对）。4) 四个模型家族的SFT对比。5) 受控OLMo-2-1B实验：三组配对种子、2048 token响应上限，在匹配的60-rollout窗口下比较组相对优势与带GAE的学习评论家。
AI.result: 三个PPO注意力更新的稳定秩为9.6–18.3，却分别需要532–1,222个奇异分量才能覆盖80%能量，验证理论分离。九个RLVR阶段共131个相邻检查点对在其原生网格上余弦均为负，涵盖PPO与GRPO轨迹。四个模型家族的SFT显示配置依赖的对齐，Mistral与FP32 Llama出现后期负余弦。OLMo-2-1B中，匹配60-rollout窗口下后期平均余弦分别为+0.259（组相对优势）与+0.012（GAE评论家），配对差值-0.247，种子级95%区间[-0.358,-0.137]。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果区分了谱集中度、能量覆盖率与轨迹方向三个层面，说明满秩更新与低稳定秩变化并不矛盾；并证明在匹配训练条件下，优势系统会影响更新方向的对齐程度。

title: Payoff-Aware Prediction of Population Game Dynamics
summary: Population game dynamics describe how aggregate behavior evolves in response to payoff signals. In many applications, the payoff function may change, and the goal is to predict the population trajectory induced by a new payoff design before trajectory data under that design are available. We study this problem as $\textbf{payoff-aware prediction of population game dynamics}$. Standard dynamics learning methods fit the motion observed under training payoffs, but do not separate the payoff-dependent incentive from the payoff-independent response structure needed for prediction under new payoffs. Building on the existing framework of Riemannian game dynamics, we propose PA-RmD, a payoff-aware learning method that keeps payoff information explicit and learns the payoff-independent response structure from data. Theoretically, we show that the learned model preserves fixed-payoff Nash equilibria and derive finite-time one-step prediction bounds under shared-response and payoff-coverage conditions. Empirically, we evaluate PA-RmD on synthetic zero-sum and potential games, as well as a YouTube Trending multi-country dataset, showing that our method performs well under changing payoff designs.

AI.tldr: 提出PA-RmD，一种在黎曼博弈动力学框架下显式保留收益（payoff）信息、仅从数据学习与收益无关响应结构的方法，用于在缺乏新收益设计下轨迹数据时预测种群博弈动力学轨迹。
AI.motivation: 种群博弈动力学刻画聚合行为对收益信号的响应，但许多应用中收益函数会改变，目标是在新收益设计下的轨迹数据尚未获得前预测其诱导的种群轨迹。标准动力学学习方法只拟合训练收益下的运动，无法分离收益依赖的激励与收益无关的响应结构，因而难以外推到新收益。
AI.method: 基于Riemannian game dynamics（黎曼博弈动力学）现有框架，提出PA-RmD：将收益信息保持为显式输入，从数据中学习收益无关的响应结构，从而实现收益感知的动力学学习。
AI.result: 理论上证明所学模型保持固定收益下的Nash均衡，并在共享响应与收益覆盖条件下给出有限时间单步预测误差界；实验上在合成的零和博弈与势博弈以及YouTube Trending多国数据集上验证，方法在收益设计变化时表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分离收益依赖激励与收益无关响应结构，PA-RmD实现了对新收益设计下种群博弈动力学的有效预测，并具备均衡保持性与预测误差界的理论保证，在合成与真实数据上均验证了其收益变化下的泛化能力。

title: APO2CS: Advantage-Aware Preference Optimization for Two-Level Constructive Search in Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Preference optimization has emerged as a promising alternative to reward-based training for neural combinatorial optimization. However, existing methods typically rely on binary pairwise labels, which discard the magnitude of solution-quality differences and provide supervision only at the complete-solution level. We propose Advantage-aware Preference Optimization for Two-level Constructive Search (APO2CS), a preference-based training objective for constructive neural solvers that integrates both macro-level and micro-level supervision. At the macro level, APO2CS enriches pairwise preferences with an advantage term derived from objective-value differences. At the micro level, it compares partial trajectories, thereby providing denser supervision throughout the sequential construction process. The resulting objective can be used either to train a policy from scratch or to fine-tune a pretrained one. Experimental results show that APO2CS improves the expressiveness and search capability of preference learning for combinatorial optimization, while demonstrating strong effectiveness and adaptability across multiple combinatorial optimization tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出APO2CS：一种融合宏/微观两级监督的优势感知偏好优化目标，用于构造式神经组合优化求解器，可在多任务上提升表达力与搜索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于偏好的神经组合优化方法仅使用二值成对标签，既丢弃了解质量差异的幅度信息，又只在完整解层面提供监督，监督信号稀疏、表达力受限。
AI.method: 构建两级偏好监督：宏观层面在成对偏好中引入由目标值差导出的优势项，保留质量差异幅度；微观层面比较部分构造轨迹，提供贯穿序列构造过程的更密集监督。该目标既可从头训练策略，也可微调预训练策略。
AI.result: 实验表明APO2CS提升了偏好学习在组合优化中的表达力与搜索能力，并在多个组合优化任务上表现出较强有效性与适应性。
AI.conclusion: 将优势幅度信息与轨迹级细粒度监督引入偏好优化，可有效弥补二值成对标签的不足，是构造式神经组合优化中通用且可适配的训练目标。

title: Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback
summary: We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\!\left(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)}\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基数约束下带bandit反馈的在线单调子模最大化问题，提出首个对任意单调子模函数具有$\sqrt{T}$依赖的多项式时间算法，期望$(1-1/e)$-regret为$O(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)})$。
AI.motivation: 已有在线子模最大化工作或依赖全信息反馈，或对时间horizon $T$的依赖优于$\sqrt{T}$的多项式时间算法缺失；bandit反馈下仅观测所选集合的效用值，信息极度受限，需设计兼顾效率与理论保证的方法。
AI.method: 采用随机化采样与精心构造的势函数（potential），将在线子模最大化归约为概率单纯形上的在线线性优化问题，从而在bandit反馈下复用在线线性优化工具获得regret界。
AI.result: 算法为多项式时间，期望$(1-1/e)$-regret为$O(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)})$，是首个在bandit设定下对任意单调子模函数达到$\sqrt{T}$依赖的多项式时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过归约到单纯形上的在线线性优化，可在bandit反馈下高效求解基数约束在线单调子模最大化，且具有最优量级的时间依赖性；后续可关注更一般约束与更紧的regret界。

title: KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling
summary: Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. We therefore propose a randomized KKT-perturbation-aware communication mechanism, where the triggering of each agent's primal and dual communication channels depends on their impact on the KKT operator. The proposed mechanism transfers the adaptive-sampling principle of coordinate descent from allocating computation across decision blocks to allocating communication across information channels: channels with larger estimated perturbations receive greater priority for refresh. Under standard regularity assumptions, the resulting algorithm achieves $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected static regret and $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected cumulative constraint violation. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved learning and constraint-enforcement performance per transmitted bit over belief consensus baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对不可分耦合约束下的分布式在线凸优化，提出随机KKT扰动感知通信机制，将坐标下降的自适应采样思想用于通信资源分配，实现O(T^{2/3})期望静态遗憾与O(T^{2/3})累计违约。
AI.motivation: 系统中性能与约束依赖全体智能体联合构型、无法分解为个体贡献，导致每个智能体只能基于对联合动作与共享拉格朗日乘子的局部信念估计全局信息；既有信念共识方法每轮交换全维原始-对偶状态，通信开销随联合决策维数与网络规模双重增长。且事件触发方案多依赖状态变化量或一致性误差，而在不可分耦合下，同等幅度误差经KKT算子作用后产生的扰动差异显著，故按误差大小触发并不合理。
AI.method: 提出随机KKT扰动感知的通信机制：每个智能体的原始通道与对偶通道是否触发通信，取决于该信息对KKT算子的影响程度；将坐标下降的自适应采样原理从"在决策块间分配计算"迁移为"在信息通道间分配通信"，对估计扰动量更大的通道赋予更高刷新优先级，并以随机化触发保证无偏性与收敛性分析可行。
AI.result: 在标准正则性假设下，算法达到O(T^{2/3})的期望静态遗憾和O(T^{2/3})的期望累计约束违反；数值实验表明，相对于信念共识基线，单位传输比特所换取的学习性能与约束满足性能均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 在不可分成本与耦合约束的分布式在线凸优化中，按KKT算子扰动而非状态变化量来调度通信，能更有效地节约通信开销并保持理论保证，为通信受限下的分布式在线学习提供了通道级自适应触发范式。

title: MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in high stakes scientific applications, yet methods that flag OOD inputs without retraining the model have been validated almost exclusively on image classification. We introduce MOOD (Materials Out-of-Distribution Detection), a benchmark for evaluating whether these post-hoc OOD detectors transfer to graph neural networks (GNNs) on materials property prediction. MOOD evaluates 15 post-hoc detectors and 2 supervised diagnostic probes across 4 GNN architectures, 5 MatBench tasks, and 15 physically motivated compositional and structural shifts, yielding 264 evaluation settings and over 13,000 AUROC measurements across three encoder training seeds. Our evaluation reveals three key findings. First, current post-hoc detectors perform near chance; all 15 detectors achieve an AUROC around 0.5. Second, detector failures decompose into two regimes: method bottlenecks and encoder bottlenecks. Method bottlenecks arise when supervised probes can separate in-distribution (ID) from OOD samples but unsupervised detectors fail, meaning that the embeddings contain OOD signal that current detectors do not extract. Encoder bottlenecks arise when even supervised probes fail to separate ID from OOD samples, indicating that the relevant shift is not accessible in the frozen GNN representation. Third, when OOD prediction error exceeds ID error, the AUROC of distance-based and density-based detectors correlates with the size of that gap. Collectively, these findings indicate that reliable OOD detection in scientific domains requires representation learning strategies that explicitly preserve OOD relevant signal, particularly for tasks where current GNN architectures encode no extractable signal at all.

AI.tldr: MOOD基准测试表明，现有15种事后OOD检测器在材料属性预测的GNN上几乎全部退化至随机水平（AUROC≈0.5）。
AI.motivation: 事后（post-hoc）OOD检测方法几乎只在图像分类任务上被验证，尚不清楚其能否迁移到科学领域中的图神经网络（GNN）材料属性预测场景。
AI.method: 提出MOOD基准：在4种GNN架构、5个MatBench任务、15种具有物理意义的成分/结构分布偏移上，评估15种事后检测器与2种监督式诊断探针，覆盖264种评估设置、3个编码器训练种子，累计超过13,000次AUROC测量。
AI.result: (1) 所有15种事后检测器AUROC约为0.5，接近随机；(2) 检测失败可分解为“方法瓶颈”（监督探针可区分ID/OOD但无监督检测器失效，说明嵌入中含未被提取的OOD信号）与“编码器瓶颈”（连监督探针也无法区分，说明冻结的GNN表示中不存在相关信号）；(3) 当OOD预测误差高于ID误差时，距离型与密度型检测器的AUROC与该误差差值的幅度相关。
AI.conclusion: 科学领域的可靠OOD检测需要能够显式保留OOD相关信号的表示学习策略，尤其对于当前GNN架构根本无法编码可提取信号的任务。

title: Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Camera-ready version. Code: https://github.com/ggggggyyyyyy/conformal-severity-control
summary: Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.

AI.tldr: 提出Conformal Severity Control（CSC），一种事后校准框架，利用ATC药物层级量化错配严重度，在无需重训练预测器的前提下对药物推荐集合进行患者级严重度控制。
AI.motivation: 药物推荐是多标签预测任务，但现有预测集评估与校准方法主要依赖精确重叠指标，将所有漏预测药物视为同等严重，忽略了预测集与漏预测药物在药物层级上的相近程度。
AI.method: CSC以解剖治疗化学（ATC）层级量化错配严重度，构建事后校准框架，在不重训练预测器的条件下控制患者级严重度，并同时支持平均严重度与针对最高严重度错配的上分位数严重度两种控制目标。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上的实验表明，CSC能够跟随用户指定的严重度容忍度，并使预测集从远距离错配转向精确匹配或近邻匹配。
AI.conclusion: CSC将层级感知的错配严重度引入一致性校准，为药物推荐预测集提供细粒度、可控且无需重训练的质量保障机制。

title: Identifiable but Hard to Estimate: Rotation in Equally Spaced Overcomplete ICA
summary: How many observations are needed to estimate a common rotation in two-dimensional overcomplete independent component analysis? We study equally spaced mixing columns with known source count, common source law, and column norm. For a fixed non-Gaussian fourth-order Gram-Charlier source law, the rotation is identifiable modulo the column spacing. Yet the sample size for fixed relative angular accuracy grows exponentially with the source count. We characterize this sample size, up to absolute constants, by the reciprocal of the squared Hellinger distance between two rotations separated by half the column spacing. An explicit radially weighted phase estimator attains this scale uniformly over the rotation family, using the observation radius to prevent cancellation in the mean of an angular harmonic. We also determine the exact exponential decay rate of single-observation total variation for the same pair. This gives bounds on the sample size exponent; its exact value remains open. Finally, a noisy binary-source example shows how an exact zero line of the observed characteristic function can have an exponentially small normal derivative.

AI.tldr: 研究二维过完备ICA中估计公共旋转所需样本量：固定非高斯四阶Gram-Charlier源律下，旋转可识别（模列间距），但达到固定相对角度精度所需样本量随源数指数增长；该样本量被刻画为相隔半个列间距的两个旋转之间Hellinger距离平方的倒数（至绝对常数），并有径向加权相位估计量一致达到该尺度。
AI.motivation: 过完备ICA中旋转参数的可识别性与样本复杂度缺乏定量刻画：已知可识别并不等于可有效估计，需要明确样本量如何随源数增长，以及信息论意义上的最优尺度是什么。
AI.method: 设定等间距混合列、已知源数、公共源律与列范数；对固定非高斯四阶Gram-Charlier源律，以相隔半个列间距的两个旋转之间的Hellinger距离平方的倒数来刻画样本量（上下至绝对常数）；构造径向加权相位估计量，利用观测半径避免角谐波均值中的相消，使其在整个旋转族上一致达到该尺度；并推导同一对旋转下单次观测总变差的精确指数衰减率。
AI.result: 得到固定相对角度精度所需样本量随源数指数增长，并给出其（至绝对常数）的双侧刻画；给出了达到该尺度的显式估计量；确定了单次观测总变差的精确指数衰减率，由此给出样本量指数（指数）的界；同时给出一个含噪二元源例子，说明观测特征函数的精确零线可有指数小的法向导数。
